# ShellX V2-2b — Phone AI sessions, part two — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Away from the desk, a paired phone completes a whole AI session: it answers a permission from the notification itself (after unlocking the app), changes mode and model, sends photos, `@` files and dictated text, views a turn's changes and diffs and reverts a turn, reads a big card in full, reopens an earlier session or gives a folder to a tab without one, sees AI sessions on the machine list, and re-attaches by itself after ShellX restarts on the computer — while the computer shows which messages came from the phone. Two V2-2a defects are fixed on the way (request ids reused across runtimes, the iOS notification delegate set too late). Old phones, old desktops and an old background service keep working exactly as today.

**Architecture:**
- **Protocol foundation (`shellx_core`, `shellx_agent`).** Ten new phone → desktop `ai.*` kinds, a `body` on `ai.result`, and three optional fields on known kinds. Every `ai.*` message read from the wire keeps the map it came as (`AiMessage.wire`, an `Expando`), and an unknown `ai.*` kind is read as `AiRaw`, so the background service forwards `ai.*` verbatim (B2) and a later addition needs only the window. `kAiProtocol` becomes 2 in the process that holds the relay; the window's listing names what its hub does (`f`). The phone uses a V2-2b feature only when both say so (B1).
- **Hub (`shellx_agent`, window side).** A part file `ai_phone_hub_requests.dart` holds the V2-2b requests, all through one helper (`_ask`): checked against the session as it is now, one `ai.result` per request (with a body when it carries data), no body over one message. New window seams on `AiControl` / `AiSessionSource` (config, history, folder, files, changes/diff/revert, images); per-phone image blobs (`AiBlobStore`) and full-item caches.
- **Bodies (`package:shellx_ai/remote.dart`).** Config view (with the no-approval filter, moved here from the desktop), full item + slicer, history page, changes view + diff regions, image checks (moved here from the desktop), header keys `acp`/`model`/`hist`/`undo`, the source of a prompt (`src`) and its image count (`img`).
- **Model (V2-2b may touch it in two places only).** One request-id counter for the whole window run (B3); `PromptSource` on `UserItem` and `QueuedPrompt` (B24).
- **Desktop (`apps/desktop`).** `DesktopAiSource` / `_RuntimeControl` implement the new seams; `AiUndo` is extracted from the Changes panel and shared by the panel and the phone (B19); "Bạn · từ điện thoại" on messages and queued rows; a phone's revert noted in the pane.
- **Phone client (`shellx_client`).** `MachineAi.can(feature)`, one method per request kind, image upload in parts (≤ 4 in flight), the result body on `AiRequestException`.
- **Phone app (`apps/mobile`).** Push buttons (iOS category registered natively; Android `flutter_local_notifications` re-shows the push with buttons from a background handler) and an answer service that sends only after the app's lock; mode/model sheet; photos, `@`, voice in the composer; "Xem đủ" viewer; history; folder picker; Changes sheet, diff page, revert; re-attach after a desktop restart; AI line on the machine list.
- **Relay (`relay/**`, separate branch `v2-2b-relay`).** Optional `category` and `tag` on `POST /v1/notifications` → `apns.payload.aps.category`, `android.notification.tag`. Merged only when the user approves a production deploy.

**Tech Stack:** Dart ^3.11.1 / Flutter 3.41.4 (`~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin`, not on PATH); `package:test`, `fake_async`, `flutter_test`; mobile: signals + get_it + injectable + auto_route + intl_utils (generated code committed), `firebase_messaging` 16.7.0, new `image_picker` 1.2.4 and `flutter_local_notifications` 22.3.2 (Android only at run time); desktop: Riverpod 3; relay: TypeScript, Node ≥ 22, Hono, vitest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-v2-2b-phone-ai-more-design.md` (binding, Vietnamese: B1–B26, §4 protocol, §5 strings, §8 tests, §9 Review Focus), extending `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-v2-2-phone-ai-design.md` (§3, §4, §13). Research notes with file:line pointers: `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-15-v2-2b-phone-ai-more/v2-2b.md` and `v2-2b-web.md`.

## Rulings (each with "cost if wrong")

Task 1 appends these (R1–R23) to `docs/superpowers/ledgers/v2-ai.md` under `## V2-2b (phone, part two) — planning rulings`.

- **R1 — one request-id counter for the window run** (B3): a library-level `_nextRequestId` in `session_state.dart`, shared by every `AiSessionState` of the isolate; permission, question and queue ids never repeat within a run. *Cost if wrong:* ids grow without wrapping (64-bit; harmless).
- **R2 — verbatim forwarding by wire maps** (B2): each `ai.*` message read from the wire keeps its map in an `Expando` (`AiMessage.wire`); `encodeBatch` and the mux write `wire`; an unknown `ai.*` kind is read as `AiRaw` (forwarded the way it came); a malformed known kind is still skipped. Non-string keys are dropped. *Cost if wrong:* one map kept per decoded message while it lives.
- **R3 — capability = router `ai ≥ 2` AND listing `f`** (B1): learned from `session.list.result` and the window's listing; the AI session page asks `session.list` once when the protocol is unknown (opened from a push) and holds the listing while open. *Cost if wrong:* one extra round trip when a page opens cold.
- **R4 — one answer for everything:** a V2-2b request the hub does not take (yet), or an `AiRaw` with an integer `rid`, gets `refused` from a window and `unavailable` where no window serves AI. *Cost if wrong:* none (a phone never sends what `f` does not name).
- **R5 — "Deny" is not marked destructive** (B8): Apple Watch's double tap runs the first non-destructive action; with "Từ chối" `[.foreground]` first and "Cho phép" `[.foreground, .authenticationRequired]` second, that is "Từ chối". B8 lists `.destructive` for "Từ chối"; its stated goal ("a Watch double tap never allows") wins. *Cost if wrong:* "Từ chối" is not drawn red.
- **R6 — the push answer's task title comes from the push body** (B10): "Đã cho phép: <việc>" cuts the head "Cần bạn trả lời: " / "Needs your answer: " from the body; no new data key (B25). *Cost if wrong:* a body in another wording shows whole.
- **R7 — a push answer waits for the app lock, and only so long** (B10, §7): sent after the lock is passed; dropped (nothing sent) when an unlock attempt ends still locked, when the app leaves the foreground first, or after 2 minutes. *Cost if wrong:* the user taps again in the session.
- **R8 — `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` added** (B12, B15): App Store policy per the image_picker README, though never prompted (`requestFullMetadata: false`). *Cost if wrong:* one unused permission text.
- **R9 — "huỷ"/"cancel" drops that utterance only** (B14): it never clears what was typed in the AI field. *Cost if wrong:* the user clears the field by hand.
- **R10 — the machine's AI line opens the session or a chooser** (B21): exactly one session waiting → that session; otherwise the session picker's AI group in a sheet over the machine list. *Cost if wrong:* one more tap.
- **R11 — a second line string** (B21): `machineAiSessions` "✦ 2 phiên AI" when nobody waits, since "· 0 cần bạn" reads wrong. *Cost if wrong:* one more string.
- **R12 — a phone's revert opens the desktop pane's Changes panel** (B19) and writes "Đã hoàn tác N tệp (từ điện thoại)." at its foot, like the desktop's own revert. *Cost if wrong:* the panel opens without the user asking.
- **R13 — the privacy pages ship with the relay** (B25): `web/**` on `main` deploys to production like `relay/**` (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`), so the privacy text is committed on `v2-2b-relay`. *Cost if wrong:* the privacy text lags the desktop release until the user approves the deploy.
- **R14 — full items are sliced by escaped size** (B16): the full view is JSON text cut into slices whose JSON-escaped size is ≤ 36 KiB (never splitting a surrogate pair), so a body stays ≤ 48 KiB whatever the text. *Cost if wrong:* more parts for text full of quotes.
- **R15 — a V2-2b request the computer cannot take fails at once on the phone** (`AiRequestException('unsupported')`, nothing sent). *Cost if wrong:* none.
- **R16 — what mode/model choices a phone sees** (B11): every choice the no-approval predicate does not flag (Claude's `default`, `plan`, `acceptEdits`, `auto`, and other agents' unflagged ones); a boolean option named like a no-approval mode is not offered; the window checks again when setting (`on_computer`). *Cost if wrong:* "Bypass permissions" stays a computer-only choice.
- **R17 — blob numbers are the phone's own** (B12): unique per `MachineAi`, kept per phone on the desktop, taken by the prompt that uses them. *Cost if wrong:* none.
- **R18 — a path from a phone must be one the window offered** (B13, B19): relative, no `..`, ≤ 1 KiB, and checked again by the window (inside the session folder, there). *Cost if wrong:* a file the phone typed by hand is refused.
- **R19 — the image caps evict, they do not refuse** (B12): past 5 images or 20 MiB per phone, the phone's least recently used images are dropped (an upload retried under new numbers is never blocked for 2 minutes); an image over 10 MiB, or alone over the phone's 20 MiB, is `too_large`. *Cost if wrong:* an image uploaded long before its prompt is uploaded again.
- **R20 — B23 remaps only sids this app run has seen** (B23): a push sid that a listing of this run named, and that the current listing no longer names, opens the one session with the same `acp`, agent and folder, else the machine page; a sid never seen opens its page as in V2-2a (the push carries no `acp`, so the phone cannot tell a sid of the previous run from a tab opened while it slept). *Cost if wrong:* such a page shows "closed" with B22's "Mở danh sách phiên".
- **R21 — Android re-draws only a push with an `ai-` tag** (B9): only the relay of Task 7 sets `android.notification.tag`; a push through an older relay stays as FCM drew it — no buttons, and never two notifications for one request. *Cost if wrong:* Android buttons wait for the relay deploy, like iOS's.
- **R22 — "Xem đủ" on every open tool card with a body** (B16): the mirror cuts a call's input without saying so, so the phone cannot tell every cut card. *Cost if wrong:* a button that sometimes loads what is already shown.
- **R23 — images lost with the channel go again with the next Send** (B12, §7): the text and the images stay in the composer ("Ảnh chưa gửi được. Thử lại"), and one tap on Send uploads them again (new numbers) and then sends the prompt; nothing is uploaded or sent by itself. *Cost if wrong:* the upload starts at the tap instead of when the channel returns.

## Global Constraints

- **Toolchain:** Flutter only via `PATH=~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin:$PATH flutter …`; Dart via `~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin/dart`. Flutter 3.41.4 / Dart 3.11.1. New packages pinned exactly: `image_picker: 1.2.4`, `flutter_local_notifications: 22.3.2` (Android core-library desugaring `com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.4`). `firebase_messaging` stays `^16.7.0`.
- **Lock files:** `pubspec.lock` files are git-ignored: never `git add` them. After a macOS desktop build, revert the `COCOAPODS:` line change in `apps/desktop/macos/Podfile.lock`. After an iOS mobile build that adds pods, commit the new pod lines in `apps/mobile/ios/Podfile.lock` with `COCOAPODS: 1.16.2` kept.
- **Naming:** "Claude" or "Claude Agent", never "Claude Code", in feature names and UI strings.
- **Credentials:** ShellX never reads, stores or relays credentials; never passes `--hide-claude-auth`; never puts `SHELLX_*` variables (e.g. `SHELLX_CLI_TOKEN`) in an agent's environment.
- **Never auto-allow (D13, spec §6):** no path in which a phone answers without a user tap; a notification button is that tap, and its answer goes only after the app's own lock (R7); push buttons offer only the first `allow_once` that turns on no no-approval mode and the first `reject_once` — never `allow_always`/`reject_always`; no answer is ever resent after a lost channel; a no-approval mode is never listed for, nor set from, a phone (R16); a remembered no-approval mode is never re-applied.
- **No content in logs (D12, B25):** no prompt, agent text, path, file name, diff, image, URL, header or body in any log; new log lines print only `error.runtimeType`. `toString()` of every new `ai.*` message is `'<Type>(…)'`; of every new body/view/record `'…'` (`with Redacted`) or `'<Name>(…)'`; each pinned by a test. Push data carries only an integer id, two option ids and a tag beyond V2-2a's (B25).
- **Protocol (exact values):** `kAiProtocol = 2`; `kAiMaxBodyBytes = 48 * 1024` (unchanged); `kAiMaxBlobPartBytes = kAiMaxBodyBytes`; `kAiMaxPromptBytes = 32 * 1024`; `kAiMaxPromptFiles = 20`; `kAiMaxPathBytes = 1024`; slices ≤ 36 KiB escaped (`kAiSliceBytes`), full item ≤ 2 MiB (`kAiFullItemBytes`), cached 60 s, ≤ 4 per phone; history ≤ 50 sessions per page, titles ≤ 120 bytes; config ≤ 40 choices per option, names ≤ 60 characters; changes ≤ 200 files; `ai.files` ≤ 8 suggestions; images ≤ 5 × 10 MiB, ≤ 20 MiB per phone, kept ≤ 2 minutes unused, ≤ 4 parts in flight; new result codes `no_images`, `confirm`, `busy_turn`, `not_ready`, `undo_off`, `too_big` (+ `unsupported` made by the phone itself). Every new message fits one sealed batch with its envelope (pinned per kind).
- **Old peers:** a malformed `ai.*` message is skipped and an unknown kind ignored, never dropping the channel; every V2-2b feature is gated by router `ai ≥ 2` AND listing `f` (R3); an older desktop or service never receives a V2-2b request; an older phone ignores `body`, `f`, `src`, `img` and the new header keys.
- **Request budget** unchanged (60 at once, then 30/s per phone; acks and detaches free); every new request kind, each `ai.blob` part included, costs one token and gets exactly one `ai.result`.
- **Relay:** only Task 7 touches `relay/**`, on branch `v2-2b-relay`; the privacy pages (`web/**`) go on that branch too (R13). Merging either to `main` is a production deploy — never done by an implementer.
- **Mobile:** strings in `apps/mobile/lib/l10n/intl_en.arb` and `intl_vi.arb` (same keys; `test/l10n_test.dart` checks), generated with `cd apps/mobile && PATH=~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin:$PATH dart run intl_utils:generate`; routes and DI with `cd apps/mobile && PATH=~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin:$PATH dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`; generated files committed. Colours and type from `context.colors` / `context.typo` only; no looping animation except a spinner while loading and the existing mic pulse. Page width 120 (`apps/mobile/analysis_options.yaml`).
- **Desktop:** strings in `apps/desktop/lib/l10n/app_en.arb` + `app_vi.arb`, generated with `cd apps/desktop && PATH=~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin:$PATH flutter gen-l10n` (generated `lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart` committed).
- **Commands (verified 2026-10-15):** `cd packages/<p> && ~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin/dart test [file]` and `~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin/dart analyze` for `shellx_core`, `shellx_ai`, `shellx_agent`, `shellx_client`, `shellx_e2e`; `cd apps/<app> && PATH=~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin:$PATH flutter test [file]` and `… flutter analyze` for `desktop`, `mobile`; `cd relay && npm ci && npm test && npm run typecheck`. Format only the files a task touches: `~/fvm/versions/3.41.4/bin/dart format <files>` from the package or app directory.
- **Commits:** `feat(v2-ai): …`, `fix(v2-ai): …`, `test(v2-ai): …`, `build(mobile): …`, `feat(relay): …`, `docs(v2-ai): …`; at least one per task; every message ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- **Running the apps:** never on the user's real data. Any launch of the desktop app uses a copy with bundle id `pro.shellx.desktop.smoketest` and a temporary home (`CFFIXED_USER_HOME`), as in the session's `scratchpad/smoke/run.sh`.

## Review Focus

The five failure modes of spec §9, most likely to hurt a user first. Each line names the tests that pin it, in the task that owns the code.

1. **An answer lands on another request** — a pane's runtime replaced (B3), a notification tapped late, a sid from before ShellX restarted (B23). Every path ends `stale` or opens a page; nothing answers another request. [Task 1: "an answer to the old runtime's request is stale; the new request stays asked", "a queued prompt of the old runtime is not the new one's either". Task 6: "a session of the previous run opens as the one session of the same agent session now", "none, or two, of the same agent session now: the machine opens". Task 20: "stale says it was answered elsewhere and sends nothing else", "an old sid gets not_found, then the page: …", "bad data sends nothing: …", "a lost channel is never retried (…)", "a cancelled unlock sends nothing, also when the app is unlocked later".]
2. **An older background service swallows new messages and the phone waits forever.** [Task 3: "a window's message of a kind this service does not know reaches the phone as it was sent", "a known kind keeps the keys this service does not know, both ways", "without a window, every V2-2b request and a newer phone's request with a rid are answered unavailable at once; one without a rid gets nothing". Task 4: "the router says ai 1 (a V2-2a desktop, or a V2-2b window behind a V2-2a background service): no V2-2b feature, even one the listing names".]
3. **One oversize message drops the whole channel** — images, `ai.item`, `ai.changes` with many files, long history titles. [Task 2: "the largest of each V2-2b message fits one sealed batch with its envelope". Task 12: "Review Focus 3: quotes, backslashes and control characters, the worst escaping, still fit". Task 14: "at most 50 sessions, titles cut; what could not be sent back is left out (Review Focus 3)". Task 16: "a part at the limit is taken, and one message holds it (Review Focus 3)". Task 24: "ten thousand changed files with long paths fit one body; the rest is counted (Review Focus 3)", "a confirm lists what fits of ten thousand touched files", "a file of nearly 1 MiB fits one message; one over is too_big (Review Focus 3)". Task 10's config view is cut to one body by `encodeConfigView`.]
4. **A revert from the phone while the computer works** — a turn running, a file just changed. [Task 24: "while a turn runs a revert is busy_turn, and nothing goes back (Review Focus 4)", "a file the computer changed after the phone looked asks first; "clean" leaves it (Review Focus 4)". Task 25: "a revert asks first with the files; a tap in its first 400 ms does nothing (Review Focus 4)", "files changed after the turn: the computer asks, the phone offers only-unchanged or all (Review Focus 4)", "while a turn runs the revert is dim and says to wait; busy_turn …".]
5. **A no-approval mode slips through,** by an id nobody listed or by an `ai.config` sent directly. [Task 10: "R16: an id that only says it (yolo, clearAndBypass, danger-full-access) is never offered, nor a switch named like one", the refusal tests of `aiConfigRefusal` (`on_computer` whatever was offered), "the phone gets the choices without "Bypass permissions"; its choice reaches the agent and is remembered as the chip remembers it". Task 8: "the allow button is never an answer that turns on a mode acting without asking (Review Focus 5)".]

### Task 1: Request ids unique for the whole window run

Spec B3 (a V2-2a bug, fixed first, B26). Permission, question and queue ids come from a counter **per `AiSessionState`** (`session_state.dart:90`), and every runtime gets a fresh state (`ai_host.dart:116`), while the phone's session id (`<epoch>.<pane>`) does not change when a pane's runtime is replaced (a folder chosen again, its agent switched off and on). So `{sid, permission: 0, option: "allow"}` meant for runtime A can land on request 0 of runtime B, whose options reuse the same ids (`allow`, `reject`). With push buttons (B7–B10) a tap can come minutes late, so the window becomes real.

R1: one library-level counter `_nextRequestId` in `session_state.dart`, shared by every `AiSessionState` of the isolate (the window's UI isolate holds all of them); it never goes back in a run, so `(sid, id)` names one request. Tests read ids from the state (`currentPermission!.id`), never a literal, so nothing else changes (verified: shellx_ai, shellx_agent, shellx_client suites, `apps/desktop/test/ai/ai_phone_test.dart`, `test/ui/ai/ai_permission_bar_test.dart`, `apps/mobile/test/features/ai/ai_session_page_test.dart`).

```dart
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import '../support/ai_rig.dart';

const _phone = 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';

PermissionRequest _perm(String toolCallId) => PermissionRequest.fromJson({
  'sessionId': 's',
  'toolCall': {'toolCallId': toolCallId, 'title': 'Sửa src/main.ts'},
  'options': [
    {'optionId': 'allow', 'name': 'Yes', 'kind': 'allow_once'},
    {'optionId': 'reject', 'name': 'No', 'kind': 'reject_once'},
  ],
});

/// V2-2b B3, Review Focus 1: a pane keeps its session id when its runtime is
/// replaced (a folder chosen again, its agent switched off and on), so an
/// answer the phone meant for the old runtime's request can never land on
/// the request of the new one.
void main() {
  test('an answer to the old runtime\'s request is stale; the new request '
      'stays asked', () {
    final rig = HubRig();
    final before = rig.source.add(-1);
    final old = before.addPermission(_perm('c1'), aiT0);
    final now = rig.source.replace(-1); // another runtime, the same pane
    final current = now.addPermission(_perm('c1'), aiT0);
    expect(current.id, isNot(old.id));
    rig.hub.handle(
      _phone,
      AiAnswer(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 1, permission: old.id, option: 'allow'),
    );
    final result = rig.last<AiResult>(_phone);
    expect((result.rid, result.ok, result.code), (1, false, 'stale'));
    expect(rig.source.controls[-1]!.permissions, isEmpty);
    expect(now.currentPermission?.id, current.id, reason: 'still asked');
  });

  test('a queued prompt of the old runtime is not the new one\'s either', () {
    final rig = HubRig();
    final before = rig.source.add(-1);
    before.beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], aiT0);
    final old = before.enqueue(const [TextBlock('later')])!;
    final now = rig.source.replace(-1);
    now.beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], aiT0);
    final current = now.enqueue(const [TextBlock('later')])!;
    expect(current.id, isNot(old.id));
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, AiUnqueue(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 2, queued: old.id));
    expect(rig.last<AiResult>(_phone).code, 'stale');
    expect(now.queue.single.id, current.id);
  });
}
```

Append to `docs/superpowers/ledgers/v2-ai.md`:

```markdown

## V2-2b (phone, part two) — planning rulings

Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-v2-2b-phone-ai-more.md` (spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-v2-2b-phone-ai-more-design.md`, decisions B1–B26). The relay task (Task 7) and the privacy pages (Task 26) live on branch `v2-2b-relay` until the user approves a production deploy.

Ruling R1 (B3): one library-level counter `_nextRequestId` in `session_state.dart`, shared by every `AiSessionState` of the process; never goes back in a run — cost if wrong: ids only grow (no wrap within a run in practice).
Ruling R2 (B2): every `ai.*` message read from the wire keeps the map it came as (an `Expando`, `AiMessage.wire`); `encodeBatch` writes `wire` for AI messages; an unknown `ai.*` kind decodes to `AiRaw`, a malformed known kind is still skipped; keys that are no strings are dropped from a wire map — cost if wrong: one map kept per decoded AI message.
Ruling R3 (B1): a phone may use a V2-2b feature only when the router's `ai` is at least 2 (learned from `session.list.result`) and the window's last listing names it (`f`); the AI session page asks `session.list` once when the protocol is unknown and holds the listing while open — cost if wrong: one round trip more for a page opened from a push.
Ruling R4: a V2-2b request kind the hub does not take yet, or an `AiRaw` with an integer `rid`, is answered `refused` by the hub, and `unavailable` where no window serves AI (slot, background service) — cost if wrong: none, every request still gets one answer.
Ruling R5 (B8): "Deny" is not `.destructive` (options `[.foreground]`), so it is the first non-destructive action, the one an Apple Watch double tap runs; "Allow" is `[.foreground, .authenticationRequired]` — B8's goal (a double tap never allows) wins over its option list — cost if wrong: "Deny" is drawn plain, not red.
Ruling R6 (B10): the action title of "Đã cho phép: <việc>" comes from the push body with the head "Cần bạn trả lời: " or "Needs your answer: " cut off; no new data key (B25) — cost if wrong: a body in other words is shown whole.
Ruling R7 (B10): a push answer waits for the app's lock; it is dropped (nothing sent) when an unlock attempt ends still locked, when the app leaves the foreground before it is sent, or after 2 minutes — cost if wrong: the user answers in the app after a slow unlock.
Ruling R8 (B12): iOS gets `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (App Store policy, image_picker README) though it is never prompted (`requestFullMetadata: false`) — cost if wrong: one more line in Info.plist.
Ruling R9 (B14): "huỷ"/"cancel" as the last word drops that utterance only; it never clears what was typed — cost if wrong: clearing the field takes a tap.
Ruling R10 (B21): a tap on a machine's AI line opens the one waiting session when exactly one waits, else the AI chooser sheet — cost if wrong: one more tap with several sessions.
Ruling R11 (B21): a second string `machineAiSessions` ("✦ 2 phiên AI") for a line with nobody waiting — cost if wrong: one more string.
Ruling R12 (B19): a phone's revert opens the desktop pane's Changes panel and writes its note there, as the desktop's own revert does — cost if wrong: the panel opens on the computer without a click there.
Ruling R13 (B25): the privacy pages (`web/**`) deploy on merge to `main` like `relay/**`, so they are committed on `v2-2b-relay` — cost if wrong: the pages wait for the relay's go-ahead.
Ruling R14 (B16): an item in full is JSON text cut into slices of at most 36 KiB once JSON-escaped; a slice never splits a surrogate pair — cost if wrong: a few more parts for text full of quotes.
Ruling R15: a phone request of a V2-2b feature fails at once with `unsupported`, sending nothing, when the feature cannot be used (R3) — cost if wrong: none.
Ruling R16 (B11): a phone is offered only the choices `aiTurnsOnNoApproval` does not flag, never a switch named like a no-approval mode; the window checks again when setting (`on_computer`) — cost if wrong: "Bypass permissions" stays a computer-only choice (as B11 wants).
Ruling R17 (B12): image (blob) numbers are the phone's own, kept per phone on the desktop and taken by the prompt — cost if wrong: an upload whose prompt failed is sent again.
Ruling R18 (B13, B19): a path from a phone is used only when it is one the window offers right now, relative, without `..`, at most `kAiMaxPathBytes`; the window checks it again inside the session folder — cost if wrong: a file renamed meanwhile is refused.
Ruling R19 (B12): past 5 images or 20 MiB per phone, the desktop drops that phone's least recently used images instead of refusing the new one (a retried upload uses new numbers); an image over 10 MiB, or alone over 20 MiB, is `too_large` — cost if wrong: an image uploaded long before its prompt is uploaded again.
Ruling R20 (B23): a push sid this app run saw in a listing, which the current listing no longer names, opens the one session with the same `acp`, agent and folder, else the machine page; a sid never seen opens as in V2-2a (the push carries no `acp`) — cost if wrong: such a page shows "closed" with "Mở danh sách phiên".
Ruling R21 (B9): Android re-draws only a push that came with an `ai-` tag (only the relay of Task 7 sets it); through an older relay the push stays as FCM drew it, without buttons, never twice — cost if wrong: Android buttons wait for the relay deploy, like iOS's.
Ruling R22 (B16): "Xem đủ" shows on every open tool card with a body, since the mirror cuts a call's input without a flag — cost if wrong: the button sometimes loads what is already shown.
Ruling R23 (B12, §7): images lost with the channel are uploaded again by the next tap on Send, which then sends the prompt; nothing is uploaded or sent by itself — cost if wrong: the upload starts at the tap, not when the channel returns.
```

### Task 2: The V2-2b `ai.*` messages, `AiRaw` and wire maps, `kAiProtocol = 2`, frozen V2-2a decoder

Spec B1 (the router half), B2 (the core half), B4, §4.1. Ten request kinds, three optional fields on V2-2a kinds, and `ai.result`'s `body`:

| `t` | Class | Fields (wire keys) |
|---|---|---|
| `ai.config.get` | `AiConfigGet` | `sid`, `rid` |
| `ai.config` | `AiConfigSet` | `sid`, `rid`, `body` |
| `ai.blob` | `AiBlob` | `rid`, `blob`, `part`, `parts`, `mime?`, `data` |
| `ai.files` | `AiFiles` | `sid`, `rid`, `q` (`query`) |
| `ai.item` | `AiItemPart` | `sid`, `rid`, `i` (`index`), `part` |
| `ai.history` | `AiHistory` | `sid`, `rid`, `cursor?` |
| `ai.folder` | `AiFolder` | `sid`, `rid`, `folder` |
| `ai.changes` | `AiChanges` | `sid`, `rid`, `turn?` |
| `ai.diff` | `AiDiff` | `sid`, `rid`, `turn?`, `path` |
| `ai.revert` | `AiRevert` | `sid`, `rid`, `turn?`, `keep?` |
| `ai.prompt` | `AiPrompt` | + `blobs?` (ints), `files?` (strings), written only when not empty |
| `ai.open` | `AiOpen` | + `resume?` |
| `ai.result` | `AiResult` | + `body?` |

R2: every `ai.*` message read from the wire keeps the map it came as (an `Expando`), and `AiMessage.wire` returns it — else `toMap()`. `encodeBatch` writes `wire` for AI messages, so a process that forwards what it reads (the background service, Task 3) passes on what a newer peer said. A kind this version does not know is read as an `AiRaw` (type, `sid?`, `rid?`) instead of being skipped; a malformed message of a kind this version reads is still skipped. The decoder builds a new `AiList()` instance rather than the constant, so the canonical `const AiList()` never carries a wire map. `kAiProtocol` becomes 2 (B1a): the router of a V2-2b process says it.

The hub's `handle` and the service's `_towardsPhone` switch over the sealed `AiMessage`, so they get the new kinds here (R4): each new request is answered `refused` by its own two-line stub — the task of its feature replaces exactly those two lines — and an `AiRaw` with an integer `rid` too; `_ridOf` covers them all, so the request budget answers `busy` with their rid. `_towardsPhone` becomes `bool?` (`AiRaw() => null`); this task keeps an `AiRaw` from the window dropped (`!= true`), Task 3 passes it on.

Three existing tests change on purpose: the V2-2a "unknown kind is skipped" case now reads an `AiRaw`; the `ai` of `session.list.result` is `kAiProtocol` (2); and an `ai.in` of an unknown kind now reaches the hub (moved to a new test). The phone (`MachineAi.handle` has a `default`), the desktop and the mobile app compile unchanged.

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import '../support/ai_rig.dart';

const _phone = 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';

/// One of each V2-2b request, with rids 1 to 10.
List<AiMessage> _requests() => [
  const AiConfigGet(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 1),
  AiConfigSet(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 2, body: Uint8List.fromList([0x7B, 0x7D])),
  AiBlob(rid: 3, blob: 1, part: 0, parts: 1, data: Uint8List(4)),
  const AiFiles(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 4, query: 'a'),
  const AiItemPart(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 5, index: 0, part: 0),
  const AiHistory(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 6),
  const AiFolder(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 7, folder: 'ws:a'),
  const AiChanges(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 8),
  const AiDiff(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 9, path: 'a.ts'),
  const AiRevert(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 10),
];

/// What [map] decodes to: an `ai.*` kind this version does not know is an
/// [AiRaw] only when it comes from the wire.
AiMessage _read(Map<String, Object?> map) =>
    decodeBatch(encodeCbor([map])).single as AiMessage;

/// V2-2b B1, B2, B4 (R4): until its feature lands, a V2-2b request gets its
/// one answer, `refused`; so does a newer phone's request (an [AiRaw] with a
/// `rid`). None of them escapes the request budget.
void main() {
  test('every V2-2b request is answered refused, once, with its rid', () {
    final rig = HubRig()..source.add(-1);
    for (final m in _requests()) {
      rig.hub.handle(_phone, m);
    }
    expect(
      [
        for (final r in rig.to(_phone).whereType<AiResult>())
          (r.rid, r.ok, r.code),
      ],
      [for (var rid = 1; rid <= 10; rid++) (rid, false, 'refused')],
    );
  });

  test('a newer phone\'s request (an AiRaw) gets its one answer when it has '
      'a rid; without one, nothing', () {
    final rig = HubRig()..source.add(-1);
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'sid': 'ep.-1', 'rid': 9}));
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'sid': 'ep.-1'}));
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'rid': 'nine'}));
    expect(rig.to(_phone), [
      const AiResult(rid: 9, ok: false, code: 'refused'),
    ]);
  });

  test('V2-2b requests spend the budget like the others: over it, busy with '
      'their rid', () {
    final rig = HubRig()..source.add(-1);
    // The rig's clock stands still: the 60 of the burst are all there is.
    for (var rid = 1; rid <= 60; rid++) {
      rig.hub.handle(_phone, AiConfigGet(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: rid));
    }
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, const AiHistory(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 61));
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'rid': 62}));
    expect(
      [
        for (final r in rig.to(_phone).whereType<AiResult>())
          if (r.rid > 60) (r.rid, r.code),
      ],
      [(61, 'busy'), (62, 'busy')],
    );
  });
}
```

Replace the whole of `packages/shellx_core/lib/src/protocol/ai_messages.dart` with (already `dart format`-ted):

```dart
part of 'messages.dart';

/// V2-2 D3, V2-2b B1: the `ai.*` protocol of the process that holds the
/// relay, reported in `session.list.result` (`ai`). 1: V2-2a. 2: V2-2b, whose
/// background service forwards `ai.*` verbatim (B2), so that whatever the
/// window offers in its listing (`f`) reaches it. A phone shows AI sessions
/// from 1 on, and uses a V2-2b feature only from 2 on, when the listing names
/// it.
const int kAiProtocol = 2;

/// V2-2 D4: the largest `body` of an `ai.*` message. One sealed batch
/// ([kMaxSealedBatchBytes], 65 493 bytes) holds it with the envelope and
/// room to spare, so an AI message never makes `SecureChannel.seal` throw
/// (which would drop the whole channel, terminals included).
const int kAiMaxBodyBytes = 48 * 1024;

/// V2-2 D4: the largest prompt a phone sends, in UTF-8 bytes.
const int kAiMaxPromptBytes = 32 * 1024;

/// V2-2b B12: the most image bytes one `ai.blob` carries.
const int kAiMaxBlobPartBytes = kAiMaxBodyBytes;

/// V2-2b B13: the most files one prompt mentions.
const int kAiMaxPromptFiles = 20;

/// V2-2b B13, B19: the longest path a phone names, in UTF-8 bytes.
const int kAiMaxPathBytes = 1024;

/// V2-2b B2: the map each `ai.*` message read from the wire came as (string
/// keys only), for [AiMessage.wire].
final _aiWireMaps = Expando<Map<String, Object?>>('ai wire map');

Map<String, Object?> _stringKeyed(Map<Object?, Object?> map) => {
  for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in map.entries)
    if (key is String) key: value,
};

/// V2-2: messages between a phone and the AI sessions of a desktop (spec
/// V2-2 §4, V2-2b §4). Their content travels as `body` bytes (UTF-8 JSON,
/// read by `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart`), so the transport sees a flat map
/// of depth 3 whatever the content is, and never a float.
///
/// An `ai.*` message this version cannot read is skipped ([AppMessage.
/// fromMap] returns null), never fatal: only the AI view resynchronises,
/// the channel and its terminals stay. A kind this version does not know is
/// read as an [AiRaw] (B2). [toString] never shows a prompt, a folder or a
/// body (V2-1 D20).
sealed class AiMessage extends AppMessage {
  const AiMessage();

  /// The AI session the message is about; null for `ai.list`,
  /// `ai.list.result`, `ai.open`, `ai.blob` and `ai.result` without a
  /// session.
  String? get sid;

  /// V2-2b B2: what goes on the wire for this message — the map it was read
  /// from when it came from the wire (keys this version does not know
  /// included), else [toMap]. A process that forwards what it reads (the
  /// background service) so passes on what a newer peer said: a later
  /// addition needs only the window.
  Map<String, Object?> get wire => _aiWireMaps[this] ?? toMap();

  @override
  String toString() => '$runtimeType(…)';

  /// Every `ai.*` message read from the wire, with the map it came as
  /// ([wire]); null when a kind this version reads is malformed.
  static AiMessage? _fromMap(String t, _Fields f) {
    try {
      final message = _decode(t, f);
      _aiWireMaps[message] = _stringKeyed(f._map);
      return message;
    } on FormatException {
      return null; // Skipped, never fatal (see [AiMessage]).
    }
  }

  static AiMessage _decode(String t, _Fields f) => switch (t) {
    // Not the constant: each one read carries the map it came as.
    'ai.list' => AiList(),
    'ai.list.result' => AiListResult(
      available: f.boolean('available'),
      body: f.bytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.attach' => AiAttach(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      body: f.optionalBytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.detach' => AiDetach(sid: f.string('sid')),
    'ai.ack' => AiAck(sid: f.string('sid'), seq: f.integer('seq')),
    'ai.earlier' => AiEarlier(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      before: f.integer('before'),
    ),
    'ai.snapshot' => AiSnapshot(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      seq: f.integer('seq'),
      body: f.bytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.update' => AiUpdate(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      seq: f.integer('seq'),
      body: f.bytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.closed' => AiClosed(sid: f.string('sid'), reason: f.string('reason')),
    'ai.prompt' => AiPrompt(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      text: f.string('text'),
      blobs: f.optionalIntegers('blobs') ?? const [],
      files: f.optionalStrings('files') ?? const [],
    ),
    'ai.answer' => AiAnswer(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      permission: f.optionalInteger('permission'),
      option: f.optionalString('option'),
      ask: f.optionalInteger('ask'),
      action: f.optionalString('action'),
      body: f.optionalBytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.cancel' => AiCancel(sid: f.string('sid'), rid: f.integer('rid')),
    'ai.stop' => AiForceStop(sid: f.string('sid'), rid: f.integer('rid')),
    'ai.unqueue' => AiUnqueue(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      queued: f.integer('queued'),
    ),
    'ai.open' => AiOpen(
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      agent: f.string('agent'),
      folder: f.string('folder'),
      resume: f.optionalString('resume'),
    ),
    'ai.result' => AiResult(
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      ok: f.boolean('ok'),
      code: f.optionalString('code'),
      sid: f.optionalString('sid'),
      body: f.optionalBytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.config.get' => AiConfigGet(sid: f.string('sid'), rid: f.integer('rid')),
    'ai.config' => AiConfigSet(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      body: f.bytes('body'),
    ),
    'ai.blob' => AiBlob(
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      blob: f.integer('blob'),
      part: f.integer('part'),
      parts: f.integer('parts'),
      mime: f.optionalString('mime'),
      data: f.bytes('data'),
    ),
    'ai.files' => AiFiles(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      query: f.string('q'),
    ),
    'ai.item' => AiItemPart(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      index: f.integer('i'),
      part: f.integer('part'),
    ),
    'ai.history' => AiHistory(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      cursor: f.optionalString('cursor'),
    ),
    'ai.folder' => AiFolder(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      folder: f.string('folder'),
    ),
    'ai.changes' => AiChanges(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      turn: f.optionalInteger('turn'),
    ),
    'ai.diff' => AiDiff(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      turn: f.optionalInteger('turn'),
      path: f.string('path'),
    ),
    'ai.revert' => AiRevert(
      sid: f.string('sid'),
      rid: f.integer('rid'),
      turn: f.optionalInteger('turn'),
      keep: f.optionalString('keep'),
    ),
    _ => AiRaw._(t, sid: f.loose<String>('sid'), rid: f.loose<int>('rid')),
  };
}

/// Phone → desktop: list the AI sessions and keep the list current (the
/// desktop sends `ai.list.result` again whenever it changes, until the
/// channel ends).
final class AiList extends AiMessage {
  const AiList();
  @override
  String? get sid => null;
  @override
  String get type => 'ai.list';
  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => {'t': type};
}

/// Desktop → phone: the AI sessions, agents and folders ([body], an
/// `AiListing`); [available] is false while no window serves AI (the
/// desktop app is closed and only the background service runs).
final class AiListResult extends AiMessage {
  const AiListResult({required this.available, required this.body});
  final bool available;
  final Uint8List body;
  @override

  @override
  String get type => 'ai.list.result';
  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => {
    't': type,
    'available': available,
    'body': body,
  };
}

/// Phone → desktop: mirror session [sid]. [body] (an `AiHave`) says what
/// the phone already holds, so a re-attach only brings what changed.
final class AiAttach extends AiMessage {

}

/// Phone → desktop: stop mirroring [sid].
final class AiDetach extends AiMessage {

}

/// Phone → desktop: every mirror message of [sid] up to [seq] arrived

}

/// Phone → desktop: the items of [sid] before index [before] ("load
/// earlier"); answered with an `ai.update` page.
final class AiEarlier extends AiMessage {

}

/// Desktop → phone: the first mirror message after an attach.
final class AiSnapshot extends AiMessage {

}

/// Desktop → phone: what changed, a continuation, or an earlier page.
final class AiUpdate extends AiMessage {
  const AiUpdate({required this.sid, required this.seq, required this.body});

}

/// Desktop → phone: [sid] is no longer mirrored. [reason]: `gone` (the tab
/// closed), `desktop_closed` (the window quit), `unavailable` (no window
/// serves AI); a newer desktop may send other words.
final class AiClosed extends AiMessage {
  const AiClosed({required this.sid, required this.reason});
  @override
  final String sid;
  final String reason;
  @override

  @override

}

/// Phone → desktop: send [text] to [sid] (queued while a turn runs), with
/// the images it uploaded ([blobs], V2-2b B12) and the files it mentions
/// ([files], B13). An older desktop reads only [text]: a phone sends the two
/// lists only to a window whose listing offers them (B1).
final class AiPrompt extends AiMessage {
  const AiPrompt({
    required this.sid,
    required this.rid,
    required this.text,
    this.blobs = const [],
    this.files = const [],

  final int rid;
  final String text;

  final List<String> files;
  @override
  String get type => 'ai.prompt';
  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => {
    't': type,
    'sid': sid,
    'rid': rid,
    'text': text,
    if (blobs.isNotEmpty) 'blobs': blobs,
    if (files.isNotEmpty) 'files': files,
  };
}

/// Phone → desktop: the user's answer. Either [permission] with the

final class AiAnswer extends AiMessage {

    't': type,
    'sid': sid,
    'rid': rid,
    if (permission != null) 'permission': permission,
    if (option != null) 'option': option,
    if (ask != null) 'ask': ask,
    if (action != null) 'action': action,
    if (body != null) 'body': body,
  };
}

}

/// Phone → desktop: a new AI session with [agent] in [folder] (a key from
/// the listing, never a path the phone made up). With [resume] (V2-2b B17)

final class AiOpen extends AiMessage {

/// Desktop → phone: how request [rid] ended. [code] when not [ok]:
/// `stale`, `refused`, `queue_full`, `too_large`, `busy`, `not_found`,
/// `unavailable`, `on_computer`, and since V2-2b `no_images`, `confirm`,
/// `busy_turn`, `not_ready`, `undo_off`, `too_big` (a newer desktop may send
/// other words). [sid]: the new session of an `ai.open`. [body] (V2-2b B4):
/// what a V2-2b request asked for, as JSON; an older phone ignores it.
final class AiResult extends AiMessage {

    't': type,
    'rid': rid,
    'ok': ok,
    if (code != null) 'code': code,
    if (sid != null) 'sid': sid,
    if (body != null) 'body': body,
  };
}

    'rid': rid,
    'blob': blob,
    'part': part,
    'parts': parts,
    'mime': ?mime,
    'data': data,
  };
}

  };
}

/// Phone → desktop (V2-2b B19): the diff of [path] (one of `ai.changes`'
/// files) since [turn] began (null: since the session's first turn).

/// Phone → desktop (V2-2b B19): put the files changed since [turn] began
/// back (null: since the session's first turn). The desktop works it out
/// again now; when some files changed after the turn it answers `confirm`
/// (with them) unless [keep] says what to do: `clean` (only the others) or

final class AiRevert extends AiMessage {

    'sid': sid,
    'rid': rid,
    'turn': ?turn,
    'keep': ?keep,
  };
}

/// V2-2b B2: an `ai.*` kind this version does not know (a newer peer's),
/// read so that the background service passes it on as it came ([wire]),
/// the way it came: from a phone to the window, from the window to a phone.
/// A window and a phone ignore it, but for a request with an integer [rid],
/// which gets its one `ai.result` (`refused` from a window, `unavailable`
/// where none serves AI).
final class AiRaw extends AiMessage {
  AiRaw._(this.type, {this.sid, this.rid});

  final String type;
  @override
  final String? sid;
  final int? rid;
  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => _aiWireMaps[this] ?? {'t': type};
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b: an optional list of integers; a list holding anything else is
  /// malformed.
  List<int>? optionalIntegers(String key) {
    final value = _map[key];
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is List && value.every((e) => e is int)) {
      return [for (final e in value) e as int];
    }
    throw FormatException('$_type: "$key" must be a list of integers');
  }

  /// V2-2b: an optional list of strings; a list holding anything else is
  /// malformed.
  List<String>? optionalStrings(String key) {
    final value = _map[key];
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is List && value.every((e) => e is String)) {
      return [for (final e in value) e as String];
    }
    throw FormatException('$_type: "$key" must be a list of strings');
  }

  /// V2-2b B2: [key] when it is a [T], else null; never throws (the fields
  /// of a kind this version does not know).
  T? loose<T>(String key) {
    final value = _map[key];
    return value is T ? value : null;
  }
```

### Task 3: The background service forwards `ai.*` verbatim; every new request answered without a window

Spec B2 and §4.1 ("Mọi loại mới có mặt trong `aiUnavailableReply`"), Review Focus 2. A V2-2a service decodes and re-encodes every `ai.*` message (`mux_ai.dart` `_carried`, `_carry`, `_emit`): a new kind is dropped both ways and a new key on a known kind is stripped. From V2-2b on the service passes messages on as they came (`AiMessage.wire`, R2), and a kind it does not know goes the way it came: from a phone to the window (`handle` → `ai.in`), from the window's `ai.out` to the phone. The size check (`_emit`, one sealed batch) is unchanged, so an oversize message of an unknown kind is dropped like any other. Without a window, every V2-2b request — and a newer phone's `AiRaw` with an integer `rid` — is answered `unavailable` at once (R4), by the service (`MuxAiForwarder`) and by the in-process slot (`AiEndpointSlot`) alike, both through `aiUnavailableReply`; a phone never waits 10 s for a window that is not there. An older service still drops the new kinds: the phone never sends them through one (Task 4, R3).

**Files:**
- Modify: `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/mux/mux_ai.dart` (`_carry`, `fromUi`, `MuxAiBinding`, doc comments)
- Modify: `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/ai/ai_endpoint.dart` (`aiUnavailableReply`)
- Test (new): `packages/shellx_agent/test/mux/mux_ai_verbatim_test.dart`
- Modify (test): `packages/shellx_agent/test/mux/mux_ai_edges_test.dart`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 2): `AiMessage.wire`, `AiRaw`, the new request kinds, `bool? _towardsPhone(AiMessage)`.
- Produces: `aiUnavailableReply(AiMessage, {String reason})` answers every V2-2b request kind and `AiRaw(rid: final rid?)` with `AiResult(rid: rid, ok: false, code: 'unavailable')`; `MuxAiForwarder` passes `AiRaw` from the window on to the phone; `_carry` and `MuxAiBinding` write `message.wire`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Every new request answered without a window**

In `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/ai/ai_endpoint.dart`, replace the whole of `aiUnavailableReply` (with its doc comment) by

```dart
/// What a desktop answers when nobody serves AI (V2-2 D1): the list is
/// unavailable, an attach is closed with [reason], a request fails
/// `unavailable` — every V2-2b request too, and a newer phone's request
/// (an [AiRaw] with a `rid`, V2-2b B2), so a phone never waits for a
/// window that is not there. Null for messages that need no answer.
AiMessage? aiUnavailableReply(
  AiMessage message, {
  String reason = 'unavailable',
}) => switch (message) {
  AiList() => AiListResult(available: false, body: emptyAiListingBody),
  AiAttach(:final sid) => AiClosed(sid: sid, reason: reason),
  AiPrompt(:final rid) ||
  AiAnswer(:final rid) ||
  AiCancel(:final rid) ||
  AiForceStop(:final rid) ||
  AiUnqueue(:final rid) ||
  AiOpen(:final rid) ||
  AiConfigGet(:final rid) ||
  AiConfigSet(:final rid) ||
  AiBlob(:final rid) ||
  AiFiles(:final rid) ||
  AiItemPart(:final rid) ||
  AiHistory(:final rid) ||
  AiFolder(:final rid) ||
  AiChanges(:final rid) ||
  AiDiff(:final rid) ||
  AiRevert(:final rid) => AiResult(rid: rid, ok: false, code: 'unavailable'),
  AiRaw(rid: final rid?) => AiResult(rid: rid, ok: false, code: 'unavailable'),
  _ => null,
};
```

### Task 4: Capability on the phone (router `ai ≥ 2` + listing `f`) and request bodies

Spec B1 and B4 on the phone, R3 and R15, Review Focus 2. Two halves prove a feature works end to end: (a) the process that holds the relay says `ai` 2 in `session.list.result` — its router, and with the background service its forwarder, passes V2-2b messages on (Task 3); (b) the window's listing names the feature (`"f": [...]`) — its hub does it. The phone uses a feature only when both hold (`MachineAi.can`); with either missing its buttons do not show and its request fails at once with `unsupported`, sending nothing (`_feature`, R15). A V2-2a desktop, or a V2-2b window behind a V2-2a service (router `ai: 1`, listing with `f`), therefore never gets a request it would drop.

The words (`AiFeature`) live in `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart`. The hub names `AiPhoneHub.offered`, empty for now: each feature's task adds its word when the hub and the window both do it (contract table: Task 6 `acpHead`, Task 8 `pushAnswer`, Task 10 `config`, Task 12 `item`, Task 14 `history` and `folder`, Task 16 `blob`, Task 17 `files`, Task 24 `changes` and `revert`). A listing without features is byte for byte a V2-2a body (no `f` key). `f` survives the cut that keeps a long listing within one message.

`AiResult.body` (Task 2) reaches the caller: `_request` keeps returning the `AiResult`, and a refusal's body (a `confirm`'s files, B19) comes with the `AiRequestException` as a JSON object. `SessionRouter` takes the `ai` it reports (`aiProtocol`, default `kAiProtocol`) so that tests can play an older desktop; the client harness passes it on.

```dart
/// A router with an AI endpoint: [aiProtocol] as it is told, or its own
/// default when null.
(SessionRouter, List<OutboundMessage>) _router({int? aiProtocol}) {
  var next = 10;
  int ids() => next++;
  final shells = SessionManager(
    ptyFactory: FakePtyFactory(),
    shellResolver: const FixedShellResolver(),
    homeDirectory: '/Users/test',
    baseEnvironment: const {},
    nextId: ids,
  );
  final desktop = DesktopSessionManager(nextId: ids);
  final router = aiProtocol == null
      ? SessionRouter(
          shells: shells,
          desktop: desktop,
          desktopSharing: () => true,
          ai: AiEndpointSlot(),
        )
      : SessionRouter(
          shells: shells,
          desktop: desktop,
          desktopSharing: () => true,
          ai: AiEndpointSlot(),
          aiProtocol: aiProtocol,
        );
  final sent = <OutboundMessage>[];
  router.outbound.listen(sent.add);
  return (router, sent);
}

AiListing _listing(AiListResult r) =>
    AiListing.fromJson(decodeBody(r.body)!, available: r.available);

/// V2-2b B1 (R3): the two halves of a phone's "can": what the relay process
/// reports, and what the window's hub names in its listing.
void main() {
  group('the router reports the protocol of its process', () {
    test('kAiProtocol (2) by default', () {
      fakeAsync((async) {
        final (router, sent) = _router();
        router.handle(_phone, const SessionList(desktop: true));
        async.flushMicrotasks();
        expect((sent.single.message as SessionListResult).ai, 2);
      });
    });

    test('the one it is told: a test plays an older desktop', () {
      fakeAsync((async) {
        final (router, sent) = _router(aiProtocol: 1);
        router.handle(_phone, const SessionList(desktop: true));
        async.flushMicrotasks();
        expect((sent.single.message as SessionListResult).ai, 1);
      });
    });
  });

  group('the hub names what it does in its listing', () {
    test('every listing names the hub\'s features (AiPhoneHub.offered)', () {
      final rig = HubRig()..source.add(-1);
      rig.hub.handle(_phone, const AiList());
      final listing = _listing(rig.last<AiListResult>(_phone));
      expect(listing.features, AiPhoneHub.offered);
    });

    test('they stay when the listing is cut to fit one message', () {
      final source = FakeAiSource();
      for (var i = 1; i <= 400; i++) {
        source.add(-i, title: 'x' * 190);
      }
      final hub = AiPhoneHub(
        source: source,
        epoch: 'ep',
        features: {AiFeature.config, AiFeature.item},
      );
      final sent = <OutboundMessage>[];
      hub.outbound.listen(sent.add);
      hub.handle(_phone, const AiList());
      final result = sent.single.message as AiListResult;
      expect(result.body.length, lessThanOrEqualTo(kAiMaxBodyBytes));
      final listing = _listing(result);
      expect(listing.sessions.length, lessThan(400), reason: 'it was cut');
      expect(listing.features, {'config', 'item'});
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
/// makes the hub take it.

  (1, const AiConfigGet(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 1), AiFeature.config),
  (
    2,
    AiConfigSet(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 2, body: Uint8List.fromList([0x7B, 0x7D])),
    AiFeature.config,
  ),
  (
    3,

    AiFeature.blob,
  ),
  (4, const AiFiles(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 4, query: 'a'), AiFeature.files),
  (
    5,
    const AiItemPart(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 5, index: 0, part: 0),
    AiFeature.item,
  ),
  (6, const AiHistory(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 6), AiFeature.history),
  (7, const AiFolder(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 7, folder: 'ws:a'), AiFeature.folder),
  (8, const AiChanges(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 8), AiFeature.changes),
  (9, const AiDiff(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 9, path: 'a.ts'), AiFeature.changes),
  (10, const AiRevert(sid: 'ep.-1', rid: 10), AiFeature.revert),
];

/// What [map] decodes to: an `ai.*` kind this version does not know is an
/// [AiRaw] only when it comes from the wire.
AiMessage _read(Map<String, Object?> map) =>
    decodeBatch(encodeCbor([map])).single as AiMessage;

/// V2-2b B1, B2, B4 (R4): until its feature lands (its word in
/// [AiPhoneHub.offered]), a V2-2b request gets its one answer, `refused`; so
/// does a newer phone's request (an [AiRaw] with a `rid`). None of them

      rig.hub.handle(_phone, message);

    expect(

        for (final r in rig.to(_phone).whereType<AiResult>())
          (r.rid, r.ok, r.code),

      [for (final (rid, _) in waiting) (rid, false, 'refused')],

    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'sid': 'ep.-1'}));
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, _read({'t': 'ai.later', 'rid': 'nine'}));
    expect(rig.to(_phone), [
```

```dart
/// was a JSON object; never in [toString].
```

```dart
  int? get protocol => _protocol;

  /// V2-2b B1 (R3): whether this phone may use [feature] (an `AiFeature`
  /// word) now: the computer's relay process speaks `ai` 2 or more, so
  /// whatever lies between the phone and the window passes V2-2b messages
  /// on, and the window's last listing names it. With either missing, the
  /// feature's buttons do not show and its requests fail at once (R15).
  bool can(String feature) =>
      (_protocol ?? 0) >= 2 && (_listing?.features.contains(feature) ?? false);

  /// The last listing; null before the first one.
  AiListing? get listing => _listing;
```

```dart
  /// A V2-2b request of [feature] (R15): when the computer cannot take it
  /// ([can] is false) it fails at once with `unsupported`, sending nothing;
  /// else it goes like every request, and its [AiResult] (with its
  /// [AiResult.body]) is the caller's to read.
  // The first feature's request (V2-2b Task 10) is its first caller.
  // ignore: unused_element
  Future<AiResult> _feature(
    String feature,
    String? sid,
    AiMessage Function(int rid) make,
  ) {
    if (!can(feature)) {
      return Future.error(const AiRequestException('unsupported'));
    }
    return _request(sid, make);
  }
```

### Task 5: "Bạn · từ điện thoại": the source of a prompt

Spec B24 (and §4.2: the mirror's user record gains `src`). A prompt carries who wrote it, `enum PromptSource { computer, phone }`, all the way from the hub to the timeline: the hub sends every prompt of a phone as an `AiPhonePrompt`, the window sends it with `AiRuntime.send(…, source: PromptSource.phone)`, and the source rides on the `UserItem` the turn starts with — also when the prompt first waits in the queue (`QueuedPrompt.source`, drained with its own source). On the computer the message reads **"Bạn · từ điện thoại"** / "You · from your phone" instead of "Bạn", and a queued prompt from the phone is led by the same words. On the phone, a user record of a phone's prompt carries `"src": "phone"` (an older phone skips the key) and the bubble says **"từ điện thoại"** under the text. `session/load` cannot keep the source (the agent stores none): a replayed conversation reads "Bạn". This is one of the two places V2-2b may change the V2-1a model (spec header).

`AiControl.send` changes from `send(List<ContentBlock>)` to `send(AiPhonePrompt)` (Tasks 16 and 17 add images and files to `AiPhonePrompt`). Every `AiControl` changes with it: the desktop's `_RuntimeControl`, the hub rig's `FakeAiControl`, and the two `_Control` fakes of the `shellx_client` tests. Cost if wrong: two words per message on the computer.

```dart
/// V2-2b B24: a prompt keeps who wrote it, in the timeline and in the queue.
void main() {
  test('a turn begun from the phone says so; one from the computer is the '
      'default', () {
    final s = _state()
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('Sửa lỗi')], _at, source: PromptSource.phone)
      ..endTurn(outcome: TurnOutcome.finished, at: _at)

    expect(s.takeQueued()!.source, PromptSource.phone);
```

```dart
List<PromptSource> _sources(RuntimeRig r) => [

/// V2-2b B24: `AiRuntime.send` carries who wrote the prompt into its turn,
/// also when the prompt waited in the queue.
void main() {
  test(
    'a phone\'s prompt starts a turn the timeline says is the phone\'s',
    () async {
      final r = RuntimeRig(
        first: FakeScenario(
          turns: [
            [FakeSteps.text('ok')],
          ],
        ),
      );
      addTearDown(r.dispose);
      await r.runtime.start();
      expect(
        await r.runtime.send(const [
          TextBlock('a'),
        ], source: PromptSource.phone),
        isTrue,
      );
      await r.until(() => r.turnEnds.length == 1);
      expect(await r.runtime.send(const [TextBlock('b')]), isTrue);
      await r.until(() => r.turnEnds.length == 2);
      expect(_sources(r), [PromptSource.phone, PromptSource.computer]);
    },
  );

  test('queued prompts go out in order, each as its own writer\'s', () async {

      first: FakeScenario(
        turns: [

        ],
      ),

    addTearDown(r.dispose);

    expect(await r.runtime.send(const [TextBlock('a')]), isTrue);
    expect(
      await r.runtime.send(const [TextBlock('b')], source: PromptSource.phone),
      isTrue,
    );
    expect(await r.runtime.send(const [TextBlock('c')]), isTrue);
    expect(r.state.queue.map((q) => q.source), [
      PromptSource.phone,
      PromptSource.computer,
    ]);
    await r.until(() => r.turnEnds.length == 3);
    expect(_sources(r), [
      PromptSource.computer,
      PromptSource.phone,
      PromptSource.computer,
    ]);
  });

  test('a prompt sent while the agent is stopped waits with its source and '
      'goes out with it once the agent runs', () async {
    final r = RuntimeRig(
      first: FakeScenario(
        turns: [
          [FakeSteps.text('ok')],
        ],

    addTearDown(r.dispose);
    expect(
      await r.runtime.send(const [TextBlock('a')], source: PromptSource.phone),
      isTrue,
    );
    await r.until(() => r.turnEnds.length == 1);
    expect(_sources(r), [PromptSource.phone]);
```

```dart
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

final _at = DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 15, 9);

AiSessionState _state() =>
    AiSessionState(agentId: 'claude', agentName: 'Claude', cwd: '/p');

/// The phone's copy of [s], made the way the hub sends it.
AiMirror _mirror(AiSessionState s) {
  final mirror = AiMirror();
  final sub = AiSubscription(s, generation: 1);
  var out = sub.attach(null);
  for (var round = 0; round < 100; round++) {
    for (final o in out) {
      expect(mirror.apply(decodeBody(o.body)!, snapshot: o.snapshot), isTrue);
      sub.ack(o.seq);
    }
    if (!sub.dirty) break;
    out = sub.delta();
  }
  return mirror;
}

/// V2-2b B24: a phone's prompt is marked `src: phone` on the wire; the
/// computer's carries no key (what an older phone reads stays the same).
void main() {
  test('the record of a phone\'s prompt says src phone; the computer\'s '
      'says nothing', () {
    final s = _state()
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('a')], _at, source: PromptSource.phone)
      ..endTurn(outcome: TurnOutcome.finished, at: _at)
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('b')], _at);
    final users = [
      for (final (i, item) in s.timeline.items.indexed)
        if (item is UserItem) encodeItem(item, i),
    ];
    expect(users.first['src'], 'phone');
    expect(users.last.containsKey('src'), isFalse);
  });

  test('the phone\'s mirror knows which prompts it wrote, also of a long one '
      'that came in pieces', () {
    final s = _state()
      ..beginTurn(
        [TextBlock('x' * (kAiRecordBytes * 2))],
        _at,
        source: PromptSource.phone,
      )
      ..endTurn(outcome: TurnOutcome.finished, at: _at)
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('ở máy tính')], _at);
    final texts = _mirror(s).items.whereType<MirrorText>().toList();
    expect(texts.first.text.length, kAiRecordBytes * 2);
    expect(texts.map((t) => t.fromPhone), [true, false]);
  });
}
```

```dart
        return state.enqueue(prompt, source: source) != null;
      case AgentPhase.stopped:
        if (state.enqueue(prompt, source: source) == null) return false;
        unawaited(start());
        return true;
      case AgentPhase.needsAuth || AgentPhase.failed:
        return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _runTurn(List<ContentBlock> prompt, PromptSource source) async {
    final client = _client;
    final sid = state.sessionId;
    if (client == null || sid == null) return;
    final turn = state.beginTurn(prompt, _now(), source: source);
```


with



### Task 6: Header keys (`acp`, `model`, `hist`, `undo`); re-attach after a restart; pushes of a previous run

Spec §4.2 (header), B22, B23, and the page half of R3. Two commits.

**Header keys.** `encodeHead` gains `acp` (the agent's own session id, clipped to 200 bytes like the listing's), `model` (`{id, name}`: the current choice of the option in category `model`, each clipped to 200 bytes; B11 shows it), `hist: true` (the agent has `session/list`; B17) and `undo: "on" | "off"` (`off` = no turn has a restore point and an "undo is off" card is still open: the desktop Changes panel's own rule; B19). `undo` is always written, so a phone tells "on" from an older computer (null). The cut that keeps a header inside one record drops `model` first, then plan, mode, options as before. `MirrorHead` reads them; a V2-2a header reads as "nothing known" (`acp`/`model`/`undo` null, `history` false). The turns undo knows (`AiTurns`, `aiTurnsOf`, `aiUndoOffOf`) move verbatim from the desktop Changes panel to `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart` (new `undo_view.dart`, plus `aiUndoIsOff`), since the header and Task 24 read them; the panel re-exports them, so no desktop caller changes. The hub names `acp_head` in its listings (`AiPhoneHub.offered`).

**The phone (R3).** `AiMachine` gains `protocol`, `can(feature)` and `seen(sid)`: the last listing entry seen for a sid in this run of the app (`AiSeenSessions`: in memory, the newest 200, never logged). `AiSessionController` takes the `WorkspaceRegistry` and holds the machine's AI listing while the page is open — after one `session.list` when the protocol is unknown (a page opened from a notification). It listens to every listing while it holds it and bumps `version` for each (in `_onChange`'s batch): a button gated by `can(...)` (Tasks 11, 13, 15, 18, 25) shows as soon as a listing names its feature. `listing` and `can` serve those tasks.

**B22.** When the session closes `gone` or `desktop_closed` (also the `gone` that ends the client's one re-attach after `unavailable`), the controller looks at every listing for 30 s: exactly one session under another sid with the same `acp`, agent and folder (as the header or the last listing told them) → it lets go of the old link, attaches the new sid, moves the text field's draft to the new key, and the page says "Đã nối lại sau khi ShellX khởi động lại." until the user sends. None or several → the page stays closed and its strip offers "Mở danh sách phiên": the AI chooser (the session picker's AI group alone), whose pick replaces the page. Nothing is ever sent to the session found (V2-2 D13).

**B23** (Review Focus 1). A tapped push whose sid this phone saw in a listing and that the held listing no longer names opens the one session with the same `acp`, agent and folder now, else the machine page; nothing is answered. A sid the phone never saw opens as it is, as in V2-2a: the push carries no `acp` (B25), so the phone cannot tell an old run's sid it never saw from a tab opened while it slept, and sending the main V2-2a push (a new session's permission) to the machine page would be the worse mistake. The page that opens finds out, and B22 takes over. (Task 20 opens pages through the same `NotificationOpener.open`.)

**Scaffolding for later tasks.** `_Header({…, onSubtitle, menu})` (Task 11 passes `onSubtitle`; Tasks 15 and 25 add entries to the `menu:` list `_header` now passes; with neither, the header looks as in V2-2a), `openAiChooser` (Task 22 uses it on the machine list, R10), `showSessionPicker(…, aiOnly:)`, `AiWords.failure(s, 'unsupported')` (R15's code: "Cập nhật ShellX trên máy tính…"). Routes the chooser and `RouterMachineNavigator.showAi` push are keyed by their session (`ValueKey('ai:$agentId/$sid')`): `replace` of a page by another session's page otherwise keeps the old page's state, and so its session (found while testing the chooser).

Cost if wrong: after the computer restarts ShellX the phone shows a closed session (the V2-2a behaviour) — never a prompt or an answer sent to another session.

- [ ] **Step 3: The turns undo knows, in `package:shellx_ai`**

Create `packages/shellx_ai/lib/src/remote/undo_view.dart` (`aiTurnsOf` and `aiUndoOffOf` are the panel's, unchanged):

```dart
import '../model/notices.dart';
import '../model/session_state.dart';
import '../model/timeline.dart';

/// The session's turns that have a restore point: the first, the last (the
/// running one counts), the last finished one; and whether a turn runs.
typedef AiTurns = ({int? first, int? last, int? lastFinished, bool running});

/// V2-1 §4.4: [s]'s turns that have a restore point. Moved here from the
/// desktop's Changes panel for V2-2b, whose phone header (`undo`) and changes
/// (B19) read it too; the panel re-exports it.
AiTurns aiTurnsOf(AiSessionState s) {
  int? first, last, lastFinished;
  for (final item in s.timeline.items) {
    if (item is TurnEndItem && item.checkpoint != null) {
      first ??= item.turn;
      last = item.turn;
      lastFinished = item.turn;
    }
  }
  final running = s.turn;
  if (running != null && running.checkpoint != null) {
    first ??= running.index;
    last = running.index;
  }
  return (
    first: first,
    last: last,
    lastFinished: lastFinished,
    running: running != null,
  );
}

/// Why undo is off right now: the latest "undo is off" card of the
/// conversation that is still open; null when undo works.
UndoUnavailable? aiUndoOffOf(AiSessionState s) {
  final items = s.timeline.items;
  for (var i = items.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    final item = items[i];
    if (item is! NoticeItem || item.resolved) continue;
    final notice = item.notice;
    if (notice is UndoUnavailable) return notice;
  }
  return null;
}

/// V2-2b §4.2 (`undo` of the phone's header): no turn of [s] has a restore
/// point and the conversation says why — the Changes panel's own rule for
/// "undo is off".
bool aiUndoIsOff(AiSessionState s) =>
    aiTurnsOf(s).last == null && aiUndoOffOf(s) != null;
```

```dart
enum AiChangesScope { turn, session }

/// The session's turns that have a restore point: the first, the last (the
/// running one counts), the last finished one; and whether a turn runs.
typedef AiTurns = ({int? first, int? last, int? lastFinished, bool running});

AiTurns aiTurnsOf(AiSessionState s) {

  for (final item in s.timeline.items) {
    if (item is TurnEndItem && item.checkpoint != null) {
      first ??= item.turn;
      last = item.turn;
      lastFinished = item.turn;
    }
  }
  final running = s.turn;
  if (running != null && running.checkpoint != null) {
    first ??= running.index;
    last = running.index;
  }
  return (
    first: first,
    last: last,
    lastFinished: lastFinished,
    running: running != null,
  );
}
```

```dart
/// Why undo is off right now: the latest "undo is off" card of the
/// conversation that is still open; null when undo works.
UndoUnavailable? aiUndoOffOf(AiSessionState s) {
  final items = s.timeline.items;
  for (var i = items.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    final item = items[i];
    if (item is! NoticeItem || item.resolved) continue;
    final notice = item.notice;
    if (notice is UndoUnavailable) return notice;
  }
  return null;
```
```dart
}

/// V2-2b B11: the current model, by id and name — the choice of the option
/// in the `model` category; null when the agent offers none.
Map<String, Object?>? _model(AiSessionState s) {
  for (final o in s.configOptions ?? const <ConfigOption>[]) {
    if (o.category != 'model') continue;
    for (final c in o.choices) {
      if (c.value == o.currentValue) {
        return {'id': clipText(c.value, 200), 'name': clipText(c.name, 200)};
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

```dart
              state: AiRemoteState.idle,
              acpSessionId: 'sess-1',
            ),

        ),
      )
      ..emitListing(const AiListing());

    expect(ai.seen('e.-2'), isNull);
  });
```
