```dart
import 'package:fake_async/fake_async.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_drafts.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';

import '../../support/fakes.dart';

const _sid = 'e.-1';

AiSessionInfo _info(String sid, {String? acp = 'sess-1', String agent = 'claude', String cwd = '/p'}) => AiSessionInfo(
  sid: sid,
  agentId: agent,
  agentName: 'Claude',
  title: 'Nút đăng xuất',
  state: AiRemoteState.idle,
  cwd: cwd,
  acpSessionId: acp,
);

/// V2-2b R3, B1, B22: the session page holds the computer's AI listing, and follows its session to the sid
/// it has after the computer restarted ShellX — exactly one match, within 30 s, nothing sent to it.
void main() {
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late WorkspaceRegistry registry;
  late AiDrafts drafts;

  setUp(() {
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);
    machine = backend.addMachine(agentA);
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    registry = WorkspaceRegistry(session.backend);
    drafts = AiDrafts();
  });

  tearDown(() => registry.dispose());

  AiSessionController make() => AiSessionController(agentA, _sid, session, drafts, registry);

  /// A computer that speaks V2-2b and has listed session [_sid] as `sess-1` in `/p`.
  void known() {
    machine.ai
      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info(_sid)]));
  }

  group('the listing (R3)', () {
    test('a page that came before any list of the computer asks for one, which tells the protocol, and holds '
        'the listing until it closes', () async {
      machine.ai.listedProtocol = 2;
      final controller = make();
      await pumpEventQueue();
      expect(machine.listCalls, 1);
      expect(machine.ai.protocol, 2);
      expect(machine.ai.watching, isTrue);
      controller.dispose();
      expect(machine.ai.watching, isFalse);
      expect(machine.ai.hasListingListener, isFalse);
    });

    test('a computer whose protocol is known is not listed again', () async {
      known();
      final controller = make();
      await pumpEventQueue();
      expect(machine.listCalls, 0);
      expect(machine.ai.watching, isTrue);
      controller.dispose();
    });

    test('a V2-2b feature is on only with protocol 2 and the listing naming it (B1)', () async {
      final controller = make();
      machine.ai
        ..protocolValue = 1
        ..emitListing(const AiListing(features: {AiFeature.config}));
      expect(controller.can(AiFeature.config), isFalse, reason: 'an older background service');
      machine.ai
        ..protocolValue = 2
        ..emitListing(const AiListing());
      expect(controller.can(AiFeature.config), isFalse, reason: 'an older window');
      machine.ai.emitListing(const AiListing(features: {AiFeature.config}));
      expect(controller.can(AiFeature.config), isTrue);
      controller.dispose();
    });

    test('a listing that names a feature arrives later: can() turns true and the page is told (version); after '
        'dispose nothing listens', () async {
      machine.ai.listedProtocol = 2;
      final controller = make();
      final made = controller.version.value;
      await pumpEventQueue();
      expect(controller.version.value, greaterThan(made), reason: 'the protocol, learned from the one list');
      expect(controller.can(AiFeature.config), isFalse);
      final known = controller.version.value;
      machine.ai.emitListing(const AiListing(features: {AiFeature.config}));
      expect(controller.can(AiFeature.config), isTrue);
      expect(controller.version.value, greaterThan(known));
      controller.dispose();
      expect(machine.ai.hasListingListener, isFalse);
    });
  });

  group('found again after the computer restarted ShellX (B22)', () {
    for (final reason in ['gone', 'desktop_closed']) {
      test('closed "$reason": the one session of the same agent session, agent and folder is followed, and the '
          'draft goes with it', () {
        known();
        final controller = make()..keepDraft('còn dở');
        machine.ai.session(_sid)
          ..sync()
          ..close(reason);
        expect(controller.sid, _sid);
        expect(controller.draft, isEmpty, reason: 'over, as long as it is not found again');
        machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
        expect(controller.sid, 'k.-3');
        expect(controller.reattached.value, isTrue);
        expect(controller.linkState, AiLinkState.attaching);
        expect(machine.ai.session(_sid).detached, isTrue, reason: 'the old link is let go');
        machine.ai.session('k.-3').sync();
        expect(controller.linkState, AiLinkState.live);
        expect(controller.draft, 'còn dở');
        expect(drafts.of('$agentA/$_sid'), isEmpty);
        controller.dispose();
        expect(machine.ai.session('k.-3').detached, isTrue);
      });
    }

    test('a page that came from a notification knows the agent session from the header (acp)', () {
      machine.ai.protocolValue = 2;
      final controller = make();
      final ai = machine.ai.session(_sid);
      ai.desktop.setSession('sess-1');
      ai
        ..sync()
        ..close('gone');
      machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
      expect(controller.sid, 'k.-3');
      controller.dispose();
    });

    test('none, or two, of the same agent session: the page stays closed', () {
      known();
      final controller = make();
      machine.ai.session(_sid)
        ..sync()
        ..close('gone');
      machine.ai.emitListing(
        AiListing(
          sessions: [
            _info('k.-3', cwd: '/elsewhere'),
            _info('k.-4', agent: 'codex'),
            _info('k.-5', acp: 'sess-2'),
            _info('k.-6', acp: null),
          ],
        ),
      );
      expect(controller.sid, _sid);
      machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3'), _info('k.-4')]));
      expect(controller.sid, _sid, reason: 'two tabs on one agent session: which one is not known');
      expect(controller.linkState, AiLinkState.closed);
      expect(controller.reattached.value, isFalse);
      controller.dispose();
    });

    test('after 30 s it is not looked for any more', () {
      fakeAsync((async) {
        known();
        final controller = make();
        machine.ai.session(_sid)
          ..sync()
          ..close('desktop_closed');
        async.elapse(AiSessionController.findAgainFor + const Duration(seconds: 1));
        machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
        expect(controller.sid, _sid);
        controller.dispose();
      });
    });

    for (final reason in ['unavailable', 'unreadable']) {
      test('closed "$reason" (it may pass): not looked for', () {
        known();
        final controller = make();
        machine.ai.session(_sid)
          ..sync()
          ..close(reason);
        machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
        expect(controller.sid, _sid);
        controller.dispose();
      });
    }

    test('closed "unavailable", then "gone" once the computer was asked again (another run of ShellX): '
        'followed', () {
      known();
      final controller = make();
      final old = machine.ai.session(_sid)
        ..sync()
        ..close('unavailable');
      machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
      expect(controller.sid, _sid, reason: 'it may pass');
      old.close('gone');
      expect(controller.sid, 'k.-3');
      controller.dispose();
    });

    test('the session found again is only followed: nothing is sent to it; "Đã nối lại" goes once the user '
        'sends', () async {
      known();
      final controller = make();
      machine.ai.session(_sid)
        ..sync()
        ..close('gone');
      machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
      machine.ai.session('k.-3').sync();
      expect(machine.ai.prompts, isEmpty);
      expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
      expect(machine.ai.askAnswers, isEmpty);
      expect(await controller.send('tiếp nhé'), isNull);
      expect(machine.ai.prompts, [('k.-3', 'tiếp nhé')]);
      expect(controller.reattached.value, isFalse);
      controller.dispose();
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
/// V2-2b B22 on the session page: "Đã nối lại sau khi ShellX khởi động lại." once the session is followed
/// to its new sid; "Mở danh sách phiên" on a session closed for good; the header's V2-2b parts stay off.
void main() {

  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;

  setUp(() {
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);

      ..registerSingleton<PopupHandler>(FakePopupHandler())
      ..registerSingleton<SessionHolder>(session)
      ..registerSingleton<ExternalLinks>(FakeExternalLinks())
      ..registerFactoryParam<AiSessionController, String, String>(
        (agentId, sid) => AiSessionController(agentId, sid, session, AiDrafts(), registry),
      );
  });

  tearDown(() async {
    registry.dispose();
    await getIt.reset();
  });

  Future<void> open(WidgetTester tester) async {
    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1170, 2532);
    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3;
    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      routedApp(
        open: () => AiSessionRoute(agentId: agentA, machineName: 'MacBook', sid: _sid),
        routes: [AutoRoute(page: AiSessionRoute.page)],
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
    await tester.pump();
    machine.ai.session(_sid).sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  }

  testWidgets('without V2-2b features the header has no menu and its line is plain text', (tester) async {

      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info(_sid)]));
    await open(tester);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu')), findsNothing);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.status.tap')), findsNothing);
  });

  testWidgets('a listing that arrives after the page opened rebuilds it: "Mở danh sách phiên" shows once the '
      'computer\'s sessions are known', (tester) async {

    await open(tester);
    machine.ai.session(_sid).close('gone');
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.closed')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.openList')), findsNothing, reason: 'no listing yet');
    machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3', acp: 'sess-7')]));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.openList')), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('followed to its new sid after a restart: "Đã nối lại…" until the user sends', (tester) async {
    machine.ai
      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info(_sid)]));
    await open(tester);
    machine.ai.session(_sid).close('desktop_closed');
    await tester.pump();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.closed')), findsOneWidget);
    machine.ai.emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info('k.-3')]));
    machine.ai.session('k.-3').sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.closed')), findsNothing);
    expect(find.text('Đã nối lại sau khi ShellX khởi động lại.'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.enterText(find.byKey(const Key('ai.composer')), 'tiếp nhé');
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.send')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(machine.ai.prompts, [('k.-3', 'tiếp nhé')]);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.reattached')), findsNothing);
  });

  testWidgets('closed for good: "Mở danh sách phiên" offers the computer\'s AI sessions only, and the one '
      'picked takes this page\'s place', (tester) async {
    machine.ai
      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(AiListing(sessions: [_info(_sid)]));
    await open(tester);
    machine.ai.session(_sid).close('gone');
    machine.ai.emitListing(
      AiListing(
        sessions: [_info('k.-3', acp: 'sess-7', title: 'Sửa giỏ hàng')],
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Phiên AI này đã đóng trên máy tính.'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.openList')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Sửa giỏ hàng'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('picker-desktop-hint')), findsNothing, reason: 'AI sessions only');
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('picker-ai-k.-3')));
    // Not pumpAndSettle: the new page shows a spinner until its snapshot arrives.
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
    expect(machine.ai.sessions.containsKey('k.-3'), isTrue, reason: 'the page of k.-3 attached it');
    machine.ai.session('k.-3').sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.openList')), findsNothing);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.back')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('open'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'it took the closed page\'s place');
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';

/// V2-2b B22, B23: the last listing entry of every AI session of one machine seen in this run of the app —
/// what a session was (its agent's own session id, its agent, its folder) once the computer restarted ShellX
/// and gave it another sid. In memory only, never logged; the newest [capacity] sessions.
final class AiSeenSessions {
  static const int capacity = 200;

  final Map<String, AiSessionInfo> _seen = {};

  /// Every session of [listing] is seen as it is now.
  void note(AiListing listing) {
    for (final session in listing.sessions) {
      _seen
        ..remove(session.sid)
        ..[session.sid] = session;
    }
    while (_seen.length > capacity) {
      _seen.remove(_seen.keys.first);
    }
  }

  /// The last entry seen for [sid]; null when none was.
  AiSessionInfo? of(String sid) => _seen[sid];

  int get length => _seen.length;
}
```

```dart
  void emitListing(AiListing listing) {
    supportedValue = true;
    listingValue = listing;
    for (final session in listing.sessions) {
      seenSessions[session.sid] = session;
    }
    _listings.add(listing);
  }

  /// V2-2b B1: the computer's `ai` protocol as the app knows it (null: no list answered yet).
  int? protocolValue;

  /// What the computer's `session.list.result` says (`ai`): a list of the sessions

  /// [protocolValue] and [supportedValue] itself.
  int? listedProtocol;

  /// A list of the machine's sessions came back.
  void noteList() {
    final protocol = listedProtocol;
    if (protocol == null) return;
    protocolValue = protocol;
    supportedValue = protocol >= 1;
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 12: The controller holds the listing and finds its session again (B22)**

Replace the whole of `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart` with the following. V2-2a's members keep their behaviour; what changes: the session id can change (B22), so every request reads `_sid` when it is made; `keepDraft` remembers the text for a session found again; `send` ends "Đã nối lại…"; `_onChange` remembers who the session is and looks for it once it is over; `dispose` lets go of the listing; the listing hold, `_remember`, `_findAgain` and `_followAgain` are new.

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_drafts.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';

/// V2-2 §5.2: one AI session on the phone. It mirrors the session while the
/// page is open (attached when made, detached on [dispose]) and sends only
/// what the user explicitly asked for: nothing is ever answered, or sent again,
/// by itself (V2-2 D13). A request answers its failure code (null: done) so
/// the page can say it ([AiWords.failure]); nothing here is ever logged but
/// error types.
///
/// V2-2b: it holds the computer's AI listing while the page is open (R3: what the computer can do, B1; the
/// sessions it has, B22), and follows its session to its new sid when the computer restarted ShellX (B22).
@injectable
class AiSessionController extends Controller {
  AiSessionController(
    @factoryParam this.agentId,
    @factoryParam String sid,
    SessionHolder session,
    this._drafts,
    this._registry,
  ) : _sid = sid,
      _backend = session.backend.peek() {
    final backend = _backend;
    if (backend == null) {
      _closed.value = true;
      return;
    }
    final MachineSession machine;
    try {
      machine = backend.machine(agentId);
    } on StateError {
      // Not pinned any more: forgotten by an `untrusted` handshake the client ran on its own. The
      // machine says why; the page does not call it "closed on the computer".
      _machineState.value = const MachineFailed(MachineConnectionFailure.untrusted);
      _closed.value = true;
      return;
    }
    _machine = machine;
    _machineState.value = machine.state;
    _machineStates = machine.states.listen((s) => _set(_machineState, s));
    _follow(machine.ai.attach(sid));
    _onChange();
    unawaited(_holdListing(machine));
  }

  /// B22: how long a session closed on the computer is looked for under another sid.
  static const Duration findAgainFor = Duration(seconds: 30);

  final String agentId;
  String _sid;
  final ShellxBackend? _backend;
  final AiDrafts _drafts;
  final WorkspaceRegistry _registry;
  MachineSession? _machine;
  AiSessionHandle? _link;
  StreamSubscription<void>? _changes;
  StreamSubscription<MachineConnectionState>? _machineStates;
  Timer? _tick;
  bool _disposed = false;

  /// The machine's workspace once the page holds its AI listing (R3), and how to let the listing go.
  TerminalWorkspace? _workspace;
  void Function()? _releaseListing;
  StreamSubscription<AiListing>? _listingFeed;

  /// B22: who the session is — the agent's own session id, the agent, the folder — as far as the phone knows.
  String? _acp;
  String? _agent;
  String? _cwd;

  /// B22: the time to find the session again runs; [_findAgainOver] once it ran out.
  Timer? _findAgainTimer;
  bool _findAgainOver = false;

  /// What the text field held last ([keepDraft]): a session found again under another sid keeps it.
  String _lastDraft = '';

  /// The app is on screen (the page tells, see [setForeground]).
  bool _foreground = true;

  /// The answer to a permission or question is on its way (only after it the buttons wait for the
  /// computer).
  bool _answerInFlight = false;

  final Signal<int> _version = signal(0);
  final Signal<bool> _closed = signal(false);
  final Signal<MachineConnectionState> _machineState = signal(const MachineIdle());
  final Signal<bool> _sending = signal(false);
  final Signal<int?> _answering = signal(null);
  final Signal<bool> _stopping = signal(false);
  final Signal<DateTime> _now = signal(DateTime.now());
  final Signal<bool> _reattached = signal(false);

  /// The session shown: the one the page was opened for, or the one it was found again as after the
  /// computer restarted ShellX (B22).
  String get sid => _sid;

  /// The backend the page shows the relay state of; null when signed out.
  ShellxBackend? get backend => _backend;

  /// The machine's AI sessions; null when the page cannot show this session.
  AiMachine? get ai => _machine?.ai;

  /// V2-2b B1 (R3): whether the computer can do [feature] (an [AiFeature]) now.
  bool can(String feature) => _machine?.ai.can(feature) ?? false;

  /// The computer's AI listing as far as it can be trusted (the page holds it while open); null when none
  /// came yet.
  AiListing? get listing => _workspace?.aiListing;

  /// Bumps on every change of the mirror, the link or the listing (read it in a Watch).
  ReadonlySignal<int> get version => _version;

  /// The page cannot show this session (signed out, machine not pinned).
  ReadonlySignal<bool> get closed => _closed;

  /// The state of the machine's channel. The link stays `attaching` while the machine is failed or
  /// untrusted, so this is what says the computer cannot be reached.
  ReadonlySignal<MachineConnectionState> get machineState => _machineState;
  ReadonlySignal<bool> get sending => _sending;

  /// The permission or question being answered, from the tap until the computer's header shows it
  /// gone (its buttons wait), or null.
  ReadonlySignal<int?> get answering => _answering;
  ReadonlySignal<bool> get stopping => _stopping;

  /// Ticks every second while a turn runs on a live link, with the app on screen ("Đang chạy · 0:12").
  ReadonlySignal<DateTime> get now => _now;

  /// B22: the session was found again under another sid after the computer restarted ShellX ("Đã nối lại
  /// sau khi ShellX khởi động lại."), until the user sends something.
  ReadonlySignal<bool> get reattached => _reattached;

  /// What the user left in the text field of this session the last time, empty when nothing (in memory;
  /// see [AiDrafts]). Of this session on this machine: the same id on another computer is another one.
  String get draft => _drafts.of(_draftKey);

  /// The text field now holds [text]. A session that is over for good keeps no draft: a message that was
  /// refused after it closed is not put back — unless the session is found again (B22), which takes it.
  void keepDraft(String text) {
    _lastDraft = text;
    if (_over) return;
    _drafts.keep(_draftKey, text);
  }

  String get _draftKey => '$agentId/$_sid';

  /// The computer dropped the session (`gone`) or ShellX quit there (`desktop_closed`): nothing more will
  /// be said in it. Not `detached` (a page of this phone leaving), `unavailable` or `unreadable`: they may
  /// pass. See [AiWords.closed].
  bool get _over {
    final link = _link;
    return link != null &&
        link.state == AiLinkState.closed &&
        (link.closedReason == 'gone' || link.closedReason == 'desktop_closed');
  }

  /// The app comes to the foreground (true) or goes away from it (false): the page tells, since it is
  /// the page that sees the lifecycle. In the background nothing counts the turn's time (a second tick
  /// wakes the phone for a header nobody sees); coming back sets the clock at once.
  void setForeground(bool value) {
    if (_foreground == value) return;
    _foreground = value;
    _syncTick();
  }

  AiMirror? get mirror => _link?.mirror;
  MirrorHead? get head => _link?.mirror.head;
  AiLinkState get linkState => _link?.state ?? AiLinkState.closed;
  String? get closedReason => _link?.closedReason;

  /// The page's text field may send: live, the computer takes prompts.
  bool get canSend => !_closed.peek() && linkState == AiLinkState.live && (head?.canSend ?? false) && !_sending.peek();

  /// Sends [text] (queued on the computer while a turn runs). Null when
  /// taken; else the failure code. A message that failed on the way may have
  /// landed ([AiWords.outcomeUnknown]): it is never sent again by itself.
  Future<String?> send(String text) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null || text.trim().isEmpty) return 'refused';
    if (_sending.peek()) return AiWords.inFlight;
    _set(_reattached, false);
    _set(_sending, true);
    try {
      await machine.ai.prompt(_sid, text);
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      return _failure(error);
    } finally {
      _set(_sending, false);
    }
  }

  /// The user's pick on the permission panel (V2-1 D10): one explicit tap.
  Future<String?> answerPermission(MirrorPermission permission, PermissionOption option) {
    final sid = _sid;
    return _answer(permission.id, () => _machine!.ai.answerPermission(sid, permission.id, option.optionId));
  }

  /// The user's answer to a question (V2-1 D22).
  Future<String?> answerAsk(int ask, ElicitationResponse response) {
    final sid = _sid;
    return _answer(ask, () => _machine!.ai.answerAsk(sid, ask, response));
  }

  /// Stop the turn (the desktop's Esc).
  Future<String?> stop() async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return 'refused';
    if (_stopping.peek()) return AiWords.inFlight;
    _set(_stopping, true);
    try {
      await machine.ai.cancel(_sid);
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      return _failure(error);
    } finally {
      _set(_stopping, false);
    }
  }

  /// "Dừng hẳn", once the computer offers it.
  Future<String?> forceStop() {
    final sid = _sid;
    return _simple(() => _machine!.ai.forceStop(sid));
  }

  /// Drops queued prompt [id].
  Future<String?> unqueue(int id) {
    final sid = _sid;
    return _simple(() => _machine!.ai.unqueue(sid, id));
  }

  /// "Tải thêm".
  void loadEarlier() => _link?.loadEarlier();

  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    _tick?.cancel();
    _findAgainTimer?.cancel();
    unawaited(_changes?.cancel());
    unawaited(_machineStates?.cancel());
    unawaited(_listingFeed?.cancel());
    _releaseListing?.call();
    _link?.detach();
  }

  /// R3: the page holds the computer's AI listing while it is open — it says what the computer can do
  /// (B1) and which sessions it has (B22). A page opened from a notification has not listed the computer's
  /// sessions yet: it asks once, which also tells the computer's protocol.
  Future<void> _holdListing(MachineSession machine) async {
    if (machine.ai.protocol == null) {
      try {
        await machine.listSessions();
      } catch (error) {
        // Offline, or a handshake that failed: the strips say so; the features stay off until a list answers.
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('AI page list error: ${error.runtimeType}');
      }
    }
    if (_disposed) return;
    final TerminalWorkspace workspace;
    try {
      workspace = _registry.forMachine(agentId);
    } on StateError {
      return; // Not pinned any more: the machine says why.
    }
    _workspace = workspace;
    _releaseListing = workspace.holdAiListing();
    // Every listing tells the page ([version]): a button of a feature ([can]) shows as soon as a listing
    // names it, and the protocol learned above counts at once. Cancelled on [dispose].
    _listingFeed = machine.ai.listings.listen((_) => _onChange());
    _onChange();
  }

  /// An answer is one tap and one request. Once the computer took it, the buttons keep waiting until
  /// its header shows the request gone (or the link is lost, and what it holds then decides), so a
  /// second tap cannot answer the same request again. A failed one lets them work again.
  Future<String?> _answer(int id, Future<void> Function() run) async {
    if (_machine == null) return 'refused';
    if (_answering.peek() != null) return AiWords.inFlight;
    _answerInFlight = true;
    _set(_answering, id);
    try {
      await run();
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      _set(_answering, null);
      return _failure(error);
    } finally {
      _answerInFlight = false;
      _releaseAnswer();
    }
  }

  Future<String?> _simple(Future<void> Function() run) async {
    if (_machine == null) return 'refused';
    try {
      await run();
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      return _failure(error);
    }
  }

  /// The code of a request that failed. The computer's own come with [AiRequestException]. A
  /// [MachineConnectionException] is the channel: lost or silent, the request may have landed
  /// ([AiWords.outcomeUnknown]); a handshake that failed sent nothing, and the machine says why.
  String _failure(Object error) {
    switch (error) {
      case AiRequestException(:final code):
        return code;
      case MachineConnectionException(:final failure):
        return switch (failure) {
          MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline || MachineConnectionFailure.timeout => AiWords.outcomeUnknown,
          MachineConnectionFailure.untrusted => AiWords.untrusted,
          MachineConnectionFailure.protocolUnsupported => AiWords.updateRequired,
        };
      default:
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('AI request error: ${error.runtimeType}');
        return AiWords.error;
    }
  }

  bool _stillAsking(int id) => head?.permission?.id == id || head?.ask?.id == id;

  /// Lets the buttons of an answer work again once the computer has moved on, or the link was lost.
  void _releaseAnswer() {
    final id = _answering.peek();
    if (id == null || _answerInFlight) return;
    if (!_stillAsking(id) || linkState != AiLinkState.live) _set(_answering, null);
  }

  /// Mirrors [link], and tells [_onChange] of each change of it.
  void _follow(AiSessionHandle link) {
    unawaited(_changes?.cancel());
    _link = link;
    _changes = link.changes.listen((_) => _onChange());
  }

  void _onChange() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    // Two pages of the same session share one link while it is open, and leaving one detaches it: the
    // page that stays takes a fresh link rather than show a session closed that is not.
    final link = _link;
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine != null && link != null && link.state == AiLinkState.closed && link.closedReason == 'detached') {
      _follow(machine.ai.attach(_sid));
    }
    _remember();
    _syncTick();
    if (_over) {
      // A session that is over takes its draft with it (the drafts are bounded, but need not hold this one).
      _drafts.keep(_draftKey, '');
      _findAgain();
    }
    batch(() {
      _releaseAnswer();
      _version.value++;
    });
  }

  /// B22: who this session is, so that it can be found again under another sid. The listing says it the
  /// way it says every session (the folder cut as it cuts it); the header (V2-2b `acp`) knows the agent's
  /// session id even when the page came from a notification and no listing named the session yet.
  void _remember() {
    final seen = _machine?.ai.seen(_sid);
    final head = _link?.mirror.head;
    _acp = head?.acp ?? seen?.acpSessionId ?? _acp;
    _agent = seen?.agentId ?? (head == null || head.agentId.isEmpty ? null : head.agentId) ?? _agent;
    _cwd = seen?.cwd ?? head?.cwd ?? _cwd;
  }

  /// B22: the computer closed the session (`gone`, `desktop_closed`); after ShellX restarted there its tab
  /// may be back under another sid. For [findAgainFor] every listing is looked at: exactly one session of
  /// the same agent session, agent and folder is this one, and the page follows it; none or several, and
  /// the page stays closed (with "Mở danh sách phiên"). Never more than following: nothing is sent to it.
  void _findAgain() {
    if (_findAgainOver) return;
    _findAgainTimer ??= Timer(findAgainFor, () => _findAgainOver = true);
    final machine = _machine;
    final acp = _acp;
    final held = listing;
    if (machine == null || acp == null || held == null || !held.available) return;
    final matches = [
      for (final s in held.sessions)
        if (s.sid != _sid && s.acpSessionId == acp && s.agentId == _agent && s.cwd == _cwd) s,
    ];
    if (matches.length != 1) return;
    _followAgain(machine, matches.single.sid);
  }

  /// B22: the page shows [newSid] from now on; the text field's draft goes with it.
  void _followAgain(MachineSession machine, String newSid) {
    final old = _link;
    unawaited(_changes?.cancel());
    _changes = null;
    old?.detach(); // closed already: only let go
    _sid = newSid;
    _findAgainTimer?.cancel();
    _findAgainTimer = null;
    _findAgainOver = false;
    _follow(machine.ai.attach(newSid));
    if (_lastDraft.trim().isNotEmpty) _drafts.keep(_draftKey, _lastDraft);
    _set(_reattached, true);
  }

  /// The turn's clock runs while a turn runs on a link that is live, with the app on screen. After a
  /// loss nothing is known of the turn (it may have ended long ago), a closed link has none, and the
  /// background has nobody to look at it.
  void _syncTick() {
    final counting = !_disposed && _foreground && linkState == AiLinkState.live && head?.turn != null;
    if (counting && _tick == null) {
      _set(_now, DateTime.now()); // the time since the turn began is read at once, not a second later
      _tick = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) => _set(_now, DateTime.now()));
    } else if (!counting) {
      _tick?.cancel();
      _tick = null;
    }
  }

  void _set<T>(Signal<T> s, T value) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    s.value = value;
  }
}
```

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_chooser.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_new_session_sheet.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/widgets/session_picker.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// V2-2b B21, B22: the computer's AI sessions to pick from — the session picker's AI group alone, with
/// "Phiên AI mới" when the computer can start one (V2-2 D9) — from [listing]. The session picked, or the
/// new one, opens over this page, or in its place with [replace] (a closed session's page, B22). A new
/// session that may or may not have been made says so, as the terminal page does: nothing is asked again
/// by itself (V2-2 D13).
Future<void> openAiChooser(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String agentId,
  required String machineName,
  required AiMachine ai,
  required AiListing listing,
  bool replace = false,
}) async {
  final choice = await showSessionPicker(
    context,
    SessionListing(const [], desktopSharing: null, aiSupported: true, ai: listing),
    aiOnly: true,
  );
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  final String sid;
  switch (choice) {
    case OpenAiSession(:final session):
      sid = session.sid;
    case NewAiSession():
      final picked = await showAiNewSessionSheet(context, listing);
      if (picked == null || !context.mounted) return;
      String? made;
      String? code;
      try {
        made = await ai.open(picked.agent, picked.folder);
      } on AiRequestException catch (e) {
        code = e.code;
      } on MachineConnectionException catch (e) {
        code = switch (e.failure) {
          MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline || MachineConnectionFailure.timeout => AiWords.openUnknown,
          MachineConnectionFailure.untrusted => AiWords.untrusted,
          MachineConnectionFailure.protocolUnsupported => AiWords.updateRequired,
        };
      }
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      if (made == null) {
        final text = AiWords.failure(S.of(context), code ?? 'refused');
        if (text != null) getIt<PopupHandler>().showError(title: text);
        return;
      }
      sid = made;
    case AttachSession() || OpenNewSession() || null:
      return;
  }
  // Keyed by its session: a page that takes the place of another session's page is a new page (the
  // router would otherwise keep the old one's state, and so its session).
  final route = AiSessionRoute(key: ValueKey('ai:$agentId/$sid'), agentId: agentId, machineName: machineName, sid: sid);
  // Each completes when the page closes: not awaited.
  unawaited(replace ? context.router.replace(route) : context.router.push(route));
}
```

```dart
  Widget _strips(BuildContext context) {

    return Column(
```

```dart
/// V2-2b: one entry of the header's "⋯" menu (B17 "Lịch sử phiên", B20 "Thay đổi").
typedef AiHeaderAction = ({Key key, String label, VoidCallback onTap});

class _Header extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Header({
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.state,
    required this.onBack,
    // Task 11 passes it ("Chế độ và model").
    // ignore: unused_element_parameter
    this.onSubtitle,
    this.menu = const [],
  });

  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final AiRemoteState? state;
  final VoidCallback onBack;

  /// V2-2b B11: the subtitle opens "Chế độ và model"; null: it is plain text.
  final VoidCallback? onSubtitle;

  /// V2-2b B17, B20: the "⋯" menu; none when empty.
  final List<AiHeaderAction> menu;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.colors;
    final dot = switch (state) {
      AiRemoteState.needsInput => colors.warn,
      AiRemoteState.running || AiRemoteState.starting => colors.link,
      AiRemoteState.failed => colors.error,
      _ => colors.secondaryText,
    };
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 4, 12, 6),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          IconButton(
            key: const Key('ai.back'),
            tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
            icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, color: colors.primary),
            onPressed: onBack,
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  title,
                  key: const Key('ai.title'),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: context.typo.subHeader.bold.copyWith(color: colors.primaryText),
                ),
                2.sizedHeight,
                _subtitleRow(context, dot),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (menu.isNotEmpty)
            PopupMenuButton<int>(
              key: const Key('ai.menu'),
              icon: Icon(Icons.more_horiz, color: colors.primary),
              onSelected: (i) => menu[i].onTap(),
              itemBuilder: (context) => [
                for (final (i, action) in menu.indexed)
                  PopupMenuItem<int>(key: action.key, value: i, child: Text(action.label)),
              ],
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _subtitleRow(BuildContext context, Color dot) {
    final colors = context.colors;
    final row = Row(
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 8,
          height: 8,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: dot, shape: BoxShape.circle),
        ),
        6.sizedWidth,
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            subtitle,
            key: const Key('ai.status'),
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(
              color: state == AiRemoteState.needsInput ? colors.warn : colors.secondaryText,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (onSubtitle != null) Icon(Icons.expand_more, size: 16, color: colors.secondaryText),
      ],
    );
    final tap = onSubtitle;
    if (tap == null) return row;
    // At least 44 points under the finger: the whole line is the button.
    return InkWell(
      key: const Key('ai.status.tap'),
      onTap: tap,
      child: ConstrainedBox(constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 44), child: row),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B23: what AI session [sid] of [agentId] is now. A sid this phone saw in a listing of the
  /// machine (in this run of the app) that the listing held now no longer names is of a previous run of
  /// ShellX on the computer (or of a tab closed since): the one session of the same agent session, agent
  /// and folder it was seen with, else null (none, or several: the machine's page). Any other sid is
  /// itself: named by the listing, newer than the listing the phone holds (a tab opened while the phone
  /// slept), or one nothing can tell about (no listing held, no window serving AI) — the page finds out,
  /// and B22 follows it.
  String? _aiSessionNow(String agentId, String sid) {
    final TerminalWorkspace workspace;
    try {
      workspace = _registry.forMachine(agentId);
    } on StateError {
      return sid;
    }
    final listing = workspace.aiListing;
    if (listing == null || !listing.available || listing.sessions.any((s) => s.sid == sid)) return sid;
    final was = workspace.machine.ai.seen(sid);
    if (was == null) return sid;
    final acp = was.acpSessionId;
    if (acp == null) return null;
    final now = [
      for (final s in listing.sessions)
        if (s.acpSessionId == acp && s.agentId == was.agentId && s.cwd == was.cwd) s,
    ];
    return now.length == 1 ? now.single.sid : null;
  }
```

### Task 7: Relay: `category` and `tag` on `POST /v1/notifications` (branch `v2-2b-relay`)

Spec B6, §4.3. An agent may now ask, for one push, for a notification **category** (only `ai_perm`: iOS shows the buttons the app registered for an AI permission request) and a **tag** (`^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$`: Android's `notification.tag`, so the app can put a notification with buttons in the place of the one the system drew). Anything else in either key is `400 bad_request` and nothing is sent. FCM gets `apns.payload.aps.category` and `android.notification.tag`; the `notification` block stays, so an older phone — or a phone whose app never runs — shows the same notification as today, and no per-phone capability is needed. An older relay ignores both keys (`readJsonObject` only checks the body is an object), so the desktop of Task 8 and the phones of Tasks 20–21 work with today's relay too: there are just no buttons until this lands.

**This task touches only `relay/**` and is committed on its own branch, `v2-2b-relay`.** Any push to `main` that touches `relay/**` (or `web/**`) runs `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: it builds the image (every relay test), pushes it and rolls it out on the production VPS. The implementer never merges or pushes this branch; the controller keeps it apart until the user approves a production deploy (R13: the privacy pages of Task 26 go on the same branch). *Cost if wrong:* none for users until it is deployed; then old phones see no change, new phones get buttons.

**Files:**
- Modify: `relay/src/routes/notifications.ts` (whole file below)
- Modify: `relay/src/push/fcm.ts` (`PushMessage`, the FCM message in `FcmClient.send`)
- Modify: `relay/README.md` ("Push notifications", the `POST /v1/notifications` bullet)
- Test: `relay/test/notifications.test.ts`, `relay/test/fcm.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing of other tasks (self-contained).
- Produces (relay API, consumed by Task 8's `ShellxApi.sendNotification(…, category:, tag:)` and by the phones of Tasks 20–21 through FCM):
  - `POST /v1/notifications {title, body, data?, category?, tag?}`; `category ∈ NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES = ["ai_perm"]`, `tag` matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$`; `null` counts as absent; anything else → `400 bad_request`.
  - `interface PushMessage { token; title; body; data; category?: string; tag?: string }` (`relay/src/push/fcm.ts`).
  - FCM HTTP v1 message (spec §4.3): `{token, notification: {title, body}, data, android: {priority: "high", notification?: {tag}}, apns: {payload: {aps: {sound: "default", category?}}}}`; without category and tag exactly today's shape.

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the route**

Replace the whole of `relay/src/routes/notifications.ts` with:

```ts
import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { AppEnv } from "../app.js";
import { requireAuth } from "../auth/session.js";
import { TOKEN_IDLE_TTL_MS } from "../auth/tokens.js";
import { jsonBodyLimit } from "../http/body-limit.js";
import { Errors, readJsonObject } from "../http/errors.js";
import { logMeta } from "../log.js";

export const NOTIFICATION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS = 200;
export const NOTIFICATION_BODY_MAX_CHARS = 1000;
export const NOTIFICATION_DATA_MAX_KEYS = 10;
export const NOTIFICATION_DATA_VALUE_MAX_CHARS = 256;
/**
 * FCM refuses messages over 4096 bytes of payload; title + body + data keys and values (UTF-8)
 * stay under this, leaving room for `agent_id` and the rest of the message (a category and a tag
 * below included: at most 7 + 64 bytes).
 */
export const NOTIFICATION_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 3584;
/**
 * V2-2b B6: the categories a phone registers buttons for — iOS shows them when `aps.category` names
 * one. `ai_perm`: an AI agent's permission request ("Từ chối" / "Cho phép").
 */
export const NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES: readonly string[] = ["ai_perm"];
/** V2-2b B6: an Android notification tag (a notification with the same tag takes its place). */
const TAG = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$/;
const DATA_KEY = /^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$/;
const LONE_SURROGATE = /[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/;

/** False for a string with a lone UTF-16 surrogate (it has no UTF-8 form; FCM would refuse it). */
function isWellFormed(text: string): boolean {
  return !LONE_SURROGATE.test(text);
}

function utf8Bytes(text: string): number {
  return Buffer.byteLength(text, "utf8");
}

/**
 * Keys FCM refuses in `data` with INVALID_ARGUMENT — which would make the relay delete the phone's
 * token — so they are refused here with 400 instead. `agent_id` is set by the relay itself.
 */
function isReservedDataKey(key: string): boolean {
  return ["from", "notification", "message_type", "collapse_key", "agent_id"].includes(key) || /^(google|gcm)/i.test(key);
}

function codePoints(text: string): number {
  return [...text].length;
}

function parseData(value: unknown): Record<string, string> | null {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return {};
  if (typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);
  if (entries.length > NOTIFICATION_DATA_MAX_KEYS) return null;
  const data: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, item] of entries) {
    if (!DATA_KEY.test(key) || isReservedDataKey(key) || typeof item !== "string") return null;
    if (!isWellFormed(item) || codePoints(item) > NOTIFICATION_DATA_VALUE_MAX_CHARS) return null;
    data[key] = item;
  }
  return data;
}

/**
 * V2-2b B6: an optional string of the body that must pass [valid]: undefined when it is absent (or
 * null), null when it is there and does not pass (the request is refused).
 */
function parseOptional(value: unknown, valid: (text: string) => boolean): string | undefined | null {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return undefined;
  return typeof value === "string" && valid(value) ? value : null;
}

interface Recipient {
  device_id: string;
  token: string;
}

export const notificationRoutes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

/**
 * POST /v1/notifications {title, body, data?, category?, tag?} — agents only (push spec §5). Sends one
 * push to every phone of the account that has a pairing record with this agent, a push token and a live
 * sign-in. `data` (at most 10 keys `[a-z0-9_]{1,64}`, string values ≤ 256 characters) is passed through
 * with `agent_id` added by the relay. V2-2b B6: `category` (one of [NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES]) makes iOS
 * show that category's buttons, `tag` (1..64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]`) is the Android notification's tag;
 * both are optional, anything else in them is 400, and the notification itself is sent as before.
 * Answers `202 {sent}` once FCM has answered for every phone; tokens FCM reports as gone are deleted.
 * 503 `push_unavailable` when the relay has no Firebase configuration; 429 past 120 per agent per
 * hour (N10). 400 for anything FCM would refuse as a payload error (too large — title, body and
 * data over 3.5 KB of UTF-8 —, lone surrogates), so such a request never reaches FCM and never costs
 * a phone its token. Neither the content nor the tokens are ever logged.
 */
notificationRoutes.post("/", requireAuth, jsonBodyLimit, async (c) => {
  const auth = c.get("auth");
  if (auth.kind !== "agent") throw Errors.agentOnly();
  const push = c.get("push");
  if (push === null) throw Errors.pushUnavailable();
  if (!(await c.get("limiters").notifyAgent.limit(auth.deviceId))) throw Errors.rateLimited();
  const body = await readJsonObject(c.req.raw);
  const { title, body: text } = body;
  if (typeof title !== "string" || title.trim() === "" || codePoints(title) > NOTIFICATION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS) throw Errors.badRequest();
  if (typeof text !== "string" || text.trim() === "" || codePoints(text) > NOTIFICATION_BODY_MAX_CHARS) throw Errors.badRequest();
  if (!isWellFormed(title) || !isWellFormed(text)) throw Errors.badRequest();
  const data = parseData(body.data);
  if (data === null) throw Errors.badRequest();
  const category = parseOptional(body.category, (value) => NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES.includes(value));
  const tag = parseOptional(body.tag, (value) => TAG.test(value));
  if (category === null || tag === null) throw Errors.badRequest();
  const payloadBytes =
    utf8Bytes(title) + utf8Bytes(text) + Object.entries(data).reduce((n, [k, v]) => n + utf8Bytes(k) + utf8Bytes(v), 0);
  if (payloadBytes > NOTIFICATION_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) throw Errors.badRequest();

  const db = c.get("db");
  const recipients = db.all<Recipient>(
    `SELECT pt.device_id, pt.token
       FROM pairings p
       JOIN devices d ON d.id = p.mobile_id AND d.user_id = ? AND d.kind = 'mobile'
       JOIN push_tokens pt ON pt.device_id = p.mobile_id
      WHERE p.agent_id = ?
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tokens t WHERE t.device_id = d.id AND t.last_used_at >= ?)`,
    auth.userId,
    auth.deviceId,
    c.get("now")() - TOKEN_IDLE_TTL_MS,
  );
  const message = {
    title,
    body: text,
    data: { ...data, agent_id: auth.deviceId },
    ...(category === undefined ? {} : { category }),
    ...(tag === undefined ? {} : { tag }),
  };
  const results = await Promise.all(recipients.map((r) => push.send({ ...message, token: r.token })));
  let sent = 0;
  let removed = 0;
  results.forEach((result, i) => {
    if (result === "ok") sent++;
    if (result === "invalid_token") {
      const r = recipients[i]!;
      removed += db.run("DELETE FROM push_tokens WHERE device_id = ? AND token = ?", r.device_id, r.token).changes;
    }
  });
  logMeta("notification", { device_id: auth.deviceId, recipients: recipients.length, sent, tokens_removed: removed });
  return c.json({ sent }, 202);
});
```

(Only the doc comments, `NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES`, `TAG`, `parseOptional`, the two lines that read `category`/`tag` and the `message` literal change; the rest is the file as it was.)

### Task 8: The desktop asks for pushes with answer buttons

Spec B7 (and B6's data, §4.3), Review Focus 5. When a session starts to need the user for a **permission** request, the push the hub asks for now carries that request's id and the two answers its buttons may give:

- **allow** = the first `allow_once` option that does **not** turn on a mode acting without asking (`aiOptionEnablesNoApproval`);
- **reject** = the first `reject_once` option;
- never `allow_always` / `reject_always` (they change what happens next, against D13's "never remember");
- missing either, or an id that would not fit a push data value (1..256 characters), or a tag that would not pass the relay's rule → the plain push of V2-2a, with no answer data;
- a question never has buttons (its push never says what it asks, M2).

`AgentNotifications.aiNotice` then adds `perm`, `allow`, `reject` to `data` (5 keys, the relay adds `agent_id`: under the 10-key cap) and asks for `category: "ai_perm"` and the request's tag `ai-<epoch>-<pane>-<perm>` (`ai-k3f9za--12-41` for `k3f9za.-12`, request 41). `ShellxApi.sendNotification` sends both keys; a relay older than Task 7 ignores them, so the data still reaches the phone and only the buttons are missing. Through the background service the window's `ai.push` carries the three new fields; a V2-2a service reads none of them and sends the plain push. The rule that recognises a no-approval mode moves from the desktop to `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart` so the hub (pure Dart, `shellx_agent`) can use it; the desktop keeps its import path through a re-export. The listing names `push_answer` (`AiFeature.pushAnswer`); the phone does not need it to answer (the push data itself says the push can be answered), it tells that this window's pushes carry their answers.

Nothing new leaves the encrypted channel but an integer id, two option ids and a tag (B25); the request ids are unique for the window's run (Task 1, B3), so an id never names another runtime's request.

```dart
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

PermissionOption _option(String id, PermissionKind kind) =>
    PermissionOption(optionId: id, name: id, kind: kind);

/// V2-1 D11, R6, V2-2b B7: the rule for a mode that lets an agent act without
/// asking, where the phone hub reads it (the desktop keeps its own, fuller
/// tests of it through its re-export).
void main() {
  test('every agent\'s word for it, and the words nobody listed that say '
      'it, with any mark between them', () {
    for (final id in [
      'bypassPermissions',
      'full-access',
      'danger-full-access',
      'yolo',
      'clearAndBypass',
      'YOLO-mode',
      'skip:permissions',
      'allow-all-tools',
      'auto approve',
      'dangerously-skip-permissions',
      'full access',
    ]) {
      expect(aiIsNoApprovalMode(id), isTrue, reason: id);
    }
  });

  test('the everyday modes and values do not match; only text can be one', () {
    for (final id in [
      'default',
      'acceptEdits',
      'plan',
      'auto',
      'auto_edit',
      'read-only',
      'workspace-write',
      'opus',
      '',
    ]) {
      expect(aiIsNoApprovalMode(id), isFalse, reason: id);
    }
    expect(aiIsNoApprovalMode(null), isFalse);
    expect(aiIsNoApprovalMode(true), isFalse);
  });

  test('a switch named like one turns it on only when it is on', () {
    expect(aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: 'yolo', value: true), isTrue);
    expect(aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: 'yolo', value: false), isFalse);
    expect(
      aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: 'mode', value: 'bypassPermissions'),
      isTrue,
    );
    expect(aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: 'model', value: 'opus'), isFalse);
  });

  test('a permission answer turns it on when it is no reject and names such '
      'a mode', () {
    expect(
      aiOptionEnablesNoApproval(
        _option('bypassPermissions', PermissionKind.allowOnce),
      ),
      isTrue,
    );
    expect(
      aiOptionEnablesNoApproval(
        _option('bypassPermissions', PermissionKind.rejectOnce),
      ),
      isFalse,
    );
    expect(
      aiOptionEnablesNoApproval(_option('allow', PermissionKind.allowOnce)),
      isFalse,
    );
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:fake_async/fake_async.dart';
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_agent/shellx_agent.dart';

import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import '../support/ai_rig.dart';

const _phone = 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';

/// A permission request with [options], as `(optionId, kind)`.
PermissionRequest _perm(List<(String, String)> options) =>
    PermissionRequest.fromJson({
      'sessionId': 's',
      'toolCall': {'toolCallId': 'c1', 'title': 'Sửa src/main.ts'},
      'options': [
        for (final (id, kind) in options)
          {'optionId': id, 'name': id, 'kind': kind},
      ],
    });

/// The one push of a permission with [options], in a session nobody shows.
AiPush _pushFor(List<(String, String)> options) {
  late AiPush push;
  fakeAsync((async) {
    final pushes = <AiPush>[];
    final rig = HubRig(pushes: pushes, clock: () => aiT0.add(async.elapsed));
    rig.source.add(-1)
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], aiT0)
      ..addPermission(_perm(options), aiT0);
    push = pushes.single;
  });
  return push;
}

/// V2-2b B7: the push of a permission request carries the two answers its
/// buttons give — never one that turns on a mode acting without asking, never
/// an "always" one — and a question's push has none.
void main() {
  test('a permission\'s push carries its id, the first "allow once" and the '
      'first "reject once", and the tag of the request', () {
    fakeAsync((async) {
      final pushes = <AiPush>[];
      final rig = HubRig(pushes: pushes, clock: () => aiT0.add(async.elapsed));
      final s = rig.source.add(-1)..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], aiT0);
      final p = s.addPermission(
        _perm([
          ('always', 'allow_always'),
          ('allow', 'allow_once'),
          ('reject', 'reject_once'),
          ('never', 'reject_always'),
        ]),
        aiT0,
      );
      final push = pushes.single;
      expect(
        (push.permission, push.allow, push.reject),
        (p.id, 'allow', 'reject'),
      );
      expect(push.tag, 'ai-ep--1-${p.id}');
      expect(push.answerable, isTrue);
      expect('$push', '…');
    });
  });

  test('the allow button is never an answer that turns on a mode acting '
      'without asking (Review Focus 5)', () {
    expect(
      _pushFor([
        ('bypassPermissions', 'allow_once'),
        ('allow', 'allow_once'),
        ('reject', 'reject_once'),
      ]).allow,
      'allow',
    );
    for (final options in [
      [('bypassPermissions', 'allow_once'), ('reject', 'reject_once')],
      [('yolo-mode', 'allow_once'), ('reject', 'reject_once')],
      [
        ('Allow, and skip:permissions', 'allow_once'),
        ('reject', 'reject_once'),
      ],
    ]) {
      final push = _pushFor(options);
      expect(
        (push.permission, push.allow, push.reject, push.answerable),
        (null, null, null, false),
        reason: '$options',
      );
      expect(push.detail, 'Sửa src/main.ts', reason: 'still the plain push');
    }
  });

  test('without an "allow once" and a "reject once" that fit the push data, '
      'the push has no buttons: never an "always" answer', () {
    for (final options in [
      [('always', 'allow_always'), ('reject', 'reject_once')],
      [('allow', 'allow_once'), ('never', 'reject_always')],
      [('allow', 'allow_once')],
      [('allow', 'allow_once'), ('r' * 257, 'reject_once')],
      [('', 'allow_once'), ('reject', 'reject_once')],
    ]) {
      final push = _pushFor(options);
      expect(push.answerable, isFalse, reason: '$options');
      expect(push.permission, isNull, reason: '$options');
    }
    // 256 characters, not bytes, still fit.
    expect(
      _pushFor([
        ('é' * 256, 'allow_once'),
        ('reject', 'reject_once'),
      ]).answerable,
      isTrue,
    );
  });

  test('a question\'s push never has buttons', () {
    fakeAsync((async) {
      final pushes = <AiPush>[];
      final rig = HubRig(pushes: pushes, clock: () => aiT0.add(async.elapsed));
      rig.source.add(-1)
        ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], aiT0)
        ..addAsk(
          ElicitationRequest.fromJson({
            'mode': 'form',
            'message': 'Which?',
            'requestedSchema': {
              'type': 'object',
              'properties': {
                'pick': {'type': 'string'},
              },
            },
          }),
        );
      final push = pushes.single;
      expect(
        (push.question, push.permission, push.tag, push.answerable),
        (true, null, null, false),
      );
    });
  });

  test('the background service gets the answers in ai.push; an older one, '
      'which does not read them, sends the push without buttons', () {
    const push = AiPush(
      kind: AiPushKind.needsInput,
      agentName: 'Claude',
      sid: 'ep.-1',
      detail: 'Sửa a.ts',
      permission: 7,
      allow: 'allow',
      reject: 'reject',
    );
    final fields = push.toFields();
    expect(
      (fields['perm'], fields['allow'], fields['reject']),
      (7, 'allow', 'reject'),
    );
    final back = AiPush.fromFields(fields)!;
    expect(
      (back.permission, back.allow, back.reject, back.tag),
      (7, 'allow', 'reject', 'ai-ep--1-7'),
    );
    // What a V2-2a service makes of the same fields: it reads none of them.
    final older = AiPush.fromFields(
      {...fields}
        ..remove('perm')
        ..remove('allow')
        ..remove('reject'),
    )!;
    expect((older.permission, older.answerable), (null, false));
    // Half of them is none of them.
    expect(
      AiPush.fromFields({...fields}..remove('reject'))!.answerable,
      isFalse,
    );
    expect(AiPush.fromFields({...fields, 'perm': '7'})!.permission, isNull);
    // A push without answers writes none of the keys.
    expect(
      const AiPush(
        kind: AiPushKind.done,
        agentName: 'Claude',
        sid: 'ep.-1',
      ).toFields().keys,
      isNot(contains('perm')),
    );
  });

  test('through the background service the push keeps its answers', () {
    final pushes = <AiPush>[];
    final forwarder = MuxAiForwarder(onPush: pushes.add);
    final window = Object();
    forwarder.serve(window, (_) {});
    const push = AiPush(
      kind: AiPushKind.needsInput,
      agentName: 'Claude',
      sid: 'ep.-1',
      permission: 7,
      allow: 'allow',
      reject: 'reject',
    );
    forwarder.fromUi(
      window,
      MuxMessage(MuxType.aiPush, fields: push.toFields()),
    );
    expect(
      (pushes.single.permission, pushes.single.allow, pushes.single.reject),
      (7, 'allow', 'reject'),
    );
  });

  test(
    'the tag is in the relay\'s shape, or there is none (and no button)',
    () {
      AiPush withSid(String sid) => AiPush(
        kind: AiPushKind.needsInput,
        agentName: 'Claude',
        sid: sid,
        permission: 41,
        allow: 'a',
        reject: 'r',
      );
      expect(withSid('k3f9za.-12').tag, 'ai-k3f9za--12-41');
      expect(withSid('bad sid').tag, isNull);
      expect(withSid('bad sid').answerable, isFalse);
      expect(withSid('${'k' * 60}.-1').tag, isNull); // over 64 characters
    },
  );

  test('the listing says the window\'s pushes carry their answers', () {
    final rig = HubRig()..source.add(-1);
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, const AiList());
    final r = rig.last<AiListResult>(_phone);
    expect(
      AiListing.fromJson(decodeBody(r.body)!, available: r.available).features,
      contains(AiFeature.pushAnswer),
    );
  });
}
```

In `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/ai/ai_phone_hub.dart`:

(a) Right after the line `enum AiPushKind { needsInput, done }` insert:

```dart

/// V2-2b B6: the notification category whose buttons ("Từ chối" / "Cho
/// phép") the phone shows for an AI permission request.
const String kAiPermissionCategory = 'ai_perm';

/// V2-2b B7: the longest option id a push carries as data (the relay's limit
/// on a data value, in characters).
const int kAiPushValueChars = 256;
```

(b) Replace the whole class `AiPush` — from `final class AiPush with Redacted {` to its closing `}` (its doc comment above it stays) — with:

```dart
final class AiPush with Redacted {
  const AiPush({
    required this.kind,
    required this.agentName,
    required this.sid,
    this.detail,
    this.question = false,
    this.turn,
    this.elapsed,
    this.permission,
    this.allow,
    this.reject,
  });

  final AiPushKind kind;
  final String agentName;
  final String sid;

  /// The permission the agent waits for ("Sửa src/main.ts"), in clear
  /// through the push service like a command line (N3).
  final String? detail;

  /// The agent waits for the answer to a question: the push says only that
  /// it asks. Its words are the agent's own and may quote a file, so they
  /// never leave the encrypted channel (as ruled after review, M2).
  final bool question;
  final int? turn;
  final Duration? elapsed;

  /// V2-2b B7: the permission request the push is about (its id, one of the
  /// window's run, B3) and the two answers its buttons give: an "allow once"
  /// and a "reject once" option id ([aiPushChoices]). All three, or none.
  final int? permission;
  final String? allow;
  final String? reject;

  static final _tagPattern = RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$');

  /// V2-2b B7: the notification's tag, `ai-<epoch>-<pane>-<request>` (the
  /// session id with `-` for its dot): what the Android app puts its
  /// notification with buttons in the place of. Null without a [permission],
  /// or when it would not be 1..64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]` (the relay's rule: a
  /// tag it refuses would cost the whole push).
  String? get tag {
    final id = permission;
    if (id == null) return null;
    final tag = 'ai-${sid.replaceAll('.', '-')}-$id';
    return _tagPattern.hasMatch(tag) ? tag : null;
  }

  /// The push may carry answer buttons: a [permission], two option ids of
  /// 1..[kAiPushValueChars] characters, and a [tag].
  bool get answerable =>
      permission != null && _fits(allow) && _fits(reject) && tag != null;

  static bool _fits(String? id) =>
      id != null && id.isNotEmpty && id.runes.length <= kAiPushValueChars;

  /// For `ai.push` (window → background service). `question`, `perm`,
  /// `allow` and `reject` are later keys: an older service skips them —
  /// without a detail it says only "needs your answer", without the answers
  /// it sends the push without buttons.
  Map<String, Object?> toFields() => {
    'kind': kind.name,
    'name': agentName,
    'sid': sid,
    'detail': ?detail,
    if (question) 'question': true,
    'turn': ?turn,
    if (elapsed != null) 'ms': elapsed!.inMilliseconds,
    if (permission != null && allow != null && reject != null) ...{
      'perm': permission,
      'allow': allow,
      'reject': reject,
    },
  };

  static AiPush? fromFields(Map<String, Object?> f) {
    final kind = AiPushKind.values
        .where((k) => k.name == f['kind'])
        .firstOrNull;
    final name = f['name'];
    final sid = f['sid'];
    if (kind == null || name is! String || sid is! String) return null;
    final detail = f['detail'];
    final turn = f['turn'];
    final ms = f['ms'];
    final perm = f['perm'];
    final allow = f['allow'];
    final reject = f['reject'];
    // All three, or none of them.
    final answers = perm is int && allow is String && reject is String;
    return AiPush(
      kind: kind,
      agentName: name,
      sid: sid,
      detail: detail is String ? detail : null,
      question: f['question'] == true,
      turn: turn is int ? turn : null,
      elapsed: ms is int ? Duration(milliseconds: ms) : null,
      permission: answers ? perm : null,
      allow: answers ? allow : null,
      reject: answers ? reject : null,
    );
  }
}
```

(c) Right after that class (before `typedef AiPushSink = void Function(AiPush push);`) insert:

```dart

/// V2-2b B7: the two answers the push of permission [p] may offer as
/// buttons — the first "allow once" that turns on no mode acting without
/// asking ([aiOptionEnablesNoApproval]) and the first "reject once" — or
/// null, for a push without buttons, when either is missing or an id would
/// not fit the push's data (1..[kAiPushValueChars] characters). Never an
/// "always" answer: it changes what happens next, which is no button's to do
/// (V2-2 D13).
({String allow, String reject})? aiPushChoices(PendingPermission p) {
  bool fits(String id) => id.isNotEmpty && id.runes.length <= kAiPushValueChars;
  final allow = p.request.options
      .where(
        (o) =>
            o.kind == PermissionKind.allowOnce && !aiOptionEnablesNoApproval(o),
      )
      .firstOrNull;
  final reject = p.request.options
      .where((o) => o.kind == PermissionKind.rejectOnce)
      .firstOrNull;
  if (allow == null ||
      reject == null ||
      !fits(allow.optionId) ||
      !fits(reject.optionId)) {
    return null;
  }
  return (allow: allow.optionId, reject: reject.optionId);
}
```

(`aiOptionEnablesNoApproval` comes from `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart`, which the hub imports; `PendingPermission` from `package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart`; `PermissionKind` from `package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart` — all three are imported already.)

### Task 9: iOS: the notification delegate before launch ends

Spec B5, §2 ("Lỗi V2-2a có thể có"), §12 (FlutterFire #18699). The app uses the UIScene lifecycle: plugins register after `application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)` returns, but Apple wants the `UNUserNotificationCenter` delegate set before it does, or a tap on a notification can be missed in some launch states. firebase_messaging 16.7.0's README ("iOS apps using UIScene") asks for `FLTFirebaseMessagingPlugin.configureNotificationCenterDelegate()` in `didFinishLaunching`; `AppDelegate.swift` does not call it today. This is a fix of V2-2a that the push buttons build on (Task 20 adds the `ai_perm` category in the same method). `flutter_local_notifications` is never set up on iOS (B5): its `initialize()` would register categories of its own, and `setNotificationCategories` replaces the whole set. Because `FlutterAppDelegate` is a `FlutterAppLifeCycleProvider`, firebase_messaging leaves it in place as the centre's delegate and every plugin keeps receiving the calls. *Cost if wrong:* none — the call is what the plugin documents; a device check (Task 26, spec §10.1) confirms taps in the three app states.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift` (whole file below)
- Test: `apps/mobile/test/platform_config_test.dart`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing of other tasks.
- Produces: `AppDelegate.application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)` calls `FLTFirebaseMessagingPlugin.configureNotificationCenterDelegate()` before `super` (module `firebase_messaging` imported). Task 20 adds `import UserNotifications`, `AppDelegate.registerNotificationCategories()` and its call right after this one.

Replace the whole of `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift` with:

```swift
import Flutter
import UIKit
import firebase_messaging

@main
@objc class AppDelegate: FlutterAppDelegate, FlutterImplicitEngineDelegate {
  override func application(
    _ application: UIApplication,
    didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?
  ) -> Bool {
    // V2-2b B5: a UIScene app registers its plugins after this method returns, but Apple wants the
    // notification centre's delegate set before it does; without this call a tap on a notification can
    // be missed in some launch states (firebase_messaging 16.7.0 README, "iOS apps using UIScene").
    FLTFirebaseMessagingPlugin.configureNotificationCenterDelegate()
    return super.application(application, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions: launchOptions)
  }

  func didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine(_ engineBridge: FlutterImplicitEngineBridge) {
    GeneratedPluginRegistrant.register(with: engineBridge.pluginRegistry)
  }
}
```

(`configureNotificationCenterDelegate` is declared `+ (void)configureNotificationCenterDelegate;` in `FLTFirebaseMessagingPlugin.h` of firebase_messaging 16.7.0; the CocoaPods module is `firebase_messaging`.)

### Task 10: Mode and model from the phone: `ai.config.get`, `ai.config`

Spec B11, R16, Review Focus 3 and 5. The phone reads the session's settings a phone may change — the options of the categories `mode`, `model`, `thought_level`, `model_config`, or the legacy `modes` of an agent without config options — and sets one choice. Nothing that turns on a mode acting without asking is ever listed: not Claude's `bypassPermissions`, not an id that merely says it (`yolo`, `clearAndBypass`, `danger-full-access`: B7's predicate, moved to `package:shellx_ai` by Task 8), not a switch named like one. A choice the phone sends is checked again against what the session offers **now**, by the hub and once more by the window's control: a no-approval value is `on_computer` whatever the phone sends (it is made on the computer, after its Bypass question), an option or value not offered now is `refused`, and the agent saying no is `refused`. A choice the window takes goes to the agent and is remembered for the agent's next sessions exactly as the composer's chip does (`rememberConfig`, which never remembers a no-approval value).

This task also lays down the hub's request helper every later V2-2b request uses: the part file `ai_phone_hub_requests.dart` with `_Reply` and `_ask` (one `ai.result` per request, to the phone that asked only; a body over one message is never sent: `too_big`), and `AiRefused` gains a `body`. Names are cut to 60 characters, an option keeps at most 40 choices (`more`), and the whole body is cut to `kAiRecordBytes` (Review Focus 3). Cost if wrong: "Bỏ qua mọi quyền" is set on the computer only (spec B11).
