```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';

import '../model/session_state.dart';
import 'no_approval.dart';
import 'wire.dart';

/// V2-2b B11: the categories of settings a phone may change — the mode, the
/// model, the thinking, and the model's own (Claude's "Fast"). Every other
/// option (an agent's persona, say) stays on the computer.
const Set<String> kAiConfigCategories = {
  'mode',
  'model',
  'thought_level',
  'model_config',
};

/// The most choices of one option a phone is offered; the others stay on the
/// computer (`more`).
const int kAiConfigChoices = 40;

/// The longest name of an option or a choice, in characters.
const int kAiConfigNameChars = 60;

/// The longest id (an option's or a value) a phone is offered, in UTF-8
/// bytes: it sends it back, and an agent decides how long its ids are.
const int kAiConfigIdBytes = 256;

/// One value of a select option, as a phone may pick it.
final class AiConfigChoiceView with Redacted {
  const AiConfigChoiceView({
    required this.value,
    required this.name,
    this.group,
  });

  /// What the phone sends back (`ai.config` `value`).
  final String value;
  final String name;
  final String? group;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {'v': value, 'n': name, 'g': ?group};

  /// Null without a value.
  static AiConfigChoiceView? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final value = jString(j, 'v');
    if (value == null) return null;
    return AiConfigChoiceView(
      value: value,
      name: jString(j, 'n') ?? value,
      group: jString(j, 'g'),
    );
  }
}

/// One setting a phone may change (V2-2b B11): a select with its [choices],
/// or a switch ([kind] `boolean`, [current] a bool).
final class AiConfigOptionView with Redacted {
  const AiConfigOptionView({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.category,
    required this.kind,
    this.current,
    this.choices = const [],
    this.more = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final String name;

  /// One of [kAiConfigCategories].
  final String category;

  /// `select` or `boolean`.
  final String kind;

  /// The value now: a choice's value (select), a bool (boolean); null when
  /// the agent said none the phone can read.
  final Object? current;
  final List<AiConfigChoiceView> choices;

  /// Choices left on the computer (too many, or too big for one message).
  final bool more;

  bool get isSwitch => kind == 'boolean';

  AiConfigOptionView withChoices(List<AiConfigChoiceView> choices) =>
      AiConfigOptionView(
        id: id,
        name: name,
        category: category,
        kind: kind,
        current: current,
        choices: choices,
        more: true,
      );

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'id': id,
    'name': name,
    'cat': category,
    'kind': kind,
    'cur': ?current,
    if (!isSwitch) 'choices': [for (final c in choices) c.toJson()],
    if (more) 'more': true,
  };

  /// Null without an id, a category or a kind this version reads.
  static AiConfigOptionView? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final id = jString(j, 'id');
    final category = jString(j, 'cat');
    final kind = jString(j, 'kind');
    if (id == null || category == null) return null;
    if (kind != 'select' && kind != 'boolean') return null;
    final current = j['cur'];
    return AiConfigOptionView(
      id: id,
      name: jString(j, 'name') ?? id,
      category: category,
      kind: kind!,
      current: kind == 'boolean'
          ? (current is bool ? current : null)
          : (current is String ? current : null),
      choices: [
        for (final c in jMaps(j, 'choices')) ?AiConfigChoiceView.fromJson(c),
      ],
      more: jBool(j, 'more'),
    );
  }
}

/// The legacy modes of an agent without config options (`session/set_mode`).
final class AiModesView with Redacted {
  const AiModesView({
    required this.current,
    this.choices = const [],
    this.more = false,
  });

  final String current;
  final List<AiConfigChoiceView> choices;
  final bool more;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'cur': current,
    'choices': [for (final c in choices) c.toJson()],
    if (more) 'more': true,
  };

  /// Null without a current mode.
  static AiModesView? fromJson(Map<String, Object?>? j) {
    final current = j == null ? null : jString(j, 'cur');
    if (current == null) return null;
    return AiModesView(
      current: current,
      choices: [
        for (final c in jMaps(j!, 'choices')) ?AiConfigChoiceView.fromJson(c),
      ],
      more: jBool(j, 'more'),
    );
  }
}

/// What `ai.config.get` answers (V2-2b B11): the settings of a session a
/// phone may change, without any choice that turns on a mode acting without
/// asking (R16).
final class AiConfigView with Redacted {
  const AiConfigView({this.options = const [], this.modes});

  final List<AiConfigOptionView> options;
  final AiModesView? modes;

  bool get isEmpty => options.isEmpty && modes == null;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'v': kAiWireVersion,
    'options': [for (final o in options) o.toJson()],
    if (modes != null) 'modes': modes!.toJson(),
  };

  static AiConfigView fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) => AiConfigView(
    options: [
      for (final o in jMaps(j, 'options')) ?AiConfigOptionView.fromJson(o),
    ],
    modes: AiModesView.fromJson(jMap(j, 'modes')),
  );
}

String _name(String s) {
  final runes = s.runes;
  if (runes.length <= kAiConfigNameChars) return s;
  return '${String.fromCharCodes(runes.take(kAiConfigNameChars - 1))}…';
}

bool _sendable(String id) =>
    id.isNotEmpty && utf8Length(id) <= kAiConfigIdBytes;

/// V2-2b B11, R16: what a phone may change of [s]: the options of
/// [kAiConfigCategories] with the choices that turn on no mode acting
/// without asking ([aiTurnsOnNoApproval]: Claude's `bypassPermissions`, and
/// any id that merely says it); a switch named like such a mode is not
/// offered at all. Names are cut to [kAiConfigNameChars] characters, choices
/// to [kAiConfigChoices]; an id longer than [kAiConfigIdBytes] is not
/// offered. The legacy modes only for an agent without config options, as on
/// the computer.
AiConfigView aiConfigViewOf(AiSessionState s) {
  final options = <AiConfigOptionView>[];
  for (final o in s.configOptions ?? const <ConfigOption>[]) {
    final category = o.category;
    if (category == null || !kAiConfigCategories.contains(category)) continue;
    if (!_sendable(o.id)) continue;
    switch (o.kind) {
      case ConfigKind.select:
        final all = [
          for (final c in o.choices)
            if (_sendable(c.value) &&
                !aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: o.id, value: c.value))
              AiConfigChoiceView(
                value: c.value,
                name: _name(c.name),
                group: c.group == null ? null : _name(c.group!),
              ),
        ];
        if (all.isEmpty) continue; // nothing a phone may pick
        final current = o.currentValue;
        options.add(
          AiConfigOptionView(
            id: o.id,
            name: _name(o.name),
            category: category,
            kind: 'select',
            current: current is String ? current : null,
            choices: all.take(kAiConfigChoices).toList(),
            more: all.length > kAiConfigChoices,
          ),
        );
      case ConfigKind.boolean:
        // Turned on it would act without asking: changed on the computer.
        if (aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: o.id, value: true)) continue;
        options.add(
          AiConfigOptionView(
            id: o.id,
            name: _name(o.name),
            category: category,
            kind: 'boolean',
            current: o.currentValue == true,
          ),
        );
      case ConfigKind.other:
        continue;
    }
  }
  AiModesView? modes;
  final m = s.modes;
  if (s.configOptions == null && m != null) {
    final all = [
      for (final mode in m.available)
        if (_sendable(mode.id) && !aiIsNoApprovalMode(mode.id))
          AiConfigChoiceView(value: mode.id, name: _name(mode.name)),
    ];
    if (all.isNotEmpty) {
      modes = AiModesView(
        current: m.currentModeId,
        choices: all.take(kAiConfigChoices).toList(),
        more: all.length > kAiConfigChoices,
      );
    }
  }
  return AiConfigView(options: options, modes: modes);
}

/// [view] as a body within [kAiRecordBytes] (one that is bigger would drop
/// the phone's whole channel): while it is too big, the list with the most
/// choices loses a quarter of them (one at least) and says there are more;
/// with no choice left anywhere, the last option goes, then the modes.
Uint8List encodeConfigView(AiConfigView view) {
  final options = [...view.options];
  var modes = view.modes;
  while (true) {
    final json = jsonEncode(
      AiConfigView(options: options, modes: modes).toJson(),
    );
    if (utf8Length(json) <= kAiRecordBytes) {
      return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(json));
    }
    var most = -1;
    var count = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      if (options[i].choices.length > count) {
        most = i;
        count = options[i].choices.length;
      }
    }
    final m = modes;
    if (m != null && m.choices.length > count) {
      most = options.length;
      count = m.choices.length;
    }
    if (count > 0) {
      final keep = count - (count < 4 ? 1 : count ~/ 4);
      if (most == options.length) {
        modes = AiModesView(
          current: m!.current,
          choices: m.choices.take(keep).toList(),
          more: true,
        );
      } else {
        options[most] = options[most].withChoices(
          options[most].choices.take(keep).toList(),
        );
      }
    } else if (options.isNotEmpty) {
      options.removeLast();
    } else {
      modes = null; // a view of nothing fits
    }
  }
}

/// V2-2b B11, R16: whether a phone may set option [id] of [s] to [value] now:
/// null when it may; `on_computer` for a value that turns on a mode acting
/// without asking, or for a switch named like one — whatever the phone was
/// offered, and whatever the agent offers now; `refused` for an option or a
/// value the phone is not offered now.
String? aiConfigRefusal(AiSessionState s, String id, Object? value) {
  if (value is! String && value is! bool) return 'refused';
  if (aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: id, value: value)) return 'on_computer';
  final option = (s.configOptions ?? const <ConfigOption>[])
      .where((o) => o.id == id)
      .firstOrNull;
  if (option == null) return 'refused';
  final category = option.category;
  if (category == null || !kAiConfigCategories.contains(category)) {
    return 'refused';
  }
  switch (option.kind) {
    case ConfigKind.select:
      if (value is! String || !option.choices.any((c) => c.value == value)) {
        return 'refused';
      }
    case ConfigKind.boolean:
      if (aiTurnsOnNoApproval(configId: id, value: true)) return 'on_computer';
      if (value is! bool) return 'refused';
    case ConfigKind.other:
      return 'refused';
  }
  return null;
}

/// V2-2b B11, R16: whether a phone may set the legacy mode [modeId] of [s]
/// now: null when it may; `on_computer` for a mode acting without asking;
/// `refused` for a mode not offered (none of the agent's, or an agent with
/// config options, whose mode is an option).
String? aiModeRefusal(AiSessionState s, String modeId) {
  if (aiIsNoApprovalMode(modeId)) return 'on_computer';
  final modes = s.modes;
  if (s.configOptions != null || modes == null) return 'refused';
  if (!modes.available.any((m) => m.id == modeId)) return 'refused';
  return null;
}
```

```dart
    expect(rig.source.controls[-1]!.modes, ['plan']);

  test('a session that is not there is not_found; the answer goes only to '
      'the phone that asked, not to one back on a new channel', () async {
    final (rig, _) = _rig();
    rig.hub.handle(_phone, const AiConfigGet(sid: 'ep.-9', rid: 40));

    rig.hub

    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(rig.to(_phone).whereType<AiResult>().map((r) => r.rid), [40]);
  });
```

```dart
/// V2-2b B11 on the computer: a phone's mode and model reach the agent as
/// the composer's chips do; a mode acting without asking never does.
void main() {
  late ProviderContainer c;
  late FakeAiRuntimes fakes;
  late AiPhoneHub hub;
  final out = <OutboundMessage>[];

  void boot(FakeScenario scenario) {
    out.clear();

    c = cliContainer(FakeLocalSessions(), overrides: fakes.overrides);
    hub = c.read(aiPhoneHubProvider);

  AiResult result(int rid) => out
      .map((o) => o.message)
      .whereType<AiResult>()
      .firstWhere((r) => r.rid == rid);

  Future<void> until(bool Function() test) async {
    for (var i = 0; i < 400 && !test(); i++) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 5));
    }

  bool answered(int rid) =>
      out.map((o) => o.message).whereType<AiResult>().any((r) => r.rid == rid);

  /// An AI tab whose agent a phone started; its session id.
  Future<(TerminalTab, String)> running() async {
    final tab = openTestAiTab(c, cwd: testAiCwd, select: false);

  }

    await until(() => answered(2));

      contains('session/set_config_option:model=sonnet'),
    );
    expect(rememberedConfig(c.read(settingsStoreProvider), 'claude'), {
      'model': 'sonnet',
    });
  });

  test(
    'Review Focus 5: "Bypass permissions" from a phone stays on the '
    'computer — refused by the hub, and by the window\'s own control',
    () async {
      boot(const FakeScenario(configOptions: _claudeOptions));

        ),
      );
      await until(() => answered(3));
      expect(result(3).code, 'on_computer');
      final control = c.read(_source).control(tab.ai!.id)!;
      await expectLater(
        control.setConfig('mode', 'bypassPermissions'),
        throwsA(isA<AiRefused>().having((r) => r.code, 'code', 'on_computer')),
      );
      await expectLater(
        control.setMode('yolo'),
        throwsA(isA<AiRefused>().having((r) => r.code, 'code', 'on_computer')),
      );
      expect(
        fakes.agent().received.where((m) => m.startsWith('session/set_')),
        isEmpty,
      );
      expect(
        rememberedConfig(c.read(settingsStoreProvider), 'claude'),
        isEmpty,
      );
    },
  );

  test('an agent with only modes: its modes, without one acting without '
      'asking; a mode is set as the mode chip sets it', () async {
    boot(
      const FakeScenario(
        modes: {
          'currentModeId': 'default',

    );

    expect(result(5).ok, isTrue);
    expect(fakes.agent().received, contains('session/set_mode:plan'));
```

```dart
part of 'ai_phone_hub.dart';

/// What a V2-2b request answers (B4): nothing but `ok`, a [body] (JSON), a
/// refusal [code] — or a refusal with a body (`confirm`).
final class _Reply {
  const _Reply.ok([this.body]) : code = null;
  const _Reply.refuse(this.code, [this.body]);

  final String? code;
  final Uint8List? body;
}

/// The V2-2b requests (B4, B11, …): each answers with one `ai.result`, a
/// body maybe, checked against the window as it is when it runs.
extension _AiPhoneRequests on AiPhoneHub {
  /// One V2-2b request about [sid]: [run] works it out on the session's
  /// control as the window has it now, and one `ai.result` goes back to
  /// [phone] only (a request belongs to the channel that made it). A session
  /// that is not there is `not_found`; the window's own refusal
  /// ([AiRefused]) its code and body; anything else the window's code throws
  /// `refused` (nothing escapes into its zone). A body over
  /// [kAiMaxBodyBytes] is never sent — it would drop the phone's whole
  /// channel, terminals included —: `too_big` instead.
  Future<void> _ask(
    String mobileId,
    _Phone phone,
    String sid,
    int rid,
    Future<_Reply> Function(AiControl control) run,
  ) async {
    _Reply reply;
    try {
      final control = _controlOf(sid);
      reply = control == null
          ? const _Reply.refuse('not_found')
          : await run(control);
    } on AiRefused catch (refusal) {
      reply = _Reply.refuse(refusal.code, refusal.body);
    } on Object {
      reply = const _Reply.refuse('refused');
    }
    final body = reply.body;
    if (body != null && body.length > kAiMaxBodyBytes) {
      reply = const _Reply.refuse('too_big');
    }
    _send(
      mobileId,
      AiResult(
        rid: rid,
        ok: reply.code == null,
        code: reply.code,
        body: reply.body,
      ),
      phone,
    );
  }

  /// V2-2b B11: the choices of [sid] a phone may make ([aiConfigViewOf]).
  void _configGet(String mobileId, _Phone phone, String sid, int rid) =>
      unawaited(
        _ask(
          mobileId,
          phone,
          sid,
          rid,
          (c) async => _Reply.ok(encodeConfigView(aiConfigViewOf(c.state))),
        ),
      );

  /// V2-2b B11, R16: one choice, checked against what the session offers now
  /// — a choice acting without asking is the computer's (`on_computer`) —,
  /// then set as the computer's chip sets it (the window checks it once
  /// more). The agent saying no is `refused`.
  void _configSet(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiConfigSet m) => unawaited(
    _ask(mobileId, phone, m.sid, m.rid, (c) async {
      final j = decodeBody(m.body);
      if (j == null) return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
      final mode = j['mode'];
      if (mode is String) {
        final no = aiModeRefusal(c.state, mode);
        if (no != null) return _Reply.refuse(no);
        await c.setMode(mode);
        return const _Reply.ok();
      }
      final id = j['id'];
      final value = j['value'];
      if (id is! String) return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
      final no = aiConfigRefusal(c.state, id, value);
      if (no != null) return _Reply.refuse(no);
      await c.setConfig(id, value!);
      return const _Reply.ok();
    }),
  );
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B11: the mode, model and thinking choices of [sid] this phone may
  /// make. Throws [AiRequestException] (`unsupported` at once, sending
  /// nothing, when the computer cannot: R15) or [MachineConnectionException].
  Future<AiConfigView> config(String sid) async {
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.config,
      sid,
      (rid) => AiConfigGet(sid: sid, rid: rid),
    );
    return AiConfigView.fromJson(decodeBody(result.body) ?? const {});
  }

  /// V2-2b B11: sets option [id] of [sid] to [value] (a choice's value, or a
  /// bool for a switch). One explicit tap, one request: never sent again.
  Future<void> setConfig(String sid, String id, Object value) => _feature(
    AiFeature.config,
    sid,
    (rid) => AiConfigSet(
      sid: sid,
      rid: rid,
      body: encodeBody({'id': id, 'value': value}),
    ),
  );

  /// V2-2b B11: sets the mode of [sid] for an agent with only modes.
  Future<void> setMode(String sid, String modeId) => _feature(
    AiFeature.config,
    sid,
    (rid) =>
        AiConfigSet(sid: sid, rid: rid, body: encodeBody({'mode': modeId})),
  );
```

### Task 11: Phone: "Chế độ và model" sheet

Spec B11 and acceptance check 2 on the phone. The session's status line names the model after the mode ("Claude · Hỏi trước · Opus 5.5", from Task 6's `MirrorHead.modelName`) and, while the session is live and the computer offers `config` (R3), it is a button: it opens the sheet "Chế độ và model". The sheet asks the computer each time it opens (the choices are the session's **now**) and shows one group per option — CHẾ ĐỘ (Claude's known modes in the words of the status line: "Hỏi trước", "Lập kế hoạch" …), MODEL, MỨC SUY NGHĨ, an option of category `model_config` under its own name (a switch for a boolean, Claude's "Fast"), and the legacy modes of an agent without config options under CHẾ ĐỘ. A tap on a choice that is not the current one is one request, sent once (never again by itself); the sheet closes when the computer took it (the header shows the change when the computer sends it); a refusal leaves the sheet open and says why — `on_computer` as "Chọn mục này trên máy tính." Nothing else is sent while a choice is on its way. A list with `more` says "Còn lựa chọn khác trên máy tính.". A computer without the feature (R15) leaves the line plain text: nothing is ever sent to it. No choice acting without asking can appear: the computer never lists one (Task 10, R16).

Strings: spec §5 (`aiConfigTitle`, `aiConfigMode`, `aiConfigModel`, `aiConfigEffort`) plus two this task needs: `aiConfigMore` ("More choices on the computer." / "Còn lựa chọn khác trên máy tính.") and `aiConfigOnComputer` ("Choose this on the computer." / "Chọn mục này trên máy tính.": the permission panel's `aiPermOnComputer` speaks of an answer, not of a choice).

```dart
  /// V2-2b B11: what [config] answers, and the choices set (session, option, value) and modes set.
  AiConfigView configValue = const AiConfigView();

  final List<(String, String, Object)> configSets = [];
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The sheet**

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_config_sheet.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// V2-2b B11: "Chế độ và model" over the session page.
Future<void> showAiConfigSheet(BuildContext context, {required AiSessionController controller}) =>
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: context.colors.surface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (_) => AiConfigSheet(controller: controller),
    );

/// V2-2b B11: the session's mode, model and thinking — and the model's own switch ("Fast") — as the computer
/// offers them to a phone: never a choice acting without asking (R16). A tap is one choice, sent once; the
/// sheet closes when the computer took it, and stays, saying why, when it did not. Claude's known modes are
/// worded as in the session's status line.
class AiConfigSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiConfigSheet({super.key, required this.controller});

  final AiSessionController controller;

  @override
  State<AiConfigSheet> createState() => _AiConfigSheetState();
}

class _AiConfigSheetState extends State<AiConfigSheet> {
  AiConfigView? _view;
  String? _error;

  /// The option (its id, or `mode` for the legacy modes) whose choice is on its way: nothing else is
  /// sent meanwhile.
  String? _busy;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_load());
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final got = await widget.controller.loadConfig();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _view = got.view;
      _error = got.code;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _set(String key, Future<String?> Function() send) async {
    if (_busy != null) return;
    setState(() => _busy = key);
    final code = await send();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _busy = null);
    if (code == null) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
      return;
    }
    final s = S.of(context);
    final text = code == 'on_computer' ? s.aiConfigOnComputer : AiWords.failure(s, code);
    if (text != null) widget.controller.popupHandler.showError(title: text);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final view = _view;
    final error = _error;
    return SafeArea(
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 20),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(s.aiConfigTitle, key: const Key('ai.config.title'), style: context.typo.heading20.heavy),
            12.sizedHeight,
            if (view == null && error == null)
              const Center(
                child: Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(24), child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
              )
            else if (view == null)
              Text(
                AiWords.failure(s, error!) ?? s.somethingWentWrong,
                key: const Key('ai.config.error'),
                style: context.typo.paragraph.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
              )
            else ...[
              for (final o in view.options) ..._option(context, o),
              if (view.modes case final modes?) ..._modes(context, modes),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _option(BuildContext context, AiConfigOptionView o) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    if (o.isSwitch) {
      return [
        SwitchListTile(
          key: Key('ai.config.${o.id}'),
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          title: Text(o.name),
          value: o.current == true,
          onChanged: _busy != null ? null : (on) => _set(o.id, () => widget.controller.setConfig(o.id, on)),
        ),
      ];
    }
    final group = switch (o.category) {
      'mode' => s.aiConfigMode,
      'model' => s.aiConfigModel,
      'thought_level' => s.aiConfigEffort,
      _ => o.name,
    };
    return [
      _Header(group),
      _Choices(
        id: o.id,
        current: o.current is String ? o.current! as String : null,
        choices: [
          for (final c in o.choices)
            (c, o.category == 'mode' ? AiWords.modeName(s, c.value, c.name) ?? c.name : c.name),
        ],
        busy: _busy != null,
        onPick: (value) => _set(o.id, () => widget.controller.setConfig(o.id, value)),
      ),
      if (o.more) _More(s.aiConfigMore),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> _modes(BuildContext context, AiModesView modes) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    return [
      _Header(s.aiConfigMode),
      _Choices(
        id: 'mode',
        current: modes.current,
        choices: [for (final c in modes.choices) (c, AiWords.modeName(s, c.value, c.name) ?? c.name)],
        busy: _busy != null,
        onPick: (value) => _set('mode', () => widget.controller.setMode(value)),
      ),
      if (modes.more) _More(s.aiConfigMore),
    ];
  }
}

class _Header extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Header(this.text);

  final String text;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 2),
    child: Text(
      text.toUpperCase(),
      style: context.typo.paragraph13.bold.copyWith(color: context.colors.secondaryText, letterSpacing: 0.8),
    ),
  );
}

/// The choices of one option, one row each (`ai.config.<id>.<value>`), the current one selected. A row
/// that is not the current one sends it; nothing is sent while another choice is on its way.
class _Choices extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Choices({
    required this.id,
    required this.current,
    required this.choices,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onPick,
  });

  final String id;
  final String? current;
  final List<(AiConfigChoiceView, String)> choices;
  final bool busy;
  final ValueChanged<String> onPick;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => RadioGroup<String>(
    groupValue: current,
    onChanged: (value) {
      if (value == null || value == current || busy) return;
      onPick(value);
    },
    child: Column(
      children: [
        for (final (c, label) in choices)
          RadioListTile<String>(
            key: Key('ai.config.$id.${c.value}'),
            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            enabled: !busy,
            value: c.value,
            title: Text(label),
            subtitle: c.group == null ? null : Text(c.group!),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class _More extends StatelessWidget {
  const _More(this.text);

  final String text;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
    child: Text(text, style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: context.colors.secondaryText)),
  );
}
```

### Task 12: A big item in full: `ai.item` in parts

Spec B16, R14, Review Focus 3. The mirror carries an item cut to fit one message (a call's output to a few KiB, a question's form under 16 KiB); "Xem đủ" loads the whole of it. The desktop makes the **full view** of item `i` once — a text whole; a call's output with each line cut at 2 000 characters as the desktop's card cuts it, every diff whole (a file over 1 MiB on either side only named: read it on the computer), the input of a call of kind `other` as indented JSON; a question's whole form — as JSON text, and keeps it for the phone that asked, by `sid/i` and the item's `rev`, 60 s after the last slice asked and 4 items per phone at most. Each `ai.item {sid, rid, i, part}` answers one slice `{"i", "r", "part", "parts", "text"}`; a slice is at most 36 KiB **once escaped for JSON** (R14), so a body stays far below `kAiMaxBodyBytes` whatever the text holds — quotes, backslashes, control characters, lone surrogates (Review Focus 3) — and never ends between the two halves of a surrogate pair. A view over 2 MiB is `too_big` (the card keeps saying "Xem trên máy tính"); an index or a part that is not there, or an item with nothing more than the mirror holds (a turn's end, a notice), `refused`. The phone asks one slice at a time — one request in flight, so terminals and the session's own messages keep the channel and the budget — and when `r` changes while it loads (a command still running) it starts again from the first slice, three times at most, then fails `changing`. A body no hub sends (more than 512 slices, a field missing) is `refused`; an error the caller's progress callback throws ends the load (the page that asked is gone).

Create `packages/shellx_ai/lib/src/remote/full_view.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';

import '../model/timeline.dart';
import 'acp_out.dart';
import 'item_codec.dart' show itemText;
import 'mirror.dart';
import 'wire.dart';

/// V2-2b B16, R14: the most bytes one slice of a full item takes once escaped
/// for JSON. With the slice's envelope a body stays far below [kAiBodyBytes]
/// whatever the text holds (quotes, control characters, lone surrogates).
const int kAiSliceBytes = 36 * 1024;

/// V2-2b B16: the largest full item a phone loads, in UTF-8 bytes of its
/// JSON (about 60 slices); a bigger one is read on the computer (`too_big`).
const int kAiFullItemBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

/// A line of tool output in a full item, cut as the desktop's card cuts it.
const int kAiFullLineChars = 2000;

/// The largest side of a diff in a full item, in UTF-8 bytes; a bigger file
/// is named, and read on the computer.
const int kAiFullDiffBytes = 1024 * 1024;

/// V2-2b B16: item [item] in full as JSON text — what the phone's "Xem đủ"
/// shows: a text whole; a tool call's output (each line cut at
/// [kAiFullLineChars]), every diff whole (a side over [kAiFullDiffBytes] only
/// named, `big`) and, for a call of kind `other`, its input; a question's
/// whole form. Null for an item that holds nothing more than the mirror
/// shows (a turn's end, a notice).
String? aiFullItemJson(TimelineItem item) {
  final Map<String, Object?> view;
  switch (item) {
    case UserItem() || StreamedTextItem():
      view = {
        'k': switch (item) {
          UserItem() => 'user',
          ThoughtItem() => 'thought',
          _ => 'agent',
        },
        'text': itemText(item) ?? '',
      };
    case ToolItem():
      view = _tool(item);
    case AskItem():
      view = {'k': 'ask', 'req': elicitationToJson(item.request)};
    case TurnEndItem() || NoticeItem():
      return null;
  }
  return jsonEncode(view);
}

Map<String, Object?> _tool(ToolItem t) {
  final f = t.fields;
  final texts = <String>[];
  final diffs = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  for (final c in f.content ?? const <ToolContent>[]) {
    switch (c) {
      case ToolContentBlock(:final block):
        final text = switch (block) {
          TextBlock(:final text) => text,
          ResourceLinkBlock(:final name) => name,
          ResourceBlock(:final text) => text ?? '',
          _ => '',
        };
        if (text.isNotEmpty) texts.add(plainText(text));
      case ToolDiff():
        diffs.add(_diff(c));
      case ToolTerminal() || ToolContentOther():
        break;
    }
  }
  String? input;
  final raw = f.rawInput;
  if (raw != null && (f.kind == null || f.kind == ToolKind.other)) {
    try {
      input = const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(raw);
    } on Object {
      input = null; // Not JSON: not shown, as in the mirror.
    }
  }
  return {
    'k': 'tool',
    'title': ?f.title,
    if (texts.isNotEmpty) 'out': _cutLines(texts.join('\n')),
    if (diffs.isNotEmpty) 'diffs': diffs,
    'input': ?input,
  };
}

Map<String, Object?> _diff(ToolDiff d) {
  final old = d.oldText;
  if (utf8Length(d.newText) > kAiFullDiffBytes ||
      (old != null && utf8Length(old) > kAiFullDiffBytes)) {
    return {'path': d.path, 'big': true};
  }
  return {
    'path': d.path,
    'old': ?old,
    'new': d.newText,
    if (old == null) 'created': true,
  };
}

/// [text] with each line cut at [kAiFullLineChars] characters ("…" after).
String _cutLines(String text) {
  if (!text.split('\n').any((l) => l.length > kAiFullLineChars)) return text;
  return [
    for (final line in text.split('\n'))
      if (line.length <= kAiFullLineChars)
        line
      else
        '${line.substring(0, _safeEnd(line, kAiFullLineChars))}…',
  ].join('\n');
}

/// [end], one less when it would split a surrogate pair.
int _safeEnd(String s, int end) {
  final c = s.codeUnitAt(end - 1);
  return c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDBFF ? end - 1 : end;
}

/// V2-2b B16, R14: where the slices of [text] end (exclusive offsets, the
/// last one `text.length`): each slice is at most [maxBytes] once escaped
/// for JSON, so its body fits a message whatever the text holds, and none
/// ends inside a surrogate pair. An empty text is one empty slice.
List<int> aiSliceEnds(String text, {int maxBytes = kAiSliceBytes}) {
  final ends = <int>[];
  var start = 0;
  var size = 0;
  var i = 0;
  while (i < text.length) {
    final c = text.codeUnitAt(i);
    var units = 1;
    final int cost;
    if (c == 0x22 || c == 0x5C) {
      cost = 2; // \" \\
    } else if (c < 0x20) {
      // \b \t \n \f \r, else \u00XX
      cost = c == 0x08 || c == 0x09 || c == 0x0A || c == 0x0C || c == 0x0D
          ? 2
          : 6;
    } else if (c < 0x80) {
      cost = 1;
    } else if (c < 0x800) {
      cost = 2;
    } else if (c >= 0xD800 &&
        c <= 0xDBFF &&
        i + 1 < text.length &&
        (text.codeUnitAt(i + 1) & 0xFC00) == 0xDC00) {
      cost = 4;
      units = 2;
    } else if (c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDFFF) {
      cost = 6; // a lone surrogate: \uXXXX at most
    } else {
      cost = 3;
    }
    if (size + cost > maxBytes && i > start) {
      ends.add(i);
      start = i;
      size = 0;
    }
    size += cost;
    i += units;
  }
  ends.add(text.length);
  return ends;
}

/// V2-2b B16: an item in full as the phone's viewer shows it (what
/// [aiFullItemJson] made, joined from its slices).
final class AiFullView with Redacted {
  const AiFullView({
    required this.kind,
    this.title,
    this.text,
    this.output,
    this.diffs = const [],
    this.bigDiffs = const [],
    this.input,
    this.request,
  });

  /// `user`, `agent`, `thought`, `tool`, `ask`, or a newer computer's word.
  final String kind;
  final String? title;

  /// A text item's whole text.
  final String? text;

  /// A tool call's output; each line at most [kAiFullLineChars] characters.
  final String? output;

  /// Every diff of the call, whole ([MirrorDiff.oldText] null: a new file;
  /// `plus`, `minus` and `cut` unset).
  final List<MirrorDiff> diffs;

  /// The paths of the files too big to load: read on the computer.
  final List<String> bigDiffs;

  /// The call's input as indented JSON (calls of kind `other`).
  final String? input;

  /// A question's whole form.
  final ElicitationRequest? request;

  /// Null without a kind.
  static AiFullView? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final kind = jString(j, 'k');
    if (kind == null) return null;
    final diffs = jMaps(j, 'diffs').toList();
    final req = jMap(j, 'req');
    return AiFullView(
      kind: kind,
      title: jString(j, 'title'),
      text: jString(j, 'text'),
      output: jString(j, 'out'),
      diffs: [
        for (final d in diffs)
          if (!jBool(d, 'big'))
            MirrorDiff(
              path: jString(d, 'path') ?? '',
              oldText: jBool(d, 'created') ? null : jString(d, 'old') ?? '',
              newText: jString(d, 'new') ?? '',
            ),
      ],
      bigDiffs: [
        for (final d in diffs)
          if (jBool(d, 'big')) jString(d, 'path') ?? '',
      ],
      input: jString(j, 'input'),
      request: req == null ? null : ElicitationRequest.fromJson(req),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
void _tool(AiSessionState s, String id, String output) => s.applyUpdate(

    'sessionUpdate': 'tool_call',
    'toolCallId': id,
    'title': 'Run',
    'kind': 'execute',

        'type': 'content',

      },

  aiT0,

/// Every slice of item [index], asked one after the other as the phone
/// does; the results in order.
Future<List<AiResult>> _load(HubRig rig, int index) async {
  final results = <AiResult>[];
  var parts = 1;
  for (var part = 0; part < parts; part++) {
    // A second between requests: the phone's budget (30 a second) refills.
    rig.now = rig.now.add(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    rig.hub.handle(
      _phone,
      AiItemPart(sid: _sid, rid: 100 + part, index: index, part: part),
    );
    await pumpEventQueue();
    final result = rig.last<AiResult>(_phone);
    results.add(result);
    if (!result.ok) break;
    parts = decodeBody(result.body)!['parts']! as int;
  }
  return results;
}

String _joined(List<AiResult> results) =>
    [for (final r in results) decodeBody(r.body)!['text']! as String].join();

/// V2-2b B16, R14: a big item in full, one slice per request.
```

In `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/ai/ai_phone_hub_requests.dart`, after the class `_Reply`, add:

```dart

/// How long a phone's full item is kept for its next slices, and how many a
/// phone has at most (V2-2b B16): at most 4 × 2 MiB of text per phone.
const _fullItemKeep = Duration(seconds: 60);
const _fullItemsPerPhone = 4;

/// One item made in full for one phone (V2-2b B16): its JSON text and where
/// its slices end, for the rev it was made of.
final class _FullItem {
  _FullItem(this.rev, this.text, this.ends, this.at);

  final int rev;
  final String text;
  final List<int> ends;

  /// When a slice of it was last asked for.
  DateTime at;
}
```

and, as the last member of the extension `_AiPhoneRequests`, add:

```dart

  /// V2-2b B16, R14: slice [AiItemPart.part] of item [AiItemPart.index] in
  /// full. The item is made once per rev and kept for the phone's next
  /// slices ([_fullItemKeep], [_fullItemsPerPhone]); its body says the rev
  /// (`r`), so a phone that sees it change (a command still running) starts
  /// again. An item over [kAiFullItemBytes] is read on the computer
  /// (`too_big`); one with nothing more to show, an index or a part that is
  /// not there, `refused`.
  void _fullItem(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiItemPart m) => unawaited(
    _ask(mobileId, phone, m.sid, m.rid, (c) async {
      final items = c.state.timeline.items;
      if (m.index < 0 || m.index >= items.length) {
        return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
      }
      final item = items[m.index];
      final now = _now();
      phone.items.removeWhere((_, f) {
        final idle = now.difference(f.at);
        return idle > _fullItemKeep || idle.isNegative;
      });
      final key = '${m.sid}/${m.index}';
      var full = phone.items[key];
      if (full == null || full.rev != item.rev) {
        final text = aiFullItemJson(item);
        if (text == null) return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
        if (utf8Length(text) > kAiFullItemBytes) {
          return const _Reply.refuse('too_big');
        }
        full = _FullItem(item.rev, text, aiSliceEnds(text), now);
      }
      // The one asked for last is the one kept longest.
      phone.items
        ..remove(key)
        ..[key] = full;
      while (phone.items.length > _fullItemsPerPhone) {
        phone.items.remove(phone.items.keys.first);
      }
      full.at = now;
      final parts = full.ends.length;
      if (m.part < 0 || m.part >= parts) return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
      final start = m.part == 0 ? 0 : full.ends[m.part - 1];
      return _Reply.ok(
        encodeBody({
          'i': m.index,
          'r': full.rev,
          'part': m.part,
          'parts': parts,
          'text': full.text.substring(start, full.ends[m.part]),
        }),
      );
    }),
  );
```

```dart
/// V2-2b B16: how many times a full item that changes while it loads starts
/// again, and the most slices one may have (2 MiB of the worst escaping is
/// about 350).
const int _itemRestarts = 3;
const int _maxItemParts = 512;
```

3. After `setMode` (Task 10), add:

```dart

  /// V2-2b B16: item [index] of [sid] in full, loaded one slice at a time:
  /// one request in flight, so the channel and the budget stay free for
  /// everything else. [onPart] is told after each slice (1-based); an error
  /// it throws ends the load (the page that asked is gone). When the item
  /// changes on the computer while it loads (a command still running), the
  /// load starts again from the first slice, at most [_itemRestarts] times,
  /// then fails `changing`. Throws [AiRequestException] (`too_big`: read it on
  /// the computer; `unsupported`, R15) or [MachineConnectionException].
  Future<AiFullView> fullItem(
    String sid,
    int index, {
    void Function(int part, int parts)? onPart,
  }) async {
    for (var round = 0; round <= _itemRestarts; round++) {
      final text = StringBuffer();
      int? rev;
      var parts = 1;
      var changed = false;
      for (var part = 0; part < parts; part++) {
        final result = await _feature(
          AiFeature.item,
          sid,
          (rid) => AiItemPart(sid: sid, rid: rid, index: index, part: part),
        );
        final body = decodeBody(result.body);
        final r = body == null ? null : jInt(body, 'r');
        final n = body == null ? null : jInt(body, 'parts');
        final slice = body == null ? null : jString(body, 'text');
        // What no hub sends: a body that cannot be read, or more slices than
        // any item may have.
        if (r == null || n == null || n < 1 || n > _maxItemParts) {
          throw const AiRequestException('refused');
        }
        if (slice == null || jInt(body!, 'part') != part) {
          throw const AiRequestException('refused');
        }
        if (rev != null && r != rev) {
          changed = true;
          break;
        }
        rev = r;
        parts = n;
        text.write(slice);
        onPart?.call(part + 1, parts);
      }
      if (changed) continue;
      Object? json;
      try {
        json = jsonDecode(text.toString());
      } on FormatException {
        json = null;
      }
      final view = json is Map<String, Object?>
          ? AiFullView.fromJson(json)
          : null;
      if (view == null) throw const AiRequestException('refused');
      return view;
    }
    throw const AiRequestException('changing');
  }
```

### Task 13: Phone: "Xem đủ" viewer

Spec B16 and acceptance check 7 on the phone. What the phone shows cut gets a "Xem đủ" button (`Key('ai.viewAll.<index>')`, 44 points): a message of the user's or of the agent cut by the computer or by the phone, an unfolded thought likewise, a question line whose form is too big for the mirror, a card too big to send (`big`), and the body of an open tool card (the mirror carries a call's output and input cut to a few KiB without always saying so — an input has no `cut` flag — so an open card always offers its whole body). The button exists only when the computer offers `item` (R3, R15). It opens a page of its own over the session: the item's title, a spinner and "Đang tải 3/12" while slices come, then its lines in the monospace font, built only near the screen (a `ListView.builder` of one row per line; a line longer than 4 000 characters is cut, "…" after it): a text, a call's output, every diff in the conversation's diff rows (a file too big only named: "Quá lớn để xem trên điện thoại. Xem trên máy tính."), a call's input, a question's words. `too_big` says the same words; a load that kept changing says "Mục này vẫn đang thay đổi trên máy tính. Thử lại sau giây lát."; a lost channel is said as a reconnection (nothing was asked to change). Leaving the page ends the loading: the progress callback throws once the page is gone, and `MachineAi.fullItem` asks nothing more (Task 12).

A question whose form is too big for the mirror (its card has no form; the dock says "Trả lời câu hỏi này trên máy tính.") gets "Xem đủ" in the dock too (`Key('ai.ask.viewAll')`): it loads the whole form, and the dock then shows it as any other question, answered with one tap; the hub checks the values against the form (V2-2 D13, `form.accepts`).

Strings: spec §5 (`aiViewAll`, `aiLoadingParts`) plus one this task needs: `aiItemChanging` ("It is still changing on the computer. Try again in a moment." / "Mục này vẫn đang thay đổi trên máy tính. Thử lại sau giây lát."). `AiWords.failure` gains `too_big` (the existing `aiFromComputerOnly`) and `changing`.

```dart
  /// V2-2b B16: what [fullItem] answers by item index (a missing one is `refused`); how many slices it
  /// reports, and the gate each slice waits for when set (index 0: the first slice).
  final Map<int, AiFullView> fullItems = {};
  int fullParts = 1;
  List<Completer<void>>? partGates;
  final List<(String, int)> fullAsked = [];

  /// Slices served, over every load.
  int partsServed = 0;

  @override
  Future<AiFullView> fullItem(String sid, int index, {void Function(int part, int parts)? onPart}) async {
    fullAsked.add((sid, index));
    for (var part = 1; part <= fullParts; part++) {
      final gates = partGates;
      if (gates != null && gates.length >= part) await gates[part - 1].future;
      await _request();
      partsServed++;
      onPart?.call(part, fullParts);
    }
    final view = fullItems[index];
    if (view == null) throw const AiRequestException('refused');
    return view;
  }
```

```dart

  /// V2-2b B16: item [index] in full for "Xem đủ", a slice at a time ([onPart]; an error it throws ends the
  /// load: the page left), or the failure code.
  Future<({AiFullView? view, String? code})> loadFull(int index, void Function(int part, int parts) onPart) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return (view: null, code: 'refused');
    try {
      return (view: await machine.ai.fullItem(sid, index, onPart: onPart), code: null);
    } catch (error) {
      return (view: null, code: _failure(error));
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B16: the forms of questions too big for the mirror, loaded in full by their id.
  final Map<int, ElicitationRequest> _forms = {};

  /// The form of question [ask] once [loadForm] brought it; null before.
  ElicitationRequest? formOf(int ask) => _forms[ask];

  /// V2-2b B16: the whole form of question [ask] (card [index]), so that it is answered here like any other
  /// (with one tap; the computer checks the values with the form). Null when loaded, else the failure code.
  Future<String?> loadForm(int ask, int index) async {
    final full = await loadFull(index, (_, _) {});
    final request = full.view?.request;
    if (request == null) return full.code ?? 'refused';
    _forms[ask] = request;
    _set(_version, _version.peek() + 1);
    return null;
  }
```

```dart
/// What the conversation's items may ask of the page (V2-2b): an item in full ("Xem đủ", B16) and a turn's
/// changes (B20). The page provides it around the conversation; a callback is null when the computer does not
/// offer it, and the items then show nothing for it. Callbacks that stay the same (a page's own methods) keep
/// the items from rebuilding.
class AiItemActions extends InheritedWidget {
  const AiItemActions({super.key, this.onViewAll, this.onChanges, required super.child});

  /// B16: item [index] in full, on its own page.
  final void Function(int index)? onViewAll;

  /// B20: the changes of turn [turn].
  final void Function(int turn)? onChanges;

  static AiItemActions? maybeOf(BuildContext context) => context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<AiItemActions>();

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(AiItemActions oldWidget) =>
      oldWidget.onViewAll != onViewAll || oldWidget.onChanges != onChanges;
}

/// "Xem đủ" (V2-2b B16) under what the phone shows cut, or not at all: the whole item on its own page.
/// Nothing when the computer does not offer it.

    final open = AiItemActions.maybeOf(context)?.onViewAll;

      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: TextButton(
        key: Key('ai.viewAll.$index'),
        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
          minimumSize: const Size(44, 44),
        ),
        onPressed: () => open(index),
        child: Text(S.of(context).aiViewAll),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
/// The look of one diff line (V2-2 D6): context dimmed, a removed or added line on its colour.
TextStyle aiDiffLineStyle(BuildContext context, String mark) {
  final colors = context.colors;
  return const TextStyle(fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono, fontSize: 12, height: 1.35).copyWith(
    color: mark == ' ' ? colors.secondaryText : colors.primaryText,
    backgroundColor: switch (mark) {
      '+' => colors.okDot.withValues(alpha: 0.16),
      '-' => colors.error.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
      _ => null,
    },
  );
}

/// One diff line on a row of its own (V2-2b B16: the full view builds only the rows on screen). A line
/// longer than [kShownLineChars] is cut, "…" after it.
class AiDiffLineRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const AiDiffLineRow({super.key, required this.line});

  final DiffLine line;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final text = line.text.length > kShownLineChars ? '${line.text.substring(0, kShownLineChars)}…' : line.text;
    return Text('${line.mark} $text', style: aiDiffLineStyle(context, line.mark));
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert' show LineSplitter;

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_text.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_items.dart' show AiDiffLineRow;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// Loads an item in full, telling [onPart] of each slice (1-based); the failure code when it cannot
/// ([AiWords.failure]). An error [onPart] throws ends the loading.
typedef AiFullLoader = Future<({AiFullView? view, String? code})> Function(void Function(int part, int parts) onPart);

/// V2-2b B16: "Xem đủ" — one item in full on its own page over the session: "Đang tải 3/12" while its
/// slices come, then its lines in a monospace font, built only near the screen (a text; a call's output,
/// every diff in the conversation's diff rows, its input; a question's words) — or why the phone cannot
/// show it (too big: on the computer). Leaving the page ends the loading.
@RoutePage()
class AiItemPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiItemPage({super.key, required this.title, required this.load});

  final String title;
  final AiFullLoader load;

  @override
  State<AiItemPage> createState() => _AiItemPageState();
}

/// One row of the page.
sealed class _Row {
  const _Row();
}

final class _Line extends _Row {
  const _Line(this.text);
  final String text;
}

final class _Diff extends _Row {
  const _Diff(this.line);
  final DiffLine line;
}

/// A file's path above its diff.
final class _Title extends _Row {
  const _Title(this.text);
  final String text;
}

/// Words of the app, not of the item.
final class _Note extends _Row {
  const _Note(this.text);
  final String text;
}

final class _Gap extends _Row {
  const _Gap();
}

/// What [_AiItemPageState] throws from its progress once it is gone: the loading ends.
final class _Left implements Exception {
  const _Left();
}

class _AiItemPageState extends State<AiItemPage> {
  int _part = 0;
  int _parts = 0;
  List<_Row>? _rows;
  String? _code;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_start());
  }

  Future<void> _start() async {
    final got = await widget.load((part, parts) {
      if (!mounted) throw const _Left();
      setState(() {
        _part = part;
        _parts = parts;
      });
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    final view = got.view;
    final s = S.of(context);
    setState(() {
      if (view == null) {
        // A lost channel is said as a reconnection: nothing was asked to change.
        final code = got.code ?? 'refused';
        _code = code == AiWords.outcomeUnknown ? 'offline' : code;
      } else {
        _rows = _rowsOf(s, view);
      }
    });
  }

  static List<_Row> _rowsOf(S s, AiFullView view) {
    List<_Row> lines(String text) => [for (final l in const LineSplitter().convert(text)) _Line(l)];
    return [
      if (view.text case final text?) ...lines(text),
      if (view.request case final request?) ...lines(request.message),
      if (view.output case final output?) ...lines(output),
      for (final d in view.diffs) ...[
        const _Gap(),
        _Title(d.path),
        for (final l in diffLines(d.oldText, d.newText)) _Diff(l),
      ],
      for (final path in view.bigDiffs) ...[const _Gap(), _Title(path), _Note(s.aiFromComputerOnly)],
      if (view.input case final input?) ...[const _Gap(), ...lines(input)],
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final rows = _rows;
    final code = _code;
    final Widget body;
    if (rows != null) {
      body = ListView.builder(
        key: const Key('ai.item.lines'),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 24),
        itemCount: rows.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, i) => _row(context, rows[i]),
      );
    } else if (code != null) {
      body = Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
          child: Text(
            AiWords.failure(s, code) ?? s.somethingWentWrong,
            key: const Key('ai.item.error'),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.typo.paragraph.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      body = Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const CircularProgressIndicator(),
            if (_parts > 0) ...[
              12.sizedHeight,
              Text(
                s.aiLoadingParts(_part, _parts),
                key: const Key('ai.item.loading'),
                style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
    }
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: colors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 4, 12, 6),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    key: const Key('ai.item.back'),
                    tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
                    icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, color: colors.primary),
                    onPressed: () => context.router.maybePop(),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      widget.title,
                      key: const Key('ai.item.title'),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: context.typo.subHeader.bold.copyWith(color: colors.primaryText),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(child: body),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _row(BuildContext context, _Row row) {
    final colors = context.colors;
    return switch (row) {
      _Line(:final text) => Text(
        text.length > kShownLineChars ? '${text.substring(0, kShownLineChars)}…' : text,
        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono, fontSize: 12, height: 1.35, color: colors.primaryText),
      ),
      _Diff(:final line) => AiDiffLineRow(line: line),
      _Title(:final text) => Text(text, style: context.typo.metadata12.bold.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText)),
      _Note(:final text) => Text(text, style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText)),
      _Gap() => 10.sizedHeight,
    };
  }
}
```

```dart
  /// The question the computer waits for, as the form to answer it: its card when the phone holds it,
  /// else one without a form, which is answered on the computer (it can still be declined). A form too big
  /// for the mirror that was loaded in full (V2-2b B16) is the form.
  MirrorAsk? _waitingAsk(MirrorHead head, AiMirror mirror) {
    final ref = head.ask;
    if (ref == null) return null;
    final card = ref.item == null ? null : mirror.at(ref.item!);
    final MirrorAsk ask;
    if (card is MirrorAsk) {
      if (!card.open) return null;
      ask = card;
    } else {
      ask = MirrorAsk(ref.item ?? -1, 0, 0, id: ref.id, status: 'open');
    }
    final form = ask.request == null ? _controller.formOf(ask.id) : null;
    return form == null ? ask : MirrorAsk(ask.index, ask.rev, ask.turn, id: ask.id, status: ask.status, request: form);
  }

  /// V2-2b B16: item [index] in full, on its own page.
  void _viewAll(int index) {
    final title = _itemTitle(S.of(context), _controller.mirror?.at(index), _controller.head?.agentName ?? '');
    unawaited(context.router.push(AiItemRoute(title: title, load: (onPart) => _controller.loadFull(index, onPart))));
  }

  static String _itemTitle(S s, MirrorItem? item, String agent) => switch (item) {
    MirrorTool() => AiWords.toolTitle(s, item),
    MirrorAsk() => s.aiAskTitle(agent),
    MirrorText(kind: MirrorTextKind.thought) => s.aiThought,
    MirrorText(kind: MirrorTextKind.agent) => agent,
    _ => s.aiViewAll,
  };

  /// V2-2b B16: the whole form of question [ask] (card [index]).
  Future<void> _loadForm(int ask, int index) async {
    setState(() => _loadingForm = true);
    final code = await _controller.loadForm(ask, index);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _loadingForm = false);
    _say(code == AiWords.outcomeUnknown ? 'offline' : code);
  }
```

`_viewAll` is a method of the page: the same tear-off on every build, so `AiItemActions` does not make the conversation rebuild.

### Task 14: Session history, resume, folder for a tab without one

Spec B17 and B18, protocol §4.1 (`ai.history`, `ai.open {resume}`, `ai.folder`), tests §8 (B17/B18), Review Focus 3.

- **`ai.history {sid, rid, cursor?}`** answers a page of the agent's earlier sessions in the session's folder (`session/list`, V2-1 D15) through `_ask` (Task 10). Only while the agent runs: before that `not_ready` (the phone asks again once the session runs). An agent without `session/list` is `refused` — the phone shows no button for it (`hist` in the header, Task 6). A page carries at most 50 sessions, titles cut to 120 bytes; an agent page longer than that is served by the hub itself in pages of 50 (its own cursor `shellx-rest-<n>`, kept per phone), so no session is skipped, and the agent's next cursor comes after the last of them. An id or a cursor too long to be sent back is never given to the phone (`kAiAcpIdBytes`, `kAiHistoryCursorBytes`).
- **`ai.open {resume}`**: the V2-2a checks (a ready agent, a folder key the window offers, D9) and a resume id that is not empty and at most 200 bytes; the window opens a new AI tab with `sessionId: resume`, **not selected** (`select: false`), whose agent starts and reopens it with `session/load` (D15) — as the desktop's own History does (`AiPaneView._history`). Two tabs on one agent session when the user opens it twice: as on the desktop (cost written in B17).
- **`ai.folder {sid, rid, folder}`** only for a tab without a folder (`no_folder`, D14) and only a key the window offers now (D9, R18). The window does what the tab's own "Use this folder" does (`AiPaneView._useFolder`): its runtime, if any, is forgotten and the pane gets the folder. The hub then looks at its tabs at once: a phone parked on that session (told `no_folder`) attaches again and its agent starts (§13 D15).
- Every `AiControl` and `AiSessionSource` implementer gets the new members: `FakeAiControl`/`FakeAiSource` (shellx_agent rig), the four fakes of `packages/shellx_client/test/ai_test.dart` and `ai_edges_test.dart`, and the desktop's `DesktopAiSource`/`_RuntimeControl`.

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';

import 'wire.dart';

/// V2-2b B17: the most sessions one `ai.history` page carries.
const int kAiHistoryPage = 50;

/// The longest title of an earlier session a page carries, in UTF-8 bytes.
const int kAiHistoryTitleBytes = 120;

/// The longest agent session id a phone is given — and so the longest it
/// sends back in `ai.open {resume}`.
const int kAiAcpIdBytes = 200;

/// The longest cursor of a next page a phone is given — and so the longest it
/// sends back in `ai.history {cursor}`.
const int kAiHistoryCursorBytes = 1024;

/// An `updatedAt` longer than this is no date: it is left out.
const int _atBytes = 64;

/// One earlier session of the agent in the session's folder
/// (`session/list`, V2-1 D15).
final class AiPastSession with Redacted {
  const AiPastSession({required this.acp, this.title, this.at});

  /// The agent's session id: what `ai.open {resume}` sends back.
  final String acp;

  /// Its title, cut; null when the agent gave none.
  final String? title;

  /// When it last changed (ISO 8601, as the agent said it).
  final String? at;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {'acp': acp, 'title': ?title, 'at': ?at};

  /// Null without an `acp`.
  static AiPastSession? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final acp = jString(j, 'acp');
    if (acp == null || acp.isEmpty) return null;
    return AiPastSession(
      acp: acp,
      title: jString(j, 'title'),
      at: jString(j, 'at'),
    );
  }
}

/// V2-2b B17: what `ai.history` answers — a page of [sessions], the cursor
/// of the [next] page (null: this was the last), and the agent's id of the
/// session that asked ([current]: open already, not offered again).
final class AiHistoryPage with Redacted {
  const AiHistoryPage({this.sessions = const [], this.next, this.current});

  final List<AiPastSession> sessions;
  final String? next;
  final String? current;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'sessions': [for (final s in sessions) s.toJson()],
    'next': ?next,
    'current': ?current,
  };

  static AiHistoryPage fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) => AiHistoryPage(
    sessions: [
      for (final s in jMaps(j, 'sessions')) ?AiPastSession.fromJson(s),
    ],
    next: jString(j, 'next'),
    current: jString(j, 'current'),
  );
}

/// [result] (the agent's `session/list` page) as the body of `ai.history`:
/// at most [kAiHistoryPage] sessions, titles cut to [kAiHistoryTitleBytes].
/// A session id, a cursor or a [current] id too long to be sent back is left
/// out, and so is an `updatedAt` that is no date. These limits keep a page
/// far below one body (V2-2 D4); should it still be over [kAiRecordBytes],
/// its last sessions go, and its next page with them, which would skip them.
Uint8List encodeHistoryPage(ListSessionsResult result, {String? current}) {
  String? sendable(String? id, int max) =>
      id == null || id.isEmpty || utf8Length(id) > max ? null : id;
  final sessions = <AiPastSession>[];
  for (final s in result.sessions) {
    if (sessions.length == kAiHistoryPage) break;
    final acp = sendable(s.sessionId, kAiAcpIdBytes);
    if (acp == null) continue;
    final title = s.title?.trim();
    sessions.add(
      AiPastSession(
        acp: acp,
        title: title == null || title.isEmpty
            ? null
            : clipText(title, kAiHistoryTitleBytes),
        at: sendable(s.updatedAt, _atBytes),
      ),
    );
  }
  var page = AiHistoryPage(
    sessions: sessions,
    next: sendable(result.nextCursor, kAiHistoryCursorBytes),
    current: sendable(current, kAiAcpIdBytes),
  );
  var body = encodeBody(page.toJson());
  while (body.length > kAiRecordBytes && page.sessions.isNotEmpty) {
    page = AiHistoryPage(
      sessions: page.sessions.sublist(0, page.sessions.length - 1),
      current: page.current,
    );
    body = encodeBody(page.toJson());
  }
  return body;
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B17: a page of the agent's earlier sessions in the session's
  /// folder. Only while the agent runs (`not_ready` before it does: the phone
  /// asks again once it runs); an agent without `session/list` is
  /// `refused`. An agent page longer than [kAiHistoryPage] is served from
  /// here in pages of that many, under the hub's own cursor, so that the
  /// phone skips none; the agent's next cursor comes after the last of them.
  void _history(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiHistory h) {
    unawaited(
      _ask(mobileId, phone, h.sid, h.rid, (c) async {
        final s = c.state;
        if (s.phase != AgentPhase.ready && s.phase != AgentPhase.running) {
          return const _Reply.refuse('not_ready');
        }
        if (!s.capabilities.listSessions) {
          return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
        }
        final cursor = h.cursor;
        final held = phone.historyRest;
        final List<SessionSummary> sessions;
        final String? after;
        if (held != null && held.sid == h.sid && held.cursor == cursor) {
          sessions = held.rest;
          after = held.next;
        } else {
          if (cursor != null &&
              (cursor.isEmpty ||
                  utf8Length(cursor) > kAiHistoryCursorBytes)) {
            return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
          }
          final page = await c.listSessions(cursor: cursor);
          if (page == null) return const _Reply.refuse('refused');
          sessions = page.sessions;
          after = page.nextCursor;
        }
        phone.historyRest = null;
        var next = after;
        if (sessions.length > kAiHistoryPage) {
          final mine = 'shellx-rest-${_nextHistoryRest++}';
          phone.historyRest = (
            sid: h.sid,
            cursor: mine,
            rest: sessions.sublist(kAiHistoryPage),
            next: after,
          );
          next = mine;
        }
        return _Reply.ok(
          encodeHistoryPage(
            ListSessionsResult(
              sessions: sessions.take(kAiHistoryPage).toList(),
              nextCursor: next,
            ),
            current: s.sessionId,
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  /// V2-2b B18: the folder of a tab that has none (V2-2 D14 `no_folder`): a
  /// key the window offers now (D9, R18), never a path. The window then does
  /// what the tab's own "Use this folder" does, and the hub looks at its tabs
  /// at once: a phone parked on the session attaches again and its agent
  /// starts (V2-2 §13 D15). One answer, to [phone] only.
  Future<void> _folder(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiFolder f) async {
    String? code;
    try {
      final paneId = _paneOf(f.sid);
      final entry = paneId == null
          ? null
          : _source.sessions.where((e) => e.paneId == paneId).firstOrNull;
      if (paneId == null || entry == null) {
        code = 'not_found';
      } else if (entry.unavailable != AiRemoteState.noFolder ||
          !_source.folders.any((x) => x.key == f.folder)) {
        code = 'refused';
      } else if (!await _source.chooseFolder(paneId, f.folder)) {
        code = 'refused';
      } else {
        _rescan();
      }
    } on Object {
      code = 'refused'; // the window's code failed: still one answer
    }
    _send(
      mobileId,
      AiResult(rid: f.rid, ok: code == null, code: code),
      phone,
    );
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/misc.dart' show Override;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_agent/shellx_agent.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/testing.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_desktop/src/ai/ai_phone.dart';
import 'package:shellx_desktop/src/ai/ai_runtimes.dart';
import 'package:shellx_desktop/src/terminal/terminal_tabs.dart';

import '../cli/support/cli_container.dart';
import 'ai_fakes.dart';
import 'fake_local_sessions.dart';

/// The phone of these tests.
const testPhone = '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333';

/// A window with real tabs and runtimes on fake agents, and its phone hub
/// (V2-2 D2): what a phone's requests reach, and what the hub sends back
/// ([out]). The container is disposed with the test.
final class PhoneHubRig {
  PhoneHubRig(FakeScenario scenario, {List<Override> more = const []})
    : fakes = FakeAiRuntimes(scenario) {
    c = cliContainer(
      FakeLocalSessions(),
      overrides: [...fakes.overrides, ...more],
    );
    hub = c.read(aiPhoneHubProvider);
    hub.outbound.listen(out.add);
  }

  final FakeAiRuntimes fakes;
  late final ProviderContainer c;
  late final AiPhoneHub hub;
  final out = <OutboundMessage>[];

  List<T> sent<T>() => out.map((o) => o.message).whereType<T>().toList();

  /// The last answer to request [rid].
  AiResult result(int rid) => sent<AiResult>().lastWhere((r) => r.rid == rid);

  /// The last listing the phone was sent.
  AiListing listing() {
    final r = sent<AiListResult>().last;
    return AiListing.fromJson(decodeBody(r.body)!, available: r.available);
  }

  String sidOf(TerminalTab tab) => hub.sidOf(tab.ai!.id);

  AiSessionState stateOf(TerminalTab tab) =>
      c.read(aiRuntimesProvider.notifier).existing(tab.ai!.id)!.state;

  /// [message] from the phone.
  void say(AiMessage message) => hub.handle(testPhone, message);

  /// Waits (real time, 2 s at most) until [test] holds.
  Future<void> until(bool Function() test) async {
    for (var i = 0; i < 400 && !test(); i++) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 5));
    }
    expect(test(), isTrue, reason: 'condition not reached');
  }

  /// Waits for the answer to request [rid].
  Future<AiResult> answer(int rid) async {
    await until(() => sent<AiResult>().any((r) => r.rid == rid));
    return result(rid);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/testing.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_desktop/src/terminal/terminal_tabs.dart';

import '../support/ai_fakes.dart';
import '../support/ai_phone_rig.dart';
import '../support/ai_tabs.dart';

/// V2-2b B17, B18 on the real window: history, resume, and a folder chosen on
/// the phone for a tab without one.
void main() {
  test("the agent's earlier sessions reach the phone; one opens in a new tab "
      'that reopens it, not selected (B17)', () async {
    final rig = PhoneHubRig(
      const FakeScenario(
        sessions: [
          {
            'sessionId': 'old-1',
            'cwd': '/w',
            'title': 'Nút đăng xuất',
            'updatedAt': '2026-10-13T09:30:00Z',
          },
        ],
      ),
    );
    final tab = openTestAiTab(rig.c, cwd: testAiCwd, select: true);
    final sid = rig.sidOf(tab);
    rig.say(AiAttach(sid: sid));
    await rig.until(() => rig.stateOf(tab).phase == AgentPhase.ready);
    rig.say(AiHistory(sid: sid, rid: 1));
    final page = AiHistoryPage.fromJson(
      decodeBody((await rig.answer(1)).body)!,
    );
    expect([for (final s in page.sessions) s.acp], ['old-1']);
    expect(page.current, 'sess-1');
    rig.say(const AiList());
    final folder = rig
        .listing()
        .folders
        .singleWhere((f) => f.path == testAiCwd)
        .key;
    final selected = rig.c.read(terminalTabsProvider).selectedId;
    rig.say(AiOpen(rid: 2, agent: 'claude', folder: folder, resume: 'old-1'));
    final opened = await rig.answer(2);
    expect(opened.ok, isTrue);
    final again = rig.c
        .read(terminalTabsProvider)
        .tabs
        .singleWhere((t) => t.ai != null && rig.sidOf(t) == opened.sid);
    expect(again.ai!.sessionId, 'old-1');
    expect(again.ai!.cwd, testAiCwd);
    expect(
      rig.c.read(terminalTabsProvider).selectedId,
      selected,
      reason: 'the computer keeps the tab it shows',
    );
    await rig.until(() => rig.fakes.launcher.channels.length == 2);
    await rig.until(
      () => rig.fakes.agent(1).received.contains('session/load:old-1'),
    );
  });

  test('a tab without a folder runs in one the computer offers; the phone '
      'waiting for it sees it start; a folder twice, or a key not offered, '
      'is refused (B18)', () async {
    final rig = PhoneHubRig(const FakeScenario());
    openTestAiTab(rig.c, cwd: testAiCwd, select: false); // offers its folder
    final bare = openTestAiTab(rig.c, cwd: null, select: false);
    final sid = rig.sidOf(bare);
    rig.say(const AiList());
    expect(
      rig.listing().sessions.singleWhere((s) => s.sid == sid).state,
      AiRemoteState.noFolder,
    );
    final folder = rig
        .listing()
        .folders
        .singleWhere((f) => f.path == testAiCwd)
        .key;
    rig.say(AiAttach(sid: sid)); // told why it cannot run, and waits
    rig.say(AiFolder(sid: sid, rid: 1, folder: folder));
    expect((await rig.answer(1)).ok, isTrue);
    final now = rig.c
        .read(terminalTabsProvider)
        .tabs
        .singleWhere((t) => t.id == bare.id);
    expect(now.ai!.cwd, testAiCwd);
    expect(now.ai!.sessionId, isNull);
    await rig.until(() => rig.fakes.launcher.channels.isNotEmpty);
    await rig.until(() => rig.stateOf(now).phase == AgentPhase.ready);
    expect(
      rig.sent<AiSnapshot>().where((s) => s.sid == sid),
      hasLength(greaterThanOrEqualTo(2)),
      reason: 'the "cannot run" snapshot, then the live one',
    );
    rig.say(AiFolder(sid: sid, rid: 2, folder: folder));
    expect((await rig.answer(2)).code, 'refused', reason: 'it has one now');
    final other = openTestAiTab(rig.c, cwd: null, select: false);
    rig.say(
      AiFolder(
        sid: rig.sidOf(other),
        rid: 3,
        folder: 'path:/typed/on/the/phone',
      ),
    );
    expect((await rig.answer(3)).code, 'refused');
  });
}
```

```dart
  @override
  Future<int?> open(String agentId, String folderKey, {String? resume}) async {
    final path = folders.where((f) => f.key == folderKey).firstOrNull?.path;
    final agent = aiAgentById(_ref.read(aiAgentsProvider), agentId);
    if (path == null || agent == null) return null;
    final tabId = _ref
        .read(terminalTabsProvider.notifier)
        .openAiTab(
          agentId: agent.id,
          agentName: agent.name,
          title: _ref.read(appL10nProvider).aiNewSession,
          cwd: path,
          // V2-2b B17: reopens that earlier session (`session/load`), as the
          // desktop's History does (V2-1 D15).
          sessionId: resume,
          workspace: _workspaceFor(folderKey, path),
          select: false, // the computer's user keeps their tab (V2-2 D9)
        );
    final pane = _ref
        .read(terminalTabsProvider)
        .tabs
        .where((t) => t.id == tabId)
        .firstOrNull
        ?.ai;
    if (pane == null) return null;
    // Its agent starts at once (D9). A runtime that cannot be made leaves no
    // tab behind: the phone hears "refused" (§7), the computer shows nothing.
    if (control(pane.id, start: true) == null) {
      _ref.read(terminalTabsProvider.notifier).close(tabId);
      return null;
    }
    return pane.id;
  }

  /// V2-2b B18: what the tab's own "Use this folder" does
  /// (`AiPaneView._useFolder`), for a tab that has no folder yet: a runtime it
  /// may have is forgotten and the pane gets [folderKey]'s folder (a new
  /// session: no session id). False when the pane has a folder, is gone, or
  /// the key is not offered now. The runtime is made, and its agent started,
  /// when a phone attaches or the pane shows (V2-2 D15).
  @override
  Future<bool> chooseFolder(int paneId, String folderKey) async {
    final path = folders.where((f) => f.key == folderKey).firstOrNull?.path;
    final pane = _ref
        .read(terminalTabsProvider)
        .tabOfPane(paneId)
        ?.aiPanes[paneId];
    if (path == null || pane == null || pane.cwd != null) return false;
    _ref.read(aiRuntimesProvider.notifier).forget(paneId);
    _ref
        .read(terminalTabsProvider.notifier)
        .updateAiPane(paneId, (p) => p.copyWith(cwd: path, sessionId: null));
    return true;
  }
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_agent/shellx_agent.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';

import 'drive.dart';
import 'harness.dart';

/// A desktop that says what a test scripts (V2-2b): its listing offers
/// [features]; every `ai.*` message the phone sends is recorded, and a
/// request is answered with what [answer] returns — or held when it returns
/// null (the test answers it later with [say]).
final class ScriptedDesktop implements AiEndpoint {
  ScriptedDesktop({this.features = const {}});

  final Set<String> features;
  final _out = StreamController<OutboundMessage>.broadcast(sync: true);
  final received = <AiMessage>[];
  AiMessage? Function(AiMessage message)? answer;

  @override
  Stream<OutboundMessage> get outbound => _out.stream;

  @override
  void handle(String mobileId, AiMessage message) {
    received.add(message);
    if (message is AiList) {
      say(
        AiListResult(
          available: true,
          body: encodeBody(AiListing(features: features).toJson()),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    final reply = answer?.call(message);
    if (reply != null) say(reply);
  }

  @override
  void phoneGone(String mobileId) {}

  @override
  void allPhonesGone() {}

  void say(AiMessage message) => _out.add(OutboundMessage(phoneId, message));

  List<T> got<T extends AiMessage>() => received.whereType<T>().toList();
}

/// The phone's AI of [h] once it knows what a V2-2b request needs (B1): the
/// protocol (a desktop list) and the listing (watched).
MachineAi readyAi(Harness h) {
  final machine = h.phoneMachine;
  h.run(machine.listSessions(includeDesktop: true));
  h.run(machine.ai.watch());
  settle(h.async);
  return machine.ai;
}
```
