```dart
import 'package:fake_async/fake_async.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import 'support/harness.dart';
import 'support/scripted_desktop.dart';

const _sid = 'ep.-1';

Matcher _aiError(String code) =>
    isA<AiRequestException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', code);

/// V2-2b B17, B18 on the phone's client.
void main() {
  late TestKeys keys;
  setUpAll(() async => keys = await TestKeys.generate());

  test('history: a page as the computer sent it; the next one asked with its '
      'cursor', () {
    fakeAsync((async) {
      final desktop = ScriptedDesktop(features: {AiFeature.history});
      desktop.answer = (m) => switch (m) {
        AiHistory(:final rid, cursor: null) => AiResult(
          rid: rid,
          ok: true,
          body: encodeBody({
            'sessions': [
              {'acp': 'old-1', 'title': 'Nút đăng xuất'},
            ],
            'next': 'c2',
            'current': 'sess-1',
          }),
        ),
        AiHistory(:final rid) => AiResult(
          rid: rid,
          ok: true,
          body: encodeBody({'sessions': <Object?>[]}),
        ),
        _ => null,
      };
      final h = Harness(async, keys, ai: desktop);
      final ai = readyAi(h);
      final first = h.run(ai.history(_sid));
      expect([for (final s in first.sessions) s.acp], ['old-1']);
      expect((first.next, first.current), ('c2', 'sess-1'));
      expect(h.run(ai.history(_sid, cursor: 'c2')).sessions, isEmpty);
      expect([for (final m in desktop.got<AiHistory>()) m.cursor], [
        null,
        'c2',
      ]);
      desktop.answer = (m) =>
          m is AiHistory ? AiResult(rid: m.rid, ok: false, code: 'not_ready') : null;
      expect(() => h.run(ai.history(_sid)), throwsA(_aiError('not_ready')));
    });
  });

  test('resume: an ai.open that names the earlier session; its sid', () {
    fakeAsync((async) {
      final desktop = ScriptedDesktop(features: {AiFeature.history});
      desktop.answer = (m) =>
          m is AiOpen ? AiResult(rid: m.rid, ok: true, sid: 'ep.-5') : null;
      final h = Harness(async, keys, ai: desktop);
      final ai = readyAi(h);
      expect(h.run(ai.resume('claude', 'ws:a', 'old-1')), 'ep.-5');
      final open = desktop.got<AiOpen>().single;
      expect((open.agent, open.folder, open.resume), (
        'claude',
        'ws:a',
        'old-1',
      ));
      desktop.answer = (m) => m is AiOpen ? AiResult(rid: m.rid, ok: true) : null;
      expect(
        () => h.run(ai.resume('claude', 'ws:a', 'old-1')),
        throwsA(_aiError('refused')),
        reason: 'ok without a session is no session',
      );
    });
  });

  test("chooseFolder: the key; the computer's refusal comes back as its code",
      () {
    fakeAsync((async) {
      final desktop = ScriptedDesktop(features: {AiFeature.folder});
      desktop.answer = (m) => m is AiFolder
          ? AiResult(
              rid: m.rid,
              ok: m.folder == 'ws:a',
              code: m.folder == 'ws:a' ? null : 'refused',
            )
          : null;
      final h = Harness(async, keys, ai: desktop);
      final ai = readyAi(h);
      h.run(ai.chooseFolder(_sid, 'ws:a'));
      expect(
        () => h.run(ai.chooseFolder(_sid, 'path:/x')),
        throwsA(_aiError('refused')),
      );
      expect([for (final m in desktop.got<AiFolder>()) (m.sid, m.folder)], [
        (_sid, 'ws:a'),
        (_sid, 'path:/x'),
      ]);
    });
  });

  test('a computer that cannot (ai 1, or a listing without the feature): '
      'nothing is sent, unsupported at once (B1, Review Focus 2)', () {
    for (final (protocol, features) in [
      (1, {AiFeature.history, AiFeature.folder}),
      (kAiProtocol, <String>{}),
    ]) {
      fakeAsync((async) {
        final desktop = ScriptedDesktop(features: features);
        final h = Harness(async, keys, ai: desktop, aiProtocol: protocol);
        final ai = readyAi(h);
        expect(
          () => h.run(ai.history(_sid)),
          throwsA(_aiError('unsupported')),
        );
        expect(
          () => h.run(ai.resume('claude', 'ws:a', 'old-1')),
          throwsA(_aiError('unsupported')),
        );
        expect(
          () => h.run(ai.chooseFolder(_sid, 'ws:a')),
          throwsA(_aiError('unsupported')),
        );
        expect(desktop.got<AiHistory>(), isEmpty);
        expect(desktop.got<AiOpen>(), isEmpty);
        expect(desktop.got<AiFolder>(), isEmpty);
      });
    }
  });
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B17: a page of the earlier sessions of [sid]'s agent in its folder
  /// ([cursor]: the next page). Throws [AiRequestException]: `not_ready`

  Future<AiHistoryPage> history(String sid, {String? cursor}) async {

  /// V2-2b B17: reopens the agent's earlier session [acp] in a new AI tab of
  /// [agent] in [folder] (a listing key: the folder of the session the
  /// history came from); the new session's sid.
  Future<String> resume(String agent, String folder, String acp) async {
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.history,
      null,
      (rid) => AiOpen(rid: rid, agent: agent, folder: folder, resume: acp),
    );
    final sid = result.sid;
    if (sid == null) throw const AiRequestException('refused');
    return sid;
  }

  Future<void> chooseFolder(String sid, String folder) => _feature(
    AiFeature.folder,
    sid,

  );
```

### Task 15: Phone: "Lịch sử phiên" and "Dùng thư mục này"

Spec B17, B18 on the phone (§5 strings `aiHistory`, `aiUseFolder`), success criteria 8 and 9, tests §8 (B17/B18, app widgets).

- **"Lịch sử phiên"** is an entry of the session page's "⋯" menu (Task 6 scaffolding), shown when the computer can (`can(AiFeature.history)`, R3) and the agent offers `session/list` (`MirrorHead.history`, Task 6), on a session that is not closed. It opens a bottom sheet with the agent's earlier sessions in this folder, a page at a time ("Tải thêm"); the session open here is not offered. A history asked while the agent does not run (`not_ready`) says so and asks again by itself once the header shows the agent running. A tap reopens that session on the computer in a new AI tab (not shown there) and the phone goes to it in place of this page (`router.replace`). The folder of the new tab is the listing's key for this session's folder (D9): never a path.
- **A tab without a folder** (`no_folder`, D14): when the computer can (`can(AiFeature.folder)`) and offers folders, the page shows them (one to pick) and "Dùng thư mục này" instead of "Chọn thư mục trên máy tính". The computer then starts the session and its snapshot comes (Task 14). Otherwise the V2-2a text stays.

```dart
  /// V2-2b B17: the history pages by cursor (null: the first one), every ask (session, cursor), and a code
  /// [history] fails with (`not_ready`) besides [failWith].
  final Map<String?, AiHistoryPage> historyPages = {};
  final List<(String, String?)> historyAsks = [];
  String? historyFailWith;

  /// V2-2b B17: every resume (agent, folder key, earlier session), and the sid it opens.
  final List<(String, String, String)> resumed = [];
  String resumedSid = 'e.-7';

  /// V2-2b B18: every folder chosen (session, folder key).
  final List<(String, String)> foldersChosen = [];

  @override
  Future<AiHistoryPage> history(String sid, {String? cursor}) async {
    historyAsks.add((sid, cursor));
    await _request();
    final code = historyFailWith;
    if (code != null) throw AiRequestException(code);
    return historyPages[cursor] ?? const AiHistoryPage();
  }

  @override
  Future<String> resume(String agent, String folder, String acp) async {
    resumed.add((agent, folder, acp));
    await _request();
    return resumedSid;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> chooseFolder(String sid, String folder) async {
    foldersChosen.add((sid, folder));
    await _request();
  }
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B17: when an earlier session last changed, "2026-10-13 09:30" in local time (as the desktop's History says
  /// it); the agent's own text when it is no date, and nothing when it sent none.
  static String historyWhen(String? at) {
    final t = at == null ? null : DateTime.tryParse(at);
    if (t == null) return at ?? '';
    final l = t.toLocal();
    String two(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '${l.year}-${two(l.month)}-${two(l.day)} ${two(l.hour)}:${two(l.minute)}';
  }
```

In `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart`, add after `unqueue`:

```dart

  /// V2-2b B18: the folders the computer offers for a tab without one (the held listing's).
  List<AiFolderChoice> get folders => listing?.folders ?? const [];

  /// V2-2b B18: runs this session, a tab without a folder, in [folder] (a listing key). Null when the computer took
  /// it — the session then starts there and its snapshot comes —, else the failure code.
  Future<String?> chooseFolder(String folder) => _simple(() => _machine!.ai.chooseFolder(sid, folder));

  /// V2-2b B17: a page of the agent's earlier sessions in this session's folder ([cursor]: the next one): the page,
  /// or the failure code (`not_ready` while the agent does not run).
  Future<({AiHistoryPage? page, String? code})> history({String? cursor}) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return (page: null, code: 'refused');
    try {
      return (page: await machine.ai.history(sid, cursor: cursor), code: null);
    } catch (error) {
      return (page: null, code: _failure(error));
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B17: reopens the agent's earlier session [acp] on the computer in a new AI tab of this session's agent and
  /// folder (not shown there): its sid, or the failure code. The folder is the listing's key for this session's
  /// folder (V2-2 D9: never a path). One that went out and got no answer may have opened it
  /// ([AiWords.openUnknown]): it is never asked again by itself (V2-2 D13).
  Future<({String? sid, String? code})> resume(String acp) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    final head = this.head;
    final cwd = head?.cwd;
    final folder = cwd == null ? null : folders.where((f) => f.path == cwd).firstOrNull?.key;
    if (machine == null || head == null || folder == null) return (sid: null, code: 'refused');
    try {
      return (sid: await machine.ai.resume(head.agentId, folder, acp), code: null);
    } catch (error) {
      final code = _failure(error);
      return (sid: null, code: code == AiWords.outcomeUnknown ? AiWords.openUnknown : code);
    }
  }
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// V2-2b B17 "Lịch sử phiên": the agent's earlier sessions in this session's folder, a page at a time ("Tải thêm"),
/// as the agent lists them; the session open here is not offered. Asked while the agent does not run, it says so
/// and asks again once the header shows it running. A tap returns that session's id (the agent's); null when
/// dismissed.
Future<String?> showAiHistorySheet(BuildContext context, AiSessionController controller) {
  return showModalBottomSheet<String>(
    context: context,
    showDragHandle: true,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    backgroundColor: context.colors.surface,
    shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
    builder: (context) => _HistorySheet(controller: controller),
  );
}

class _HistorySheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const _HistorySheet({required this.controller});

  final AiSessionController controller;

  @override
  State<_HistorySheet> createState() => _HistorySheetState();
}

class _HistorySheetState extends State<_HistorySheet> {
  final _sessions = <AiPastSession>[];
  String? _current;
  String? _next;

  /// Why the last page did not come (`not_ready`, …); null when it came.
  String? _code;
  var _loading = false;
  var _loaded = false;
  void Function()? _stopWatching;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_load(null));
    // A history asked while the agent did not run comes once it runs (the header says when).
    _stopWatching = effect(() {
      widget.controller.version.value;
      if (_code != 'not_ready' || _loading || !_runs(widget.controller.head)) return;
      scheduleMicrotask(() {
        if (mounted) unawaited(_load(null));
      });
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _stopWatching?.call();
    super.dispose();
  }

  static bool _runs(MirrorHead? head) => head?.phase == 'ready' || head?.phase == 'running';

  Future<void> _load(String? cursor) async {
    if (_loading) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _code = null;
    });
    final result = await widget.controller.history(cursor: cursor);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = false;
      _loaded = true;
      final page = result.page;
      if (page == null) {
        _code = result.code;
        return;
      }
      if (cursor == null) _sessions.clear();
      _sessions.addAll(page.sessions);
      _current = page.current;
      _next = page.next;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final code = _code;
    final shown = [
      for (final p in _sessions)
        if (p.acp != _current) p,
    ];
    Widget line(Key key, String text) => Padding(
      key: key,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
      child: Text(text, style: context.typo.paragraph.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText)),
    );
    return SafeArea(
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.75),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(s.aiHistory, style: context.typo.heading20.heavy),
              8.sizedHeight,
              if (code == 'not_ready')
                line(const Key('ai.history.notReady'), s.aiHistoryNotReady)
              else if (code != null)
                line(const Key('ai.history.error'), AiWords.failure(s, code) ?? s.somethingWentWrong)
              else if (!_loaded)
                const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(24), child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()))
              else if (shown.isEmpty && _next == null)
                line(const Key('ai.history.empty'), s.aiHistoryEmpty),
              Flexible(
                child: ListView(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  children: [
                    for (final p in shown)
                      ListTile(
                        key: ValueKey('ai.history.${p.acp}'),
                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        title: Text(p.title ?? s.aiUntitled, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                        subtitle: p.at == null ? null : Text(AiWords.historyWhen(p.at)),
                        onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, p.acp),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (_next != null && code == null)
                TextButton(
                  key: const Key('ai.history.more'),
                  onPressed: _loading ? null : () => unawaited(_load(_next)),
                  child: Text(s.aiHistoryMore),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Task 16: Images from the phone: `ai.blob`, `ai.prompt {blobs}`

Spec B12, protocol §4.1 (`ai.blob`, `ai.prompt.blobs`, `img`), §6 ("ảnh chỉ nằm trong bộ nhớ desktop tới khi gửi cho agent"), tests §8 (B12), Review Focus 3. Rulings R17 (blob numbers are the phone's own).

- **Upload.** The phone sends an image as `ai.blob {rid, blob, part, parts, mime?, data}` parts of at most `kAiMaxBlobPartBytes` (48 KiB), at most four in flight (each part is one request of the budget, V2-2 D7); each part gets its own `ai.result`. A part the computer is too busy for (`busy`) goes again after 500 ms, three times at most. A lost channel fails the upload: the phone uploads the image again — never the prompt by itself (V2-2 D13).
- **Store.** `AiBlobStore` (new, shellx_agent) keeps what each phone uploads in memory only — never written, never logged: per phone at most 5 images, 10 MiB each, 20 MiB in all; an image nothing touched for 2 minutes is dropped (lazily on every use, and by a timer within 4 minutes without one); everything a phone uploaded goes when it leaves (`phoneGone`, `allPhonesGone`) and when the hub is disposed. A part sent again replaces itself while the image is incomplete; once whole, the image stays as it came. An image that needs room (a sixth, or past 20 MiB) takes it from the phone's least recently used ones: a prompt names five at most, and a phone whose upload failed uploads its images again under new numbers (Task 18) — refused instead, its retry would fail for the 2 minutes the leftovers of the try before are kept. An image over 10 MiB, or over all a phone may hold, is `too_large` and goes.
- **Prompt.** `ai.prompt {blobs}`: at most `kAiImagesMax`, no number twice, each image whole and of a type ShellX sends by its first bytes (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP: `aiImageMime`, moved from the desktop to `package:shellx_ai`) — else `refused`; more than five: `too_large`; an agent that said it takes none: `no_images`. With images the text may be empty. The images are taken from the store only once all this holds, right before the prompt goes to the window; the type that goes to the agent is the one the bytes say (an iPhone's HEIC re-encoded to JPEG arrives as `image/jpeg` whatever it was declared as).
- **Window.** `_RuntimeControl.send` makes the agent's blocks as the composer does (V2-1 D16): text, then `image` blocks, base64 off the UI isolate when they are many bytes (`aiEncodeImages`, moved out of the UI file into `apps/desktop/lib/src/ai/ai_image_encode.dart`). The agent's `initialize` may have answered while they were encoded: one that takes no images gets none (`AiRefused('no_images')`, checked with no `await` before `send`). Before `initialize` has answered nothing is known and the prompt is taken, queued while the agent starts, as on the computer; the composer's take-back of such a message (V2-1 D16) has no phone counterpart — an agent that then turns out to take no images answers that turn with its own error, which the session shows. The user record of a prompt with images carries `img: n` (the phone shows "2 ảnh", Task 18).

Create `packages/shellx_ai/lib/src/remote/images.dart` (moved from `apps/desktop/lib/src/ui/ai/ai_images.dart`: the code as it was, two doc comments name the phone):

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

import '../model/session_state.dart';

/// The most images one message takes (V2-1 D16, V2-2b B12).
const int kAiImagesMax = 5;

/// The largest image a message takes, pasted, dropped or sent from a phone
/// (agents refuse bigger ones).
const int kAiImageMaxBytes = 10 << 20;

/// The image type of [bytes] by their first bytes (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP);
/// null: not an image ShellX sends.
String? aiImageMime(Uint8List bytes) {
  bool starts(List<int> sig, [int at = 0]) {
    if (bytes.length < at + sig.length) return false;
    for (var i = 0; i < sig.length; i++) {
      if (bytes[at + i] != sig[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  if (starts([0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47])) return 'image/png';
  if (starts([0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF])) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (starts([0x47, 0x49, 0x46, 0x38])) return 'image/gif';
  if (starts([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46]) && starts([0x57, 0x45, 0x42, 0x50], 8)) {
    return 'image/webp';
  }
  return null;
}

/// Whether [state]'s agent has said it takes no images (`promptCapabilities.
/// image`). Before `initialize` has answered it has said nothing: a new tab
/// would otherwise tell its user "Claude does not take images" for the first
/// seconds of every session. Nothing is refused then; the composer asks again
/// when the message is sent.
bool aiTakesNoImages(AiSessionState state) =>
    state.agent != null && !state.capabilities.prompt.image;
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The store**

Create `packages/shellx_agent/lib/src/ai/ai_blob_store.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart' show kAiImageMaxBytes, kAiImagesMax;
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';

/// One image a phone is uploading, or has uploaded.
final class _Blob {
  _Blob(int parts) : pieces = List<Uint8List?>.filled(parts, null);

  final List<Uint8List?> pieces;
  String? mime;
  int bytes = 0;
  late DateTime touched;

  /// Every part came: the image, whole (the pieces are let go then).
  Uint8List? whole;
}

/// V2-2b B12: the images phones upload for their next prompt (`ai.blob`, in
/// parts of at most [kAiMaxBlobPartBytes]), held in memory until a prompt
/// takes them — never written anywhere, never logged. Per phone at most
/// [kAiImagesMax] images, [kAiImageMaxBytes] each and [phoneBytes] in all: an
/// image that needs room takes it from the phone's least recently used ones
/// (a prompt names [kAiImagesMax] at most, and a phone whose upload failed
/// uploads its images again under new numbers). An image nothing touched for
/// [idle] is dropped — at once by any use, and by a timer within twice
/// [idle] without one — and everything a phone uploaded goes when it leaves
/// ([dropPhone]).
final class AiBlobStore {
  AiBlobStore({
    DateTime Function()? now,
    this.idle = const Duration(minutes: 2),
    this.phoneBytes = 20 << 20,
  }) : _now = now ?? DateTime.now;

  /// The most parts an image of [kAiImageMaxBytes] takes.
  static const int maxParts =
      (kAiImageMaxBytes + kAiMaxBlobPartBytes - 1) ~/ kAiMaxBlobPartBytes;

  final DateTime Function() _now;
  final Duration idle;
  final int phoneBytes;

  /// Per phone, its images by number, the least recently used first.
  final _phones = <String, Map<int, _Blob>>{};
  Timer? _sweeper;

  /// Takes [part] of [phone]'s image [AiBlob.blob]. Null when taken — a part
  /// sent again replaces itself, and one of an image already whole changes
  /// nothing —, else the code of its `ai.result`: `refused` for a part that
  /// does not fit (a count of parts other than before, a number out of range,
  /// nothing or too much in it, no type on part 0), `too_large` for an image
  /// over [kAiImageMaxBytes] or [phoneBytes] (it is dropped).
  String? put(String phone, AiBlob part) {
    _sweep();
    final n = part.parts;
    if (n < 1 ||
        n > maxParts ||
        part.part < 0 ||
        part.part >= n ||
        part.data.isEmpty ||
        part.data.length > kAiMaxBlobPartBytes) {
      return 'refused';
    }
    final mime = part.mime;
    final typed = mime != null && mime.isNotEmpty && mime.length <= 100;
    final held = _phones[phone]?[part.blob];
    if ((part.part == 0 && !typed) ||
        (held != null && held.pieces.length != n)) {
      return 'refused';
    }
    final blobs = _phones.putIfAbsent(phone, () => {});
    final blob = blobs.remove(part.blob) ?? _Blob(n);
    blobs[part.blob] = blob..touched = _now(); // the most recently used, last
    if (blob.whole != null) return null;
    final size =
        blob.bytes - (blob.pieces[part.part]?.length ?? 0) + part.data.length;
    if (size > kAiImageMaxBytes || size > phoneBytes) {
      blobs.remove(part.blob);
      if (blobs.isEmpty) _phones.remove(phone);
      return 'too_large';
    }
    blob.pieces[part.part] = part.data;
    blob.bytes = size;
    if (part.part == 0) blob.mime = mime;
    // Room for it: the least recently used images go (this one is last).
    while (blobs.length > kAiImagesMax || _held(blobs) > phoneBytes) {
      blobs.remove(blobs.keys.first);
    }
    if (blob.pieces.every((p) => p != null)) {
      final whole = BytesBuilder(copy: false);
      for (final piece in blob.pieces) {
        whole.add(piece!);
      }
      blob.whole = whole.takeBytes();
      blob.pieces.fillRange(0, n, null);
    }
    _arm();
    return null;
  }

  /// Whether [phone]'s image [blob] came whole.
  bool complete(String phone, int blob) {
    _sweep();
    return _phones[phone]?[blob]?.whole != null;
  }

  /// [phone]'s image [blob] when it came whole, left in the store (used:
  /// it is the most recently used now); null otherwise.
  ({String? mime, Uint8List bytes})? peek(String phone, int blob) {
    _sweep();
    final blobs = _phones[phone];
    final b = blobs?.remove(blob);
    if (blobs == null || b == null) return null;
    blobs[blob] = b..touched = _now();
    final whole = b.whole;
    return whole == null ? null : (mime: b.mime, bytes: whole);
  }

  /// [peek], and the image leaves the store: a prompt took it.
  ({String? mime, Uint8List bytes})? take(String phone, int blob) {
    final image = peek(phone, blob);
    if (image == null) return null;
    final blobs = _phones[phone]!..remove(blob);
    if (blobs.isEmpty) _phones.remove(phone);
    return image;
  }

  /// The bytes [phone] holds here now.
  int heldBy(String phone) => _held(_phones[phone] ?? const {});

  /// [phone] left: what it uploaded goes.
  void dropPhone(String phone) => _phones.remove(phone);

  /// Everything goes: every phone left, or the hub is disposed.
  void clear() {
    _phones.clear();
    _sweeper?.cancel();
    _sweeper = null;
  }

  int _held(Map<int, _Blob> blobs) =>
      blobs.values.fold(0, (n, b) => n + b.bytes);

  /// Drops every image nothing touched for [idle]. A clock set back says
  /// nothing of how long ago: nothing goes then.
  void _sweep() {
    final now = _now();
    _phones.removeWhere((_, blobs) {
      blobs.removeWhere((_, b) {
        final since = now.difference(b.touched);
        return !since.isNegative && since >= idle;
      });
      return blobs.isEmpty;
    });
  }

  /// Wakes the store [idle] from now, and again while it holds images: what
  /// nobody uses goes without waiting for the next request.
  void _arm() {
    if (_sweeper != null) return;
    _sweeper = Timer(idle, () {
      _sweeper = null;
      _sweep();
      if (_phones.isNotEmpty) _arm();
    });
  }
}
```

```dart
final class AiPhoneImage with Redacted {
```

6. Replace the whole `_prompt` method (as Task 5 left it: the V2-2a checks, then `control.send(AiPhonePrompt(text))`) with:

```dart
  /// The answer goes to [phone] only: if it is gone by then, or came back on
  /// a new channel, nothing is sent (a result belongs to the request that
  /// made it). Images (V2-2b B12) are taken from the store only once the
  /// prompt may go, right before it does; the type that goes with each is
  /// the one its bytes say.
  Future<void> _prompt(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiPrompt p) async {
    String? code;
    try {
      final control = _controlOf(p.sid);
      if (control == null) {
        code = 'not_found';
      } else {
        code = _promptRefusal(mobileId, control, p);
        if (code == null) {
          final images = [
            for (final b in p.blobs)
              if (_blobs.take(mobileId, b) case final image?)
                AiPhoneImage(aiImageMime(image.bytes)!, image.bytes),
          ];
          if (!await control.send(AiPhonePrompt(p.text, images: images))) {
            code = 'refused';
          }
        }
      }
    } on AiRefused catch (refusal) {
      code = refusal.code; // the window's own reason (`no_images`)
    } on Object {
      code = 'refused'; // nothing escapes into the window's zone
    }
    _send(mobileId, AiResult(rid: p.rid, ok: code == null, code: code), phone);
  }

  /// Why [p] cannot go to [control]'s session now (V2-2 D7, V2-2b B12); null
  /// when it can. Nothing is taken from the store here.
  String? _promptRefusal(String mobileId, AiControl control, AiPrompt p) {
    final blobs = p.blobs;
    if (p.text.trim().isEmpty && blobs.isEmpty) return 'refused';
    if (utf8Length(p.text) > kAiMaxPromptBytes) return 'too_large';
    if (control.state.queue.length >= AiSessionState.maxQueue) {
      return 'queue_full';
    }
    if (blobs.isEmpty) return null;
    if (blobs.length > kAiImagesMax) return 'too_large';
    if (blobs.toSet().length != blobs.length) return 'refused';
    for (final b in blobs) {
      final image = _blobs.peek(mobileId, b);
      if (image == null || aiImageMime(image.bytes) == null) return 'refused';
    }
    if (aiTakesNoImages(control.state)) return 'no_images';
    return null;
  }
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'ai_off_thread.dart';

/// Above this many bytes of images in a message, base64 runs off the UI
/// isolate (smoothness: 10 MiB is ~100 ms of it).
const int kAiInlineEncodeBytes = 256 << 10;

String _base64(Uint8List bytes) => base64Encode(bytes);

/// [images] as base64 for the `image` blocks, off the UI isolate when they
/// are many bytes (the composer's, V2-1 D16, and a phone's, V2-2b B12).
Future<List<String>> aiEncodeImages(OffThread run, List<Uint8List> images) {
  final bytes = images.fold<int>(0, (n, b) => n + b.length);
  return bytes > kAiInlineEncodeBytes
      ? Future.wait([for (final b in images) run(_base64, b)])
      : Future.value([for (final b in images) _base64(b)]);
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2 D7, V2-2b B12, B24: what a phone sends, as the phone's — its text,
  /// then its images as `image` blocks, base64 off the UI isolate when they
  /// are many bytes, as the composer does (V2-1 D16). The agent's answer to
  /// `initialize` may have come while they were encoded: one that takes no
  /// images is sent none (`no_images`).
  @override
  Future<bool> send(AiPhonePrompt prompt) async {
    final images = prompt.images;
    final data = images.isEmpty
        ? const <String>[]
        : await aiEncodeImages(_ref.read(aiOffThreadProvider), [
            for (final i in images) i.bytes,
          ]);
    if (images.isNotEmpty && aiTakesNoImages(_runtime.state)) {
      throw const AiRefused('no_images');
    }
    return _runtime.send([
      if (prompt.text.trim().isNotEmpty) TextBlock(prompt.text),
      for (final (i, image) in images.indexed)
        ImageBlock(data: data[i], mimeType: image.mime),
    ], source: PromptSource.phone);
  }
```


3. Replace `prompt` with:

```dart
  /// Sends [text] to [sid] (queued there while a turn runs), with the images
  /// this phone uploaded ([blobs], V2-2b B12): at most [kAiImagesMax], sent
  /// only to a computer that takes them (B1).
  Future<void> prompt(String sid, String text, {List<int> blobs = const []}) {
    if (utf8Length(text) > kAiMaxPromptBytes || blobs.length > kAiImagesMax) {
      return Future.error(const AiRequestException('too_large'));
    }
    AiMessage make(int rid) =>
        AiPrompt(sid: sid, rid: rid, text: text, blobs: blobs);
    return blobs.isEmpty
        ? _request(sid, make)
        : _feature(AiFeature.blob, sid, make);
  }

  /// V2-2b B12, R17: a number for the next image this phone uploads, never
  /// the same twice for this machine.
  int newBlobId() => _nextBlob++;

  /// V2-2b B12: uploads image [blob] — [bytes] of type [mime] — in parts of
  /// at most [kAiMaxBlobPartBytes], at most four in flight; [onProgress]
  /// after each part the computer took. A part the computer is too busy for
  /// goes again after a moment, three times at most. Throws like every
  /// request; a lost channel fails it, and the caller uploads the image again
  /// (never the prompt by itself, V2-2 D13).
  Future<void> uploadImage(
    int blob,
    String mime,
    Uint8List bytes, {
    void Function(int sent, int parts)? onProgress,
  }) async {
    if (!can(AiFeature.blob)) throw const AiRequestException('unsupported');
    if (bytes.isEmpty || bytes.length > kAiImageMaxBytes) {
      throw const AiRequestException('too_large');
    }
    final parts =
        (bytes.length + kAiMaxBlobPartBytes - 1) ~/ kAiMaxBlobPartBytes;
    var next = 0;
    var sent = 0;
    var failed = false;
    Future<void> worker() async {
      while (!failed && next < parts) {
        final part = next++;
        final from = part * kAiMaxBlobPartBytes;
        final data = bytes.sublist(
          from,
          min(from + kAiMaxBlobPartBytes, bytes.length),
        );
        try {
          await _blobPart(blob, part, parts, part == 0 ? mime : null, data);
        } on Object {
          failed = true;
          rethrow;
        }
        onProgress?.call(++sent, parts);
      }
    }

    await Future.wait([
      for (var i = 0; i < min(_partsInFlight, parts); i++) worker(),
    ]);
  }

  /// One part of an upload; `busy` waits and asks again, three times at most.
  Future<void> _blobPart(
    int blob,
    int part,
    int parts,
    String? mime,
    Uint8List data,
  ) async {
    for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      try {
        await _feature(
          AiFeature.blob,
          null,
          (rid) => AiBlob(
            rid: rid,
            blob: blob,
            part: part,
            parts: parts,
            mime: mime,
            data: data,
          ),
        );
        return;
      } on AiRequestException catch (e) {
        if (e.code != 'busy' || attempt >= 3) rethrow;
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
      }
    }
  }
```

### Task 17: `@` files from the phone: `ai.files`, `ai.prompt {files}`

Spec B13, protocol §4.1 (`ai.files`, `ai.prompt.files`), §6 ("đường dẫn từ điện thoại chỉ là đường dẫn desktop đã đưa và phải nằm trong thư mục phiên; desktop kiểm lại lúc làm"), tests §8 (B13). Ruling R18.

- **Matches.** `ai.files {sid, rid, q}` answers `{"files": [path, …]}`: at most 8 files of the session's folder matching `q`, best first — the composer's own `@` (V2-1 D16): the project index (`AiProjectFiles.index`, `.gitignore` kept, a broad folder such as home gives none) read again once a turn ended since, and its matcher (`aiMatchFiles`). The window keeps the index of at most 4 folders for the phones (`AiPhoneFileIndex`). A path the phone could not send back (R18 below, or over `kAiMaxPathBytes` once in JSON, so that eight always fit one body) is left out. A query over 200 bytes is `too_large`: it is the `@` token, not a text.
- **Prompt.** `ai.prompt {files}`: more than `kAiMaxPromptFiles` is `too_large`. The hub takes a path only when it is relative to the session's folder (R18): not empty, at most `kAiMaxPathBytes`, `/` between its parts and none of them empty, `.` or `..`, no `\`, no NUL, no leading `/`, no drive (`C:`) — else `refused`, and nothing is sent. The window checks every path again right before it sends: one `@` offers in the folder now, inside the folder, there on disk — else `refused`, nothing sent. Each goes as the composer's `resource_link` (`uri` the file's URL, `name` its base name, `title` the path), after the text and the images; a path named twice goes once.
- **Client.** `MachineAi.files(sid, query)`; `prompt(…, {files})`: more than 20 files or a path over 1 KiB is `too_large`, a computer without the feature `unsupported` (R15) — nothing sent either way.

Cost if wrong: a mention the phone shows that the agent never gets, or an agent pointed at a file outside the folder (the window's second check stops it).

```dart
  /// Why [p] cannot go to [control]'s session now (V2-2 D7, V2-2b B12, B13,
  /// R18); null when it can. Nothing is taken from the store here.
  String? _promptRefusal(String mobileId, AiControl control, AiPrompt p) {
    final blobs = p.blobs;
    final files = p.files;
    if (p.text.trim().isEmpty && blobs.isEmpty) return 'refused';
    if (utf8Length(p.text) > kAiMaxPromptBytes) return 'too_large';
    if (control.state.queue.length >= AiSessionState.maxQueue) {
      return 'queue_full';
    }
    if (blobs.length > kAiImagesMax || files.length > kAiMaxPromptFiles) {
      return 'too_large';
    }
    if (!files.every(_isRelativePath)) return 'refused';
    if (blobs.isEmpty) return null;
    if (blobs.toSet().length != blobs.length) return 'refused';
    for (final b in blobs) {
      final image = _blobs.peek(mobileId, b);
      if (image == null || aiImageMime(image.bytes) == null) return 'refused';
    }
    if (aiTakesNoImages(control.state)) return 'no_images';
    return null;
  }
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B13: the files of [f]'s session folder matching its query, for
  /// the phone's `@` — at most eight, best first, as the composer offers
  /// them. A path the phone could not send back (R18, or over
  /// [kAiMaxPathBytes] once in JSON: eight always fit one body) is left out.
  void _files(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiFiles f) => unawaited(
    _ask(mobileId, phone, f.sid, f.rid, (c) async {
      if (utf8Length(f.query) > _maxFileQueryBytes) {
        return const _Reply.refuse('too_large');
      }
      final files = await c.files(f.query);
      return _Reply.ok(
        encodeBody({
          'files': files
              .where(
                (path) =>
                    _isRelativePath(path) &&
                    utf8Length(jsonEncode(path)) <= kAiMaxPathBytes,
              )
              .take(_maxFilesShown)
              .toList(),
        }),
      );
    }),
  );
```

2. Add at the end of the file:

```dart
/// V2-2b B13: the longest `@` query a phone may ask (a token, not a text).
const int _maxFileQueryBytes = 200;

/// V2-2b B13: the most files one `ai.files` answers.
const int _maxFilesShown = 8;

final _drive = RegExp('^[A-Za-z]:');

/// V2-2b R18: whether [path] names a file inside a session's folder as `@`
/// offers it — relative, `/` between its parts and none of them empty, `.`
/// or `..`, at most [kAiMaxPathBytes]. The window checks it again (offered,
/// inside the folder, there).
bool _isRelativePath(String path) {
  if (path.isEmpty ||
      utf8Length(path) > kAiMaxPathBytes ||
      path.startsWith('/') ||
      path.contains(r'\') ||
      path.contains('\u0000') ||
      _drive.hasMatch(path)) {
    return false;
  }
  return path
      .split('/')
      .every((part) => part.isNotEmpty && part != '.' && part != '..');
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart' show AiSessionState;

import '../ui/ai/ai_changes_panel.dart' show aiLastEndedTurn;
import '../ui/ai/ai_completer.dart' show aiMatchFiles;
import 'ai_project_files.dart';

/// V2-2b B13, R18: the files of a session's folder a phone may name with
/// `@` — the project index the composer's `@` reads (V2-1 D16), read again
/// once a turn ended since, kept for at most [keep] folders.
final class AiPhoneFileIndex {
  AiPhoneFileIndex(this._project);

  final AiProjectFiles _project;

  /// The folders whose index is kept at once.
  static const keep = 4;

  /// Per folder, the least recently used first: its index, and the last turn
  /// that had ended when it was read.
  final _held = <String, ({int? turn, Future<List<String>> files})>{};

  /// The files of [state]'s folder (relative, `/` between their parts).
  Future<List<String>> files(AiSessionState state) {
    final cwd = state.cwd;
    final turn = aiLastEndedTurn(state);
    final held = _held.remove(cwd);
    final files = held != null && held.turn == turn
        ? held.files
        : _project.index(cwd).catchError((Object _) => const <String>[]);
    _held[cwd] = (turn: turn, files: files);
    if (_held.length > keep) _held.remove(_held.keys.first);
    return files;
  }

  /// The files of [state]'s folder matching [query], best first, as the
  /// composer's `@` offers them (eight at most).
  Future<List<String>> match(AiSessionState state, String query) async => [
    for (final hit in aiMatchFiles(await files(state), query)) hit.mention!,
  ];
}

/// The window's index for the phones' `@` (V2-2b B13).
final aiPhoneFileIndexProvider = Provider<AiPhoneFileIndex>(
  (ref) => AiPhoneFileIndex(ref.read(aiProjectFilesProvider)),
);
```

1. Add the imports `import 'dart:io' show File;` (after `import 'dart:async';`), `import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;` (after `import 'package:flutter_riverpod/misc.dart' show Override;`) and `import 'ai_phone_files.dart';` (after `import 'ai_off_thread.dart';`).
2. Replace `_RuntimeControl.send` (as Task 16 left it) with:

```dart
  /// V2-2 D7, V2-2b B12, B13, B24: what a phone sends, as the phone's — its
  /// text, then its images as `image` blocks, base64 off the UI isolate when
  /// they are many bytes, then a `resource_link` for each file, as the
  /// composer does (V2-1 D16). A file goes only when `@` offers it in the
  /// session's folder now and it is there (R18): else nothing is sent
  /// (`refused`). The agent's answer to `initialize` may have come while the
  /// images were encoded: one that takes no images is sent none
  /// (`no_images`), asked with no `await` before `send`.
  @override
  Future<bool> send(AiPhonePrompt prompt) async {
    final links = prompt.files.isEmpty
        ? const <ContentBlock>[]
        : await _links(prompt.files);
    final images = prompt.images;
    final data = images.isEmpty
        ? const <String>[]
        : await aiEncodeImages(_ref.read(aiOffThreadProvider), [
            for (final i in images) i.bytes,
          ]);
    if (images.isNotEmpty && aiTakesNoImages(_runtime.state)) {
      throw const AiRefused('no_images');
    }
    return _runtime.send([
      if (prompt.text.trim().isNotEmpty) TextBlock(prompt.text),
      for (final (i, image) in images.indexed)
        ImageBlock(data: data[i], mimeType: image.mime),
      ...links,
    ], source: PromptSource.phone);
  }

  /// V2-2b B13, R18: a `resource_link` for each of [files] — once each —, as
  /// the composer makes it (V2-1 D16); [AiRefused] (`refused`) for one `@`
  /// does not offer in the session's folder now, one that leaves the folder,
  /// or one that is not there.
  Future<List<ContentBlock>> _links(List<String> files) async {
    final state = _runtime.state;
    final cwd = state.cwd;
    final offered = {...await _ref.read(aiPhoneFileIndexProvider).files(state)};
    final links = <ContentBlock>[];
    for (final path in {...files}) {
      final file = p.join(cwd, path);
      if (!offered.contains(path) ||
          !p.isWithin(p.normalize(cwd), p.normalize(file)) ||
          !await File(file).exists()) {
        throw const AiRefused('refused');
      }
      links.add(
        ResourceLinkBlock(
          uri: Uri.file(file).toString(),
          name: p.basename(path),
          title: path,
        ),
      );
    }
    return links;
  }

  /// V2-2b B13: the files of the session's folder matching [query], as the
  /// composer's `@` offers them.
  @override
  Future<List<String>> files(String query) =>
      _ref.read(aiPhoneFileIndexProvider).match(_runtime.state, query);
```

```dart
  /// Sends [text] to [sid] (queued there while a turn runs), with the images
  /// this phone uploaded ([blobs], V2-2b B12) and the files `@` offered
  /// ([files], B13: paths relative to the session's folder). Images and
  /// files go only to a computer that takes them (B1, R15: `unsupported`);
  /// past the limits, `too_large` — nothing is sent either way.
  Future<void> prompt(
    String sid,
    String text, {
    List<int> blobs = const [],
    List<String> files = const [],
  }) {
    if (utf8Length(text) > kAiMaxPromptBytes ||
        blobs.length > kAiImagesMax ||
        files.length > kAiMaxPromptFiles ||
        files.any((f) => utf8Length(f) > kAiMaxPathBytes)) {
      return Future.error(const AiRequestException('too_large'));
    }
    if ((blobs.isNotEmpty && !can(AiFeature.blob)) ||
        (files.isNotEmpty && !can(AiFeature.files))) {
      return Future.error(const AiRequestException('unsupported'));
    }
    return _request(
      sid,
      (rid) =>
          AiPrompt(sid: sid, rid: rid, text: text, blobs: blobs, files: files),
    );
  }

  /// V2-2b B13: at most eight files of [sid]'s folder matching [query],
  /// best first (paths relative to the folder), for `@`.
  Future<List<String>> files(String sid, String query) async {
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.files,
      sid,
      (rid) => AiFiles(sid: sid, rid: rid, query: query),
    );
    return jStrings(decodeBody(result.body) ?? const {}, 'files');
  }
```

### Task 18: Phone: photos and `@` in the AI composer (+ B15 photo texts)

The phone half of B12 and B13, on the composer of the AI session page (V2-2 §5.2 dock):
- **Photos (B12).** An attach button (`Key('ai.attach')`) opens a sheet "Thư viện ảnh" / "Chụp ảnh". The picker is `image_picker` 1.2.4 (verified to resolve on Flutter 3.41.4 / Dart 3.11 on 2026-10-15): the library gives up to the places left of five, the camera one photo, each at most 2048 px on its longer side, JPEG quality 85, without metadata (`requestFullMetadata: false`, so iOS never asks for the photo library; R8 still puts `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` in `Info.plist`, as App Store policy wants). The phone checks every photo by its first bytes (`aiImageMime`: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP — a HEIC the picker left as it was stays out) and its size (≤ 10 MiB), and says why one stayed out. The photos show as thumbnails above the field, × takes one out. Send uploads them first, one `ai.blob` series each (Task 16's `MachineAi.uploadImage`, a progress bar meanwhile), then sends the prompt naming their blob numbers. When an upload fails nothing more goes — the prompt is never sent, and nothing is ever retried by itself (V2-2 D13): the text and the images stay, the composer says "Ảnh chưa gửi được. Thử lại", and the next tap on Send uploads again (new numbers; the desktop drops the parts that came, after 2 minutes). `no_images` from the computer says "Claude không nhận ảnh.". Images alone make a message. The attach button shows only when the computer offers images (`can(AiFeature.blob)`, B1/R3).
- **`@` files (B13).** An `@token` before the cursor (at the start of the text or after a space, at least one character, no space) asks the computer for its files (`files(sid, q)`, Task 17) 150 ms after the last keystroke; up to eight rows show above the field (four at once, the rest scroll); a tap writes `@path ` in place of the token and remembers the path; the remembered paths still in the text when the message goes are sent as its `files` (R18; a mention deleted from the text does not go). Only when the computer offers files (`can(AiFeature.files)`).
- **The bubble.** A user message with images says "2 ảnh" under its text (`MirrorText.images`, Task 16); a message of images alone shows only that line.
- **B15.** `NSCameraUsageDescription` says the camera also takes photos for AI sessions; `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` is new (R8). Android needs nothing new: the system Photo Picker asks for no permission, and the camera's run-time prompt is for the `CAMERA` permission the app already declares (`image_picker_android` asks it).
- Android's lost-data recovery (`retrieveLostData`) is out of scope: a photo taken while Android killed the app is taken again.

Cost if wrong: a photo of a type the picker did not convert has to be converted on the phone first; images are not kept when the page is left (like the draft's text, they live in memory only).

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_image_source.dart';

/// A real 1×1 PNG (68 bytes): it decodes, so a thumbnail of it draws.
final Uint8List kTinyPng = Uint8List.fromList(const [
  0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0d, 0x49, 0x48, 0x44, 0x52, //
  0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x08, 0x06, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x1f, 0x15, 0xc4, //
  0x89, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0b, 0x49, 0x44, 0x41, 0x54, 0x78, 0xda, 0x63, 0x60, 0x00, 0x02, 0x00, //
  0x00, 0x05, 0x00, 0x01, 0xe9, 0xfa, 0xdc, 0xd8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x49, 0x45, 0x4e, 0x44, //
  0xae, 0x42, 0x60, 0x82,
]);

/// The phone's photos in tests (V2-2b B12): what the library and the camera give, every call recorded.
class FakeAiImageSource implements AiImageSource {
  /// What the library gives (the first `limit` of them).
  List<Uint8List> photos = [];

  /// What the camera gives; null: the user took none.
  Uint8List? photo;

  /// Thrown by both (a permission refused, a picker that failed).
  Object? error;

  final List<int> limits = [];
  int cameraCalls = 0;

  @override
  Future<List<Uint8List>> pickPhotos({required int limit}) async {
    limits.add(limit);
    final failure = error;
    if (failure != null) throw failure;
    return photos.take(limit).toList();
  }

  @override
  Future<Uint8List?> takePhoto() async {
    cameraCalls++;
    final failure = error;
    if (failure != null) throw failure;
    return photo;
  }
}
```

```dart
  @override
  Future<void> prompt(String sid, String text, {List<int> blobs = const [], List<String> files = const []}) async {

    promptBlobs.add(blobs);
    promptFiles.add(files);
    await _request();
  }

  var _blobIds = 0;

  /// Every image upload: its number, type and size.
  final List<(int, String, int)> uploads = [];

  /// Set: uploads fail with it (a lost channel, a refusal), before any part.
  Object? uploadError;

  /// Set: an upload waits for it before its parts go (the progress shows meanwhile).
  Completer<void>? uploadGate;

  @override
  int newBlobId() => ++_blobIds;

  /// Like `MachineAi.uploadImage`: parts of [kAiMaxBlobPartBytes], each one reported as taken.
  @override
  Future<void> uploadImage(
    int blob,
    String mime,
    Uint8List bytes, {
    void Function(int sent, int parts)? onProgress,
  }) async {
    uploads.add((blob, mime, bytes.length));
    final error = uploadError;
    if (error != null) throw error;
    await uploadGate?.future;
    final parts = bytes.isEmpty ? 1 : (bytes.length + kAiMaxBlobPartBytes - 1) ~/ kAiMaxBlobPartBytes;
    for (var sent = 1; sent <= parts; sent++) {
      onProgress?.call(sent, parts);
    }
  }

  /// What [files] answers, and every query it was asked.
  List<String> fileHits = const [];
  final List<(String, String)> fileQueries = [];

  @override
  Future<List<String>> files(String sid, String query) async {
    fileQueries.add((sid, query));
    await _request();
    return fileHits;
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart' show kAiMaxBlobPartBytes, kAiMaxPromptFiles;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_attachments.dart';

import '../../support/fake_image_source.dart';

TextEditingValue _at(String text, [int? cursor]) => TextEditingValue(
  text: text,
  selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: cursor ?? text.length),
);

/// V2-2b B12, B13: what the AI composer takes as images, and its `@` mentions.
void main() {
  group('picked images (B12)', () {
    final jpeg = Uint8List.fromList([0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF, 0xE0, 1, 2, 3]);
    final heic = Uint8List.fromList([0, 0, 0, 0x18, 0x66, 0x74, 0x79, 0x70, 0x68, 0x65, 0x69, 0x63]);

    test('PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP join, by their first bytes, in order', () {
      final gif = Uint8List.fromList('GIF89a'.codeUnits);
      final webp = Uint8List.fromList([...'RIFF'.codeUnits, 0, 0, 0, 0, ...'WEBP'.codeUnits]);
      final taken = aiTakePicked([kTinyPng, jpeg, gif, webp], room: 5);
      expect(taken.images.map((i) => i.mime), ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/gif', 'image/webp']);
      expect(taken.problem, isNull);
    });

    test('a type the computer does not take (HEIC left as it was) stays out, and says so', () {
      final taken = aiTakePicked([heic, kTinyPng], room: 5);
      expect(taken.images.single.mime, 'image/png');
      expect(taken.problem, AiImageProblem.type);
    });

    test('over 10 MiB stays out, and says so', () {
      final big = Uint8List(10 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)..setAll(0, [0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF]);
      final taken = aiTakePicked([big], room: 5);
      expect(taken.images, isEmpty);
      expect(taken.problem, AiImageProblem.size);
    });

    test('no more than the room left', () {
      expect(aiTakePicked([kTinyPng, kTinyPng, kTinyPng], room: 2).images, hasLength(2));
      expect(aiTakePicked([kTinyPng], room: 0).images, isEmpty);
    });

    test('the parts an image takes on the wire; never logged', () {
      expect(AiPickedImage(kTinyPng, 'image/png').parts, 1);
      expect(AiPickedImage(Uint8List(kAiMaxBlobPartBytes), 'image/png').parts, 1);
      expect(AiPickedImage(Uint8List(kAiMaxBlobPartBytes + 1), 'image/png').parts, 2);
      expect(AiPickedImage(kTinyPng, 'image/png').toString(), 'AiPickedImage(…)');
    });
  });

  group('@ mentions (B13)', () {
    test('the token being typed: after the start or a space, up to the cursor', () {
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('@sr')), (start: 0, query: 'sr'));
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('sửa @src/ma')), (start: 4, query: 'src/ma'));
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('sửa @src rồi', 8)), (start: 4, query: 'src'));
    });

    test('no token: a bare @, an address, a space after it, a selection', () {
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('@')), isNull);
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('me@host')), isNull);
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('@src ')), isNull);
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('không có')), isNull);
      expect(
        AiMentions.tokenAt(
          const TextEditingValue(text: '@src', selection: TextSelection(baseOffset: 1, extentOffset: 3)),
        ),
        isNull,
      );
      expect(AiMentions.tokenAt(_at('@${'a' * (AiMentions.maxQueryBytes + 1)}')), isNull);
    });

    test('a pick replaces the token with @path and a space, the cursor after it', () {
      final value = _at('sửa @sr giúp', 7);
      final token = AiMentions.tokenAt(value)!;
      final next = AiMentions.insert(value, token, 'src/main.ts');
      expect(next.text, 'sửa @src/main.ts  giúp');
      expect(next.selection, const TextSelection.collapsed(offset: 'sửa @src/main.ts '.length));
    });

    test('only the mentions still in the text go, at most 20', () {
      expect(AiMentions.stillMentioned('xem @src/a.ts và @b.ts', ['src/a.ts', 'c.ts', 'b.ts']), ['src/a.ts', 'b.ts']);
      final many = [for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) 'f$i.ts'];
      expect(AiMentions.stillMentioned(many.map((p) => '@$p').join(' '), many), hasLength(kAiMaxPromptFiles));
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart' hide test;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_attachments.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_dock.dart';

import '../../support/app_harness.dart';
import '../../support/fake_image_source.dart';

/// V2-2b B12, B13: the AI composer with images and `@` suggestions.
void main() {
  late TextEditingController text;
  late List<String> taps;

  setUp(() {
    text = TextEditingController();
    taps = [];
  });

  tearDown(() => text.dispose());

  AiPickedImage png() => AiPickedImage(kTinyPng, 'image/png');

  Future<void> pump(
    WidgetTester tester, {
    List<AiPickedImage> images = const [],
    bool attach = true,
    bool running = false,
    bool sending = false,
    ({int sent, int parts})? upload,
    List<String> suggestions = const [],
    String? note,
    void Function(AiPickedImage image)? onRemove,
  }) async {
    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(400, 900);
    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 1;
    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      localized(
        Scaffold(
          body: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            child: AiComposer(
              controller: text,
              agentName: 'Claude',
              canSend: true,
              running: running,
              stopping: false,
              canForceStop: false,
              sending: sending,
              onSend: () => taps.add('send'),
              onStop: () => taps.add('stop'),
              onForceStop: () => taps.add('force'),
              images: images,
              onAttach: attach ? () => taps.add('attach') : null,
              onRemoveImage: onRemove ?? (image) => taps.add('remove ${images.indexOf(image)}'),
              upload: upload,
              suggestions: suggestions,
              onSuggestion: (path) => taps.add('pick $path'),
              note: note,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 400)); // what had to wait has waited
  }

  IconButton button(WidgetTester tester, String key) => tester.widget<IconButton>(find.byKey(Key(key)));

  testWidgets('the attach button only when the computer takes images; off at five, and while a message goes', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await pump(tester, attach: false);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.attach')), findsNothing);
    await pump(tester);
    expect(button(tester, 'ai.attach').tooltip, 'Thêm ảnh');
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.attach')));
    expect(taps, ['attach']);
    await pump(tester, images: [for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) png()]);
    expect(button(tester, 'ai.attach').onPressed, isNull);
    await pump(tester, images: [png()], sending: true);
    expect(button(tester, 'ai.attach').onPressed, isNull);
  });

  testWidgets('the images as thumbnails in the order picked; × takes one out, not while they go out', (tester) async {
    final images = [png(), png()];
    await pump(tester, images: images);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.image.0')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.image.1')), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.image.remove.1')));
    expect(taps, ['remove 1']);
    await pump(tester, images: images, sending: true);
    expect(button(tester, 'ai.image.remove.0').onPressed, isNull);
  });

  testWidgets('images alone can be sent; while they wait Send stays, Stop does not take its place', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester, images: [png()], running: true);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.stop')), findsNothing);
    expect(button(tester, 'ai.send').tooltip, 'Xếp hàng');
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.send')));
    expect(taps, ['send']);
    await pump(tester, running: true); // the images went, the field is empty: Stop comes back
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.stop')), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('the images going out: a bar of the parts taken; the note above the field', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester, images: [png()], upload: (sent: 1, parts: 4), note: 'Ảnh chưa gửi được. Thử lại');
    final bar = tester.widget<LinearProgressIndicator>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.upload')));
    expect(bar.value, 0.25);
    expect(tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.composer.note'))).data, 'Ảnh chưa gửi được. Thử lại');
    await pump(tester);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.upload')), findsNothing);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.composer.note')), findsNothing);
  });

  testWidgets('the computer\'s files for the @ being typed; a tap picks one; eight at most', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester, suggestions: [for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) 'src/f$i.ts']);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest.src/f0.ts')), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest.src/f0.ts')));
    expect(taps, ['pick src/f0.ts']);
    await tester.scrollUntilVisible(
      find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest.src/f7.ts')),
      44,
      scrollable: find.descendant(of: find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest')), matching: find.byType(Scrollable)),
    );
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest.src/f7.ts')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest.src/f8.ts'), skipOffstage: false), findsNothing);
    await pump(tester);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.suggest')), findsNothing);
  });
}
```

```dart
const sid = 'e.-1';

/// V2-2b B12, B13: a message with images and files, from the session page's controller.
void main() {
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late AiSessionController controller;

  setUp(() {
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);
    machine = backend.addMachine(agentA);
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    machine.ai
      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(const AiListing(features: {AiFeature.blob, AiFeature.files}));
    controller = AiSessionController(agentA, sid, session, AiDrafts(), WorkspaceRegistry(session.backend));
    machine.ai.session(sid).sync();
  });

  tearDown(() => controller.dispose());

  AiPickedImage png() => AiPickedImage(kTinyPng, 'image/png');

  test('each image goes up as a blob of its own, then the message names them in order, with its files', () async {
    expect(await controller.send('Xem hai ảnh', images: [png(), png()], files: const ['src/a.ts']), isNull);
    expect(machine.ai.uploads, [(1, 'image/png', kTinyPng.length), (2, 'image/png', kTinyPng.length)]);
    expect(machine.ai.prompts.single, (sid, 'Xem hai ảnh'));
    expect(machine.ai.promptBlobs.single, [1, 2]);
    expect(machine.ai.promptFiles.single, ['src/a.ts']);
    expect(controller.upload.value, isNull);
  });

  test('images alone make a message; nothing at all is refused, sending nothing', () async {
    expect(await controller.send('  ', images: [png()]), isNull);
    expect(machine.ai.promptBlobs.single, [1]);
    expect(await controller.send('   '), 'refused');
    expect(machine.ai.prompts, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('an image that does not go up: no message is sent, nothing is tried again by itself (V2-2 D13)', () async {
    machine.ai.uploadError = const MachineConnectionException(MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline);
    expect(await controller.send('Xem', images: [png(), png()]), AiWords.imageFailed);
    expect(machine.ai.uploads, hasLength(1), reason: 'the second image is not tried after the first failed');
    expect(machine.ai.prompts, isEmpty);
    expect((controller.upload.value, controller.sending.value), (null, false));
    // The user's next tap tries again, with new numbers.
    machine.ai.uploadError = null;
    expect(await controller.send('Xem', images: [png()]), isNull);
    expect(machine.ai.promptBlobs.single, [2]);
  });

  test('the progress counts the parts of every image of the message', () async {
    final big = AiPickedImage(Uint8List(kAiMaxBlobPartBytes * 2 + 1)..setAll(0, [0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF]), 'image/jpeg');
    final seen = <({int sent, int parts})?>[];
    final stop = controller.upload.subscribe(seen.add);
    addTearDown(stop);
    expect(await controller.send('x', images: [png(), big]), isNull);
    expect(seen, [
      null,
      (sent: 0, parts: 4),
      (sent: 1, parts: 4),
      (sent: 2, parts: 4),
      (sent: 3, parts: 4),
      (sent: 4, parts: 4),
      null,
    ]);
  });

  test('a refusal of the message itself keeps its code (an agent that takes no images)', () async {
    machine.ai.failWith = 'no_images';
    expect(await controller.send('x', images: [png()]), 'no_images');
    expect(machine.ai.uploads, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('files for @: the computer\'s matches; none when it fails, or does not offer them', () async {
    machine.ai.fileHits = const ['src/main.ts'];
    expect(await controller.files('ma'), ['src/main.ts']);
    expect(machine.ai.fileQueries.single, (sid, 'ma'));
    machine.ai.failWith = 'busy';
    expect(await controller.files('ma'), isEmpty);
    machine.ai
      ..failWith = null
      ..emitListing(const AiListing()); // a window that offers no files any more
    expect(await controller.files('ma'), isEmpty);
    expect(machine.ai.fileQueries, hasLength(2), reason: 'nothing asked of a computer that does not offer it');
  });
}
```

```dart
  Future<FakeAiSession> open(
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart' show aiImageMime, kAiImageMaxBytes, kAiImagesMax;
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart' show kAiMaxBlobPartBytes, kAiMaxPromptFiles;

/// V2-2b B12: where the photos of a message come from.
enum AiImageOrigin { library, camera }

/// V2-2b B12: an image picked for the next message, as it will be sent: its bytes (made by the picker, at most
/// 2048 px a side, JPEG 85) and their type by their first bytes. Identity is the object: the same bytes picked
/// twice are two images. Never logged.
final class AiPickedImage {
  AiPickedImage(this.bytes, this.mime);

  final Uint8List bytes;
  final String mime;

  /// The `ai.blob` parts it takes (`MachineAi.uploadImage` sends it in pieces of [kAiMaxBlobPartBytes]).
  int get parts => bytes.isEmpty ? 1 : (bytes.length + kAiMaxBlobPartBytes - 1) ~/ kAiMaxBlobPartBytes;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AiPickedImage(…)';
}

/// Why a picked image did not join the message.
enum AiImageProblem {
  /// Not PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP (a HEIC the picker did not convert, say).
  type,

  /// Over [kAiImageMaxBytes].
  size,
}

/// V2-2b B12: what of [picked] can go with the next message, [room] places left (of [kAiImagesMax]): the images
/// of a type a computer takes, by their first bytes, of at most [kAiImageMaxBytes], in order. [problem] says why
/// one was left out (the last reason met); null when none was. Images beyond [room] are left out silently (the
/// picker was asked for no more).
({List<AiPickedImage> images, AiImageProblem? problem}) aiTakePicked(List<Uint8List> picked, {required int room}) {
  final images = <AiPickedImage>[];
  AiImageProblem? problem;
  for (final bytes in picked) {
    if (images.length >= room) break;
    final mime = aiImageMime(bytes);
    if (mime == null) {
      problem = AiImageProblem.type;
      continue;
    }
    if (bytes.length > kAiImageMaxBytes) {
      problem = AiImageProblem.size;
      continue;
    }
    images.add(AiPickedImage(bytes, mime));
  }
  return (images: images, problem: problem);
}

/// V2-2b B13: a file mention being typed — the `@` at [start] and the [query] after it, up to the cursor.
typedef AiMentionToken = ({int start, String query});

/// V2-2b B13: `@` mentions in the AI composer, as the desktop's composer has them (D16): the token being typed
/// at the cursor, the path that replaces it, and the paths still mentioned when the message goes.
abstract final class AiMentions {
  /// The longest query sent to the computer, in UTF-8 bytes; a longer one asks nothing.
  static const int maxQueryBytes = 200;

  /// The most suggestions shown.
  static const int maxSuggestions = 8;

  /// The `@query` that ends at the cursor of [value]: an `@` at the start of the text or after a space, then at
  /// least one character and no space up to the cursor. Null for anything else: no collapsed cursor, no `@`
  /// (or one inside a word: `me@host`), an empty or too long query.
  static AiMentionToken? tokenAt(TextEditingValue value) {
    final selection = value.selection;
    if (!selection.isValid || !selection.isCollapsed) return null;
    final text = value.text;
    final end = selection.baseOffset;
    if (end <= 0 || end > text.length) return null;
    var at = end - 1;
    while (at >= 0 && text[at] != '@') {
      if (text[at].trim().isEmpty) return null;
      at--;
    }
    if (at < 0) return null;
    if (at > 0 && text[at - 1].trim().isNotEmpty) return null;
    final query = text.substring(at + 1, end);
    if (query.isEmpty || utf8.encode(query).length > maxQueryBytes) return null;
    return (start: at, query: query);
  }

  /// [value] with [token] replaced by `@path ` and the cursor after it.
  static TextEditingValue insert(TextEditingValue value, AiMentionToken token, String path) {
    final mention = '@$path ';
    final end = token.start + 1 + token.query.length;
    final text = value.text.replaceRange(token.start, end, mention);
    return TextEditingValue(
      text: text,
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: token.start + mention.length),
    );
  }

  /// The paths of [remembered] whose `@path` is still in [text], at most [kAiMaxPromptFiles]: a mention deleted
  /// from the text does not go.
  static List<String> stillMentioned(String text, Iterable<String> remembered) => [
    for (final path in remembered)
      if (text.contains('@$path')) path,
  ].take(kAiMaxPromptFiles).toList();
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

/// V2-2b B12: where the photos of a message come from — the phone's photo library (several at once) or its
/// camera. Each comes back at most 2048 px on its longer side, JPEG of quality 85 when the picker re-encodes it
/// (a HEIC photo becomes a JPEG then; the composer checks the type anyway), without its metadata. Throws what the
/// platform throws (a permission refused); the composer says so.
abstract interface class AiImageSource {
  /// Up to [limit] (1–5) photos of the library, in the order picked; empty when none was.
  Future<List<Uint8List>> pickPhotos({required int limit});

  /// One photo from the camera; null when none was taken.
  Future<Uint8List?> takePhoto();
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The picker (data)**

`apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/data/image_picker_source.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_image_source.dart';

/// [AiImageSource] over `image_picker` (V2-2b B12): the system photo picker (PHPicker on iOS, the Photo Picker on
/// Android — no permission asked for the library; `requestFullMetadata: false` keeps iOS from asking for the photo
/// library at all) and the system camera (iOS asks for the camera with `NSCameraUsageDescription`; Android asks at
/// run time for the CAMERA permission the app already declares).
@LazySingleton(as: AiImageSource)
class ImagePickerSource implements AiImageSource {
  final ImagePicker _picker = ImagePicker();

  /// The longer side of a photo sent (B12): enough for an agent to read a screenshot, light on the channel.
  static const double _side = 2048;
  static const int _quality = 85;

  @override
  Future<List<Uint8List>> pickPhotos({required int limit}) async {
    final files = await _picker.pickMultiImage(
      maxWidth: _side,
      maxHeight: _side,
      imageQuality: _quality,
      limit: limit,
      requestFullMetadata: false,
    );
    return [for (final file in files) await file.readAsBytes()];
  }

  @override
  Future<Uint8List?> takePhoto() async {
    final file = await _picker.pickImage(
      source: ImageSource.camera,
      maxWidth: _side,
      maxHeight: _side,
      imageQuality: _quality,
      requestFullMetadata: false,
    );
    return file?.readAsBytes();
  }
}
```

(`pickMultiImage(limit: 1)` is handled by image_picker 1.2.4 itself: it falls back to `pickImage`.)

```dart
  /// not ([AiWords.imageFailed]) the message is not sent at all, and nothing is tried again by itself — the images
  /// and the text stay for the user's next tap. A message that failed on the way may have landed
  /// ([AiWords.outcomeUnknown]): it is never sent again by itself (V2-2 D13).
  Future<String?> send(String text, {List<AiPickedImage> images = const [], List<String> files = const []}) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null || (text.trim().isEmpty && images.isEmpty)) return 'refused';
    if (_sending.peek()) return AiWords.inFlight;
    _set(_sending, true);
    try {
      final blobs = <int>[];
      if (images.isNotEmpty) {
        final total = images.fold<int>(0, (n, image) => n + image.parts);
        var done = 0;
        _set(_upload, (sent: 0, parts: total));
        try {
          for (final image in images) {
            final blob = machine.ai.newBlobId();
            await machine.ai.uploadImage(
              blob,
              image.mime,
              image.bytes,
              onProgress: (sent, _) => _set(_upload, (sent: done + sent, parts: total)),
            );
            done += image.parts;
            blobs.add(blob);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('AI image upload error: ${error.runtimeType}');
          return AiWords.imageFailed;
        } finally {
          _set(_upload, null);
        }
      }
      await machine.ai.prompt(sid, text, blobs: blobs, files: files);
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      return _failure(error);
    } finally {
      _set(_sending, false);
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B13: the computer's files matching [query] for `@`, at most 8; none when the computer does not offer
  /// them, the link is not live or the request fails (a suggestion is no answer the user waits for).
  Future<List<String>> files(String query) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null || !can(AiFeature.files) || linkState != AiLinkState.live) return const [];
    try {
      return await machine.ai.files(sid, query);
    } catch (error) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('AI files error: ${error.runtimeType}');
      return const [];
    }
  }
```

```dart
/// The text field and its buttons (V2-1 D16 on a phone): Send, or Queue
/// while a turn runs; Stop while a turn runs and the field is empty; Force
/// stop once the computer offers it. The draft stays when sending fails.
///
/// The field is always editable: a link that is away for a moment shuts only
/// Send ([canSend]), so a network blip never closes the keyboard in the middle
/// of a sentence. Stop, when it takes the place of Send (a queued message went
/// and the field is empty, or the turn has just begun), waits 400 ms before it
/// answers: the second tap of a double tap on Send must not stop the turn.
///
/// V2-2b B12, B13: with [onAttach], an attach button (the page asks: photo library or camera) and the [images] of
/// the next message as thumbnails above the field, each with × ([onRemoveImage]); images alone make a message, and
/// while images wait Send stays (no Stop in its place). [upload] shows them going out. [suggestions] are the
/// computer's files for the `@` being typed: a tap hands one to [onSuggestion]. [note] is one line above the field:
/// why the last images did not go, a voice problem.
class AiComposer extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiComposer({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    required this.agentName,
    required this.canSend,
    required this.running,
    required this.stopping,
    required this.canForceStop,
    required this.sending,
    required this.onSend,
    required this.onStop,
    required this.onForceStop,
    this.images = const [],
    this.onAttach,
    this.onRemoveImage,
    this.upload,
    this.suggestions = const [],
    this.onSuggestion,
    this.note,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String agentName;

  /// Send works: the link is live and the computer takes prompts.
  final bool canSend;
  final bool running;
  final bool stopping;
  final bool canForceStop;
  final bool sending;
  final VoidCallback onSend;
  final VoidCallback onStop;
  final VoidCallback onForceStop;

  /// V2-2b B12: the images of the next message, in the order picked.
  final List<AiPickedImage> images;

  /// The attach button (the computer takes images); null: no button.
  final VoidCallback? onAttach;
  final ValueChanged<AiPickedImage>? onRemoveImage;

  /// The parts of the images the computer took so far, while they go out; null otherwise.
  final ({int sent, int parts})? upload;

  /// V2-2b B13: the computer's files for the `@` being typed (at most [AiMentions.maxSuggestions] are shown).
  final List<String> suggestions;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onSuggestion;

  /// A line above the field; null: none.
  final String? note;

  @override
  State<AiComposer> createState() => _AiComposerState();
}

class _AiComposerState extends State<AiComposer> with _Settling {
  /// Whether Stop was on screen at the last look: it waits when it comes (not while it stays).
  var _stopShown = false;

  /// Stop takes the place of Send only when there is nothing to send: no text and no image.
  bool get _wantsStop => widget.running && widget.controller.text.trim().isEmpty && widget.images.isEmpty;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.controller.addListener(_changed);
    _lookAtStop();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(AiComposer oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.controller != widget.controller) {
      oldWidget.controller.removeListener(_changed);
      widget.controller.addListener(_changed);
    }
    _lookAtStop();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_changed);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _changed() {
    _lookAtStop();
    setState(() {});
  }

  /// Stop that has just taken the place of Send waits before it answers.
  void _lookAtStop() {
    final wants = _wantsStop;
    if (wants && !_stopShown) startSettling();
    _stopShown = wants;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);

      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        if (widget.suggestions.isNotEmpty && onSuggestion != null)
          _Suggestions(paths: widget.suggestions, onPick: onSuggestion),
        if (hasImages) _ImageRow(images: widget.images, onRemove: widget.sending ? null : widget.onRemoveImage),
        if (upload != null)
          Padding(

        Padding(

                  tooltip: s.aiAttach,

                  decoration: InputDecoration(

/// V2-2b B12: the images of the next message as thumbnails, in the order picked; × takes one out (not while they
/// go out: [onRemove] null). A thumbnail that does not decode shows an image icon instead.
class _ImageRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ImageRow({required this.images, required this.onRemove});

  final List<AiPickedImage> images;
  final ValueChanged<AiPickedImage>? onRemove;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final remove = onRemove;
    return SizedBox(
      key: const Key('ai.images'),
      height: 74,
      child: ListView.separated(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 0),

        separatorBuilder: (_, _) => 10.sizedWidth,
        itemBuilder: (context, i) {

            key: Key('ai.image.$i'),

            height: 64,
            child: Stack(
              children: [

                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),

                  top: 2,
                  right: 2,
                  child: IconButton(
                    key: Key('ai.image.remove.$i'),
```
