```dart
                    iconSize: 16,
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints.tightFor(width: 28, height: 28),
                    style: IconButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: colors.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.9)),
                    onPressed: remove == null ? null : () => remove(image),
                    icon: Icon(Icons.close, color: colors.primaryText),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// V2-2b B13: the computer's files for the `@` being typed, best first; a tap takes one. Four rows show at once, the
/// rest scroll.
class _Suggestions extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Suggestions({required this.paths, required this.onPick});

  final List<String> paths;
  final ValueChanged<String> onPick;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.colors;
    final dim = context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText, fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono);
    final bright = context.typo.paragraph13.bold.copyWith(
      color: colors.primaryText,
      fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono,
    );
    return Container(
      key: const Key('ai.suggest'),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 0),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 4 * 44 + 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: colors.divider),
      ),
      child: ListView(
        shrinkWrap: true,
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        children: [
          for (final path in paths.take(AiMentions.maxSuggestions))
            InkWell(
              key: Key('ai.suggest.$path'),
              onTap: () => onPick(path),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 44),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
                  child: Text.rich(
                    TextSpan(
                      children: [
                        TextSpan(text: path.substring(0, path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1), style: dim),
                        TextSpan(text: path.substring(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1), style: bright),
                      ],
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  Future<void> _send() async {
    final text = _text.text;
    final images = List.of(_images);
    // B13: the files still mentioned in the text go with it; a mention deleted from the text does not.
    final files = _controller.can(AiFeature.files) ? AiMentions.stillMentioned(text, _mentions) : const <String>[];
    // While it is on its way the message is no draft: a page opened again before the answer comes back
    // must not start with it (and send it twice). A message that did not go is put back below.
    _controller.keepDraft('');
    final code = await _controller.send(text, images: images, files: files);
    if (!mounted) {
      // The page was left while the message was on its way. Gone, it is nobody's draft; refused, it is the
      // user's again, unless a page opened since has a draft of its own.
      if (code != null && _controller.draft.isEmpty) _controller.keepDraft(text);
      return;
    }
    // The text and the images stay when the message did not go (or may not have): the user decides what to do.
    if (code == null) {
      if (_text.text == text) _text.clear();
      setState(() {
        _images.removeWhere(images.contains);
        _mentions.clear();
        _note = null;
      });
    } else {
      _controller.keepDraft(_text.text);
      if (code == AiWords.imageFailed) {
        setState(() => _note = S.of(context).aiImageFailed);
      } else {
        _say(code);
      }
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B12: photos from the library or the camera join the next message — five at most, of a type and a size
  /// the computer takes (a photo that is not says why, in the composer).
  Future<void> _attach() async {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final room = kAiImagesMax - _images.length;
    if (room <= 0) return;
    final origin = await showAiAttachSheet(context);
    if (origin == null || !mounted) return;
    final List<Uint8List> picked;
    try {
      final source = getIt<AiImageSource>();
      picked = switch (origin) {
        AiImageOrigin.library => await source.pickPhotos(limit: room),
        AiImageOrigin.camera => [?await source.takePhoto()],
      };
    } catch (error) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('AI image pick error: ${error.runtimeType}');
      if (mounted) setState(() => _note = s.aiPickFailed);
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted || picked.isEmpty) return;
    final taken = aiTakePicked(picked, room: kAiImagesMax - _images.length);
    setState(() {
      _images.addAll(taken.images);
      _note = switch (taken.problem) {
        AiImageProblem.type => s.aiImageType,
        AiImageProblem.size => s.aiImageTooBig,
        null => null,
      };
    });
  }

  void _removeImage(AiPickedImage image) => setState(() {
    _images.remove(image);
    _note = null;
  });

  /// V2-2b B13: an `@query` at the cursor asks the computer for its files after a pause; anything else clears them.
  void _lookForMention() {
    _suggestTimer?.cancel();
    final token = AiMentions.tokenAt(_text.value);
    if (token == null || !_controller.can(AiFeature.files)) {
      _suggestAsks++; // an answer still on its way is for a token that is gone
      if (_suggestions.isNotEmpty) setState(() => _suggestions = const []);
      return;
    }
    _suggestTimer = Timer(_suggestPause, () async {
      final ask = ++_suggestAsks;
      final paths = await _controller.files(token.query);
      // Only for the token still at the cursor.
      if (!mounted || ask != _suggestAsks || AiMentions.tokenAt(_text.value)?.query != token.query) return;
      setState(() => _suggestions = paths.take(AiMentions.maxSuggestions).toList());
    });
  }

  /// A suggestion picked: `@path ` in place of the token, remembered for the message.
  void _pickSuggestion(String path) {
    final token = AiMentions.tokenAt(_text.value);
    if (token == null) return;
    _mentions.add(path);
    _text.value = AiMentions.insert(_text.value, token, path);
    setState(() => _suggestions = const []);
  }
```

### Task 19: Phone: voice in the AI composer (+ B15 mic/speech texts)

B14: a mic in the AI composer, reusing the terminal's voice pieces (`SpeechInput`, `VoiceCommandParser`, the language of `AppSettings.voiceLocale`) through a small `AiDictation` controller — the terminal's `VoiceComposerController` is terminal-shaped (its own field, the tab's draft, "huỷ" clearing everything), so the AI field gets its own:
- what is heard shows after what the field holds (each partial replaces the last one); the final result stays, editable;
- "gửi" / "send" as the last word sends the field when the session can take the message and there is one (text or images); otherwise the words just stay (V2-2 D13: nothing is sent behind the user's back — this is the user's own word);
- "huỷ" / "cancel" as the last word drops what was just said and nothing else (R9);
- the listen stops when the session is not live or closed, when the page leaves, when the app is not in front (`inactive` too: a call, the shade), and when the message is sent with the Send button;
- a refused permission, a missing language, a network problem: said in the composer's note, in the terminal's words;
- the mic is there whatever the computer offers (B1 does not gate it: the words stay on the phone until sent).

B15: the iOS microphone and speech recognition prompts speak of the terminal and of AI sessions. Cost if wrong: one more controller (~200 lines) beside the terminal's; a phone that hears in the wrong language keeps the language chosen in the terminal's voice composer.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_dictation.dart`
- Modify: `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_dock.dart` (`AiComposer`: the mic)
- Modify: `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/pages/ai_session_page.dart`
- Modify: `apps/mobile/lib/l10n/intl_en.arb`, `apps/mobile/lib/l10n/intl_vi.arb` (+ generated `apps/mobile/lib/shared/src/l10n.dart`, `apps/mobile/lib/shared/src/intl/messages_en.dart`, `apps/mobile/lib/shared/src/intl/messages_vi.dart`)
- Modify: `apps/mobile/lib/core/dependency/dependency.config.dart` (generated)
- Modify: `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/Info.plist`, `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings`, `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/vi.lproj/InfoPlist.strings`
- Test: `apps/mobile/test/features/ai/ai_dictation_test.dart`, `apps/mobile/test/features/ai/ai_composer_mic_test.dart`, `apps/mobile/test/features/ai/ai_session_page_voice_test.dart` (create); `apps/mobile/test/platform_config_test.dart` (modify)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `SpeechInput`, `SpeechEvent` and its kinds, `SpeechPermission`, `SpeechErrorKind` (`features/voice/domain/speech_input.dart`); `VoiceCommandParser`, `VoiceAppend` / `VoiceSend` / `VoiceCancel` (`voice_command_parser.dart`); `VoiceLocale` (`voice_locale.dart`); `VoicePhase`, `VoiceIssue` (`voice/presentation/controllers/voice_composer_controller.dart`); `AppSettings.voiceLocale`; `FakeSpeechInput` (`test/support/fake_speech.dart`).
  - Task 18: `AiComposer`'s `note`, the page's `_images`, `_send`, `_note`; Task 6: `AiSessionController(…, registry)`, `canSend`, `version`, `linkState`.
- Produces:
  - `@injectable class AiDictation { AiDictation(SpeechInput speech, AppSettings settings); ReadonlySignal<VoicePhase> get phase; ReadonlySignal<VoiceIssue?> get issue; ReadonlySignal<VoiceLocale> get locale; void attach({required TextEditingController text, required bool Function() canSend, required void Function() onSend}); Future<void> toggle(String appLanguageCode); void stop(); void dispose(); }`.
  - `AiComposer({…, bool listening = false, VoidCallback? onMic})`; key `ai.mic`.
  - ARB key `aiMicTooltip` ("Speak a message" / "Nói tin nhắn").

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart' hide test;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_dictation.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/speech_input.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/voice_locale.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/presentation/controllers/voice_composer_controller.dart'
    show VoiceIssue, VoicePhase;

import '../../support/fake_speech.dart';

/// V2-2b B14: speaking into the AI composer.
void main() {
  late FakeSpeechInput speech;
  late AppSettings settings;
  late AiDictation dictation;
  late TextEditingController field;
  late int sends;
  late bool canSend;

  setUp(() async {
    speech = FakeSpeechInput();
    settings = AppSettings(InMemoryKeyValueStore());
    await settings.load();
    dictation = AiDictation(speech, settings);
    field = TextEditingController();
    sends = 0;
    canSend = true;
    dictation.attach(text: field, canSend: () => canSend, onSend: () => sends++);
  });

  tearDown(() {
    dictation.dispose();
    field.dispose();
  });

  Future<void> listen({String app = 'vi'}) async {
    await dictation.toggle(app);
    speech.emit(const SpeechListening(true));
  }

  test('the mic listens in the app language, on the device first; a language chosen in Settings wins', () async {
    await listen();
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.listening);
    expect(speech.starts.single, (localeId: 'vi-VN', onDevice: true));
    dictation.stop();
    await settings.setVoiceLocale(VoiceLocale.en);
    await listen(app: 'vi');
    expect(speech.starts.last.localeId, 'en-US');
  });

  test('what is heard shows after what was typed; the final result stays, nothing is sent', () async {
    field.text = 'Sửa lỗi';
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('trong'));
    expect(field.text, 'Sửa lỗi trong');
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('trong trang đăng nhập'));
    expect(field.text, 'Sửa lỗi trong trang đăng nhập');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('trong trang đăng nhập'));
    speech.emit(const SpeechListening(false));
    expect(field.text, 'Sửa lỗi trong trang đăng nhập');
    expect(field.selection, const TextSelection.collapsed(offset: 'Sửa lỗi trong trang đăng nhập'.length));
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.idle);
    expect(sends, 0);
  });

  test('"gửi" as the last word sends the field when the session can take it', () async {
    field.text = 'Thêm nút';
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('đăng xuất gửi'));
    expect(field.text, 'Thêm nút đăng xuất', reason: 'the page sends what the field holds');
    expect(sends, 1);
  });

  test('"send" in English, and "gửi" while listening in English is just a word', () async {
    await listen(app: 'en');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('add a logout button send'));
    expect((field.text, sends), ('add a logout button', 1));
    field.clear();
    await listen(app: 'en');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('xin chào gửi'));
    expect((field.text, sends), ('xin chào gửi', 1));
  });

  test('"gửi" while the session cannot take a message leaves the words in the field', () async {
    canSend = false;
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('chạy test gửi'));
    expect((field.text, sends), ('chạy test', 0));
  });

  test('"huỷ" drops what was just said, never what was typed (R9)', () async {
    field.text = 'Đừng xoá câu này';
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('ơ nhầm'));
    expect(field.text, 'Đừng xoá câu này ơ nhầm');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('ơ nhầm huỷ'));
    expect((field.text, sends), ('Đừng xoá câu này', 0));
    // The next utterance goes on from what the field holds.
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('nhé'));
    expect(field.text, 'Đừng xoá câu này nhé');
  });

  test('a tap while listening stops the recognizer; its final result still lands', () async {
    await listen();
    await dictation.toggle('vi');
    expect(speech.stops, 1);
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('xong'));
    expect(field.text, 'xong');
  });

  test('stop() ends the listen at once and keeps the field; a late result is ignored', () async {
    field.text = 'Giữ nguyên';
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('thêm'));
    dictation.stop();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.idle);
    expect(field.text, 'Giữ nguyên thêm');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('thêm nữa gửi'));
    expect((field.text, sends), ('Giữ nguyên thêm', 0));
  });

  test('stop() while the permission prompt is up: the listen never starts', () async {
    speech.permissionGate = Completer<void>();
    final starting = dictation.toggle('vi');
    dictation.stop();
    speech.permissionGate!.complete();
    await starting;
    expect(speech.starts, isEmpty);
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.idle);
  });

  test('a refused permission, a phone without the language: said, nothing heard', () async {
    speech.permission = SpeechPermission.denied;
    await dictation.toggle('vi');
    expect(dictation.issue.value, VoiceIssue.noPermission);
    expect(speech.starts, isEmpty);
    speech
      ..permission = SpeechPermission.granted
      ..localeIds = {VoiceLocale.vi: null, VoiceLocale.en: 'en-US'};
    await dictation.toggle('vi');
    expect(dictation.issue.value, VoiceIssue.localeUnavailable);
    expect(speech.starts, isEmpty);
  });

  test('on the device first; a failure before any word tries the cloud once', () async {
    await listen();
    speech.emit(const SpeechFailed(SpeechErrorKind.other));
    expect(speech.starts, [(localeId: 'vi-VN', onDevice: true), (localeId: 'vi-VN', onDevice: false)]);
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.listening);
    speech.emit(const SpeechFailed(SpeechErrorKind.network));
    expect(dictation.issue.value, VoiceIssue.network);
    expect(dictation.phase.value, VoicePhase.idle);
  });

  test('dispose ends a listen; nothing heard afterwards touches the field', () async {
    await listen();
    dictation.dispose();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('muộn'));
    expect(field.text, isEmpty);
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart' hide test;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_dock.dart';

import '../../support/app_harness.dart';

/// V2-2b B14: the mic of the AI composer.
void main() {
  late TextEditingController text;
  late int taps;

  setUp(() {
    text = TextEditingController();
    taps = 0;
  });

  tearDown(() => text.dispose());

  Future<void> pump(WidgetTester tester, {bool mic = true, bool listening = false, bool canSend = true}) async {
    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(400, 900);
    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 1;
    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      localized(
        Scaffold(
          body: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            child: AiComposer(
              controller: text,
              agentName: 'Claude',
              canSend: canSend,
              running: false,
              stopping: false,
              canForceStop: false,
              sending: false,
              onSend: () {},
              onStop: () {},
              onForceStop: () {},
              listening: listening,
              onMic: mic ? () => taps++ : null,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  IconButton micButton(WidgetTester tester) => tester.widget<IconButton>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')));

  testWidgets('no mic without a dictation', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester, mic: false);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')), findsNothing);
  });

  testWidgets('the mic, plain while it does not hear, filled while it hears; a tap is the page\'s', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester);
    expect(micButton(tester).tooltip, 'Nói tin nhắn');
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')));
    expect(taps, 1);
    await pump(tester, listening: true);
    expect(micButton(tester).tooltip, 'Dừng nghe');
    expect(find.descendant(of: find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')), matching: find.byIcon(Icons.mic)), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('the mic works while sending is not possible: words wait in the field', (tester) async {
    await pump(tester, canSend: false);
    expect(micButton(tester).onPressed, isNotNull);
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart' show InMemoryKeyValueStore;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart' hide test;

import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_dictation.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/speech_input.dart';

import '../../support/app_harness.dart';
import '../../support/fake_links.dart';
import '../../support/fake_popup_handler.dart';
import '../../support/fake_speech.dart';
import '../../support/fakes.dart';

const sid = 'e.-1';

/// V2-2b B14: the mic of the AI composer, on the session page.
void main() {
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late FakeSpeechInput speech;

  setUp(() async {
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);
    machine = backend.addMachine(agentA);
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    speech = FakeSpeechInput();
    final settings = AppSettings(InMemoryKeyValueStore());
    await settings.load();
    final drafts = AiDrafts();
    final registry = WorkspaceRegistry(session.backend);
    getIt
      ..registerSingleton<PopupHandler>(FakePopupHandler())
      ..registerSingleton<SessionHolder>(session)
      ..registerSingleton<ExternalLinks>(FakeExternalLinks())
      ..registerFactory<AiDictation>(() => AiDictation(speech, settings))
      ..registerFactoryParam<AiSessionController, String, String>(
        (agentId, sid) => AiSessionController(agentId, sid, session, drafts, registry),
      );
  });

  tearDown(() async => getIt.reset());

  Future<FakeAiSession> open(WidgetTester tester) async {
    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1170, 2532);
    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3;
    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
    final ai = machine.ai.session(sid);
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      routedApp(
        open: () => AiSessionRoute(agentId: agentA, machineName: 'MacBook', sid: sid),
        routes: [AutoRoute(page: AiSessionRoute.page)],
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
    ai.sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    return ai;
  }

  String field(WidgetTester tester) => tester.widget<TextField>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.composer'))).controller!.text;

  IconButton mic(WidgetTester tester) => tester.widget<IconButton>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')));

  /// A tap on the mic, and the recognizer says it hears.
  Future<void> listen(WidgetTester tester) async {
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')));
    await tester.pump();
    speech.emit(const SpeechListening(true));
    await tester.pump();
  }

  testWidgets('words go in the field as they come; "gửi" at the end sends the message', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    expect(mic(tester).tooltip, 'Nói tin nhắn');
    await listen(tester);
    expect(speech.starts.single, (localeId: 'vi-VN', onDevice: true));
    expect(mic(tester).tooltip, 'Dừng nghe');
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('thêm nút'));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field(tester), 'thêm nút');
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('thêm nút đăng xuất gửi'));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(machine.ai.prompts.single, (sid, 'thêm nút đăng xuất'));
    expect(field(tester), isEmpty);
    expect(mic(tester).tooltip, 'Nói tin nhắn');
  });

  testWidgets('"gửi" while the session cannot take the message: the words stay, nothing is sent', (tester) async {
    final ai = await open(tester);
    ai.lose(); // the channel is gone: the link waits for the next one
    await tester.pump();
    await listen(tester);
    speech.emit(const SpeechFinal('xin chào gửi'));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(field(tester), 'xin chào');
    expect(machine.ai.prompts, isEmpty);
  });

  testWidgets('a session that stops being live stops the mic; what was heard stays', (tester) async {
    final ai = await open(tester);
    await listen(tester);
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('sửa lỗi'));
    await tester.pump();
    ai.lose();
    await tester.pump();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
    expect(field(tester), 'sửa lỗi');
    expect(mic(tester).tooltip, 'Nói tin nhắn');
  });

  testWidgets('the app leaving the front stops the mic', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await listen(tester);
    tester.binding.handleAppLifecycleStateChanged(AppLifecycleState.inactive);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
    tester.binding.handleAppLifecycleStateChanged(AppLifecycleState.resumed);
    await tester.pump();
  });

  testWidgets('leaving the page stops the mic', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await listen(tester);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.back')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
  });

  testWidgets('Send while the mic hears: the mic stops, the message goes as it is', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await listen(tester);
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('chạy test'));
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.send')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(speech.cancels, 1);
    expect(machine.ai.prompts.single, (sid, 'chạy test'));
    speech.emit(const SpeechPartial('chạy test nữa')); // late: the listen is over
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field(tester), isEmpty);
  });

  testWidgets('a refused microphone is said in the composer', (tester) async {
    speech.permission = SpeechPermission.denied;
    await open(tester);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(
      tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.composer.note'))).data,
      'Cần quyền micro và nhận dạng giọng nói để nói lệnh',
    );
    expect(speech.starts, isEmpty);
  });

  testWidgets('the mic is there whatever the computer offers (the words stay on the phone until sent)', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    machine.ai.emitListing(const AiListing()); // no V2-2b feature at all
    await open(tester);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.mic')), findsOneWidget);
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The dictation**

`apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_dictation.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/speech_input.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/voice_command_parser.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/domain/voice_locale.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/voice/presentation/controllers/voice_composer_controller.dart'
    show VoiceIssue, VoicePhase;

/// V2-2b B14: speaking into the text field of an AI session. What is heard shows after the text already in the
/// field (each partial result replaces the last one) and the final result stays there, where it can be edited.
/// "gửi" / "send" as the last word sends the field when the session can take it, else the words just stay;
/// "huỷ" / "cancel" as the last word drops what was just said and nothing else (ruling R9: what was typed is never
/// cleared by voice). It listens in the language of the terminal's voice composer (Settings, else the app's), and
/// stops when the page says so: the session is not live or closed, the page leaves, the app is not in front.
///
/// One listen at a time. A listen is "active" from [SpeechInput.start] until its final result, an error or [stop];
/// what any other listen reports is ignored, so a late result never reaches a field it was not meant for. Nothing
/// heard is ever logged.
@injectable
class AiDictation {
  AiDictation(this._speech, this._settings) {
    _events = _speech.events.listen(_onEvent);
  }

  final SpeechInput _speech;
  final AppSettings _settings;
  late final StreamSubscription<SpeechEvent> _events;

  final Signal<VoicePhase> _phase = signal(VoicePhase.idle);
  final Signal<VoiceIssue?> _issue = signal(null);
  final Signal<VoiceLocale> _locale = signal(VoiceLocale.vi);

  TextEditingController? _text;
  bool Function() _canSend = () => false;
  void Function() _onSend = () {};

  /// The field's text when the listen started (trimmed); what is heard goes after it.
  String _committed = '';
  String? _localeId;
  bool _active = false;
  bool _starting = false;
  bool _onDeviceAttempt = false;
  bool _heard = false;

  /// This listen has shown it started (status, partial or final): an earlier listen's late `done` must not end it.
  bool _started = false;

  /// [stop] came while a listen was being set up (permission, locale): it does not start. Cleared by [toggle].
  bool _stopped = false;
  bool _disposed = false;

  /// [VoicePhase.listening] while the microphone is on, else [VoicePhase.idle] (never `closed`: the AI field is
  /// always there).
  ReadonlySignal<VoicePhase> get phase => _phase;

  /// Why the last listen could not start or ended early; null once a new one starts.
  ReadonlySignal<VoiceIssue?> get issue => _issue;

  /// The language of the last listen (it words [VoiceIssue.localeUnavailable]).
  ReadonlySignal<VoiceLocale> get locale => _locale;

  /// [text] is the field heard words go to; [canSend] says whether the session can take a message now (and there
  /// is one); [onSend] sends the field as the Send button does.
  void attach({
    required TextEditingController text,
    required bool Function() canSend,
    required void Function() onSend,
  }) {
    _text = text;
    _canSend = canSend;
    _onSend = onSend;
  }

  /// The mic: listens; while listening, stops (the final result still comes and is applied).
  Future<void> toggle(String appLanguageCode) async {
    if (_disposed || _text == null) return;
    _stopped = false;
    if (_phase.peek() == VoicePhase.listening) {
      await _speech.stop();
      return;
    }
    _locale.value = _settings.voiceLocale.peek() ?? VoiceLocale.fromLanguageCode(appLanguageCode);
    await _start();
  }

  /// Stops hearing now, keeping what the field shows; a listen still being set up does not start.
  void stop() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _stopped = true;
    if (_active) _cancelListen();
  }

  Future<void> _start() async {
    if (_starting) return;
    // `done` without a final result leaves a drained listen: drop it, then start afresh.
    if (_active) _cancelListen();
    _starting = true;
    try {
      _issue.value = null;
      final permission = await _speech.ensurePermission();
      if (_disposed || _stopped) return;
      if (permission != SpeechPermission.granted) {
        _issue.value = permission == SpeechPermission.denied ? VoiceIssue.noPermission : VoiceIssue.unsupported;
        return;
      }
      final localeId = await _speech.resolveLocale(_locale.peek());
      if (_disposed || _stopped) return;
      if (localeId == null) {
        _issue.value = VoiceIssue.localeUnavailable;
        return;
      }
      _localeId = localeId;
      _committed = _text!.text.trim();
      _heard = false;
      _started = false;
      _onDeviceAttempt = _speech.tryOnDeviceFirst;
      _active = true;
      _phase.value = VoicePhase.listening;
      await _speech.start(localeId, onDevice: _onDeviceAttempt);
    } finally {
      _starting = false;
    }
  }

  void _onEvent(SpeechEvent event) {
    if (_disposed || !_active) return;
    switch (event) {
      case SpeechPartial(:final text):
        _heard = true;
        _started = true;
        _show(_join(_committed, text));
      case SpeechFinal(:final text):
        _heard = true;
        _started = true;
        _active = false;
        _phase.value = VoicePhase.idle;
        _apply(VoiceCommandParser.parse(text, _locale.peek()));
      case SpeechFailed(:final kind):
        _onFailed(kind);
      case SpeechListening(:final listening):
        if (listening) {
          _started = true;
          _phase.value = VoicePhase.listening;
        } else if (_started) {
          // `done` may come before the final result: the listen stays active for it.
          _phase.value = VoicePhase.idle;
        }
    }
  }

  void _apply(VoiceCommand command) {
    switch (command) {
      case VoiceAppend(:final text):
        _show(_join(_committed, text));
      case VoiceCancel():
        // R9: only what was just said goes.
        _show(_committed);
      case VoiceSend(:final text):
        _show(_join(_committed, text));
        if (_canSend()) _onSend();
    }
    _committed = _text?.text.trim() ?? '';
  }

  /// Voice spec V4: on-device first where the recognizer can fall back ([SpeechInput.tryOnDeviceFirst]); a phone
  /// that cannot do it on the device fails before any words, and gets one more try with the OS cloud recognizer.
  void _onFailed(SpeechErrorKind kind) {
    final retry =
        _onDeviceAttempt && !_heard && (kind == SpeechErrorKind.localeUnavailable || kind == SpeechErrorKind.other);
    if (retry) {
      _onDeviceAttempt = false;
      _started = false;
      unawaited(_speech.start(_localeId!, onDevice: false));
      return;
    }
    _active = false;
    _phase.value = VoicePhase.idle;
    _committed = _text?.text.trim() ?? '';
    _issue.value = switch (kind) {
      SpeechErrorKind.noPermission => VoiceIssue.noPermission,
      SpeechErrorKind.unsupported => VoiceIssue.unsupported,
      SpeechErrorKind.localeUnavailable => VoiceIssue.localeUnavailable,
      SpeechErrorKind.network => VoiceIssue.network,
      SpeechErrorKind.other => VoiceIssue.failed,
      SpeechErrorKind.noMatch || SpeechErrorKind.interrupted => null,
    };
  }

  void _cancelListen() {
    _active = false;
    unawaited(_speech.cancel());
    _committed = _text?.text.trim() ?? '';
    _phase.value = VoicePhase.idle;
  }

  void _show(String value) {
    final text = _text;
    if (text == null) return;
    text.value = TextEditingValue(
      text: value,
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: value.length),
    );
  }

  static String _join(String before, String after) =>
      [before.trim(), after.trim()].where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).join(' ');

  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    if (_active) {
      _active = false;
      unawaited(_speech.cancel());
    }
    _disposed = true;
    unawaited(_events.cancel());
    _phase.dispose();
    _issue.dispose();
    _locale.dispose();
  }
}
```

### Task 20: iOS buttons `ai_perm` and the answer after the app lock

Spec B8, B10, rulings R5–R7. Tasks 7 and 8 made an AI permission push carry `aps.category = ai_perm` (relay) and the data
`perm`, `allow`, `reject` (desktop). This task gives iOS its two buttons and the phone its one way to answer from them:

- **Native (B8, R5).** `AppDelegate` registers the category `ai_perm` in `didFinishLaunching`, right after Task 9's
  `configureNotificationCenterDelegate()` call: "Từ chối" first with options `[.foreground]` — not `.destructive`, so it
  is the first non-destructive action, the one an Apple Watch double tap runs (R5) — then "Cho phép" with
  `[.foreground, .authenticationRequired]`. Both open the app. The titles come from `Localizable.strings` (en, vi) in the
  phone's language. This is the only place that registers categories (`setNotificationCategories` replaces the set).
- **Dart (B10).** firebase_messaging hands over the button as `RemoteMessage.actionIdentifier` (cold: `getInitialMessage`,
  warm: `onMessageOpenedApp`): it becomes `PushMessage.action`. `PushAnswer.of` turns a tap into an answer only when the
  data is exactly what the desktop sends (kind `ai`, `ai_session`, `agent_id`, a decimal `perm`, both `allow` and
  `reject`) and the action is exactly `allow` or `reject`; the option sent is one of the two ids the push carries, never
  another. Its title for the toast comes from the body with the head cut off (R6). `PushController` hands such a tap to
  `PushAnswerer`; everything else opens as before.
- **`PushAnswerer`.** Waits for the app to be in the foreground with its own lock open (R7: dropped when an unlock attempt
  ends still locked, when the app leaves the foreground first, or after 2 minutes — `AppLockController.inForeground` is
  new, and `onForegrounded` re-locks in the same batch so nothing sees "unlocked" in between); checks the machine is
  pinned; waits for the relay (≤ 10 s, a launch from the push) and the handshake — a failure there sent nothing and says
  so in the machine's words —; sends exactly one `answerPermission` and waits for its result; never sends it again (not
  after a lost channel, not when the same button is delivered twice); then opens the session through
  `NotificationOpener.open` (Task 6's B23 included: a sid of the previous run finds its session again, or opens the
  machine page) and shows a toast: `ok` → "Đã cho phép: Sửa src/main.ts" / "Đã từ chối: …"; `stale` → "Yêu cầu này đã
  được trả lời ở nơi khác."; `not_found` → "Phiên AI này đã đóng trên máy tính."; `on_computer` → "Trả lời yêu cầu này
  trên máy tính."; `unavailable` → "Mở ShellX trên máy tính để dùng phiên AI."; a lost channel or no answer in time →
  "Có thể chưa gửi được. Xem trong phiên."; untrusted / update → the machine's words; another code → its words.

Cost if wrong: one unlock and one switch to the app per answer (B8). The answer is never sent from the lock screen or in
the background (B10: later work).

  - `PushMessage({String? title, String? body, Map<String, String> data = const {}, String? action})` with
    `final String? action;` and `Map<String, String> pushDataOf(Map<String, dynamic> data)` (both in `push_messaging.dart`).
  - `final class PushAnswer { String agentId; String sid; int permission; String option; bool allow; String? task;
    static PushAnswer? of(PushMessage message); static String? taskOf(String? body); }` (`toString` → `'PushAnswer(…)'`).
  - `@lazySingleton class PushAnswerer { PushAnswerer({required SessionHolder session, required AppLockController lock,
    required NotificationOpener opener, required PopupHandler Function() popup, S Function()? words, Duration patience =
    const Duration(minutes: 2), Duration relayWait = const Duration(seconds: 10)}); @factoryMethod static PushAnswerer
    create(SessionHolder, AppLockController, NotificationOpener); final Duration patience; final Duration relayWait;
    Future<void> answer(PushMessage message, PushAnswer answer); }`.
  - `PushController({…, PushAnswerer? answerer})`; `PushController.create(…, AppLockController lock, PushAnswerer
    answerer)`.
  - `ReadonlySignal<bool> AppLockController.inForeground`.
  - Strings: `pushActionAllow`, `pushActionReject`, `aiPushAllowed(String title)`, `aiPushDenied(String title)`,
    `aiPushMaybeNotSent`, `aiPushAnsweredElsewhere`.
  - Test support: `RecordingAnswerer implements PushAnswerer` (`answered`: `List<(PushMessage, PushAnswer)>`).

```dart
/// What the desktop sends with a permission push that has buttons (V2-2b B7), the relay's `agent_id` included.
const Map<String, String> data = {
  'kind': 'ai',
  'ai_session': 'k3f9za.-12',
  'agent_id': agentA,
  'perm': '41',
  'allow': 'allow-once',
  'reject': 'reject-once',
};

PushMessage tap(String? action, {Map<String, String> data = data, String? body = 'Cần bạn trả lời: Sửa src/main.ts'}) =>
    PushMessage(title: 'MacBook · Claude', body: body, data: data, action: action);

/// V2-2b B10: which taps are answers, and what they answer.
void main() {
  test('"Cho phép" answers the allow option, "Từ chối" the reject option, of that request only', () {
    final allow = PushAnswer.of(tap('allow'))!;
    expect(
      (allow.agentId, allow.sid, allow.permission, allow.option, allow.allow, allow.task),
      (agentA, 'k3f9za.-12', 41, 'allow-once', true, 'Sửa src/main.ts'),
    );
    final reject = PushAnswer.of(tap('reject'))!;
    expect((reject.option, reject.allow), ('reject-once', false));
  });

  test('a tap on the notification itself, or on the system\'s own action, is no answer', () {
    expect(PushAnswer.of(tap(null)), isNull);
    expect(PushAnswer.of(tap('com.apple.UNNotificationDefaultActionIdentifier')), isNull);
    expect(PushAnswer.of(tap('allow_always')), isNull);
  });

  test('bad data sends nothing: data that is not exactly what the desktop sends is no answer', () {
    Map<String, String> without(String key) => {...data}..remove(key);
    for (final bad in [
      {...data, 'kind': 'command'},
      without('kind'),
      without('ai_session'),
      {...data, 'ai_session': ''},
      without('agent_id'),
      without('perm'),
      {...data, 'perm': 'x'},
      {...data, 'perm': '-1'},
      {...data, 'perm': '1.5'},
      {...data, 'perm': '+4'},
      {...data, 'perm': '1234567890123456'},
      without('allow'),
      without('reject'),
      {...data, 'allow': ''},
      {...data, 'reject': ''},
    ]) {
      expect(PushAnswer.of(tap('allow', data: bad)), isNull, reason: '$bad');
      expect(PushAnswer.of(tap('reject', data: bad)), isNull, reason: '$bad');
    }

    expect(PushAnswer.taskOf('Needs your answer:   '), isNull);
    expect(PushAnswer.taskOf('Something else'), 'Something else');
    expect(PushAnswer.taskOf(''), isNull);
    expect(PushAnswer.taskOf(null), isNull);
    expect(PushAnswer.of(tap('allow', body: null))!.task, isNull);
```

```dart
import '../../support/fake_push.dart';
import '../../support/fakes.dart';

const sid = 'k3f9za.-12';

PushMessage button(String action, {String perm = '41'}) => PushMessage(
  title: 'MacBook · Claude',
  body: 'Cần bạn trả lời: Sửa src/main.ts',
  data: {
    'kind': 'ai',
    'ai_session': sid,
    'agent_id': agentA,
    'perm': perm,
    'allow': 'allow-once',
    'reject': 'reject-once',
  },
  action: action,
);

/// V2-2b B10, Review Focus 1: one tap, one answer, after the app's lock; never another request, never twice.
void main() {
  late S s;
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late FakeBiometricAuthenticator biometrics;
  late bool lockEnabled;
  late AppLockController lock;
  late RecordingOpener opener;
  late FakePopupHandler popup;
  late PushAnswerer answerer;

  PushAnswerer build({
    Duration patience = const Duration(minutes: 2),
    Duration relayWait = const Duration(seconds: 10),
  }) => PushAnswerer(
    session: session,
    lock: lock,
    opener: opener,
    popup: () => popup,
    words: () => s,
    patience: patience,
    relayWait: relayWait,
  );

  setUp(() async {
    s = await S.load(const Locale('vi'));
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);
    machine = backend.addMachine(agentA);
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    biometrics = FakeBiometricAuthenticator();
    lockEnabled = false;
    lock = AppLockController(authenticator: biometrics, isEnabled: () => lockEnabled);
    opener = RecordingOpener();
    popup = FakePopupHandler();
    answerer = build();
  });

  Future<void> answer(PushMessage message) => answerer.answer(message, PushAnswer.of(message)!);

  test('"Cho phép": one answer with the allow option, then the session opens and says what was allowed', () async {
    final message = button('allow');
    await answer(message);
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, [(sid, 41, 'allow-once')]);
    expect(opener.opened, [message]);
    expect(popup.successes, ['Đã cho phép: Sửa src/main.ts']);
  });

  test('"Từ chối": the reject option', () async {
    await answer(button('reject'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, [(sid, 41, 'reject-once')]);
    expect(popup.successes, ['Đã từ chối: Sửa src/main.ts']);
  });

  test('the app is locked: nothing goes before Face ID; it goes once the lock opens', () async {
    lockEnabled = true;
    lock.lockOnLaunch();
    final done = answer(button('allow'));
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    expect(await lock.unlock('Mở khóa ShellX'), isTrue);
    await done;
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('a cancelled unlock sends nothing, also when the app is unlocked later', () async {
    lockEnabled = true;
    lock.lockOnLaunch();
    biometrics.result = false;
    final done = answer(button('allow'));
    expect(await lock.unlock('Mở khóa ShellX'), isFalse);
    await done;
    biometrics.result = true;
    expect(await lock.unlock('Mở khóa ShellX'), isTrue);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    expect(opener.opened, isEmpty);
  });

  test('the app leaves the foreground before the answer went: nothing is sent', () async {
    lockEnabled = true;
    lock.lockOnLaunch();
    final done = answer(button('allow'));
    lock.onBackgrounded();
    await done;
    lock.onForegrounded();
    await lock.unlock('Mở khóa ShellX');
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
  });

  test('a button that arrives before the app is back in the foreground waits for it', () async {
    lock.onBackgrounded();
    final done = answer(button('allow'));
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    lock.onForegrounded();
    await done;
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('no unlock within its patience: dropped', () async {
    lockEnabled = true;
    lock.lockOnLaunch();
    answerer = build(patience: const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
    await answer(button('allow'));
    await lock.unlock('Mở khóa ShellX');
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
  });

  test('stale says it was answered elsewhere and sends nothing else', () async {
    machine.ai.failWith = 'stale';
    await answer(button('allow'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
    expect(popup.infos, ['Yêu cầu này đã được trả lời ở nơi khác.']);
    expect(popup.successes, isEmpty);
  });

  test('an old sid gets not_found, then the page: a push of the run before a restart says the session closed, then '
      'the session opens (B23 finds it again when it can); nothing else is answered', () async {
    machine.ai.failWith = 'not_found';
    final message = button('allow');
    await answer(message);
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
    expect(popup.infos, ['Phiên AI này đã đóng trên máy tính.']);
    expect(opener.opened, [message]);
  });

  test('on_computer: "Trả lời yêu cầu này trên máy tính."; no window: "Mở ShellX trên máy tính…"', () async {
    machine.ai.failWith = 'on_computer';
    await answer(button('allow', perm: '1'));
    machine.ai.failWith = 'unavailable';
    await answer(button('allow', perm: '2'));
    expect(popup.infos, ['Trả lời yêu cầu này trên máy tính.', 'Mở ShellX trên máy tính để dùng phiên AI.']);
  });

  test('a lost channel is never retried ("Có thể chưa gửi được. Xem trong phiên.")', () async {
    machine.ai.connectFailure = MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline;
    final message = button('allow');
    await answer(message);
    expect(popup.errors, ['Có thể chưa gửi được. Xem trong phiên.']);
    machine.ai.connectFailure = null;
    // The same button again (a launch, then a resume): answered once.
    await answer(message);
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('the computer cannot be reached before anything went: its words, nothing sent', () async {
    machine.connectFailure = MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline;
    await answer(button('allow'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    expect(popup.errors, [s.errorAgentOffline]);
  });

  test('a launch from the push: the answer waits for the relay', () async {
    backend.relayStateValue = RelayConnectionState.connecting;
    final done = answer(button('allow'));
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    backend.emitRelay(RelayConnectionState.connected);
    await done;
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, hasLength(1));
  });

  test('the relay never comes: nothing sent, "the computer did not answer"', () async {
    backend.relayStateValue = RelayConnectionState.connecting;
    answerer = build(relayWait: const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
    await answer(button('allow'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    expect(popup.errors, [s.errorTimeout]);
  });

  test('a machine not paired on this phone (another account\'s): nothing is sent or opened', () async {
    backend.pinnedList = [];
    await answer(button('allow'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
    expect(opener.opened, isEmpty);
    expect(popup.errors, isEmpty);
  });

  test('signed out: nothing', () async {
    session.signOut();
    await answer(button('allow'));
    expect(machine.ai.permissionAnswers, isEmpty);
  });
}
```

```dart
/// Records the push answers [PushController] hands over (V2-2b B10).
class RecordingAnswerer implements PushAnswerer {
  final List<(PushMessage, PushAnswer)> answered = [];

  @override
  Duration get patience => const Duration(minutes: 2);

  @override
  Duration get relayWait => const Duration(seconds: 10);

  @override
  Future<void> answer(PushMessage message, PushAnswer answer) async => answered.add((message, answer));
}
```

Replace the whole of `apps/mobile/ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift` with (Task 9's call stays first):

```swift
import Flutter
import UIKit
import UserNotifications
import firebase_messaging

@main
@objc class AppDelegate: FlutterAppDelegate, FlutterImplicitEngineDelegate {
  override func application(
    _ application: UIApplication,
    didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?
  ) -> Bool {
    // V2-2b B5: a UIScene app registers its plugins after this method returns, but Apple wants the
    // notification centre's delegate set before it does; without this call a tap on a notification can
    // be missed in some launch states (firebase_messaging 16.7.0 README, "iOS apps using UIScene").
    FLTFirebaseMessagingPlugin.configureNotificationCenterDelegate()
    AppDelegate.registerNotificationCategories()
    return super.application(application, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions: launchOptions)
  }

  func didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine(_ engineBridge: FlutterImplicitEngineBridge) {
    GeneratedPluginRegistrant.register(with: engineBridge.pluginRegistry)
  }

  /// V2-2b B8: the buttons of an AI permission push (`aps.category` = `ai_perm`). "Deny" is the first action
  /// that is not destructive, so the double tap of an Apple Watch (which runs that one) never allows; "Allow"
  /// also needs the phone unlocked. Both open the app: the answer goes from there, after the app's own lock
  /// (B10). The only place that registers categories: a second call would replace this set.
  static func registerNotificationCategories() {
    let reject = UNNotificationAction(
      identifier: "reject",
      title: NSLocalizedString("pushActionReject", comment: "Notification button: deny the AI agent's request"),
      options: [.foreground]
    )
    let allow = UNNotificationAction(
      identifier: "allow",
      title: NSLocalizedString("pushActionAllow", comment: "Notification button: allow the AI agent's request once"),
      options: [.foreground, .authenticationRequired]
    )
    let category = UNNotificationCategory(
      identifier: "ai_perm",
      actions: [reject, allow],
      intentIdentifiers: [],
      options: []
    )
    UNUserNotificationCenter.current().setNotificationCategories([category])
  }
}
```

```python
"""Registers Runner/{en,vi}.lproj/Localizable.strings in the Runner target (V2-2b B8).

Idempotent: a project that already has them is left unchanged. Mirrors how InfoPlist.strings is registered.
"""
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
s = open(path).read()
if 'Localizable.strings' in s:
    print('already registered')
    sys.exit(0)

def put_after(anchor, text):
    global s
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('anchor not found: ' + anchor)
    s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + text, 1)

put_after(
    '\t\t5E1A0C2B2F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* InfoPlist.strings in Resources */ = {isa = PBXBuildFile; fileRef = 5E1A0C2C2F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* InfoPlist.strings */; };\n',
    '\t\t5E1A0C302F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* Localizable.strings in Resources */ = {isa = PBXBuildFile; fileRef = 5E1A0C312F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* Localizable.strings */; };\n',
)
put_after(
    '\t\t5E1A0C2E2F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* en */ = {isa = PBXFileReference; lastKnownFileType = text.plist.strings; name = en; path = en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings; sourceTree = "<group>"; };\n',
    '\t\t5E1A0C322F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* vi */ = {isa = PBXFileReference; lastKnownFileType = text.plist.strings; name = vi; path = vi.lproj/Localizable.strings; sourceTree = "<group>"; };\n'
    '\t\t5E1A0C332F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* en */ = {isa = PBXFileReference; lastKnownFileType = text.plist.strings; name = en; path = en.lproj/Localizable.strings; sourceTree = "<group>"; };\n',
)

    '\t\t\t\t5E1A0C2C2F8A4B0100D1C0DE /* InfoPlist.strings */,\n',
```

- [ ] **Step 5: `PushAnswer`**

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/notifications/domain/push_answer.dart`:

```dart
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/domain/push_messaging.dart';

/// V2-2b B10: a tap on "Cho phép" or "Từ chối" of an AI permission push, as the answer it stands for. Only the
/// two answers the desktop put in the push (B7: the first "allow once" that turns on no mode acting without
/// asking, and the first "reject once") can ever come out of it, never another option.
final class PushAnswer {
  const PushAnswer._({
    required this.agentId,
    required this.sid,
    required this.permission,
    required this.option,
    required this.allow,
    required this.task,
  });

  /// The computer that asked (`agent_id`, added by the relay).
  final String agentId;

  /// The AI session (`ai_session`).
  final String sid;

  /// The permission request (`perm`): a number the window never uses twice in a run (B3).
  final int permission;

  /// The option id to send: the push's `allow` or `reject`.
  final String option;

  /// The user tapped "Cho phép" (else "Từ chối").
  final bool allow;

  /// What the request does ("Sửa src/main.ts"), read from the push's body (R6); null when it says nothing.
  final String? task;

  /// The heads the desktop puts before the request in the body (`NotificationText.aiNeedsInput`), followed by
  /// ": " and the request, or alone when the request has no title.
  static const List<String> _heads = ['Cần bạn trả lời', 'Needs your answer'];

  static final RegExp _digits = RegExp(r'^[0-9]{1,15}$');

  /// The answer [message] carries, or null: not a button of an AI permission push (a tap on its body, a
  /// command's push), or data that is not exactly what the desktop sends — then nothing is answered.
  static PushAnswer? of(PushMessage message) {
    final action = message.action;
    if (action != 'allow' && action != 'reject') return null;
    final data = message.data;
    if (data['kind'] != 'ai') return null;
    final agentId = message.agentId;
    final sid = message.aiSession;
    final perm = data['perm'];
    final allow = data['allow'];
    final reject = data['reject'];
    if (agentId == null || sid == null || perm == null || !_digits.hasMatch(perm)) return null;
    // Both answers come together, or the push has no buttons at all (B7).
    if (allow == null || allow.isEmpty || reject == null || reject.isEmpty) return null;
    return PushAnswer._(
      agentId: agentId,
      sid: sid,
      permission: int.parse(perm),
      option: action == 'allow' ? allow : reject,
      allow: action == 'allow',
      task: taskOf(message.body),
    );
  }

  /// R6: the request a push's [body] names, without the head ("Cần bạn trả lời: Sửa src/main.ts" → "Sửa
  /// src/main.ts"); the whole body when it has another head; null when it is empty.
  static String? taskOf(String? body) {
    final text = body?.trim() ?? '';
    for (final head in _heads) {
      if (text == head) return null;
      if (text.startsWith('$head:')) {
        final task = text.substring(head.length + 1).trim();
        return task.isEmpty ? null : task;
      }
    }
    return text.isEmpty ? null : text;
  }

  /// Never the request or the ids.
  @override
  String toString() => 'PushAnswer(…)';
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `PushAnswerer`**

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/notifications/presentation/push_answerer.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/lock/presentation/app_lock_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/domain/push_answer.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/domain/push_messaging.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/presentation/notification_opener.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// How a push's answer ended, for the toast that says it.
enum _Tone { done, note, problem }

/// V2-2b B10: a tap on "Cho phép" / "Từ chối" of an AI permission push. The app has come to the front (both buttons
/// open it); the answer goes only once the app's own lock is open (R7), and it goes once: one `ai.answer` on the
/// ordinary channel, its `ai.result` awaited, never sent again after a lost channel (V2-2 D13), never twice for the
/// same request. Then the session opens (through [NotificationOpener], which also finds a session again after the
/// computer restarted, B23) and a toast says how it ended: "Đã cho phép: Sửa src/main.ts", "Yêu cầu này đã được trả
/// lời ở nơi khác."… Nothing here is ever logged but error types.
@lazySingleton
class PushAnswerer {
  PushAnswerer({
    required SessionHolder session,
    required AppLockController lock,
    required NotificationOpener opener,
    required PopupHandler Function() popup,
    S Function()? words,
    this.patience = const Duration(minutes: 2),
    this.relayWait = const Duration(seconds: 10),
  }) : _session = session,
       _lock = lock,
       _opener = opener,
       _popup = popup,
       _words = words ?? (() => S.current);

  @factoryMethod
  static PushAnswerer create(SessionHolder session, AppLockController lock, NotificationOpener opener) => PushAnswerer(
    session: session,
    lock: lock,
    opener: opener,
    // Resolved when a toast shows: the popup handler needs the router's context.
    popup: () => getIt<PopupHandler>(),
  );

  final SessionHolder _session;
  final AppLockController _lock;
  final NotificationOpener _opener;
  final PopupHandler Function() _popup;
  final S Function() _words;

  /// How long an answer waits for the app's lock to open before it is dropped (R7).
  final Duration patience;

  /// How long it waits for the relay at a launch from the push, before saying the computer did not answer.
  final Duration relayWait;

  /// The requests answered (or being answered) in this run: a button delivered twice — at a launch and again on
  /// a resume — answers once.
  final _answered = <String>{};

  /// Never throws.
  Future<void> answer(PushMessage message, PushAnswer answer) async {
    try {
      if (!_answered.add('${answer.agentId} ${answer.sid} ${answer.permission}')) return;
      if (!await _whenUnlocked()) return; // R7: nothing is sent, nothing opens
      final backend = _session.backend.peek();
      if (backend == null) return;
      final pinned = await backend.pinnedMachines();
      if (!pinned.any((machine) => machine.agentId == answer.agentId)) return;
      if (!identical(_session.backend.peek(), backend)) return;
      final (text, tone) = await _send(backend, answer);
      await _opener.open(message);
      _say(text, tone);
    } catch (error) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('PushAnswerer error: ${error.runtimeType}');
    }
  }

  /// R7: true once the app is in the foreground and its lock is open; false — the answer is dropped — when an
  /// unlock attempt ends with the app still locked (cancelled, failed), when the app leaves the foreground while
  /// it waits, or after [patience].
  Future<bool> _whenUnlocked() {
    final done = Completer<bool>();
    void Function()? stop;
    Timer? timer;
    var wasForeground = false;
    var wasAuthenticating = false;
    void finish(bool ok) {
      if (done.isCompleted) return;
      timer?.cancel();
      done.complete(ok);
      // Not from inside the effect, which may be running now.
      scheduleMicrotask(() => stop?.call());
    }

    timer = Timer(patience, () => finish(false));
    stop = effect(() {
      final foreground = _lock.inForeground.value;
      final locked = _lock.isLocked.value;
      final authenticating = _lock.isAuthenticating.value;
      if (done.isCompleted) return;
      if (wasForeground && !foreground) {
        finish(false);
        return;
      }
      if (wasAuthenticating && !authenticating && locked) {
        finish(false);
        return;
      }
      wasForeground = wasForeground || foreground;
      wasAuthenticating = authenticating;
      if (foreground && !locked && !authenticating) finish(true);
    });
    return done.future;
  }

  /// Sends the one answer and says how it ended. Before it goes, the relay and the computer must answer: a
  /// failure there sent nothing, and says why in the machine's words.
  Future<(String, _Tone)> _send(ShellxBackend backend, PushAnswer answer) async {
    final s = _words();
    final MachineSession machine;
    try {
      machine = backend.machine(answer.agentId);
    } on StateError {
      return (AiWords.machineFailure(s, MachineConnectionFailure.untrusted), _Tone.problem);
    }
    if (!await _relayConnected(backend)) {
      return (AiWords.machineFailure(s, MachineConnectionFailure.timeout), _Tone.problem);
    }
    try {
      await machine.connect();
    } on MachineConnectionException catch (error) {
      return (AiWords.machineFailure(s, error.failure), _Tone.problem);
    }
    try {
      await machine.ai.answerPermission(answer.sid, answer.permission, answer.option);
      final task = answer.task ?? '';
      return (answer.allow ? s.aiPushAllowed(task) : s.aiPushDenied(task), _Tone.done);
    } on AiRequestException catch (error) {
      return (
        switch (error.code) {
          // Answered on the computer or on another phone, or no longer asked: nothing else is answered (B10).
          'stale' => s.aiPushAnsweredElsewhere,
          // The session closed — or the push is of a run before the computer restarted (B23: the session page
          // that opens next finds it again when it can).
          'not_found' || 'gone' => s.aiClosedGone,
          'on_computer' => s.aiPermOnComputer,
          'unavailable' => s.aiUnavailable,
          final code => AiWords.failure(s, code, answer: true) ?? s.aiRequestFailed(code),
        },
        _Tone.note,
      );
    } on MachineConnectionException catch (error) {
      return (
        switch (error.failure) {
          // It may have gone: never sent again (V2-2 D13).
          MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline || MachineConnectionFailure.timeout => s.aiPushMaybeNotSent,
          final failure => AiWords.machineFailure(s, failure),
        },
        _Tone.problem,
      );
    }
  }

  /// A launch from the push: the relay may still be connecting.
  Future<bool> _relayConnected(ShellxBackend backend) async {
    if (backend.relayState == RelayConnectionState.connected) return true;
    try {
      await backend.relayStates.firstWhere((state) => state == RelayConnectionState.connected).timeout(relayWait);
      return true;
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _say(String text, _Tone tone) {
    try {
      final popup = _popup();
      switch (tone) {
        case _Tone.done:
          popup.showSuccess(title: text);
        case _Tone.note:
          popup.showInfo(title: text);
        case _Tone.problem:
          popup.showError(title: text);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('PushAnswerer toast error: ${error.runtimeType}');
    }
  }
}
```

### Task 21: Android buttons: flutter_local_notifications, background handler, replace by tag

Spec B9 (with B10 from Task 20). On Android FCM draws the push itself, without buttons. firebase_messaging runs a
top-level background handler for every push that arrives while the app is not in the foreground; this task adds one
(there was none). For an AI permission push that FCM drew with its tag (`android.notification.tag`, set by the relay of
Task 7), it draws the same push again with `flutter_local_notifications` 22.3.2 — same tag, id 0, so it replaces FCM's —
with "Từ chối" then "Cho phép", both `showsUserInterface: true` (they open the app, which needs the phone unlocked), on
the app's channel `shellx_notifications`, alerting once, named in the phone's language (`S.load`). The handler does
nothing else: no network, no app state. A tap on a button or on the body comes back through the plugin in the app's
isolate (`onDidReceiveNotificationResponse`, or `getNotificationAppLaunchDetails` at a launch) as a `PushMessage` with
the button as its `action`, into `FirebasePushMessaging.openedMessages` / `initialMessage` — then Task 20's path answers
it. The plugin is never initialised on iOS (it would replace the category of Task 20; B5).

A push FCM drew without a tag (a relay before Task 7) gets no second notification — ours would not replace it, and two
would show. When the handler cannot run (the phone keeps the app from running in the background), FCM's notification
stays without buttons. Cost if wrong: some Android phones (Xiaomi, Huawei…) show no buttons (B9).

- [ ] **Step 4: The Android side**

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/notifications/data/android_push_actions.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:ui' show Locale, PlatformDispatcher;

import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/domain/push_answer.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/notifications/domain/push_messaging.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// The channel FCM draws on (`@string/notification_channel_id`; MainActivity creates it): the notification
/// drawn again with its buttons stays in it, with the user's settings for it.
const String kPushChannelId = 'shellx_notifications';

/// The status-bar icon of the app's notifications (the one FCM uses, `default_notification_icon`).
const String _icon = '@drawable/ic_notification';

/// V2-2b B9: an AI permission push as Android shows it again, with its two buttons, in place of the one FCM drew
/// (same tag, id 0).
final class AiActionNotification {
  const AiActionNotification({required this.tag, required this.payload, this.title, this.body});

  /// The tag FCM drew the push with (`android.notification.tag`, set by the relay since B6).
  final String tag;
  final String? title;
  final String? body;

  /// The push itself ([pushPayloadOf]), for the tap that comes back to the app.
  final String payload;

  /// Never the request.
  @override
  String toString() => 'AiActionNotification(…)';
}

/// V2-2b B9: [data] of a push FCM drew with [tag], as a permission request that gets buttons: exactly the data a
/// button can answer (B10) and a tag of an AI request. Null for any other push — and for one drawn without a tag
/// (an older relay): a notification of ours would then not replace FCM's, and two would show.
AiActionNotification? aiActionNotificationOf(
  Map<String, String> data, {
  String? title,
  String? body,
  String? tag,
}) {
  if (tag == null || !tag.startsWith('ai-')) return null;
  final message = PushMessage(title: title, body: body, data: data);
  if (PushAnswer.of(PushMessage(title: title, body: body, data: data, action: 'allow')) == null) return null;
  return AiActionNotification(tag: tag, title: title, body: body, payload: pushPayloadOf(message));
}

/// What [note] is drawn with: on the app's channel, with its tag and id 0 (FCM's own notification of the push is
/// replaced, and does not alert again), "Từ chối" then "Cho phép". Both buttons open the app — which needs the
/// phone unlocked — and the answer goes from there, after the app's own lock (B10).
NotificationDetails aiActionDetails(AiActionNotification note, {required String allow, required String reject}) =>
    NotificationDetails(
      android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
        kPushChannelId,
        'ShellX',
        icon: _icon,
        tag: note.tag,
        importance: Importance.high,
        priority: Priority.high,
        onlyAlertOnce: true,
        actions: [
          AndroidNotificationAction('reject', reject, showsUserInterface: true),
          AndroidNotificationAction('allow', allow, showsUserInterface: true),
        ],
      ),
    );

/// [message] as the payload of a notification the app draws itself: its title, body and data as JSON.
String pushPayloadOf(PushMessage message) => jsonEncode({
  'title': ?message.title,
  'body': ?message.body,
  'data': message.data,
});

/// The push a payload of [pushPayloadOf] carries, with the button that was tapped ([action]); null when the
/// payload is none of ours.
PushMessage? pushMessageOfPayload(String? payload, {String? action}) {
  if (payload == null) return null;
  try {
    final json = jsonDecode(payload);
    if (json is! Map<String, Object?>) return null;
    final data = json['data'];
    if (data is! Map<String, Object?>) return null;
    final title = json['title'];
    final body = json['body'];
    return PushMessage(
      title: title is String ? title : null,
      body: body is String ? body : null,
      data: {
        for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in data.entries)
          if (value is String) key: value,
      },
      action: action,
    );
  } on FormatException {
    return null;
  }
}

/// A tap on a notification the app drew: its body (no action) or one of its buttons.
PushMessage? pushMessageOfResponse(NotificationResponse response) => pushMessageOfPayload(
  response.payload,
  action: response.notificationResponseType == NotificationResponseType.selectedNotificationAction
      ? response.actionId
      : null,
);

/// V2-2b B9, Android only: flutter_local_notifications in the app's own isolate. The taps on the notifications the
/// background handler drew again — on their body or on a button — come back as [PushMessage]s ([responses], or
/// [launchMessage] for the one that launched the app). Never made on iOS: there the buttons are the app's own
/// category (B8), and the plugin's initialisation would replace it.
final class AndroidPushActions {
  AndroidPushActions._(this._plugin);

  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _plugin;
  final _responses = StreamController<PushMessage>.broadcast();

  /// Null off Android.
  static Future<AndroidPushActions?> start() async {
    if (!Platform.isAndroid) return null;
    final plugin = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
    final actions = AndroidPushActions._(plugin);
    await plugin.initialize(
      settings: const InitializationSettings(android: AndroidInitializationSettings(_icon)),
      onDidReceiveNotificationResponse: actions._onResponse,
    );
    return actions;
  }

  Stream<PushMessage> get responses => _responses.stream;

  /// The notification of ours whose tap launched the app, once; null otherwise.
  Future<PushMessage?> launchMessage() async {
    final details = await _plugin.getNotificationAppLaunchDetails();
    final response = details?.notificationResponse;
    if (details == null || !details.didNotificationLaunchApp || response == null) return null;
    return pushMessageOfResponse(response);
  }

  void _onResponse(NotificationResponse response) {
    final message = pushMessageOfResponse(response);
    if (message != null) _responses.add(message);
  }
}

/// V2-2b B9: FCM's background handler (Android; firebase_messaging runs it in an isolate of its own for every
/// push that arrives while the app is not in the foreground). An AI permission push FCM drew with its tag is drawn
/// again in its place with the two buttons. Nothing else: no network, no app state, no Firebase service. When
/// this cannot run (the phone keeps the app from running in the background), FCM's notification stays, without
/// buttons.
@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> shellxBackgroundMessage(RemoteMessage message) async {
  // Registered on Android only (`startPushMessaging`): never draws anything on iOS (B5, B8).
  if (!Platform.isAndroid) return;
  try {
    final note = aiActionNotificationOf(
      pushDataOf(message.data),
      title: message.notification?.title,
      body: message.notification?.body,
      tag: message.notification?.android?.tag,
    );
    if (note == null) return;
    // The phone's language, as iOS names its buttons (B8).
    final words = await S.load(Locale(PlatformDispatcher.instance.locale.languageCode == 'vi' ? 'vi' : 'en'));
    final plugin = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
    await plugin.initialize(settings: const InitializationSettings(android: AndroidInitializationSettings(_icon)));
    await plugin.show(
      id: 0,
      title: note.title,
      body: note.body,
      notificationDetails: aiActionDetails(note, allow: words.pushActionAllow, reject: words.pushActionReject),
      payload: note.payload,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    // FCM's own notification stays (without buttons).
    if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('Push background error: ${error.runtimeType}');
  }
}
```

(firebase_messaging's background isolate calls `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` before the handler
(`_firebaseMessagingCallbackDispatcher`, platform interface 4.10.0), and every Android `FlutterEngine`, a background one
too, sends the system locales when it is made (`FlutterEngine.java`, Flutter 3.41.4), so `PlatformDispatcher` gives the
phone's language there; `RemoteMessage.notification.android.tag` is filled by the plugin's Android side from FCM's
notification (`FlutterFirebaseMessagingUtils`, firebase_messaging 16.7.0).)

```dart
/// V2-2b B9, Android only: the background handler that draws an AI permission push again with its buttons, and the
/// app's side of their taps. Null elsewhere, or when it cannot start (push still works, without buttons).
Future<AndroidPushActions?> _startAndroidActions(Duration timeout) async {
  if (!Platform.isAndroid) return null;
  try {
    FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(shellxBackgroundMessage);
    return await AndroidPushActions.start().timeout(timeout);
  } catch (error) {
    if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('Push buttons unavailable: ${error.runtimeType}');
    return null;
  }
}
```

```dart
/// banner): no system presentation options are set on iOS, and Android never shows them itself.

  FirebasePushMessaging(this._messaging);

  final FirebaseMessaging _messaging;
```

```dart
/// B9) come in with FCM's own.
final class FirebasePushMessaging implements PushMessaging {
```

### Task 22: AI sessions on the machine list

Spec B21, rulings R10, R11. Today the machine list opens no channel; a computer's AI sessions are seen only on its page.
A new controller, `MachineAiLines`, gives each card a line "✦ 2 phiên AI · 1 cần bạn" (warning colour while a session
waits) or "✦ 2 phiên AI" (R11, a second string: "· 0 cần bạn" would read wrong):

- While the list shows (its page is up with nothing pushed over it, the app in the foreground) and the relay is
  connected, it holds the AI listing of the online paired machines — at most 6, the first ones of the list's own order,
  which puts the machine used last first. For each: one handshake (`connect`), one `session.list` on the machine itself
  when its AI support is not known yet (not through the workspace: the terminal page must still show its picker on its
  first visit), then `TerminalWorkspace.holdAiListing()` (counted with the pages that show the same list, V2-2a).
- It lets each go when the list stops showing (a page pushed over it, the page left), the app leaves the foreground,
  the relay drops, or the machine goes offline or is no longer paired. A machine that cannot be reached shows no line
  and says nothing; pulling the list down tries it again.
- A tap on the line: exactly one waiting session → that session (`AiSessionRoute`) over the list; otherwise the
  computer's AI sessions to pick from (Task 6's `openAiChooser`) over the list (R10).

Cost if wrong: one handshake per machine each time the list is opened (battery, data, B21).
