```dart
  platform: DevicePlatform.macos,
  online: online,
  lastSeenAt: null,
  paired: paired,
);

AiListing listing({int sessions = 2, int waiting = 1, bool available = true}) => AiListing(
  available: available,
  sessions: [
    for (var i = 0; i < sessions; i++)
      AiSessionInfo(
        sid: 'e.-${i + 1}',
        agentId: 'claude',
        agentName: 'Claude',
        title: 'Phiên $i',
        state: i < waiting ? AiRemoteState.needsInput : AiRemoteState.idle,
      ),
  ],
);

/// V2-2b B21: the machine list holds the AI listing of what it shows, and only while it shows.
void main() {
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late WorkspaceRegistry registry;
  late FakePopupHandler popups;
  late MachineAiLines lines;

  /// A paired machine whose computer has AI for phones.
  FakeMachineSession add(String id, {bool? supported = true}) {
    backend.pinnedList = [...backend.pinnedList, pinned(id)];
    return backend.addMachine(id)..ai.supportedValue = supported;
  }

  setUp(() {
    backend = FakeBackend();
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    registry = WorkspaceRegistry(session.backend);
    popups = FakePopupHandler();
    getIt.registerSingleton<PopupHandler>(popups);
    lines = MachineAiLines(session, registry);
  });

  tearDown(() async {
    lines.dispose();
    registry.dispose();
    await getIt.reset();
  });

  test('a machine shown: one handshake, its listing held; the line counts sessions and the ones that wait', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA);
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.connectCalls, 1);
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isTrue);
    expect(lines.line(agentA), isNull, reason: 'nothing heard yet');
    mac.ai.emitListing(listing());
    expect(lines.line(agentA), (sessions: 2, waiting: 1));
    mac.ai.emitListing(listing(sessions: 3, waiting: 0));
    expect(lines.line(agentA), (sessions: 3, waiting: 0));
  });

  test('no line without sessions, or while no window serves AI', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA);
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    mac.ai.emitListing(listing(sessions: 0));
    expect(lines.line(agentA), isNull);
    mac.ai.emitListing(AiListing.unavailable);
    expect(lines.line(agentA), isNull);
  });

  test('at most six machines, the first ones of the list (the one used last first)', () async {
    final machines = [for (var n = 1; n <= 8; n++) add(agent(n))];
    lines
      ..setMachines([for (var n = 1; n <= 8; n++) entry(agent(n))])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect([for (final m in machines) m.ai.watching], [true, true, true, true, true, true, false, false]);
    expect(machines.last.connectCalls, 0);
  });

  test('offline, not paired, or not shown: no handshake at all', () async {
    final offline = add(agentA);
    final unpaired = backend.addMachine(agentB);
    lines.setMachines([entry(agentA, online: false), entry(agentB, paired: false)]);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    lines.setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(offline.connectCalls + unpaired.connectCalls, 0);
  });

  test('let go when a page covers the list, the app goes to the background, the relay drops or the machine goes '
      'offline; held again when it shows', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA);
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    mac.ai.emitListing(listing());

    lines.setVisible(false);
    expect((mac.ai.watching, lines.line(agentA)), (false, null));
    lines.setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isTrue);

    lines.setForeground(false);
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isFalse);
    lines.setForeground(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isTrue);

    backend.emitRelay(RelayConnectionState.disconnected);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isFalse);
    backend.emitRelay(RelayConnectionState.connected);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isTrue);

    lines.setMachines([entry(agentA, online: false)]);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isFalse);
  });

  test('a machine that cannot be reached shows nothing and says nothing; pulling down tries it again', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA)..connectFailure = MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline;
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(lines.line(agentA), isNull);
    expect(popups.errors, isEmpty);
    // Not tried again by every change of the list.
    lines.setMachines([entry(agentA)]);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.connectCalls, 1);
    mac.connectFailure = null;
    await lines.refresh();
    expect(mac.connectCalls, 2);
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isTrue);
  });

  test('a computer whose AI support is not known yet is asked once on the machine; the terminal page still shows '
      'its picker on the first visit', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA, supported: null);
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(mac.listCalls, 1);
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isFalse, reason: 'an older computer: no AI for phones, no line');
    expect(await registry.forMachine(agentA).prepare(), isNotNull);
  });

  test('disposed: everything let go', () async {
    final mac = add(agentA);
    lines
      ..setMachines([entry(agentA)])
      ..setVisible(true);
    await pumpEventQueue();
    lines.dispose();
    expect(mac.ai.watching, isFalse);
  });
}
```

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/machines/presentation/controllers/machine_ai_lines.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_core/shellx_core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/machines/domain/machine_entry.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';

/// A machine whose AI listing is held: the workspace's hold, and the feed of its listings.
typedef _Held = ({void Function() release, StreamSubscription<AiListing> feed});

/// What a machine's card says of its AI sessions ("✦ 2 phiên AI · 1 cần bạn").
typedef MachineAiLine = ({int sessions, int waiting});

/// V2-2b B21: the AI line of each machine on the list. While the list shows (its page is up, nothing pushed over
/// it, the app in the foreground) and the relay is connected, it holds the AI listing of the online paired
/// machines, at most [cap] of them, the one used last first (the list's own order): a channel to each (one
/// handshake), one `session.list` when the computer's AI support is not known yet — on the machine itself, not
/// its workspace, so the terminal page still shows its picker on the first visit — then the workspace's listing
/// hold (shared with the pages that show the same list). It lets every one go when the list stops showing, the
/// app leaves the foreground, the relay drops or the machine goes offline or is no longer paired. A machine that
/// cannot be reached shows no line and says nothing; pulling the list down tries it again ([refresh]).
@injectable
class MachineAiLines extends Controller {
  MachineAiLines(this._session, this._registry) {
    _relay = _session.backend.peek()?.relayStates.listen((_) => unawaited(_sync()));
  }

  /// B21: each held machine costs a handshake and listing updates while the list shows.
  static const int cap = 6;

  final SessionHolder _session;
  final WorkspaceRegistry _registry;
  StreamSubscription<RelayConnectionState>? _relay;
  final _held = <String, _Held>{};
  final _probing = <String>{};
  final _failed = <String>{};
  List<MachineEntry> _machines = const [];
  var _visible = false;
  var _foreground = true;
  var _disposed = false;
  final Signal<Map<String, AiListing>> _listings = signal(const {});

  /// The listing of [agentId] while it is held; null otherwise.
  AiListing? listing(String agentId) => _listings.value[agentId];

  /// The line of [agentId]'s card; null when there is none to show (not held, no AI window, no session).
  /// Reactive: a `Watch` that reads it follows the listing.
  MachineAiLine? line(String agentId) {
    final listing = _listings.value[agentId];
    if (listing == null || !listing.available || listing.sessions.isEmpty) return null;
    return (sessions: listing.sessions.length, waiting: listing.needsInput);
  }

  /// The machines the list shows now, in its order (online first, the one used last at the top).
  void setMachines(List<MachineEntry> machines) {
    _machines = machines;
    unawaited(_sync());
  }

  /// The list is on screen (false while a page is pushed over it, or once it is left).
  void setVisible(bool visible) {
    _visible = visible;
    unawaited(_sync());
  }

  /// The app is in the foreground (false in the background: the relay is suspended then anyway).
  void setForeground(bool foreground) {
    _foreground = foreground;
    unawaited(_sync());
  }

  /// Pull to refresh: the machines that failed are tried again. Completes when every try is over.
  Future<void> refresh() {
    _failed.clear();
    return _sync();
  }

  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    unawaited(_relay?.cancel());
    for (final agentId in [..._held.keys]) {
      _release(agentId);
    }
    _listings.dispose();
  }

  /// The machines to hold now: none unless the list shows, the app is in the foreground and the relay connected.
  Set<String> _wanted() {
    final backend = _session.backend.peek();
    if (_disposed || backend == null || !_visible || !_foreground) return const {};
    if (backend.relayState != RelayConnectionState.connected) return const {};
    return {
      for (final machine in _machines)
        if (machine.online && machine.paired) machine.id,
    }.take(cap).toSet();
  }

  Future<void> _sync() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    final wanted = _wanted();
    for (final agentId in [..._held.keys]) {
      if (!wanted.contains(agentId)) _release(agentId);
    }
    final backend = _session.backend.peek();
    if (backend == null) return;
    await Future.wait([
      for (final agentId in wanted)
        if (!_held.containsKey(agentId) && !_probing.contains(agentId) && !_failed.contains(agentId))
          _probe(backend, agentId),
    ]);
  }

  Future<void> _probe(ShellxBackend backend, String agentId) async {
    _probing.add(agentId);
    try {
      final machine = backend.machine(agentId);
      await machine.connect();
      // Teaches the client whether the computer has AI for phones (`ai` of `session.list.result`).
      if (machine.ai.supported == null) await machine.listSessions();
      if (machine.ai.supported != true) return; // an older computer: no line
      // The list may have stopped showing, or the machine gone, during the handshake.
      if (!_wanted().contains(agentId) || !identical(_session.backend.peek(), backend)) return;
      final workspace = _registry.forMachine(agentId);
      final release = workspace.holdAiListing();
      final feed = machine.ai.listings.listen((listing) => _put(agentId, listing));
      _held[agentId] = (release: release, feed: feed);
      final current = workspace.aiListing;
      if (current != null) _put(agentId, current);
    } catch (error) {
      // B21: a machine that cannot be reached shows nothing on the list, and says nothing.
      _failed.add(agentId);
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('MachineAiLines error: ${error.runtimeType}');
    } finally {
      _probing.remove(agentId);
    }
  }

  void _put(String agentId, AiListing listing) {
    if (_disposed || (!_held.containsKey(agentId) && !_probing.contains(agentId))) return;
    _listings.value = {..._listings.peek(), agentId: listing};
  }

  void _release(String agentId) {
    final held = _held.remove(agentId);
    if (held == null) return;
    held.release();
    unawaited(held.feed.cancel());
    if (_disposed) return;
    _listings.value = {..._listings.peek()}..remove(agentId);
  }
}
```

```dart
  final MachineListController _controller = getIt<MachineListController>();

  /// V2-2b B21: the AI line of each machine; optional, like the push controller of the app (a test that does not
  /// register it gets the list without lines).
  final MachineAiLines? _ai = getIt.isRegistered<MachineAiLines>() ? getIt<MachineAiLines>() : null;
  void Function()? _stopMachines;
  AppLifecycleListener? _lifecycle;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller.refresh();
    final ai = _ai;
    if (ai != null) {
      // Not from inside the signal's own notification: the lines write signals of their own.
      _stopMachines = _controller.state.subscribe((list) => scheduleMicrotask(() => ai.setMachines(list.machines)));
      ai.setVisible(true);
      // `inactive` (the notification shade, a system dialog) still shows the list; `hidden` and `paused` do not.
      _lifecycle = AppLifecycleListener(
        onStateChange: (state) =>
            ai.setForeground(state == AppLifecycleState.resumed || state == AppLifecycleState.inactive),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _lifecycle?.dispose();
    _stopMachines?.call();
    _ai?.dispose();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// The lines let their machines go while a page of this one is over the list (B21).
  Future<T?> _over<T>(Future<T?> Function() navigation) async {
    _ai?.setVisible(false);
    try {
      return await navigation();
    } finally {
      if (mounted) _ai?.setVisible(true);
    }
  }

  /// Pairing, unpairing and new tabs happen on the pushed pages: refresh when they close.
  Future<void> _then(Future<Object?> Function() navigation) async {
    await _over(navigation);
    if (mounted) await _controller.refresh();
  }

  Future<void> _scan() => _then(() => context.router.push(QrScannerRoute()));

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    await Future.wait([_controller.refresh(), ?_ai?.refresh()]);
  }

  Future<void> _open(MachineEntry machine) async {
    final exit = await _over(
      () => context.router.push<TerminalExit>(TerminalRoute(agentId: machine.id, machineName: machine.name)),
    );
```

```dart
/// V2-2b B21: "✦ 2 phiên AI · 1 cần bạn" (warning colour while a session waits for the user), or "✦ 2 phiên AI"
/// (R11). The whole line is the button: at least 44 points high.
class _AiLine extends StatelessWidget {

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

    final waiting = line.waiting > 0;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 44),
        child: Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          child: Text(
            waiting ? strings.machineAiLine(line.sessions, line.waiting) : strings.machineAiSessions(line.sessions),
            style: context.typo.paragraph13.bold.copyWith(color: waiting ? colors.warn : colors.secondaryText),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Task 23: Desktop: `AiUndo` extracted from the Changes panel

Spec B19 ("Tách `AiUndo` (thuần Dart, không widget) khỏi `aiRevert`… Desktop panel và hub dùng chung") and risk §12 ("Tách `AiUndo` làm hỏng hoàn tác trên desktop — test desktop hiện có phải xanh"). Today every step of a revert lives in the widget function `aiRevert` (`apps/desktop/lib/src/ui/ai/ai_changes_panel.dart:116-191`): the busy check, the changes read, the "changed after the turn" read, the B14 filter and the revert itself. A phone's `ai.revert` (Task 24) needs exactly those steps without a `BuildContext`. This task moves them, unchanged, into a UI-free class:
- `AiUndo.plan` = today's steps up to the question (busy → `AiUndoBusy`; changes unreadable → `AiUndoFailed`; none left → `AiUndoNothing`; else the paths and the files changed after the turn, every file when the end tree is unknown);
- `AiUndo.apply` = the B14 filter ("Only revert unchanged files") and `revert`/`revertSession`, with today's error handling (a failed revert is logged by error type only; a turn that started meanwhile makes it `busy`).

`aiRevert` keeps its exact behaviour on top of it: the same notes, the same dialog, the same `context.mounted` checks after each wait, the same `changesChanged()`. The desktop behaviour is pinned by the existing widget tests (`ai_changes_test.dart`, `ai_changes_safety_test.dart`, `ai_unmounted_test.dart`: 20 tests), which must pass unchanged; the extracted class gets its own tests over real runtimes (fake agents) and an in-memory project. Cost if wrong: a desktop revert regresses — the existing tests are the guard (they were run against this exact code on a scratch copy, 2026-10-15: all green).

```dart
/// Reads that fail on demand: git answering nothing.
final class _FlakyStore implements Checkpoints {
  _FlakyStore(this.project);

  final FakeProject project;

  @override
  UndoOff? get off => project.off;

  Future<Checkpoint?> snapshot(String ref) => project.snapshot(ref);

  Future<String?> currentTree() => project.currentTree();

  Future<void> restore(String treeish, Iterable<String> paths) =>

}

  for (var i = 0; i < 400 && !test(); i++) {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `AiUndo`**

`apps/desktop/lib/src/ai/ai_undo.dart` (the steps of today's `aiRevert`, in its order, with its comments):

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show debugPrint;
import 'package:shellx_ai/host.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart' show aiTurnsOf;

/// V2-2b B19: what reverting a turn (or the session) would put back, read
/// now by [AiUndo.plan].
sealed class AiUndoPlanResult {
  const AiUndoPlanResult();

  @override
  String toString() => '$runtimeType(…)';
}

/// A turn is running: a revert waits for it (the runtime refuses one
/// meanwhile).
final class AiUndoBusy extends AiUndoPlanResult {
  const AiUndoBusy();
}

/// The restore point could not be read: git did not answer, or the turn has
/// none.
final class AiUndoFailed extends AiUndoPlanResult {
  const AiUndoFailed();
}

/// Nothing of it is changed any more (put back by hand meanwhile).
final class AiUndoNothing extends AiUndoPlanResult {
  const AiUndoNothing();
}

/// The files to put back ([paths]) and those of them changed after the turn
/// ended ([after]).
final class AiUndoPlan extends AiUndoPlanResult {
  const AiUndoPlan({
    required this.turn,
    required this.paths,
    required this.after,
  });

  /// The turn whose restore point the files go back to; null: the
  /// session's first.
  final int? turn;

  /// The changed files, relative to the session folder, as git lists them.
  final List<String> paths;

  /// The files changed after the turn ended — every file when that is not
  /// known (a turn that ended without its end tree: the agent died, "Dừng
  /// hẳn").
  final Set<String> after;

  /// The files that ask first (B14): changed by the turn and again after it.
  List<String> get touched => [
    for (final path in paths)
      if (after.contains(path)) path,
  ];

  /// Some files did not change after the turn: "Only revert unchanged
  /// files" is a choice.
  bool get someClean => touched.length < paths.length;
}

/// How [AiUndo.apply] went.
final class AiUndoDone {
  const AiUndoDone({required this.ok, this.count = 0, this.busy = false});

  /// The files were put back.
  final bool ok;

  /// How many files were put back.
  final int count;

  /// Not put back because a turn started meanwhile: the runtime refuses a
  /// revert while one runs.
  final bool busy;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AiUndoDone(…)';
}

/// V2-2b B19: undo of a turn or of the whole session without a widget —
/// the Changes panel ("Revert turn", "Revert session", one file) and a
/// phone's `ai.revert` share it. [plan] reads what would go back now; the
/// caller asks the user when [AiUndoPlan.touched] is not empty (V2-1 B14);
/// [apply] puts the files back.
final class AiUndo {
  AiUndo(this.runtime);

  final AiRuntime runtime;

  /// The files changed since [turn] began (null: since the session's first
  /// turn), [only] that one when given, and which of them changed after the
  /// turn ended (null [turn]: after the last turn that finished).
  Future<AiUndoPlanResult> plan({int? turn, String? only}) async {
    if (runtime.state.turn != null) return const AiUndoBusy();
    final last = turn ?? aiTurnsOf(runtime.state).lastFinished;
    final changes = turn == null
        ? await runtime.sessionChanges()
        : await runtime.changesSince(turn);
    // git did not answer: said, never a silent nothing.
    if (changes == null) return const AiUndoFailed();
    final paths = [
      for (final c in changes)
        if (only == null || c.path == only) c.path,
    ];
    if (paths.isEmpty) return const AiUndoNothing();
    // A turn that ended without its end tree (the agent died, "Dừng hẳn")
    // cannot say what changed after it: any file may have, so every file
    // asks.
    final known = last == null
        ? const <String>{}
        : await runtime.changedAfterTurn(last);
    return AiUndoPlan(turn: turn, paths: paths, after: known ?? paths.toSet());
  }

  /// Puts the files of [plan] back — without the [AiUndoPlan.touched] ones
  /// when [keepTouched] ("Only revert unchanged files").
  Future<AiUndoDone> apply(AiUndoPlan plan, {required bool keepTouched}) async {
    final paths = keepTouched
        ? [
            for (final path in plan.paths)
              if (!plan.after.contains(path)) path,
          ]
        : plan.paths;
    if (paths.isEmpty) return const AiUndoDone(ok: true);
    final turn = plan.turn;
    var ok = false;
    try {
      ok = turn == null
          ? await runtime.revertSession(paths)
          : await runtime.revert(turn, paths);
    } on Object catch (error) {
      debugPrint('ShellX: revert failed: ${error.runtimeType}');
    }
    return AiUndoDone(
      ok: ok,
      count: ok ? paths.length : 0,
      // A turn that started meanwhile is why the runtime said no.
      busy: !ok && runtime.state.turn != null,
    );
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Put `aiRevert` on top of `AiUndo`**

In `apps/desktop/lib/src/ui/ai/ai_changes_panel.dart`, add the import after `import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';`:

```dart
import '../../ai/ai_undo.dart';
```

and replace the whole of `aiRevert` (its doc comment from `/// "Revert turn" [turn], "Revert session" ([turn] null), or one file` down to the closing `}` before `/// "Reviewed" (§4.4) belongs to a file as it is`) with:

```dart
/// "Revert turn" [turn], "Revert session" ([turn] null), or one file
/// ([only]), §4.4: the files changed since the restore point go back. Files
/// changed after the turn ended ask first (B14). Refused while a turn runs.
/// The result shows at the foot of the Changes panel, which opens. What goes
/// back is worked out by [AiUndo] (V2-2b B19), which a phone's revert uses
/// too.
Future<void> aiRevert(
  BuildContext context,
  AiRuntime runtime,
  AiPaneUi ui, {
  int? turn,
  String? only,
}) async {
  final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
  ui.openPanel();
  final undo = AiUndo(runtime);
  final planned = await undo.plan(turn: turn, only: only);
  // Every wait below can outlive the panel or the tab (closed while git
  // works): its notifiers are disposed then, and nobody reads a note.
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  final AiUndoPlan plan;
  switch (planned) {
    case AiUndoBusy():
      ui.note.value = l10n.aiRevertBusy;
      return;
    case AiUndoFailed():
      // git did not answer: said, never a silent nothing.
      ui.note.value = l10n.aiRevertFailed;
      return;
    case AiUndoNothing():
      // Nothing of it is changed any more (put back by hand): the panel
      // looks again, so the row it still shows goes.
      ui.changesChanged();
      return;
    case final AiUndoPlan p:
      plan = p;
  }
  var keepTouched = false;
  final touched = plan.touched;
  if (touched.isNotEmpty) {
    final choice = await showAiRevertDialog(
      context,
      touched: touched,
      someUnchanged: plan.someClean,
    );
    if (choice == null || !context.mounted) return;
    keepTouched = choice == AiRevertChoice.onlyUnchanged;
  }
  final done = await undo.apply(plan, keepTouched: keepTouched);
  if (!context.mounted) return;
  ui.note.value = done.ok
      ? l10n.aiReverted(done.count)
      // A turn started while the dialog was open: that is the reason.
      : done.busy
      ? l10n.aiRevertBusy
      : l10n.aiRevertFailed;
  ui.changesChanged();
}
```

(The panel's own `aiTurnsOf` uses in `_AiChangesPanelState` stay as they are: since Task 6 the panel imports and re-exports it from `package:shellx_ai/remote.dart`.)

### Task 24: Changes, diff and revert from the phone; the desktop pane note

Spec B19 and §4.1 (`ai.changes`, `ai.diff`, `ai.revert`), Review Focus 3 and 4, R12, R18. A phone asks for:
- **`ai.changes {sid, rid, turn?}`** → `ai.result {body}`: what the desktop's Changes panel shows (the same reads as `AiChangesPanel._load`): the files changed since `turn` began (`scope: turn`) or since the session's first turn (`scope: session`), `{"p", "k": "a|m|d", "plus"?, "minus"?}` each (≤ 200, the rest counted in `more`, fewer when the paths are long — the body always fits), `after` (the files changed again after the turn ended), `turns: {first, last, done}`, and `off` (why undo is off) while no turn has a restore point.
- **`ai.diff {sid, rid, turn?, path}`** → one file's changed region as the diff page draws it (each side ≤ 20 KiB, halved while the escaped JSON is too big), or `{"binary": true}` / `{"missing": true}`; `too_big` for a file over 1 MiB (the desktop's viewer cap); `undo_off` without a restore point. R18: the hub refuses a path a window could never have offered (absolute, `..`, backslash, drive, NUL, over `kAiMaxPathBytes`) without asking the window; the window refuses one that is not among the changes *now* (so it is inside the session folder, as git lists it).
- **`ai.revert {sid, rid, turn?, keep?}`** → worked out again by the window at that moment with Task 23's `AiUndo` (RF4: what the phone saw may be old): `busy_turn` while a turn runs, `undo_off` without a restore point, `confirm` with `{"touched", "more"?, "some_clean", "files"}` when files changed after the turn and `keep` is absent; `keep: clean` leaves those files, `keep: all` reverts them too; `ok` with `{"reverted": n}`. Then the desktop's pane says it (R12): the Changes panel opens on "Đã hoàn tác N tệp (từ điện thoại)." — like a revert made on the computer.

The listing now names `changes` and `revert` (B1); after this task every V2-2b request kind has its handler. Cost if wrong: a revert from the phone that the computer's user did not see coming — it is always one explicit tap on the phone (Task 25), recomputed and asked again here when files changed after the turn, never sent twice.

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';

import '../model/changes.dart';
import 'item_codec.dart' show aiTextDiffRegion;
import 'mirror.dart';
import 'wire.dart';

/// V2-2b B19: the most files one `ai.changes` answer lists; the others are
/// counted in [AiChangesView.more] and seen on the computer.
const int kAiChangesMax = 200;

/// V2-2b B19: one side of a file's diff on the phone's diff page, before the
/// JSON is cut harder to fit ([aiFileDiffBody]).
const int kAiFileDiffSideBytes = 20 * 1024;

/// One file changed since a restore point, as a phone lists it (V2-2b B19).
final class AiChangedFile with Redacted {
  const AiChangedFile({
    required this.path,
    required this.kind,
    this.plus,
    this.minus,
  });

  /// [change] as a phone lists it.
  factory AiChangedFile.of(FileChange change) => AiChangedFile(
    path: change.path,
    kind: switch (change.kind) {
      ChangeKind.added => 'a',
      ChangeKind.modified => 'm',
      ChangeKind.deleted => 'd',
    },
    plus: change.added,
    minus: change.removed,
  );

  /// Relative to the session folder, `/` separators.
  final String path;

  /// `a` (added), `m` (modified) or `d` (deleted).
  final String kind;

  /// Lines added and removed; null for a binary file.
  final int? plus;
  final int? minus;

  bool get binary => plus == null;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'p': path,
    'k': kind,
    'plus': ?plus,
    'minus': ?minus,
  };

  /// Null without a path; an unknown kind reads as `m`.
  static AiChangedFile? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final path = jString(j, 'p');
    if (path == null || path.isEmpty) return null;
    return AiChangedFile(
      path: path,
      kind: switch (jString(j, 'k')) {
        'a' => 'a',
        'd' => 'd',
        _ => 'm',
      },
      plus: jInt(j, 'plus'),
      minus: jInt(j, 'minus'),
    );
  }
}

/// What `ai.changes` answers (V2-2b B19), as the desktop's Changes panel
/// shows it: the files changed since [turn] began (`scope` `turn`) or since
/// the session's first turn (`session`), those of them changed again after
/// the turn ended ([after]), the turns that have a restore point, and why
/// undo is off ([off], an `UndoOff` name) while no turn has one.
final class AiChangesView with Redacted {
  const AiChangesView({
    required this.scope,
    this.turn,
    this.files = const [],
    this.after = const [],
    this.first,
    this.last,
    this.done,
    this.off,
    this.more = 0,
  });

  /// `turn` or `session`.
  final String scope;
  final int? turn;
  final List<AiChangedFile> files;
  final List<String> after;

  /// The first and the last turn with a restore point (a running turn
  /// counts), and the last one that finished with one.
  final int? first;
  final int? last;
  final int? done;
  final String? off;

  /// Files left out of [files] (more than [kAiChangesMax], or than a body
  /// holds).
  final int more;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'scope': scope,
    'turn': ?turn,
    'files': [for (final f in files) f.toJson()],
    'after': after,
    'turns': {'first': ?first, 'last': ?last, 'done': ?done},
    'off': ?off,
    if (more > 0) 'more': more,
  };

  /// Never throws: what is not as written reads as absent.
  static AiChangesView fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) {
    final turns = jMap(j, 'turns') ?? const <String, Object?>{};
    return AiChangesView(
      scope: jString(j, 'scope') == 'turn' ? 'turn' : 'session',
      turn: jInt(j, 'turn'),
      files: [for (final f in jMaps(j, 'files')) ?AiChangedFile.fromJson(f)],
      after: jStrings(j, 'after'),
      first: jInt(turns, 'first'),
      last: jInt(turns, 'last'),
      done: jInt(turns, 'done'),
      off: jString(j, 'off'),
      more: max(0, jInt(j, 'more') ?? 0),
    );
  }
}

/// [view] as an `ai.changes` body within [kAiRecordBytes]: at most
/// [kAiChangesMax] files, fewer while the JSON is too big (paths are as long
/// as a project makes them); what is left out is counted in `more`, and the
/// [AiChangesView.after] paths of files left out go with them.
Uint8List encodeChangesView(AiChangesView view) {
  final files = view.files.take(kAiChangesMax).toList();
  String json() {
    final kept = {for (final f in files) f.path};
    return jsonEncode(
      AiChangesView(
        scope: view.scope,
        turn: view.turn,
        files: files,
        after: [
          for (final path in view.after)
            if (kept.contains(path)) path,
        ],
        first: view.first,
        last: view.last,
        done: view.done,
        off: view.off,
        more: view.more + view.files.length - files.length,
      ).toJson(),
    );
  }

  var text = json();
  while (utf8Length(text) > kAiRecordBytes && files.isNotEmpty) {
    files.removeRange(files.length - max(1, files.length ~/ 10), files.length);
    text = json();
  }
  return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(text));
}

/// V2-2b B19: the body of `ai.diff` for [path] — its changed region with 3
/// lines around it, [oldText] null for a file that was not there — each side
/// within [side] bytes, halved while the JSON is over [kAiRecordBytes] (a
/// file of control characters grows six times when escaped).
/// Null when even a sixteenth does not fit: the window answers `too_big`.
Map<String, Object?>? aiFileDiffBody({
  required String path,
  String? oldText,
  required String newText,
  int side = kAiFileDiffSideBytes,
}) {
  for (final scale in const [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]) {
    final region = aiTextDiffRegion(
      path: path,
      oldText: oldText,
      newText: newText,
      side: side ~/ scale,
    );
    if (utf8Length(jsonEncode(region)) <= kAiRecordBytes) return region;
  }
  return null;
}

/// V2-2b B19: the region of an `ai.diff` body as the phone draws it; null for
/// `{"binary": true}`, `{"missing": true}` or a body it cannot read.
MirrorDiff? aiFileDiffOf(Map<String, Object?> body) {
  if (jBool(body, 'binary') || jBool(body, 'missing')) return null;
  final next = jString(body, 'new');
  if (next == null) return null;
  return MirrorDiff(
    path: jString(body, 'path') ?? '',
    oldText: jBool(body, 'created') ? null : jString(body, 'old') ?? '',
    newText: next,
    plus: jInt(body, 'plus') ?? 0,
    minus: jInt(body, 'minus') ?? 0,
    cut: jBool(body, 'cut'),
  );
}

/// What `ai.revert` asks before it puts back files changed after the turn
/// (`confirm`, V2-2b B19, the desktop's B14 question): those files (as many
/// as fit, [more] after them), whether some files did not change after the
/// turn ("Only unchanged files" is then a choice), and how many files the
/// revert would put back in all.
final class AiRevertConfirm with Redacted {
  const AiRevertConfirm({
    this.touched = const [],
    this.more = 0,
    this.someClean = false,
    this.files = 0,
  });

  final List<String> touched;
  final int more;
  final bool someClean;
  final int files;

  /// The files changed after the turn in all.
  int get touchedCount => touched.length + more;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
    'touched': touched,
    if (more > 0) 'more': more,
    'some_clean': someClean,
    'files': files,
  };

  static AiRevertConfirm fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) => AiRevertConfirm(
    touched: jStrings(j, 'touched'),
    more: max(0, jInt(j, 'more') ?? 0),
    someClean: jBool(j, 'some_clean'),
    files: max(0, jInt(j, 'files') ?? 0),
  );
}

/// The body of a `confirm` answer to `ai.revert`: [touched] as long as they
/// fit in half a record (the rest counted), [someClean], and [total] files.
Uint8List encodeRevertConfirm({
  required List<String> touched,
  required bool someClean,
  required int total,
}) {
  final kept = <String>[];
  var size = 0;
  for (final path in touched) {
    final bytes = utf8Length(jsonEncode(path)) + 1;
    if (size + bytes > kAiRecordBytes ~/ 2) break;
    kept.add(path);
    size += bytes;
  }
  return encodeBody(
    AiRevertConfirm(
      touched: kept,
      more: touched.length - kept.length,
      someClean: someClean,
      files: total,
    ).toJson(),
  );
}
```

```dart
  /// V2-2b B19: the changes of [m]'s turn (null: the whole session), as the
  /// window's Changes panel shows them now.
  void _phoneChanges(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiChanges m) => unawaited(
    _ask(
      mobileId,
      phone,
      m.sid,
      m.rid,
      (c) async => _Reply.ok(encodeChangesView(await c.changes(turn: m.turn))),
    ),
  );

  /// V2-2b B19, R18: one file's diff. A path no window could have offered is
  /// refused here, before the window is asked; the window checks that it is
  /// one of the changes now.
  void _phoneDiff(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiDiff m) {
    if (!_isPhoneChangePath(m.path)) {
      _send(mobileId, AiResult(rid: m.rid, ok: false, code: 'refused'), phone);
      return;
    }
    unawaited(
      _ask(
        mobileId,
        phone,
        m.sid,
        m.rid,
        (c) async =>
            _Reply.ok(encodeBody(await c.diff(turn: m.turn, path: m.path))),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: a revert, worked out again by the window now: `busy_turn`
  /// while a turn runs, `undo_off`, `confirm` (with the files changed after
  /// the turn) unless [AiRevert.keep] says what to do with them.
  void _phoneRevert(String mobileId, _Phone phone, AiRevert m) {
    final keep = m.keep;
    if (keep != null && keep != 'clean' && keep != 'all') {
      _send(mobileId, AiResult(rid: m.rid, ok: false, code: 'refused'), phone);
      return;
    }
    unawaited(
      _ask(
        mobileId,
        phone,
        m.sid,
        m.rid,
        (c) async => _Reply.ok(
          encodeBody({'reverted': await c.revert(turn: m.turn, keep: keep)}),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
```

and, after the extension (top level of the part file):

```dart
/// V2-2b R18: a path a phone may name for a changed file — relative to the
/// session folder with `/` separators: not empty, no empty, `.` or `..`
/// segment, no drive, backslash or NUL, at most [kAiMaxPathBytes] of UTF-8.
/// The window checks that it is one of the changes now.
bool _isPhoneChangePath(String path) {
  if (path.isEmpty || utf8Length(path) > kAiMaxPathBytes) return false;
  if (path.startsWith('/') || path.contains('\\') || path.contains('\x00')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z]:').hasMatch(path)) return false;
  return !path.split('/').any((s) => s.isEmpty || s == '.' || s == '..');
}
```

```dart
  Future<AiChangesView> changes(String sid, {int? turn}) async {
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.changes,
      sid,
      (rid) => AiChanges(sid: sid, rid: rid, turn: turn),
    );
    return AiChangesView.fromJson(decodeBody(result.body) ?? const {});
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: the diff of [path] (one of [changes]' files) since [turn]
  /// began: an `ai.diff` body — its region (read it with `aiFileDiffOf`),
  /// or `{"binary": true}` / `{"missing": true}`.
  Future<Map<String, Object?>> diff(
    String sid,
    String path, {
    int? turn,
  }) async {
    // The computer refuses one this long anyway (R18); a longer message is
    // not worth sending.
    if (utf8Length(path) > kAiMaxPathBytes) {
      throw const AiRequestException('refused');
    }
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.changes,
      sid,
      (rid) => AiDiff(sid: sid, rid: rid, turn: turn, path: path),
    );
    return decodeBody(result.body) ?? const {};
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: puts the files changed since [turn] began back (null: since
  /// the session's first turn); how many files went back. Only ever sent by
  /// a tap, once: a lost channel fails it and nothing sends it again (V2-2
  /// D13). When files changed after the turn the computer asks first:
  /// [AiRequestException] `confirm` with an `AiRevertConfirm` as its body —
  /// ask the user, then call again with [keep] `clean` or `all`.
  Future<int> revert(String sid, {int? turn, String? keep}) async {
    final result = await _feature(
      AiFeature.revert,
      sid,
      (rid) => AiRevert(sid: sid, rid: rid, turn: turn, keep: keep),
    );
    return jInt(decodeBody(result.body) ?? const {}, 'reverted') ?? 0;
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
```

```dart
  /// The turn whose restore point a phone's [turn] means: that one, else
  /// the session's first; null when it has none (undo was off).
  int? _restoreTurn(int? turn) {
    final from = turn ?? aiTurnsOf(_runtime.state).first;
    return from == null || _runtime.checkpointOf(from) == null ? null : from;
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: what the Changes panel shows of [turn] (null: the session),
  /// read now — the same reads (`AiChangesPanel._load`).
  @override
  Future<AiChangesView> changes({int? turn}) async {
    final s = _runtime.state;
    final turns = aiTurnsOf(s);
    AiChangesView view([
      List<FileChange> files = const [],
      Set<String> after = const {},
    ]) => AiChangesView(
      scope: turn == null ? 'session' : 'turn',
      turn: turn,
      files: [for (final c in files) AiChangedFile.of(c)],
      after: [
        for (final c in files)
          if (after.contains(c.path)) c.path,
      ],
      first: turns.first,
      last: turns.last,
      done: turns.lastFinished,
      // Why there is nothing to undo, while no turn has a restore point.
      off: turns.last == null ? aiUndoOffOf(s)?.reason.name : null,
    );
    if (_restoreTurn(turn) == null) return view();
    final files = turn == null
        ? await _runtime.sessionChanges()
        : await _runtime.changesSince(turn);
    // git did not answer: said, not an empty list.
    if (files == null) throw const AiRefused('refused');
    final last = turn ?? turns.lastFinished;
    final after = last == null ? null : await _runtime.changedAfterTurn(last);
    return view(files, after ?? const {});
  }

  /// V2-2b B19, R18: one file's diff — a file of the changes as they are
  /// now, so inside the session folder — as the desktop's diff overlay reads
  /// it: before the turn against the disk, 1 MiB at most.
  @override
  Future<Map<String, Object?>> diff({int? turn, required String path}) async {
    final from = _restoreTurn(turn);
    if (from == null) throw const AiRefused('undo_off');
    final files = turn == null
        ? await _runtime.sessionChanges()
        : await _runtime.changesSince(turn);
    if (files == null) throw const AiRefused('refused');
    if (!files.any((c) => c.path == path)) throw const AiRefused('refused');
    final before = aiFileContentOf(await _runtime.fileBefore(from, path));
    final now = await _ref
        .read(aiProjectFilesProvider)
        .read(p.join(_runtime.state.cwd, path));
    if (before is AiFileBinary || now is AiFileBinary) {
      return {'path': path, 'binary': true};
    }
    if (before is AiFileTooLarge || now is AiFileTooLarge) {
      throw const AiRefused('too_big');
    }
    if (before is AiFileMissing && now is AiFileMissing) {
      return {'path': path, 'missing': true};
    }
    final body = aiFileDiffBody(
      path: path,
      oldText: before is AiFileText ? before.text : null,
      newText: now is AiFileText ? now.text : '',
    );
    if (body == null) throw const AiRefused('too_big');
    return body;
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: [AiUndo], as the panel's "Revert turn" — worked out again
  /// now, since what the phone saw may be old (RF4) — with the question of
  /// B14 asked through the phone (`confirm`). The pane says what went back.
  @override
  Future<int> revert({int? turn, String? keep}) async {
    if (_runtime.state.turn != null) throw const AiRefused('busy_turn');
    if (_restoreTurn(turn) == null) throw const AiRefused('undo_off');
    final undo = AiUndo(_runtime);
    final AiUndoPlan plan;
    switch (await undo.plan(turn: turn)) {
      case AiUndoBusy():
        throw const AiRefused('busy_turn');
      case AiUndoFailed():
        throw const AiRefused('refused');
      case AiUndoNothing():
        return 0;
      case final AiUndoPlan planned:
        plan = planned;
    }
    final touched = plan.touched;
    if (touched.isNotEmpty && keep == null) {
      throw AiRefused(
        'confirm',
        body: encodeRevertConfirm(
          touched: touched,
          someClean: plan.someClean,
          total: plan.paths.length,
        ),
      );
    }
    final done = await undo.apply(plan, keepTouched: keep == 'clean');
    if (!done.ok) throw AiRefused(done.busy ? 'busy_turn' : 'refused');
    final reverts = _ref.read(aiPhoneRevertsProvider);
    if (done.count > 0 && !reverts.isClosed) {
      reverts.add((paneId: _paneId, count: done.count));
    }
    return done.count;
  }
```

### Task 25: Phone: Changes sheet, diff page, revert

Spec B20 (the phone's side of B19), V2-2 §13 (buttons that ignore taps for 400 ms), V2-2 D13 (a request lost with its channel is never sent again), R3, R15, R18, Review Focus 4.
- A turn's summary that changed files — "Lượt 3 · 0:41 · 2 tệp đổi +44 −5" — becomes a link (at least 44 points tall) when the computer offers `changes` (R3); it opens the **"Thay đổi"** sheet on that turn. The "⋯" menu (Task 6) has "Thay đổi" for the whole session while the session is live.
- The sheet: "Lượt này" / "Cả phiên" (from the menu, "Lượt này" is the last turn with a restore point, `turns.last` of the first answer); one row per file — A (green) / M (amber) / D (red), its folder dimmed and its name, "+3 −1" or "nhị phân", "đã đổi sau lượt này" in amber —, "Còn N tệp nữa — xem trên máy tính." for files the answer left out; "Không có thay đổi." or why undo is off ("Hoàn tác đang tắt cho dự án này (không tìm thấy git).").
- A row opens the **diff page**, full screen: the changed region the computer read now (before the turn, or before the session, against the disk), removed and added lines in monospace, built only as they scroll into view; "Tệp nhị phân — xem trên máy tính.", "Tệp này không có, cả trước lẫn bây giờ." or the failure (`too_big`: "Quá lớn để xem trên điện thoại. Xem trên máy tính.") instead. The phone only asks for a path the sheet listed (R18; the computer checks again).
- At the sheet's foot, **"Hoàn tác lượt này"** ("Hoàn tác cả phiên" for the session), red; dim while a turn runs on the computer ("Chờ lượt này xong." under it), while a revert is on its way, while the session is not live, and when the computer cannot (`revert`). A tap asks first — "Đưa 2 tệp về như trước lượt 3?" with the files (8 at most, then "Còn N tệp nữa…"), Cancel and the red revert — and only then sends one `ai.revert`. When the computer answers `confirm` (files changed after the turn), the phone asks its question as the desktop's B14 dialog does: "1 tệp đã đổi sau lượt này." with Cancel, "Chỉ tệp chưa đổi sau đó" (only when some files did not change after the turn) and "Hoàn tác hết", then sends `keep: clean|all`. The buttons of both questions ignore taps for 400 ms, so the tap that opened one cannot answer it (Review Focus 4). It ends with "Đã hoàn tác 2 tệp." or the failure's words (`busy_turn` → "Chờ lượt này xong.", `undo_off`, a lost channel → "Có thể chưa gửi được…": never sent again).

Cost if wrong: a destructive action from a small screen — it is always asked first with the files, the questions settle for 400 ms, and each tap sends one request at most.

Keys beyond spec §5 (all in both ARB files): `aiRevertSession`, `aiRevertConfirmSession`, `aiReverted`, `aiChangesEmpty`, `aiChangesMore`, `aiChangedAfter`, `aiBinaryFile`, `aiDiffBinary`, `aiDiffMissing`, `aiDiffVsTurn`, `aiDiffVsSession` (the whole-session wording, the result, the sheet's empty and overflow lines, and the diff page's subtitle and notes).

```dart
  /// V2-2b B19 (Task 25): what [changes] answers, and the (sid, turn) asked; what [diff] answers, and the (sid, path,
  /// turn) asked; the answers of [revert] in turn — a number of files, or an exception to throw — and the (sid, turn,
  /// keep) asked.
  AiChangesView changesValue = const AiChangesView(scope: 'session');
  final List<(String, int?)> changesAsked = [];
  Map<String, Object?> diffValue = const {'missing': true};
  final List<(String, String, int?)> diffsAsked = [];
  final List<Object> revertAnswers = [];
  final List<(String, int?, String?)> reverts = [];

  @override
  Future<AiChangesView> changes(String sid, {int? turn}) async {
    changesAsked.add((sid, turn));
    await _request();
    return changesValue;
  }

  @override
  Future<Map<String, Object?>> diff(String sid, String path, {int? turn}) async {
    diffsAsked.add((sid, path, turn));
    await _request();
    return diffValue;
  }

  @override
  Future<int> revert(String sid, {int? turn, String? keep}) async {
    reverts.add((sid, turn, keep));
    await _request();
    final answer = revertAnswers.isEmpty ? 0 : revertAnswers.removeAt(0);
    if (answer is Exception) throw answer;
    return answer as int;
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shellx_acp/shellx_acp.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_ai/shellx_ai.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart' hide test;
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_drafts.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_revert_outcome.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/terminal/presentation/controllers/terminal_workspace.dart';

import '../../support/app_harness.dart';
import '../../support/fake_links.dart';
import '../../support/fake_popup_handler.dart';
import '../../support/fakes.dart';

const sid = 'e.-1';

/// Turn 1 changed `src/a.ts` and added `b.txt`.
const _turnOne = AiChangesView(
  scope: 'turn',
  turn: 1,
  files: [
    AiChangedFile(path: 'src/a.ts', kind: 'm', plus: 3, minus: 1),
    AiChangedFile(path: 'b.txt', kind: 'a', plus: 2, minus: 0),
  ],
  first: 1,
  last: 1,
  done: 1,
);

/// V2-2b B20: the Changes sheet, a file's diff page and the revert, on the phone.
void main() {
  late FakeBackend backend;
  late FakeMachineSession machine;
  late FakeSessionHolder session;
  late FakePopupHandler popups;

  setUp(() {
    backend = FakeBackend(pinnedList: [pinned(agentA)]);
    machine = backend.addMachine(agentA);
    session = FakeSessionHolder(backend);
    popups = FakePopupHandler();
    final drafts = AiDrafts();
    final registry = WorkspaceRegistry(session.backend);
    getIt
      ..registerSingleton<PopupHandler>(popups)
      ..registerSingleton<SessionHolder>(session)
      ..registerSingleton<ExternalLinks>(FakeExternalLinks())
      ..registerFactoryParam<AiSessionController, String, String>(
        (agentId, sid) => AiSessionController(agentId, sid, session, drafts, registry),
      );
    // The computer can show and revert changes (V2-2b B1).
    machine.ai
      ..protocolValue = 2
      ..emitListing(const AiListing(features: {AiFeature.changes, AiFeature.revert}))
      ..changesValue = _turnOne;
  });

  tearDown(() async => getIt.reset());

  /// The session page of [sid], whose first turn changed two files (and which runs a second turn when [running]).
  Future<FakeAiSession> open(WidgetTester tester, {bool running = false}) async {
    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1170, 2532);
    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3;
    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
    final ai = machine.ai.session(sid);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    ai.desktop
      ..beginTurn(const [TextBlock('go')], now)
      ..endTurn(
        outcome: TurnOutcome.finished,
        at: now,
        changes: const [
          FileChange(path: 'src/a.ts', kind: ChangeKind.modified, added: 3, removed: 1),
          FileChange(path: 'b.txt', kind: ChangeKind.added, added: 2, removed: 0),
        ],
      );
    if (running) ai.desktop.beginTurn(const [TextBlock('more')], now);
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      routedApp(
        open: () => AiSessionRoute(agentId: agentA, machineName: 'MacBook', sid: sid),
        routes: [
          AutoRoute(page: AiSessionRoute.page),
          AutoRoute(page: AiFileDiffRoute.page),
        ],
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
    ai.sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    return ai;
  }

  /// Taps the turn's summary: the sheet of turn 1.
  Future<void> openTurnOne(WidgetTester tester) async {
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.turnEnd.1')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  }

  /// Taps [key] once the question's buttons have settled (400 ms).
  Future<void> answer(WidgetTester tester, Key key) async {
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(key));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  }

  testWidgets('the summary of a turn opens its changes; a file opens its diff', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    expect(find.textContaining('2 tệp đổi +5 −1'), findsOneWidget);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    expect(machine.ai.changesAsked, [(sid, 1)]);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.sheet')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.change.src/a.ts')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('+3 −1'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('A'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Hoàn tác lượt này'), findsOneWidget);

    machine.ai.diffValue = const {'path': 'src/a.ts', 'old': 'a\nb', 'new': 'a\nc', 'plus': 1, 'minus': 1};
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.change.src/a.ts')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(machine.ai.diffsAsked, [(sid, 'src/a.ts', 1)]);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.fileDiff')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('- b'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('+ c'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.textContaining('So với đầu lượt 1'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.fileDiff.back')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.sheet')), findsOneWidget, reason: 'back on the sheet');
  });

  testWidgets('a binary file and a file there neither before nor now say so', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    machine.ai.diffValue = const {'path': 'b.txt', 'binary': true};
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.change.b.txt')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Tệp nhị phân — xem trên máy tính.'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.fileDiff.back')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    machine.ai.diffValue = const {'path': 'b.txt', 'missing': true};
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.change.b.txt')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Tệp này không có, cả trước lẫn bây giờ.'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('the menu opens the whole session; "Lượt này" is the last turn', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu.changes')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(machine.ai.changesAsked, [(sid, null)]);
    expect(find.text('Hoàn tác cả phiên'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.turn')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(machine.ai.changesAsked, [(sid, null), (sid, 1)]);
    expect(find.text('Hoàn tác lượt này'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('a revert asks first with the files; a tap in its first 400 ms '
      'does nothing (Review Focus 4)', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    machine.ai.revertAnswers.add(2);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(find.text('Đưa 2 tệp về như trước lượt 1?'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(
      find.descendant(of: find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.dialog')), matching: find.text('src/a.ts')),
      findsOneWidget,
    );
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.confirm')));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, isEmpty, reason: 'the tap that opened it must not answer it');
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.confirm'));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, [(sid, 1, null)]);
    expect(popups.successes, ['Đã hoàn tác 2 tệp.']);
  });

  testWidgets('files changed after the turn: the computer asks, the phone '
      'offers only-unchanged or all (Review Focus 4)', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    machine.ai.revertAnswers.addAll([
      const AiRequestException(
        'confirm',
        body: {
          'touched': ['b.txt'],
          'some_clean': true,
          'files': 2,
        },
      ),
      1,
    ]);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.confirm'));
    expect(find.text('1 tệp đã đổi sau lượt này.'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.clean')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.all')), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.clean')));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, hasLength(1), reason: 'its buttons wait too');
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.clean'));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, [(sid, 1, null), (sid, 1, 'clean')]);
    expect(popups.successes, ['Đã hoàn tác 1 tệp.']);
  });

  testWidgets('cancel sends nothing; "only unchanged" is not offered when every '
      'file changed', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.cancel'));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, isEmpty);
    machine.ai.revertAnswers.add(
      const AiRequestException(
        'confirm',
        body: {
          'touched': ['src/a.ts', 'b.txt'],
          'some_clean': false,
          'files': 2,
        },
      ),
    );
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.confirm'));
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.revert.clean')), findsNothing);
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.cancel'));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, [(sid, 1, null)]);
  });

  testWidgets('while a turn runs the revert is dim and says to wait; busy_turn '
      'from the computer says the same (Review Focus 4)', (tester) async {
    await open(tester, running: true);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    expect(tester.widget<FilledButton>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert'))).onPressed, isNull);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.busy')), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Chờ lượt này xong.'), findsOneWidget);

    // The turn ends; the computer still has one running when the revert lands.
    final ai = machine.ai.session(sid);
    ai.desktop.endTurn(outcome: TurnOutcome.finished, at: DateTime.now());
    ai.sync();
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    machine.ai.revertAnswers.add(const AiRequestException('busy_turn'));
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.confirm'));
    expect(popups.errors, ['Chờ lượt này xong.']);
  });

  testWidgets('a revert lost with the channel may not have gone, and is never '
      'sent again', (tester) async {
    await open(tester);
    await openTurnOne(tester);
    machine.ai.connectFailure = MachineConnectionFailure.agentOffline;
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert')));
    await tester.pump();
    await answer(tester, const Key('ai.revert.confirm'));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, hasLength(1));
    expect(popups.errors.single, startsWith('Có thể chưa gửi được'));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
    expect(machine.ai.reverts, hasLength(1));
  });

  testWidgets('undo off: the sheet says why and offers no revert', (tester) async {
    machine.ai.changesValue = const AiChangesView(scope: 'session', off: 'noGit');
    await open(tester);
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu.changes')));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Hoàn tác đang tắt cho dự án này (không tìm thấy git).'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(tester.widget<FilledButton>(find.byKey(const Key('ai.changes.revert'))).onPressed, isNull);
  });

  testWidgets('a computer that cannot: no menu entry, the summary is no button', (tester) async {
    machine.ai.emitListing(const AiListing());
    await open(tester);
    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('ai.turnEnd.1')), findsNothing);
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('ai.menu')), findsNothing);
    expect(machine.ai.changesAsked, isEmpty);
  });

  test('nothing of an outcome is printed', () {
    expect(const AiRevertDone(2).toString(), 'AiRevertDone(…)');
    expect(const AiRevertFailed('busy_turn').toString(), 'AiRevertFailed(…)');
    expect(const AiRevertAsk(AiRevertConfirm(touched: ['secret.ts'])).toString(), 'AiRevertAsk(…)');
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart' show AiRevertConfirm;

/// V2-2b B20: how a revert the user asked for on the phone ended. Nothing of it is printed.
sealed class AiRevertOutcome {
  const AiRevertOutcome();
}

/// [count] files went back.
final class AiRevertDone extends AiRevertOutcome {
  const AiRevertDone(this.count);

  final int count;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AiRevertDone(…)';
}

/// The computer asks first: some files changed after the turn ([question], the desktop's B14 question).
final class AiRevertAsk extends AiRevertOutcome {
  const AiRevertAsk(this.question);

  final AiRevertConfirm question;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AiRevertAsk(…)';
}

/// Nothing went back, for [code] (`AiWords.failure` words it).
final class AiRevertFailed extends AiRevertOutcome {
  const AiRevertFailed(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AiRevertFailed(…)';
}
```

In `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart`:
- add `import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_revert_outcome.dart';` after the `ai_drafts.dart` import;
- add the field after `final Signal<DateTime> _now = signal(DateTime.now());`:


- add after `void loadEarlier() => _link?.loadEarlier();`:

```dart

  /// V2-2b B20: a revert is on its way; its button waits.
  ReadonlySignal<bool> get reverting => _reverting;

  /// V2-2b B19: the files changed since [turn] began (null: since the session's first turn), or the code of what went
  /// wrong ([AiWords.failure]).
  Future<({AiChangesView? view, String? code})> loadChanges({int? turn}) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return (view: null, code: 'refused');
    try {
      return (view: await machine.ai.changes(sid, turn: turn), code: null);
    } catch (error) {
      return (view: null, code: _failure(error));
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B19: the diff of [path] since [turn] began (null: since the session's first turn), as an `ai.diff` body,
  /// or the code of what went wrong.
  Future<({Map<String, Object?>? diff, String? code})> loadDiff(String path, {int? turn}) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return (diff: null, code: 'refused');
    try {
      return (diff: await machine.ai.diff(sid, path, turn: turn), code: null);
    } catch (error) {
      return (diff: null, code: _failure(error));
    }
  }

  /// V2-2b B19, B20: one revert the user asked for — after the phone's own question — of [turn] (null: the whole
  /// session); [keep] (`clean` or `all`) answers the computer's question about files changed after the turn. One
  /// request: a lost channel is [AiWords.outcomeUnknown], and nothing sends it again (V2-2 D13).
  Future<AiRevertOutcome> revert({int? turn, String? keep}) async {
    final machine = _machine;
    if (machine == null) return const AiRevertFailed('refused');
    if (_reverting.peek()) return const AiRevertFailed(AiWords.inFlight);
    _set(_reverting, true);
    try {
      return AiRevertDone(await machine.ai.revert(sid, turn: turn, keep: keep));
    } on AiRequestException catch (error) {
      if (error.code == 'confirm') return AiRevertAsk(AiRevertConfirm.fromJson(error.body ?? const {}));
      return AiRevertFailed(error.code);
    } catch (error) {
      return AiRevertFailed(_failure(error));
    } finally {
      _set(_reverting, false);
    }
  }
```
