Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/widgets/ai_changes_sheet.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_client/shellx_client.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_revert_outcome.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// How long the buttons of a revert question ignore taps after it appears (V2-2 §13, B20): the tap that opened it
/// must not answer it too.
const Duration _kSettle = Duration(milliseconds: 400);

/// The most files a revert question lists; "and N more" says the rest.
const int _kListed = 8;

/// V2-2b B20: "Thay đổi" — the files a turn changed ([turn]; null: the whole session, "Cả phiên"), each one opening
/// its diff ([onOpenFile]), and the revert at the foot: red, dim while a turn runs, and asked first, with the files
/// (B19). From a turn's summary it opens on that turn; from the menu on the whole session, and "Lượt này" is then the
/// last turn with a restore point.
Future<void> showAiChangesSheet(
  BuildContext context,
  AiSessionController controller, {
  int? turn,
  required void Function(String path, int? turn) onOpenFile,
}) => showModalBottomSheet<void>(
  context: context,
  showDragHandle: true,
  isScrollControlled: true,
  backgroundColor: context.colors.surface,
  shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
  builder: (context) => AiChangesSheet(controller: controller, turn: turn, onOpenFile: onOpenFile),
);

class AiChangesSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiChangesSheet({super.key, required this.controller, required this.onOpenFile, this.turn});

  final AiSessionController controller;
  final int? turn;
  final void Function(String path, int? turn) onOpenFile;

  @override
  State<AiChangesSheet> createState() => _AiChangesSheetState();
}

class _AiChangesSheetState extends State<AiChangesSheet> {
  /// The turn of "Lượt này": the one asked for, else the last with a restore point (the first answer says it).
  late int? _turn = widget.turn;

  /// "Lượt này" (true) or "Cả phiên" (false).
  late bool _thisTurn = widget.turn != null;
  AiChangesView? _view;
  String? _error;
  var _loading = true;
  var _asked = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_load());
  }

  /// Reads the changes of the scope shown; a newer read wins over an older one still on its way.
  Future<void> _load() async {
    final asked = ++_asked;
    if (mounted && !_loading) setState(() => _loading = true);
    final result = await widget.controller.loadChanges(turn: _thisTurn ? _turn : null);
    if (!mounted || asked != _asked) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = false;
      _view = result.view;
      _error = result.code == null ? null : AiWords.failure(S.of(context), result.code!) ?? S.of(context).aiRefused;
      _turn ??= result.view?.last;
    });
  }

  void _scope(bool thisTurn) {
    if (thisTurn == _thisTurn) return;
    setState(() => _thisTurn = thisTurn);
    unawaited(_load());
  }

  /// One revert, asked first on the phone with the files; when the computer asks too (files changed after the turn),
  /// its question with the desktop's choices (B14). Never sent again by itself.
  Future<void> _revert(int? turn, List<String> paths, int more) async {
    final controller = widget.controller;
    final s = S.of(context);
    final sure = await showAiRevertConfirm(context, paths: paths, more: more, turn: turn);
    if (!sure || !mounted) return;
    var outcome = await controller.revert(turn: turn);
    if (outcome case AiRevertAsk(:final question)) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final keep = await showAiRevertTouched(context, question);
      if (keep == null || !mounted) return;
      outcome = await controller.revert(turn: turn, keep: keep);
    }
    switch (outcome) {
      case AiRevertDone(:final count):
        controller.popupHandler.showSuccess(title: s.aiReverted(count));
      case AiRevertFailed(:final code):
        final text = AiWords.failure(s, code);
        if (text != null) controller.popupHandler.showError(title: text);
      case AiRevertAsk():
        // Asked again although the phone said what to keep: nothing went back.
        controller.popupHandler.showError(title: s.aiRequestFailed('confirm'));
    }
    if (mounted) unawaited(_load());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    return SafeArea(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 16),
        child: Column(
          key: const Key('ai.changes.sheet'),
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(s.aiChanges, style: context.typo.heading20.heavy),
            12.sizedHeight,
            SegmentedButton<bool>(
              showSelectedIcon: false,
              segments: [
                ButtonSegment(
                  value: true,
                  enabled: _turn != null,
                  label: Text(s.aiThisTurn, key: const Key('ai.changes.turn')),
                ),
                ButtonSegment(
                  value: false,
                  label: Text(s.aiWholeSession, key: const Key('ai.changes.session')),
                ),
              ],
              selected: {_thisTurn},
              onSelectionChanged: (choice) => _scope(choice.single),
            ),
            12.sizedHeight,
            ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.5),
              child: _body(context),
            ),
            12.sizedHeight,
            Watch(_foot),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _body(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final dim = context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText);
    final view = _view;
    if (_loading) {
      return const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }
    if (view == null) {
      return Text(_error ?? s.aiRefused, key: const Key('ai.changes.error'), style: dim);
    }
    if (view.files.isEmpty) {
      final why = AiWords.undoReason(s, view.off);
      return Text(
        view.off == null
            ? s.aiChangesEmpty
            : why == null
            ? s.aiNoticeUndoOff
            : s.aiNoticeUndoOffReason(why),
        key: Key(view.off == null ? 'ai.changes.empty' : 'ai.changes.off'),
        style: dim,
      );
    }
    final after = view.after.toSet();
    return ListView(
      shrinkWrap: true,
      children: [
        for (final f in view.files)
          _FileRow(
            key: ValueKey('ai.change.${f.path}'),
            file: f,
            after: after.contains(f.path),
            onTap: () => widget.onOpenFile(f.path, _thisTurn ? _turn : null),
          ),
        if (view.more > 0)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
            child: Text(s.aiChangesMore(view.more), key: const Key('ai.changes.more'), style: dim),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// The revert: red, for the scope shown; dim and waiting while a turn runs on the computer (B20), or while one is
  /// on its way.
  Widget _foot(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = widget.controller;
    controller.version.value; // a turn that starts or ends
    final reverting = controller.reverting.value;
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final view = _view;
    final turn = _thisTurn ? _turn : null;
    final running = controller.head?.running ?? false;
    final files = view?.files ?? const <AiChangedFile>[];
    final enabled =
        controller.can(AiFeature.revert) &&
        controller.linkState == AiLinkState.live &&
        !_loading &&
        files.isNotEmpty &&
        !running &&
        !reverting;
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        FilledButton(
          key: const Key('ai.changes.revert'),
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: colors.error, foregroundColor: colors.white),
          onPressed: enabled ? () => unawaited(_revert(turn, [for (final f in files) f.path], view?.more ?? 0)) : null,
          child: Text(turn == null ? s.aiRevertSession : s.aiRevertTurn),
        ),
        if (running) ...[
          6.sizedHeight,
          Text(
            s.aiRevertBusy,
            key: const Key('ai.changes.busy'),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.warn),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// One changed file: A/M/D, its folder dimmed and its name, "+3 −1" (or "nhị phân"), and whether it changed again
/// after the turn.
class _FileRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FileRow({super.key, required this.file, required this.after, required this.onTap});

  final AiChangedFile file;
  final bool after;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final f = file;
    final (letter, color) = switch (f.kind) {
      'a' => ('A', colors.ok),
      'd' => ('D', colors.error),
      _ => ('M', colors.warn),
    };
    final slash = f.path.lastIndexOf('/');
    final dir = slash < 0 ? '' : f.path.substring(0, slash + 1);
    final name = f.path.substring(slash + 1);
    final small = context.typo.paragraph13;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 44),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: 18,
              child: Text(letter, style: small.bold.copyWith(color: color)),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text.rich(
                    TextSpan(
                      children: [
                        TextSpan(
                          text: dir,
                          style: small.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
                        ),
                        TextSpan(
                          text: name,
                          style: small.copyWith(color: colors.primaryText),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  if (after) Text(s.aiChangedAfter, style: context.typo.metadata12.copyWith(color: colors.warn)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            8.sizedWidth,
            Text(
              f.binary ? s.aiBinaryFile : '+${f.plus} −${f.minus}',
              style: context.typo.metadata12.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// V2-2b B20: "Revert 2 files to before turn 3?" with the files, Cancel and the red revert. Its buttons wait 400 ms
/// before they answer. True: revert.
Future<bool> showAiRevertConfirm(
  BuildContext context, {
  required List<String> paths,
  int more = 0,
  int? turn,
}) async {
  final s = S.of(context);
  final count = paths.length + more;
  final chosen = await showDialog<String>(
    context: context,
    builder: (context) => _SettledQuestion(
      key: const Key('ai.revert.dialog'),
      title: turn == null ? s.aiRevertConfirmSession(count) : s.aiRevertConfirm(count, turn),
      paths: paths,
      more: more,
      actions: [
        (key: const Key('ai.revert.cancel'), label: s.actionCancel, value: null, red: false, outlined: false),
        (
          key: const Key('ai.revert.confirm'),
          label: turn == null ? s.aiRevertSession : s.aiRevertTurn,
          value: 'yes',
          red: true,
          outlined: false,
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  return chosen == 'yes';
}

/// V2-2b B19, B20: the computer's question when files changed after the turn (the desktop's B14): Cancel, "Chỉ tệp
/// chưa đổi sau đó" (when some did not change) and "Hoàn tác hết". The keep word to send, or null for Cancel.
Future<String?> showAiRevertTouched(BuildContext context, AiRevertConfirm question) {
  final s = S.of(context);
  return showDialog<String>(
    context: context,
    builder: (context) => _SettledQuestion(
      key: const Key('ai.revert.touched'),
      title: s.aiRevertTouched(question.touchedCount),
      paths: question.touched,
      more: question.more,
      actions: [
        (key: const Key('ai.revert.cancel'), label: s.actionCancel, value: null, red: false, outlined: false),
        if (question.someClean)
          (key: const Key('ai.revert.clean'), label: s.aiRevertOnlyClean, value: 'clean', red: false, outlined: true),
        (key: const Key('ai.revert.all'), label: s.aiRevertAll, value: 'all', red: true, outlined: false),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

typedef _Action = ({Key key, String label, String? value, bool red, bool outlined});

/// A question about files whose buttons ignore taps for [_kSettle] after it appears.
class _SettledQuestion extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SettledQuestion({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.paths,
    required this.more,
    required this.actions,
  });

  final String title;
  final List<String> paths;
  final int more;
  final List<_Action> actions;

  @override
  State<_SettledQuestion> createState() => _SettledQuestionState();
}

class _SettledQuestionState extends State<_SettledQuestion> {
  Timer? _settle;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _settle = Timer(_kSettle, () {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _settle = null);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _settle?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final settled = _settle == null;
    final mono = context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono, color: colors.primaryText);
    final rest = widget.more + (widget.paths.length > _kListed ? widget.paths.length - _kListed : 0);
    return AlertDialog(
      title: Text(widget.title, style: context.typo.subHeader.bold),
      content: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            for (final path in widget.paths.take(_kListed)) Text(path, style: mono),
            if (rest > 0) ...[
              4.sizedHeight,
              Text(s.aiChangesMore(rest), style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText)),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        for (final a in widget.actions)
          if (a.outlined)
            OutlinedButton(
              key: a.key,
              onPressed: settled ? () => Navigator.of(context).pop(a.value) : null,
              child: Text(a.label),
            )
          else if (a.red)
            FilledButton(
              key: a.key,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: colors.error, foregroundColor: colors.white),
              onPressed: settled ? () => Navigator.of(context).pop(a.value) : null,
              child: Text(a.label),
            )
          else
            TextButton(
              key: a.key,
              onPressed: settled ? () => Navigator.of(context).pop(a.value) : null,
              child: Text(a.label),
            ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

Create `apps/mobile/lib/features/ai/presentation/pages/ai_file_diff_page.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:shellx_ai/remote.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/core/core.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_text.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/domain/ai_words.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/features/ai/presentation/controllers/ai_session_controller.dart';
import 'package:shellx_mobile/shared/shared.dart';

/// V2-2b B20: one changed file's diff, full screen — its changed region as the computer read it now (before [turn],
/// or before the session when [turn] is null, against the disk), up to 20 KiB a side: removed and added lines in
/// monospace, one widget per visible line. A binary file, a file there neither before nor now, or one too large say
/// so instead.
@RoutePage()
class AiFileDiffPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AiFileDiffPage({super.key, required this.controller, required this.path, this.turn});

  /// The session page's controller (its page is under this one).
  final AiSessionController controller;

  /// Relative to the session folder, as the Changes sheet listed it.
  final String path;
  final int? turn;

  @override
  State<AiFileDiffPage> createState() => _AiFileDiffPageState();
}

class _AiFileDiffPageState extends State<AiFileDiffPage> {
  var _loaded = false;
  String? _note;
  MirrorDiff? _diff;
  List<DiffLine> _lines = const [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_load());
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final result = await widget.controller.loadDiff(widget.path, turn: widget.turn);
    if (!mounted) return;
    final s = S.of(context);
    final body = result.diff;
    final diff = body == null ? null : aiFileDiffOf(body);
    setState(() {
      _loaded = true;
      _diff = diff;
      _lines = diff == null ? const [] : diffLines(diff.oldText, diff.newText);
      _note = switch (result.code) {
        final code? => AiWords.failure(s, code) ?? s.aiRefused,
        null when diff != null => null,
        null when jBool(body ?? const {}, 'binary') => s.aiDiffBinary,
        null => s.aiDiffMissing,
      };
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final turn = widget.turn;
    final diff = _diff;
    final note = _note;
    return Scaffold(
      key: const Key('ai.fileDiff'),
      backgroundColor: colors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 4, 12, 6),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    key: const Key('ai.fileDiff.back'),
                    tooltip: MaterialLocalizations.of(context).backButtonTooltip,
                    icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new, color: colors.primary),
                    onPressed: () => context.router.maybePop(),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          AiWords.fileName(widget.path),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: context.typo.subHeader.bold.copyWith(color: colors.primaryText),
                        ),
                        2.sizedHeight,
                        Text(
                          [
                            turn == null ? s.aiDiffVsSession : s.aiDiffVsTurn(turn),
                            if (diff != null) '+${diff.plus} −${diff.minus}',
                            if (diff != null && diff.oldText == null) s.aiCreated,
                          ].join(' · '),
                          style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: !_loaded
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : note != null
                  ? Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Text(
                        note,
                        key: const Key('ai.fileDiff.note'),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: context.typo.paragraph.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
                      ),
                    )
                  : _Lines(lines: _lines, cut: diff?.cut ?? false),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// The lines of a diff region, built only as they scroll into view; a line too long for the screen wraps.
class _Lines extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Lines({required this.lines, required this.cut});

  final List<DiffLine> lines;
  final bool cut;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = context.colors;
    const mono = TextStyle(fontFamily: FontFamily.jetBrainsMono, fontSize: 12, height: 1.35);
    return ListView.builder(
      key: const Key('ai.fileDiff.lines'),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
      itemCount: lines.length + (cut ? 1 : 0),
      itemBuilder: (context, i) {
        if (i == lines.length) {
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Text(
              S.of(context).aiFromComputerOnly,
              style: context.typo.paragraph13.copyWith(color: colors.secondaryText),
            ),
          );
        }
        final line = lines[i];
        return Container(
          color: switch (line.mark) {
            '+' => colors.okDot.withValues(alpha: 0.16),
            '-' => colors.error.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
            _ => null,
          },
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 1),
          child: Text(
            '${line.mark} ${line.text}',
            style: mono.copyWith(color: line.mark == ' ' ? colors.secondaryText : colors.primaryText),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

```dart
class _TurnEnd extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TurnEnd(this.item);
  final MirrorTurnEnd item;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final s = S.of(context);
    final colors = context.colors;
    final time = AiWords.clock(item.elapsed);
    final head = switch (item.outcome) {
      'cancelled' => s.aiTurnStopped(item.turn, time),
      'interrupted' => s.aiTurnInterrupted(item.turn),
      'failed' => s.aiTurnFailed(item.turn),
      _ => s.aiTurnSummary(item.turn, time),
    };
    final files = item.files;
    final changed = files != null && files > 0;
    final parts = [
      head,
      if (changed) '${s.aiTurnFiles(files)} +${item.plus} −${item.minus}',
    ];
    // V2-2b B20: a turn that changed files opens them ("Thay đổi"), when the computer offers it.
    final onChanges = changed ? AiItemActions.maybeOf(context)?.onChanges : null;
    // The summary can be long on a narrow phone ("Đã dừng lượt 12 · 1:02:03 · 120 tệp đổi +1234 −567"): it wraps
    // within most of the width and the lines at its sides take what is left.
    Widget summary = LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) => Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: Divider(color: colors.divider)),
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: box.maxWidth * 0.8),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
              child: Text(
                parts.join(' · '),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: context.typo.metadata12.copyWith(color: onChanges == null ? colors.secondaryText : colors.link),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(child: Divider(color: colors.divider)),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (onChanges != null) {
      summary = InkWell(
        key: ValueKey('ai.turnEnd.${item.turn}'),
        onTap: () => onChanges(item.turn),
        // At least 44 points under the finger.
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 44),
          child: Center(child: summary),
        ),
      );
    }
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Column(children: [summary, if (item.error != null) _Hint(item.error!)]),
    );
  }
}

   - A photo you pick from your library or take in an AI session is scaled down on the phone and sent to your computer through that channel. The computer keeps it in memory only until it goes to the agent (an image not used is dropped after 2 minutes); ShellX does not store it.

It also carries the session's id, the request's number, two option ids ("allow once" and "reject once") and a tag that lets the phone show the notification with buttons. Tapping "Allow" or "Deny" opens the app; the answer is sent only after you unlock the app, through the end-to-end encrypted channel.
